jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: AI Engineer Mid\-Level \| Dallas, TX (Hybrid) \| Full\-Time WHO WE ARE Computer Visionaries (CV.AI) is a Dallas\-based AI software development firm that helps businesses achieve AI sovereignty and get off the SaaS treadmill. We don't believe in renting someone else's roadmap. We believe in building solutions purpose\-built for each client's business, powered by the latest in agentic AI and intelligent automation. We work across industries, including manufacturing, construction, investment management, and hospitality, helping organizations use agentic technology to transform how they operate. Our engagements range from replacing bloated SaaS stacks with custom AI\-driven workflows to building multi\-agent systems that automate entire business processes. At CV.AI, we see agentic development and vibe coding as personal multipliers. Agents represent a fundamental shift in how software gets built and delivered. Our team members respond, “I'll get my agent on that,” for everything from architecture design to task updates. If that mindset resonates with you, keep reading. POSITION DETAILS Job Title: AI Engineer Level: Mid\-Level Employment Type: W2, Full\-Time Location: Hybrid — Dallas, TX (Galleria / Addison area) Reports To: VP, AI Engineering Compensation: Competitive, commensurate with experience ROLE OVERVIEW We're looking for a mid\-level AI Engineer who uses AI agents as a personal force multiplier to architect, test, document, and ship production\-grade solutions for our clients. You'll work on client engagements across industries, translating business requirements into agentic workflows, deploying intelligent systems, and ensuring every deliverable meets enterprise standards for security, scalability, and repeatability. You'll also regularly interact with clients, explaining technical deliverables clearly and confidently. You'll work alongside senior engineers and engagement leads in small, fast\-moving teams where every team member has an outsized impact. To meet our clients' requirements, this role is open only to U.S. citizens and permanent residents. An offer of employment may be contingent on a background check. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES * Design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions, from single\-agent workflows to multi\-agent orchestration, with agents serving as core functionality, user interfaces, or both. * Use spec\-driven and test\-driven development practices with AI agents to produce reliable, secure, tested, and well\-documented code. * Identify and bring new applications of AI to our clients' businesses. * Evaluate agent\-produced code for quality, security, and alignment with client requirements. * Build and integrate client\-facing applications that embed AI capabilities where users work, replacing manual processes and legacy SaaS tools. * Contribute to agentic knowledge systems, including RAG pipelines, agent memory architectures, and shared human\-agent wikis. * Document architectures, decision criteria, integration patterns, and deployment configurations to support knowledge transfer. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS * 2–5 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record of production deployments. * Experience using AI agents, coding assistants, or agentic frameworks to deploy production\-grade code at a company or for a client. * Experience with spec\-driven and test\-driven development workflows. * Ability to critically evaluate agent\-produced code and identify hallucinations, security gaps, and quality issues before deployment. * A strong focus on security, scalability, repeatability, and well\-documented deliverables. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Comfort presenting technical deliverables and progress directly to clients. * Familiarity with modern web frameworks, RESTful APIs, and CI/CD workflows. * Ability to work a hybrid schedule from our Dallas offices in the Galleria / Addison area. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Experience building or implementing agentic knowledge systems, including RAG pipelines, agent memory systems, or wikis designed for shared human\-agent use. * Hands\-on experience integrating computer vision technologies into production systems. * Familiarity with LLM APIs, including Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, or equivalent, and prompt engineering patterns. * Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI, and integration protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Prior experience in consulting, managed services, or client\-embedded delivery. * Experience working in regulated environments or with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, or HIPAA. * Proficiency in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or both. THE MINDSET WE'RE LOOKING FOR We're hiring for technical skills and a way of thinking. The right candidate sees AI agents as teammates. When a problem lands on your desk, your instinct is to consider which agent can help tackle it, whether that means writing tests, researching an API, scaffolding a service, or reviewing a pull request. You're curious, you ship, and you hold yourself to a high standard of quality even when agents are doing the heavy lifting. WHY CV.AI * Build production systems for real clients at the cutting edge of agentic AI. * Join small, high\-impact teams where your contributions are visible and valued from day one. * Work a hybrid schedule from our offices near the shops and restaurants of the Galleria and Addison. Some of our coolest work happens in the real world. * Work with a leadership team that uses agents daily and practices what it preaches. Yes, an agent helped write this posting, and a human edited it. * Gain exposure to a diverse range of industries and technical challenges. No two engagements are the same. * Earn competitive W2 compensation with a firm that invests in long\-term relationships with its engineers. Computer Visionaries (CV.AI) www.cvaius.com (http://www.cvaius.com) Dallas, TX

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: If you thrive in fast paced environments, enjoy hands\-on problem solving, and want to make a measurable impact while working with modern automation and control systems, this role offers the challenge, autonomy, and growth opportunities to take your engineering career to the next level. In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print ‑and apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities. What You’ll Do * Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety. * Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package. * Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on\-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed. * Inspect systems to ensure the operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieve operational conditions prescribed by the client. * Oversee scope of development, work request initiation, scheduling, and inspection of work performed by outside contractors, which includes proprietary work, licensed installations, upgrades, and maintenance and inspection of specialized systems. * Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation. * Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS\-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems. * Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies. * Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts. * Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents. * Perform controls systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability. * Clearly communicate technical issues, project timelines, and product impacts with site leadership, operations and maintenance teams. * Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members. * Perform other job\-related duties as needed or assigned. What You’ll Need * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. * Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2\-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered. * Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming. * 2\+ years of experience working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA\-based monitoring and control systems. * Ability to be available and work in a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays. * Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight. * Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more. * Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems. Preferred Qualifications * 2\+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming. * Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems. * Experience with robotic maintenance. * In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. jobs.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Position** As Cloud DevOps Engineer, You will build and maintain the pipelines, infrastructure, and observability that move software from commit to production safely. The work sits across two disciplines: designing cloud infrastructure as code, and engineering the CI/CD systems that deploy it. This is a hands\-on engineering role reporting to IT leadership, with ownership of deployment reliability, environment consistency, and the tooling application teams depend on daily. **Responsibilities** Infrastructure and Platform * Design, provision, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS or Azure using infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform preferred; jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description: Description: IDX is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our software engineering organization and help evolve how we build, deliver, and operate secure digital products. This is a technical leadership role rather than a day\-to\-day coding position. The Director will be accountable for software architecture, engineering management, quality engineering, and test automation, while partnering closely with Product Management, Cloud Operations, Security, Compliance, IT, and other internal stakeholders. The role is well suited to an experienced engineering leader or a strong Senior Engineering Manager ready to step into broader organizational and technical responsibility. **This role reports to the Chief Technology Officer and will be a hybrid role with time spent in the IDX office in Beaverton, OR.** **Role and Responsibilities*** Provide day\-to\-day leadership for the engineering organization, establishing clear priorities, ownership, and operating rhythms. * Coach and develop engineers through regular feedback, performance reviews, and career development. * Own software architecture and guide technical decisions across web and mobile applications, APIs, external integrations, microservices, and event\-driven systems. * Partner with Product Management on delivery planning, roadmap execution, and transparent resolution of scope, schedule, quality, and technical tradeoffs. * Be accountable for quality engineering and test automation, including the evolution of practical, risk\-based testing strategies. * Partner with Cloud Operations teams on cloud architecture, platform reliability, observability, DevOps, and CI/CD capabilities in AWS and Azure DevOps. * Partner with Security, Compliance, and IT to embed security, privacy, resilience, and compliance considerations throughout the software development lifecycle. * Help lead and strengthen the engineering practices that prevent incident occurrence and improve service reliability. * Advance the responsible use of AI and automation in daily engineering work, helping the team build confidence, establish sound practices, and identify appropriate AI\-enabled product opportunities. * Improve delivery predictability, developer productivity, technical\-debt management, and roadmap outcomes through meaningful metrics and continuous improvement. * Collaborate with third\-party vendors and engineering partners to maintain clear technical expectations and effective delivery relationships. * Promote a culture of high standards, pragmatic problem\-solving, sustainable delivery, coaching, delegation, and empowered decision\-making. Requirements: **Required Qualifications and Skills** * Progressive software engineering leadership experience, including success managing and developing individual engineers. * Strong technical judgment and experience guiding architecture for cloud\-based, production software systems. * Experience with modern web or mobile applications, APIs, third\-party integrations, microservices, and event\-driven architectures. * Working knowledge of AWS and contemporary software delivery practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and operational readiness. * Demonstrated ability to partner with Product Management and other stakeholders to turn priorities into realistic delivery plans and resolve tradeoffs constructively. * A record of improving engineering quality, delivery practices, technical health, and team effectiveness. * Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks, and options to technical and nontechnical audiences. * A coaching\-oriented leadership style that creates accountability while enabling teams to make sound decisions with some autonomy. * Practical curiosity about AI\-assisted engineering and the judgment to promote its responsible use without sacrificing security, quality, or maintainability. **Required Experience and/or Education** * Leadership experience in a regulated business or other environment with significant security, privacy, or compliance obligations. * Familiarity with one or more of the following: HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, or FISMA. * Experience leading distributed or nearshore engineering teams. * Experience modernizing software architecture or reducing material technical debt. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **About Mind:** --------------- Mind Robotics is building Physical AI for real\-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. We believe the hardest problems in AI are solved when researchers and engineers are hands\-on with the physical world every day \- and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. Join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion. **About the team and the role:** -------------------------------- We're hiring an Onsite Engineering Manager to lead our forward deployed and software engineering team at a key customer in Normal, IL. You'll own two things at once: the health of our fleet of data collection devices, and the engineers who keep it running. **This role will start with critical robot data collection devices and then transition into robot deployment support.** You are the seam between the customer and HQ. Onsite, you're the senior technical voice the customer trusts when something breaks. At HQ, you're the person who turns field pain into a roadmap. You'll manage a small team of Forward Deployed and Software Engineers, own the escalation path into HQ engineering, and decide what gets patched in the field versus fixed in the product. This is a hands\-on management role. The right person can sit beside an engineer reading logs in the morning and renegotiate a deployment timeline with a customer lead in the afternoon. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Lead and grow the onsite team of Forward Deployed Engineers and SW engineers — hiring, onboarding, 1:1s, performance, and coverage across the customer's operating hours. * Own fleet reliability as a number: define the uptime, data\-capture, and time\-to\-resolution targets the team is measured against, and run the dashboards and reviews that keep them honest. * Set the technical bar onsite for provisioning, diagnostics, and networking — standard runbooks, repeatable device bring\-up, and postmortems that actually close. * Own the senior technical relationship with the customer: scope new requests, communicate incidents and timelines, and push back when a request doesn't fit. * Run the escalation path into HQ engineering — triage what the field absorbs versus what becomes a product fix, and represent the field in roadmap and prioritization. * Stay hands\-on. When a device, network, or deployment problem outruns the team, you're in it with them. You are comfortable with coding and work with your team to build and review PRs. * Lead trialing and testing of images, bug fixes and feature development work with offsite teams to bring in changes faster **Requirements:** ----------------- * 3\+ years managing engineers — field, hardware, infrastructure, or platform — including hiring, coaching, and growth * Deep hands\-on troubleshooting background with embedded devices, single\-board computers, cameras, or similar hardware; enough depth to review an engineer's diagnosis rather than take it on faith. * Comfort with Linux system administration and Bash or Python: you can still read a systemd unit, a provisioning script, or a tcpdump capture yourself. * Solid networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, subnets, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewall rules) and the judgment to tell our problem from the customer's network. * Customer\-facing maturity: you can own a hard conversation about an outage or a slipped date without spending the relationship. * The self\-direction to run a site away from HQ, and the discipline to keep HQ informed before they have to ask. * Experience standing up or scaling a forward deployed, field service, or solutions engineering team (nice to have). * Prior time as a Forward Deployed Engineer or in a similar onsite role — you've done the job you're now managing (nice to have). * Familiarity with fleet and infrastructure tooling: Docker, Portainer, Ansible, Grafana/Prometheus, remote device management (nice to have). * Background in robotics deployment, computer vision systems, IP cameras, or industrial IoT (nice to have). * Experience running incident response and postmortem practice across a distributed fleet (nice to have).

jobs.description: Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities: * Provide independent, timely and professional fire protection engineering support, services and consultation for the planning, design, construction, and maintenance of facilities for the Navy, Marine Corps, and other Supported Commands, including minor works projects, specific projects, special projects, military construction (MILCON), demolition, maintenance, space utilization and facilities development. * Participate in conferences with project stakeholders and collaborates with other engineering and architectural disciplines to ensure system coordination and integration with specific project requirements. * Typical projects include: fire protection engineering services for life safety, type of construction, height and area requirements, separation distances, fire rated construction, spray\-applied fireproofing, firestopping, sprinkler systems, fire alarm systems, mass notification systems, clean agent fire suppression systems, base\-wide fire alarm reporting systems, water distribution systems, hydraulic analysis, fire modeling, and performance\-based designs of major size and complexity for use in government facilities, including multi\-story office buildings, steam plants, hospitals, housing, manufacturing, training, and similar structures. Job Qualifications and Skills: * Registration as Professional Engineer (PE) in the discipline of Fire Protection Engineering is desired. * Substantial professional knowledge and practical application of fire protection engineering concepts, theories, principles, practices, and techniques necessary to plan, design, construct and maintain a wide range of shore\-based engineering projects. * Knowledge of DoD and Navy guide specifications, criteria and policy, industry codes and standards, and standard practices as related to fire protection engineering design, including the Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) codes and standards, International Building Code (IBC), International Mechanical Code (IMC),International Residential Code (IRC), FM Global Loss Prevention Data Sheets, Society of Fire Protection Engineer's Handbook, and various other industry standards. * Knowledge of local, state, federal, and foreign country laws, codes, and other statutory requirements affecting fire protection engineering design throughout the NAVFAC Mid\-Atlantic AOR. * Knowledge of related architectural and engineering fields and their associated impacts as related to fire protection engineering design. Ability to make oral presentations of proposed designs and results of studies * Knowledge and experience with Autodesk software, Microsoft Office products, fire protection engineering design and analysis software and other applicable DoD computer systems and software used by the Command. * Ability to produce results of analysis in writing and consolidate findings of others and evaluate recommendations and facts. * Knowledge of budgeting, planning and project management techniques, including the ability to coordinate the work of others and lead teams. * Knowledge of and full compliance with Safety Policy and Guidance, and use of personal protective equipment. Experience A minimum of 5 years of professional engineering code compliant facilities design experience for new construction, including renovation design experience, is required. Education Completion of a course of studies accredited by the Accreditation Board for Engineers and Technology (ABET) for a fire protection engineering program from a college or university for a bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or fire protection engineering, supplemented by a considerable amount of hands\-on facilities design experience, is required. If degree is in mechanical engineering, then a PE registration in the discipline of Fire Protection Engineering is required A degree in appropriate engineer, architecture, landscape architecture, or community planning discipline. You'll embed with the business teams who run those workflows, learn them in detail, and build AI\-powered tools alongside them that scale their expertise as we grow. This is an engineering role first: you'll write production code, take it through security review, and support it after launch. You'll report directly to the Head of Technology, and your scope will grow with every project you deliver. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES:** * Embed with an assigned business team and learn the work by doing it alongside them. * Document workflows step by step – inputs, systems, decisions, handoffs, and exceptions – including what happens upstream and downstream, in a standard format the team reviews and signs off on. * Build and ship production automations for well\-defined workflows. * Work with Platform Engineering so each automation runs on the existing platform – shared data, integrations, and monitoring – and fits the systems already in place rather than standing alone. * Write clear specifications and acceptance criteria for work that belongs in the core lending platform, and hand them to Platform Engineering. * Write tests and documentation for each automation, and take it through code review and the security and AI governance gate before it reaches production. * Build with least\-privilege agent identities, audit logging, and human review for any output that affects a loan decision or a disbursement of funds. * Measure time and error rates before and after each automation, and report the results. * Train users on new automations, gather feedback, and fix issues quickly after launch. * Monitor shipped automations, respond to failures, and maintain runbooks so the business team knows how to handle exceptions. **GENERAL DUTIES:** * Learn the lending business, from application through payoff, well enough to spot automation opportunities others miss. * Bring automation ideas to the Forward Deployed Engineer II and the Head of Technology with a rough estimate of hours saved. * Partner with Data \& Analytics on data definitions and data\-quality issues found in the field. * Contribute reusable components to shared libraries. * Follow engineering standards, including version control, code review, automated testing, and change management. * Protect borrower data in line with company security policies and the AI Use Policy, and raise risks early. * Keep workflow maps, specifications, runbooks, and change logs current. * Provide regular status updates to department leaders and the Head of Technology. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 1–3 years of professional experience writing code that real users relied on – in software engineering, automation, data engineering, or a technical analyst role with substantial coding. * Working proficiency in Python or TypeScript and SQL, plus experience with REST APIs and unstructured data. * Hands\-on experience building with LLM APIs – prompting, structured outputs, and document extraction – in professional or personal projects. * Daily use of AI coding tools, with the habit of verifying their output with tests. * Familiarity with loop engineering – agent workflows that act, check their own results, and stop or escalate to a person at the right point. * Asks good questions before building, and can explain a technical idea to a non\-technical colleague. * Thinks in systems: considers how a change in one workflow affects the data, systems, and people around it. * Organized, detail\-oriented writer – workflow maps and specifications are deliverables in this role, not afterthoughts. * Interest in financial services; exposure to lending, real estate, construction, or accounting a plus. * Experience with OutSystems or another low\-code platform, Microsoft 365/SharePoint, or Jira a plus. * Portfolio, GitHub profile, or other examples of shipped work strongly preferred. **The Pay** Salary range is $90,000 to $105,000, with a discretionary bonus of 15% per year **The Work Environment** * This role works **on\-site** from Ascent's Encino office, Monday \- Thursday (Fridays are work\-from\-home). **Our Benefits** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Our benefits include four health plans, two dental plans, health savings account with employer contribution, flexible spending accounts, vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and other optional benefits from which to choose. **Our Pledge** We pledge to be fair and considerate in hiring and promoting individuals, ensuring everyone can contribute their fullest potential regardless of background, identity, or personal circumstances. By promoting equal opportunity, we not only enhance our workplace but also contribute to a more just and equitable society. At Ascent, we stand united in building a community where everyone is empowered to succeed. Thank you for joining us on our journey towards a more inclusive future.

jobs.description: **Position Summary** -------------------- GripFusion is building the next generation of sports performance technology with Tactile Intelligence. As our Forward\-Deployed Software Engineer, you will expand every surface where GripFusion meets the athlete, from the ForceBall to the iPad, mobile, and web experiences that turn tactile data into decisions. This is a product\-facing engineering role reporting to Will Shawn, Head of Software. You will work across the full stack, spend time with players and coaches to understand how they use novel tactile data, and turn what you learn into shipped product. You will bring design and athlete thinking to every decision. You will work alongside our product, embedded, data science, and design teams to build new visualizations, connect GripFusion to the systems our customers already use, and carry common design practices across our baseball and golf platforms. **What You'll Build** --------------------- * **The iPad app.** Extend and harden our primary product, built in React Native on an AWS backend and used by teams today. * **The web dashboard.** Build a new React dashboard where coaches and staff review sessions, compare athletes, and share insights. * **The mobile** **app.** Build a mobile app that communicates directly with the ForceBall and supports broader use cases at the field. * **Novel visualizations.** Invent new ways to show tactile and athlete data, including 3D graphics that make the invisible obvious. * **Integrations.** Pull in data from the other systems teams already use, so GripFusion fits naturally into their workflow. * **The golf platform.** Contribute to our golf product and carry common design patterns and components across baseball and golf. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Work across the full stack, from BLE device communication and cloud services to mobile and web interfaces. * Partner with players, coaches, and team staff to understand user needs and how they interact with tactile data. * Balance quick prototyping and discovery with production\-level engineering, testing, and deployment. * Work with design to shape the user experience, and establish shared design practices across verticals. * Partner with embedded and data science to define device data transmission, state handling, and data formats. * Visit MLB teams to test with athletes and coaches, and bring product thinking back to the software stack. * Use AI development tools every day, and help shape how the software team builds with them. **Desired Skills \& Qualifications** ------------------------------------ * 4\+ years shipping production software across mobile and web, ideally with React Native, React, and TypeScript. * Full\-stack experience, including cloud backends on AWS and the CI/CD and release pipelines that get apps to users. * A track record of working directly with clients, users, or stakeholders to shape what gets built. * Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding tools and agentic workflows. * Experience with hardware systems, Bluetooth or other device data transmission, and device state diagrams (preferred). * Offline\-first mobile architecture and on\-device data analysis (preferred). * Data visualization or 3D graphics on web or mobile, such as three.js, WebGL, or React Three Fiber (preferred). * Experience integrating third\-party data sources and APIs (preferred). * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field. **Who You Are** --------------- * **An owner.** You take product and technical ownership end to end, from first conversation to shipped feature. * **A builder who explores.** You love quick prototypes and discovery, but you know when a prototype needs to become a product. * **Product\- and design\-minded.** You care about how an experience feels, not just whether it works. * **An athlete at heart.** You have competed or coached, and you understand how players train, compete, and take feedback. * **A great communicator.** You are as comfortable in a clubhouse with players and coaches as you are in a code review. * **AI\-first.** You embrace AI tools as a core part of how you design, build, and ship. **Impact \& Growth** -------------------- This role is designed to grow with the company. You will shape how GripFusion shows up for athletes and coaches across every surface we build. As our baseball and golf platforms expand, you will have a seat at the table on product direction, design practices, and how our AI\-first engineering team works. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * **Base salary:** $110,000 to $145,000, commensurate with experience. * **Equity:** 0\.1% to 0\.25%. * **Benefits:** Healthcare, dental, vision, and retirement matching. **Work Environment** -------------------- * Full\-time, in\-person role based at GripFusion's Performance Lab headquarters in Ann Arbor, MI, including our in\-house pitching lab, with up to 10% travel to MLB/NCAA teams and partners. * Collaborative, innovation\-first startup environment working across hardware, firmware, software, design, and data science. * Direct access to leadership and the opportunity to build a new category of sports performance technology from the ground up. * Career development opportunities and professional growth. * Family first, with a close\-knit team that enjoys solving hard problems.

Our platform helps creators transform ideas and scripts into structured production workflows, including story development, character creation, episode and shot planning, AI image/video generation, and editing. We are currently expanding our engineering team and looking for a **Full\-Stack Engineer** to help build our platform. If you're passionate about AI video creation, we'd love to have you join our team and help turn more great stories into amazing videos! About the Role Your main focus is the Next.js frontend and the product experience, but you'll also work in the Python backend and the video generation pipeline yourself, so a feature ships end to end, from UI to API. This is a core role on an early team. You'll take over an existing codebase, help get us through launch and post\-launch stability, and have a real say in technical decisions. Responsibilities Frontend (60%) * Design and build the core creator experiences: the AI agent chat and composer, the project pipeline from story to render, the character workspace, and the storyboard and video editing tools. * Make the node\-based generation canvas a joy to use: dragging, connecting, grouping, undo and redo, autosave, and live progress on image and video generation. * Maintain the Next.js BFF layer: sign\-in flows (email code, OAuth, Apple), session cookies and the API proxy. Backend (40%) * Maintain and improve the design and versioning of the prompt templates behind our video models, covering shot beats, camera direction, dialogue, sound design and reference\-image binding, along with the segmentation logic. * Review generated videos and agent replies with a critical eye, and turn what you see into better prompts, defaults and validation rules. * Add the Python / FastAPI endpoints your features need, working with the backend engineer. Requirements * Experience with complex, stateful UI, such as editors, canvases, chat or real\-time dashboards: optimistic updates, undo history, autosave, streaming data. * You can take over an existing codebase. You're comfortable reading a large TypeScript monorepo, learning its conventions quickly and making it your own. * LLM agent and prompt experience. You've written system prompts, tool definitions or structured\-output schemas for a production LLM feature, and improved them against real output. * Hands\-on AI video and image generation. You've used models like Seedance, Kling, Runway, Veo or Hailuo and know how to prompt them well. * Python backend skills. Comfortable writing FastAPI (or similar) endpoints and debugging across the browser, BFF and API. Nice to Have * Strong visual taste. You care about layout, type, color and motion, and can explain why one design works better than another. Your portfolio shows it. * Figma and design\-system work. Rim Universe is moving quickly, so we value engineers who can work independently, solve problems proactively, and communicate clearly with the team. If you're passionate about AI video creation, welcome to join us! Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) * Employee discount * Flexible schedule Language: * Mandarin (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: GTM AI Engineering
jobs.description: As a GTM AI Engineer at Applied Compute, you’ll build the software, agents, and data infrastructure that power our go\-to\-market engine. Your systems will help us identify promising accounts, reach the right people, and turn information from across our business into actionable insights. This is a software engineering role dedicated to our internal GTM systems. You’ll spend your time designing, coding, deploying, and improving tools our team uses every day. You’ll own projects from problem definition through production, with responsibility for their architecture, reliability, and business impact. You’ll work closely with our GTM team to understand their workflows, prioritize what to build, and improve the systems as the company grows. **What you’ll do** * **Build agents and applications for GTM workflows.** Develop systems for account research, prospect discovery, outreach personalization, inbound qualification, and pipeline reporting. * **Build the data foundation.** Connect our CRM, communication tools, meeting transcripts, and external data sources. Make account and contact information accurate, current, and accessible to the people and agents that need it. * **Turn recurring work into reusable software.** Identify manual bottlenecks and build tools that reduce repetitive work and help the team act on relevant information. * **Make LLM workflows reliable.** Develop evaluations, review workflows, and feedback loops that improve research accuracy, generated content, and agent behavior. * **Own production quality.** Maintain a shared codebase with code review, automated testing, monitoring, documentation, and reliable deployments. Debug failures and improve systems as usage grows. * **Measure and improve results.** Instrument workflows to understand their effect on qualified pipeline, conversion, and time saved. Use those results to guide experiments and engineering priorities. **What we’re looking for** * Prior professional experience as a software engineer or machine learning engineer, building and maintaining production systems on an engineering team. * Strong programming skills in Python or TypeScript, with experience working with APIs, databases, and integrations. * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent workflows, and evaluations. * Comfort working with SQL and messy data, including reconciling information across multiple sources. * Strong engineering judgment: you can ship quickly while keeping systems understandable, testable, and maintainable. * Ownership and product sense. You can turn an ambiguous business problem into a useful tool, work directly with its users, and improve it based on evidence. **Nice to have** * Experience building internal tools, data pipelines, or automation used by a sales, marketing, or growth team. * Familiarity with CRM systems, enrichment providers, and sales engagement tools. * Experience designing experiments and measuring how software changes affect business outcomes. The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time position is **$160,000–$240,000**. Total compensation for this role also includes meaningful equity in a fast\-growing startup, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both personally and professionally. Base salary is determined by a range of factors including individual qualifications, experience, skills, interview performance, market data, and work location. The listed salary range is intended as a guideline and may be adjusted. **About us** ============ Applied Compute builds Specific Intelligence for the enterprise. We provide the continual learning infrastructure for companies to build agent workforces trained on proprietary data and institutional expertise. Our researchers and platform embed directly within customer environments to build custom evals, train models, and deploy agents that get better with use. * **Why we’re excited:** We get to work at a rare intersection. Our product team builds the platform powering a new generation of digital coworkers. Our research team pushes the frontier of post\-training and reinforcement learning. Our applied AI team sits side\-by\-side with customers as they ship agents into production. This combination of strong product, deep research, and boots on the ground is what we believe it takes to bring AI to the enterprise. We are product\-led, research\-enabled, and forward\-deployed. * **Who we are**: We’re a team of engineers, researchers, and operators. Many of us are former founders. We've built RL infrastructure at OpenAI, data foundations at Scale AI, and systems at Together, Two Sigma, Watershed, and others. We work with F50 customers and are fortunate to be backed by partners like Kleiner Perkins, Benchmark, Sequoia, Lux, and Greenoaks. * **Who Thrives Here**: We're looking for people who are excited about applying novel research and complex systems to real\-world problems. Our team genuinely enjoys working with customers: listening, empathizing, and understanding how work actually gets done in their organizations. Former founders, people who've built a lot of side projects, or anyone who's shown they can own something end\-to\-end, tend to do well here. **Benefits \& Logistics** ========================= This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our office in the Mission. We offer: * Competitive compensation and equity * 100% employer\-paid health insurance coverage for you and your family * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave * Daily lunches and dinners * Transportation and relocation support * 5% 401k match We sponsor visas. While we can't guarantee success for every candidate or role, if you're the right fit, we're committed to working through the process with you. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. As set forth in Applied Compute’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Transform healthcare with us.** --------------------------------- At Qualified Health, we're redefining what's possible with Generative AI in healthcare. Our infrastructure provides the guardrails for safe AI governance, healthcare\-specific agent creation, and real\-time algorithm monitoring—working alongside leading health systems to drive real change. This is more than just a job. It's an opportunity to build the future of AI in healthcare, solve complex challenges, and make a lasting impact on patient care. If you're ambitious, innovative, and ready to move fast, we'd love to have you on board. Join us in shaping the future of healthcare. **Job Summary:** ---------------- We're hiring a **Principal Applied AI Engineer** to set the technical vision for how Qualified Health builds agentic AI systems across the entire product portfolio. This is a company\-level technical leadership role: you'll shape multi\-year infrastructure strategy, represent engineering in decisions about AI direction at the leadership table, and set the bar for what "production\-grade agentic AI in healthcare" means at QH. You'll still write code and dive into hard technical problems directly, but your primary impact will be through the systems, standards, and people you influence across teams. **Key Responsibilities:** ------------------------- * Define the multi\-year technical strategy and architecture for agentic workflow infrastructure supporting the full QH product portfolio (100\+ workflows and growing). * Represent applied AI engineering in cross\-functional and leadership\-level decisions on product direction, build\-vs\-buy, and platform investment. * Set org\-wide engineering standards for LLM evaluation, deployment, safety, and monitoring — informing QH's broader AI governance approach. * Act as a technical escalation point for the hardest, highest\-ambiguity problems across product lines. * Mentor and develop Staff\-level engineers; help shape the technical career ladder for applied AI roles. * Stay ahead of the frontier — evaluate emerging models, frameworks, and techniques (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, etc.) and determine what's worth adopting at QH. * Partner with founders and engineering leadership on how AI infrastructure investment ties to company strategy. **Required Qualifications:** ---------------------------- * Deep software engineering foundation (Python required) with a track record of architecting systems used company\-wide. * 8\+ years building production software, including 4\+ years building and scaling AI\-powered/LLM\-driven applications in production. * Proven experience setting technical direction and standards adopted across multiple teams, not just a single product line. * Deep expertise in MLOps, model deployment, and workflow automation at an organizational/platform level. * Demonstrated ability to operate with full autonomy on ambiguous, high\-stakes technical and strategic problems. * Strong track record influencing technical decisions at the leadership level, including with non\-technical stakeholders. **Desirable Skills:** --------------------- * Bachelor's degree \+ 10 years OR Master's degree \+ 8 years in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). * Recognized expertise (internally or externally — talks, publications, open source, prior platform\-level roles) in applied AI/agentic systems. * Experience building AI infrastructure in a regulated or high\-stakes domain (healthcare, finance, etc.). * History of founding or scaling a technical function from the ground up in a startup environment. * Experience mentoring Staff\-level engineers and shaping technical career ladders. **Why Join Qualified Health?** ------------------------------ This is an opportunity to join a fast\-growing company and a world\-class team, that is poised to change the healthcare industry. We are a passionate, mission\-driven team that is building a category\-defining product. We are backed by premier investors and are looking for founding team members who are excited to do the best work of their careers. Our employees are integral to achieving our goals so we are proud to offer competitive salaries with equity packages, robust medical/dental/vision insurance, flexible working hours, hybrid work options and an inclusive environment that fosters creativity and innovation. **Our Commitment to Diversity** ------------------------------- Qualified Health is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is essential to our success, and we are committed to building a team that reflects the world we live in. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status. **Pay \& Benefits:** The pay range for this role is between $230,000 and $350,000, depending on skills, qualifications, experience, and location. jobs.title: Lead Data Platform & Database Engineer
jobs.description: We are hiring a Lead Data Platform \& Database Engineer to take full ownership of our relational database estate. We are hiring the person who will own the database and data estate at TrustEngine end to end: assess what we have, run a time\-critical upgrade as the first job, and then set the direction and standards that mature the whole environment. TrustEngine is the product of a merger, so we run two stacks — C\#/.NET on Microsoft SQL Server, and TypeScript/JavaScript on MySQL — both in AWS. Our SQL Server is BYOL on EC2: we install, configure, and operate it ourselves, an on\-premises setup that happens to live in AWS. MySQL runs on RDS. The role sits on our Platform team and is the senior technical authority on data for both engineering teams. The immediate need is someone who can hit the ground running on a time\-critical OS upgrade before year\-end; the longer\-term job is to leave the estate in a state we can stand behind with customers, auditors, and our insurer. Why this role: We are a merged company running two stacks, and the estate has not had a single accountable owner. We are looking for someone who wants to fix it properly rather than patch it, and who will be given the mandate to do so. **What You'll Do** * Deep and current Microsoft SQL Server administration — this is the core of the role * Recent hands\-on experience with full SQL Server installation and configuration on a server you manage yourself — Windows Server on EC2 or on\-premises — not a managed service such as RDS or Azure SQL. Must include OS\-level work beneath a live production instance. * Windows Server administration, including OS upgrades and migrations * Most recent SQL Server upgrade performed, stated on the profile: source and target versions, in\-place or side\-by\-side, year, and the Windows Server version pairing. Career\-span claims without versions will not be considered. * SQL Server high availability — Always On Availability Groups, failover clustering * MySQL administration * AWS — EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch * AI proficiency (e.g., Claude) applied to day\-to\-day work * 7\+ years of experience * Prior end\-to\-end ownership of a production database estate, including assessing an inherited environment and driving it to a measurably better state * Experience setting data standards and reviewing schema and data\-access design across application teams **Requirements** **What You'll Bring** * Snowflake administration and development — preferred; our data engineering team covers Snowflake day to day * ETL pipelines and tools (e.g. Rivery, dbt) * Data warehouse design and development * Data lake on S3 * BI/analytics and tools (e.g. Metabase, QuickSight) * Data governance and data quality practice * SQL Server migration to a managed service (RDS or equivalent) **Benefits** Salary Range Up to $190,000 * 100% Remote position, with a virtual office * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Flexible Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Short Term \& Long Term Disability * Training \& Development * Wellness Resources

jobs.description: **Shape the heartbeat of high‑volume operations** ================================================= Step into a role where your work directly drives uptime, safety, and throughput. In the afternoon, you’re shoulder‑to‑shoulder with maintenance and operations, diagnosing a stubborn sensor network issue across Ethernet/IP, ControlNet, or DeviceNet. respond rapidly to emergencies and coordinate additional assistance as required. * Inspect systems to verify they operate within design parameters and meet client‑defined conditions. * Scope, schedule, and oversee work by external contractors, including proprietary solutions, licensed installs, upgrades, and specialized systems maintenance. * Engineer reliability and process improvements from concept through network‑wide deployment. * Monitor and troubleshoot industrial networks (Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS‑i), motor control centers, servo drives, VFDs, and electrical distribution. * Track equipment metrics; partner with site teams to resolve electrical causes of performance gaps. * Communicate clearly with leadership, operations, and maintenance on technical issues, timelines, and production impacts. * Lead failure analyses and process reviews; recommend corrective actions or training to prevent recurrence. * Conduct controls assessments to sustain and elevate equipment reliability. * Build strong relationships with the client and the Operations Maintenance team. * Perform other related duties as assigned. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required** * Bachelor’s degree preferred with 2–5 years of relevant experience; equivalent combinations of education and experience considered. * Participation in at least two engineering design cycles (specification, component selection, programming). * 2\+ years with PLC programming, robotics components/controls, and SCADA‑based monitoring and control. * Flexibility to support varied shifts/areas, including nights, weekends, and holidays. * Proven independent problem‑solving in standard situations with minimal oversight. * Physical capability to stoop, stand, walk, climb stairs/ladders, and lift/carry 50\+ lbs. * Skilled at navigating sensitive or complex discussions, setting expectations, and resolving issues. ### **Preferred** * 2\+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in control systems troubleshooting/programming. * Hands‑on with diverse conveyor and sortation technologies. * Experience with robotic maintenance. * Strong Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, Outlook). * Exceptional organization and a curious, investigative mindset. * Advanced math capability (percentages, fractions, and financial‑related calculations). ### **Core proficiencies and tools** * Proficient in PLC programming and SCADA systems. * Hands‑on with Allen‑Bradley PLCs. **Work authorization** ---------------------- Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.description: We find and fix every vulnerability in our customers' applications. When a new AI model is released, we run it against their applications before attackers do, and close what it finds. **About Wakefield** ------------------- Wakefield is an applied research lab working on AI\-native security services. We build security agents and publish how they work. Our methods, benchmark and raw data are public so anyone can check them. * Source code optional: blackbox agents sign in as every role and test the running app. Whitebox agents read the code on every pull request. * If Wakefield can't prove it, the customer never sees it: agents replay each finding in a real browser and record it. Then Wakefield writes the fix, ready to open as a pull request, and retests it. We have SLAs for zero false positives. * One service that replaces DAST, SAST, SCA, SBOM, and the tests companies run in\-house or buy in. **The role** ------------ Our customers range from security engineers to leaders who have never read an HTTP request. They need to trust what an agent found, see the proof, and get it fixed. You'll own the Wakefield console end to end, from schema to UI: findings and their proof, fixes, scans, chat, and the integrations and MCP server that bring Wakefield into the tools people already use. **What you'll work on** ----------------------- * The finding page: the recording, the requests, the steps to reproduce and the fix, clear enough for someone who isn't a security expert. * Adding an application and a test login for each role, and following the agents while they work. * Fixes: patches with a confidence level, pull requests a person opens, and retests that confirm the fix. * Chat and the MCP server, so people can ask Wakefield what to fix first from wherever they work. * Integrations with GitHub, Jira, Linear, Slack and the rest. * Reports a CISO can hand to a board or an auditor. **Requirements** ---------------- * 2\+ years of engineering experience, or equivalent depth from open source or your own projects * Time at a fast\-growing startup * You've built products from scratch and shipped them to real users * You've owned polished features end to end, from backend to UI * Strong product and design judgment: what to cut, what to polish, when to ship * Strong full\-stack fundamentals: Python, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, debugging unfamiliar code * You use coding agents every day and still understand every line you ship * You build and tinker for fun because you genuinely care about how products are made and used **Nice to have** ---------------- * You've founded a company or shipped security or developer tools * You work where design and engineering overlap: you prototype in code and sweat spacing, motion and copy **How we hire** --------------- * Meet the co\-founders. * A one\-week paid trial with us in the office. * Offer. **Logistics** ------------- * Location: San Francisco, in person. jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Field Deployment & Support
jobs.description: **About Destro AI** Destro AI is building the intelligence layer for robotics — the system that coordinates robots, humans, and workflows across complex real\-world operations. Founded by former leaders from HAI Robotics, Dexterity, and Matic, Destro is built on a simple thesis: robotics has solved movement, but not decision\-making. Destro is backed by investors who have previously invested in and built companies like Brex, Figma, Notion, and Instacart. Destro's MothershipOS is a shared brain across all robots, unlocking complex factory and warehouse workflows. Unlike traditional systems that rely on local intelligence on each robot, Destro brings global intelligence across the entire operation. Destro recently closed its Seed round at one of the highest valuations for a robotics company at this stage, and is already deploying in production with large enterprise operators. **About The Role** We're hiring a Robotics Forward Deployed Engineer, to own the software that runs MothershipOS in live customer warehouses. This role is responsible for writing and maintaining production code, not solely for troubleshooting it, and will serve as the engineering presence on\-site when systems need to be brought up, stabilized, or restored to full function. **Schedule Expectations** This is a field deployment role, not a standard office\-hours position. Warehouse operations run multiple shifts, and go\-lives, incidents, and integrations are not confined to business hours. * Regular work outside standard business hours should be expected, including nights and weekends. Go\-lives are frequently scheduled during off\-hours or weekend downtime windows to avoid disrupting customer operations. * This role may be paged for production issues, including robot faults, network outages, and server failures, outside normal hours, and is expected to respond promptly, either remotely or on\-site. * Extensive travel to customer sites is required, at times on short notice. * Candidates seeking a fixed 9\-to\-5, Monday\-through\-Friday schedule are unlikely to find this role a fit. **What You'll Do** *Software* * Write, test, and maintain the software services that run MothershipOS at customer sites, including deployment tooling and diagnostic utilities. * Design and build internal tools that make field deployments faster and more repeatable. * Translate field learnings into production\-hardening fixes and improvements in the core codebase. * Maintain clear technical documentation and runbooks so issues can be diagnosed consistently across sites. *Field Deployment* * Deploy and validate Destro's software stack in live warehouses, working directly with customer operations, IT, and engineering teams. * Own production issues end\-to\-end during launch and stabilization, including off\-hours incidents. * Improve uptime, throughput, and reliability of deployed systems through both code and infrastructure changes. *Systems and Infrastructure* * Build and maintain containerized services (Docker Compose) running on Destro\-managed servers and edge devices. * Work with cloud infrastructure (GCP) for image management, versioning, and deployment tooling. * Configure and troubleshoot networking, including VLANs, DHCP, internal DNS, and certificate\-based service security. * Debug across the full stack: robot state faults, sensor issues, API failures, container networking, database queries, and monitoring dashboards. **Who You Are** * 2 to 6 years of experience in systems engineering, robotics software, backend engineering, infrastructure, or field engineering, with genuine software development experience rather than field support alone. * Comfortable being paged off\-hours and traveling on short notice. * Able to operate independently in ambiguous, high\-pressure environments without a fully specified solution. * Calm under pressure, direct with customers, and demonstrates strong ownership. **Technical Skills** *Required* * Strong Python or C\+\+, with the ability to write maintainable, production\-grade code. * Hands\-on Docker/Docker Compose experience, including building, deploying, debugging, and versioning images. * Linux/server administration: command line, logs, processes, systemd, firewalls. * Networking fundamentals: DHCP, DNS, VLANs, static IP reservations, TLS/certificates. * Experience with APIs and communication protocols (REST, WebSockets, MQTT). * Proficiency with Git and standard software development workflows. *Strongly Preferred* * Experience with AMRs, warehouse automation, or fleet management. * Cloud deployment experience, ideally GCP. * Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, or time\-series databases. * WMS/WES/ERP integration experience. *Nice to Have* * Experience with robot task allocation, scheduling, or routing. * Experience with wearables, scanners, or other warehouse hardware.

This role partners closely with application development, security, and infrastructure teams to drive automation, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency across the organization. As a senior\-level contributor, you will provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, influence architectural decisions, and own complex cloud and DevOps initiatives from design through production. The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on expertise in cloud platforms, virtualization, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and cloud cost optimization (FinOps) in hybrid environments. We are seeking a Mid\-Senior DevOps Engineer with **8\+ years of relevant experience** who is eager to grow their skills and contribute to our dynamic team. This is a **hybrid position**, and we expect the candidate to work **2\-3 days a week on\-site** at our office. **Responsibilities:** * + Lead collaboration with application development teams to design and implement reliable, automated CI/CD pipelines + Architect, implement, and maintain **cloud\-native and hybrid infrastructure** using Infrastructure as Code best practices + Drive automation initiatives across provisioning, deployment, monitoring, and recovery processes + Design, implement, and maintain **observability platforms**, with a strong focus on **Datadog** for metrics, logs, traces, and alerting + Establish monitoring, SLOs, and alerting strategies to improve system reliability and reduce mean time to resolution (MTTR) + Own and optimize **cloud cost efficiency**, identifying savings opportunities and implementing cost controls without compromising performance + Implement and maintain configuration management using tools such as **Ansible, Puppet, or Chef** + Own and optimize **VMware environments**, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance + Serve as a senior escalation point for production incidents, performing root cause analysis and driving long\-term remediation + Partner with security teams to enforce infrastructure security, compliance, and best practices + Lead disaster recovery planning, testing, and continuous improvement efforts + Perform regular system performance tuning, capacity planning, and cost analysis + Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers and contribute to technical standards and documentation + Create and maintain detailed architecture diagrams and operational documentation **Skills:** As a Senior DevOps/Cloud Engineer, you will design and optimize scalable cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP, providing technical leadership for automation and reliability initiatives. You will manage VMware and container platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes to support stable deployments across Windows and Linux environments. jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery\-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight. ### **Senior Electrical Engineer** Parallel Systems is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to lead the design, development, integration, and validation of vehicle electrical systems for our production autonomous battery\-electric rail vehicles. This role will own critical electrical architectures and subsystems, including power distribution, traction and braking interfaces, safety\-critical control systems, wiring harnesses, and compute/sensor networks. As a senior technical contributor, you will drive electrical engineering decisions from initial concept through production deployment, establish robust design and verification processes, and ensure reliable integration across mechanical, software, and autonomy systems. You will be responsible for developing high\-reliability electrical systems that meet demanding performance, safety, and regulatory requirements while supporting the transition from prototype development to production. The ideal candidate brings substantial experience designing and integrating complex electrical systems in automotive, rail, aerospace, or other vehicle\-based applications. You are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous technical challenges, leading cross\-functional engineering efforts, and balancing hands\-on execution with system\-level technical leadership. #### **Responsibilities** * **Own end\-to\-end electrical system development:** Lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and validation of vehicle electrical systems, including power distribution, wiring harnesses, commercial\-off\-the\-shelf hardware, and electrical test infrastructure. * **Drive technical design decisions:** Establish electrical design requirements, define system interfaces, evaluate design tradeoffs, and make recommendations that balance performance, reliability, safety, cost, and manufacturability. * **Lead safety\-critical engineering:** Develop and maintain system\-level risk assessments, Design Failure Mode and Effects Analyses (DFMEAs), hazard analyses, and verification and validation plans for critical electrical subsystems. * **Lead system integration:** Coordinate electrical interfaces with mechanical, embedded software, controls, and autonomy teams to ensure reliable operation across vehicle subsystems and dependencies. * **Drive hands\-on testing and troubleshooting:** Lead hardware bring\-up, bench testing, prototype vehicle integration, fault isolation, and root\-cause analysis to resolve complex electrical and system\-level issues. * **Support production readiness:** Partner with manufacturing, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to transition electrical designs from prototypes to production, addressing design\-for\-manufacturing, assembly, testability, and quality requirements. * **Establish engineering standards:** Develop and maintain electrical design practices, interface specifications, test procedures, and validation methods that improve system reliability and repeatability. * **Own engineering documentation and configuration:** Ensure accuracy and traceability of schematics, wiring diagrams, bills of materials (BOMs), test reports, engineering changes, and release documentation. * **Provide technical leadership:** Mentor engineers as needed, review electrical designs, identify technical risks, and drive resolution of complex engineering challenges across the product lifecycle. ### **What Success Looks Like** * **30 Days:** You've reviewed existing vehicle architectures and are contributing to the definition of system\-level requirements for new or upgraded subsystems (e.g., braking control, high\-voltage distribution). You're actively participating in safety reviews and design discussions. * **60 Days:** You're leading the design and documentation of a new electrical subsystem. You've outlined validation and compliance testing plans and are driving system alignment across disciplines. * **90 Days:** You've completed a first\-pass system architecture for a new subsystem and led its integration into a prototype or test vehicle. You're actively shaping the roadmap for future electrical system upgrades and regulatory milestones. ### **Basic Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * 5\+ years of relevant experience designing, developing, integrating, or validating electrical systems for vehicles or other complex electromechanical products. * Demonstrated ownership of electrical systems or subsystems through multiple stages of the product development lifecycle, from concept and design through testing and production. * Strong understanding of vehicle power distribution, electrical architecture, control systems, and embedded communication protocols such as CAN and Ethernet. * Experience defining system requirements, managing electrical interfaces, and developing verification and validation strategies. * Proven ability to troubleshoot complex electrical systems using first\-principles analysis, structured debugging, and root\-cause investigation. * Experience with electrical design and documentation tools such as SolidWorks Electrical, Altium, RapidHarness, or equivalent. * Ability to work cross\-functionally and communicate technical decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to engineering and manufacturing stakeholders. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing and deploying electrical systems for automotive, rail, aerospace, commercial vehicles, or heavy industrial equipment. * Experience with traction, braking, high\-voltage power distribution, vehicle control systems, or other safety\-critical vehicle subsystems. * Working knowledge of functional safety standards and frameworks, such as ISO 26262, Automotive Safety Integrity Levels (ASIL), IEC 61508, or equivalent. * Experience designing, prototyping, integrating, and validating complex wiring harnesses and electrical assemblies. * Experience with system\-level hazard analysis, DFMEA, fault analysis, reliability engineering, and formal verification and validation processes. * Programming or scripting experience in Python, C/C\+\+, Rust, or similar languages for test automation, diagnostics, or hardware integration. * Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, automated test systems, data acquisition, or electrical test stand development. * Experience supporting contract manufacturers, supplier qualification, design\-for\-manufacturing, and production ramp\-up. * Evidence of exceptional technical ability through shipped products, complex system deployments, patents, technical projects, or a portfolio of engineering work. *Parallel Systems is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any discriminatory factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. We work to build an inclusive environment in which all people can come to do their best work.* *Parallel Systems is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Parallel Systems will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact your recruiter.*

Technologies**: Experience designing and optimizing relational and NoSQL databases, including Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure SQL Database, MySQL, and Azure Cosmos DB. * **DevOps \&
