jobs.title: Software Engineer (Python, AWS)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will build the Python backend services and secure APIs on Amazon Web Services (AWS) that a federal agency relies on to process its filer applications. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you building the backend that powers how a federal agency processes its filer applications. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build the services and secure application programming interfaces (APIs) that move each submission through document processing, validation, and decisioning. * Develop backend services and REST APIs in Python and FastAPI that turn a manual, document\-heavy process into one that is fast, secure, and automated. * Build the cloud behind them on AWS: Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, and S3\. * Keep the data in PostgreSQL and handle identity and access the right way. You help deliver a secure, automated backend that carries filings from submission to decision, built for a regulated federal environment where security and auditability are not optional. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** **Requirements** * 4\+ years of software development experience in Python * Bachelor's degree * Hands\-on experience building secure REST APIs on AWS with FastAPI or a similar framework * Experience with PostgreSQL * Experience implementing authentication and access control * Experience with clean, automated software delivery * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Experience with OAuth and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) * Experience building microservices * Experience with GitHub Actions **Who you are** You have a hacker's mindset: you would rather ship a working prototype tonight than a perfect plan next week. You have built backends and APIs that hold up in production, and you move at the speed of the tools, not the clock. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Strong Python skills and hands\-on experience building secure REST APIs on AWS with FastAPI or a similar framework. * The backend fundamentals that support them: PostgreSQL, authentication and access control, and clean, automated delivery. * The judgment to build in a regulated federal environment, where security and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. The technical assessment is a live Python coding exercise. **Benefits** **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $92,000 to $133,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

As a Software Engineer II, you will deliver high quality features end\-to\-end, contribute to system design and architecture reviews, and begin owning components of production systems within a fast\-paced, AI\-native SRE engineering environment. **Responsibilities** * Design and operate intelligent, production\-grade systems that leverage real\-time signals and AI\-driven detection to improve the health of streaming platforms, critical services, and customer experience * Build and scale AI\-driven capabilities including agentic AI systems powered by modern foundation models (e.g. Claude Opus/Sonnet, GPT\-4\) enabling automated reasoning and decisioning, as well as predictive modeling and anomaly detection for real\-time system health and reliability * Develop end\-to\-end data and decisioning pipelines that transform telemetry, logs, and user signals into actionable insights, automated detection, and root cause analysis * Create and deploy scalable APIs and services that deliver predictive signals, explainability, and insights to engineering teams, operational tools, and product stakeholders * Contribute to infrastructure visibility and compliance enforcement systems that aggregate resource data across Disney products, enable ownership\-scoped querying, and prevent non\-compliant deployments * Partner cross\-functionally to embed intelligence into workflows (incident response, release validation, customer insights), improving speed and reducing operational overhead * Drive innovation in observability, reliability, and developer productivity through applied AI and new approaches **Basic Qualifications** * 3\+ years of applicable experience in backend development, including building AI\-powered or data driven applications and scalable APIs (e.g. FastAPI, Flask) * Knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture to inform what infrastructure characteristics should be measured and evaluated for reliability and compliance * Practical experience jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Applications
jobs.description: **Build things people actually want to use.** We’re building ClearFrame for people who have an idea and want to turn it into working software. It brings AI coding agents, previews and change review into one workspace, so builders can try things, see what works and recover when something goes wrong. Take a look at what we’re building: https://clearframecode.com/ We’re looking for a software engineer who enjoys that whole process: getting a rough idea into shape, building the first version, finding the awkward parts and making it better. You’ll use ClearFrame to build practical applications and example projects, test how the agents perform, and help us improve the experience for the next person. Some days that means shipping a useful feature. Other days it means tracking down a stubborn bug or explaining a workflow so clearly that someone else can follow it. What you’ll work on \- Build small applications, integrations and working examples from real project briefs. \- Review AI\-generated code, test important user flows and fix what breaks. \- Turn product friction into clear, reproducible issues and practical improvements. \- Create short demos and guides based on things you’ve actually built. \- Bring a builder’s perspective to decisions about the product. You’ll probably enjoy this role if \- You’ve built working software and can talk through the decisions behind it. \- You can debug a problem and explain how you know the fix worked. \- You’re curious about AI coding tools without treating their output as automatically correct. \- You like owning a small project from an incomplete brief to a usable result. \- You communicate clearly and are comfortable sharing work in progress. Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and modern web applications is useful. We care more about what you can build, how you think and how you learn than a particular degree or an exact number of years in a job. Why ClearFrame \- Work on a tool you’ll use as part of your own development workflow. \- Build practical projects and help shape how other people build software. \- Have room to propose ideas, test them and see the results. \- $150,000–$200,000 annual base salary, plus a target annual bonus of 20% of base salary based on individual and company performance. \- Stock options representing 0\.25%–0\.75% of fully diluted shares at grant, based on experience and scope. Options vest over four years with a one\-year cliff and require corporate approval and formal grant documents. Options have an exercise price, may be diluted and do not guarantee a cash value. How to apply Send your resume or project history and one example of something you built. A public repository, live project or short written walkthrough is welcome. Please share only work you have permission to disclose. ClearFrame experience is useful context, but you don’t need to have used it to apply. We’ll provide product access needed for the interview process. No purchase or product signup is required to be considered. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Full-Stack ML Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Company** ----------- Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into a formal representation, so every AI answer can be traced, challenged, and proved. Pramaana's architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4\. Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for a full\-stack engineer with focus on infrastructure to build the tools and systems that help Pramaana’s engineers and researchers develop, test, deploy, and operate their work more effectively. Your initial focus will be **DevOps and MLOps**: improving development environments and deployment workflows, making experiments and evaluations reproducible, and helping teams understand the behavior, performance, and cost of AI systems. You’ll build across interfaces, backend services, and infrastructure automation—not just maintain scripts or configure dashboards. This is an early\-stage role with scope across the company. As needs evolve, your work will extend into shared capabilities such as identity and access, LLM gateways, API\-key management, training and inference platform maintenance, usage metering, and internal applications. You’ll work directly with the people using these systems, turning recurring friction into reliable, self\-serve tools. We’re looking for someone who treats internal tools as products: useful, understandable, well\-maintained, and built around the workflows of the people who depend on them. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Improve how software gets built and deployed.** Develop repeatable local environments, automated tests, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment workflows. Help make configuration, secrets, releases, and rollbacks easier to manage safely. * **Build tools for the AI development lifecycle.** Create workflows for running experiments and evaluations, versioning datasets and configurations, tracking results and artifacts, and deploying or integrating model services. Make runs easier to reproduce, compare, and investigate. Help researchers get from a recipe to a running job, and from a failed job to the cause.. * **Create full\-stack, self\-serve applications.** Build interfaces and APIs that let teams launch jobs, manage configurations, inspect results, and troubleshoot failures without relying on repeated manual assistance. * **Make systems observable and costs understandable.** Connect logs, metrics, traces, and usage data so teams can diagnose issues, identify bottlenecks, and understand where time and compute are being spent. * **Contribute to shared platform services.** Help build and integrate identity, access controls, LLM routing, API keys, budgets, and usage metering across Pramaana’s products and internal workflows. * **Use existing tools thoughtfully.** Evaluate and extend open\-source or managed solutions where they fit. Build custom software where it solves a real gap, rather than recreating infrastructure unnecessarily. * **Improve tools through direct feedback.** Work alongside engineers and researchers to identify recurring problems, prioritize improvements, and measure whether tools reduce setup time, manual work, and failed runs. Maintain tests, documentation, and operational guidance for what you ship. **You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have** -------------------------------------------- * **Minimum 2\-3 years of software engineering experience**, including hands\-on work with backend services, full\-stack applications, internal tools, or deployment automation. * **A solid foundation in building software across the stack.** You can develop services and automation in Python or TypeScript, work with APIs and databases, and build usable interfaces with React or a similar framework. * **Practical cloud and deployment experience.** You’ve deployed applications using containers and a cloud platform such as AWS, worked with CI/CD, and used logs or metrics to investigate problems. * **Some hands\-on exposure to AI or ML workflows.** This could include integrating model APIs, running evaluations, tracking experiments, or operating model\-backed applications through work or substantial projects. You don’t need to be an ML researcher. * **A product mindset for internal users.** You care about clear interfaces, sensible defaults, useful documentation, and reducing the number of steps it takes someone to get their work done. * **Good engineering judgment and a collaborative approach.** You write maintainable code, test important behavior, ask for review, and communicate trade\-offs. You can take ownership of a scoped problem while recognizing when to seek help. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** ---------------------------------------------- * Experience with experiment tracking, evaluation pipelines, workflow orchestration, or model observability using tools such as MLflow, Langfuse, or Temporal. * Experience with infrastructure as code, container orchestration, or telemetry tooling, such as Terraform, Kubernetes, or OpenTelemetry. * Experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes: job queueing and preemption multi\-node training with NCCL over EFA or InfiniBand, GPU node health and driver management, or serving models with vLLM or SGLang. * Experience implementing authentication, role\-based access, API\-key management, image provenance, LLM gateways, usage and cost tracking or hardening public endpoints. * Experience adapting open\-source software or building developer tools that other engineers or researchers use regularly. You don’t need experience with every system listed above. Strong software engineering fundamentals, practical problem\-solving, and an interest in DevOps and MLOps matter more than matching every tool.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Race Operation Systems

You build the software that moves that information: the pipelines that pull data off the car, out of the simulation, and in from the sanctioning body, and the internal apps our engineers open on a race weekend. Git, automated tests, repeatable deployments. * Research and recommend software, and sometimes hardware to achieve project goals * Carry several projects at once and tell people plainly what is shipping and when. * BS in Computer Science * At least 3 years building software, backend preferred. **What we need** ---------------- * Ability to design complex systems at scale * Strong with REST APIs, SQL, and S3\-style object storage. * Python required. The person in this seat builds the foundation that group runs on. If you want your code to show up in a race result, this is the job. You should be proficient in: * Professional motorsports * REST APIs * S\-3\-style object storage * Software building experience * SQL * Python Machines \& technologies you'll use: * Microsoft Azure * Plotly * Polars * Matplotlib

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer (Audio/ML) - Skywalker Sound
jobs.description: The Skywalker Sound Development Group is seeking an experienced Data Engineer with a focus on Audio/ML to specialize in the creation, management, and optimization of data pipelines to support cutting\-edge AI/ML research. This is a critical role in preparing high\-quality datasets for the training, retraining, and evaluation of machine learning models tailored to immersive and multichannel audio applications. As a Data Engineer (Audio/ML), you will focus on developing robust pipelines for processing complex media datasets, enabling AI/ML researchers to build transformative solutions for speech processing, style transfer, and source separation. Your work will directly contribute to creating innovative soundtrack workflows for global media production. *This role is considered Hybrid, which means the employee will work 2\-3 days onsite at our Nicasio, CA office and occasionally from home.* **What You'll Do** * Design, implement, and maintain scalable, automated data pipelines for the ingestion, preprocessing, and transformation of large\-scale audio datasets. * Ensure pipelines support efficient model training and retraining workflows, enabling continuous improvement of AI/ML models. * Collaborate with AI/ML researchers to define data requirements and integrate feedback to improve data pipeline functionality. * Develop advanced preprocessing techniques for immersive and multichannel audio formats (e.g., Dolby Atmos, high\-order ambisonics). * Automate data cleaning, normalization, and augmentation processes to prepare datasets for various model architectures, including foundational models and transformers. * Integrate external datasets and APIs while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical data usage standards. * Monitor and optimize pipeline performance to handle complex and dynamic data structures effectively. * Create tools and workflows for annotating, labeling, and curating datasets, including the use of active learning methods. * Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover trends, validate dataset quality, and identify data gaps. **What We’re Looking For** * Master’s Degree with preference for PhD in Data Engineering/Science, Computer Science, Signal Processing, or a related field. * 8\+years of experience in data engineering or data science with a focus on building pipelines for AI/ML applications. * Proficiency in Python, with expertise in data manipulation libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and PyTorch’s data utilities. * Hands\-on experience with audio processing libraries and tools (e.g., Librosa, FFmpeg, SoX) for handling complex audio formats. * Familiarity with scalable pipeline tools like GitLab, Apache Spark, Airflow, or Luigi, and experience with containerized workflows (Docker, Kubernetes). * Strong understanding of data pipeline requirements for model training, retraining, and evaluation in iterative research workflows. * Experience with immersive and multichannel audio formats. * Knowledge of cloud\-based platforms and tools for storage and processing, such as AWS S3, Redshift, or Google BigQuery. * Strong problem\-solving skills, with a proactive mindset for addressing evolving data challenges. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience integrating data pipelines with AI/ML workflows, including active learning and model retraining. * Familiarity with audio\-specific datasets and metadata management strategies. * Knowledge of machine learning principles and how data quality impacts model performance. * Experience with distributed training pipelines and large\-scale dataset processing. * Contributions to open\-source projects or published research in the fields of data science or audio processing. * Experience with visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Matplotlib) for quality assurance and exploratory data analysis. * Expertise in designing systems to support AI/ML model monitoring and retraining over time. The hiring range for this position in Nicasio, CA is $173,100\.00 to $232,100\.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. **Disclaimer** This position is with Lucasfilm Ent Co Ltd, LLC Payroll Svc, which is part of a business we call Skywalker Sound. jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description: **BLT**(**Board Level Functional Test ) Engineer****Level:** E4 Taylor, Tx/ Georgetown, Tx (Onsite) **About Compal USA Technology** **Compal USA Technology** is a leading advanced manufacturing company specializing in the production of next\-generation AI servers, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise technology solutions. With rapidly expanding operations in Taylor and Georgetown TX, we are investing more than $235 million in manufacturing infrastructure and creating up to 1,500 careers in Central Texas. Guided by our commitment to ***Building Tomorrow***, we combine innovation, operational excellence, and a high\-performance culture to shape the future of technology manufacturing **Role Overview:** The BLT(**Board Level Functional Test )**Engineer owns the development, validation, release, and sustaining of Board Level Functional Test (BLT) solutions for printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) supporting AI server manufacturing — including functional test strategy, test software development, fixture integration, production release, and continuous yield improvement. Working closely with Product Design, Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Quality Engineering, and New Product Introduction (NPI) teams, this role ensures robust functional validation, manufacturing readiness, and scalable production test solutions. **Key Responsibilities:****Board Level Functional Test Development*** Define board\-level functional test strategy and architecture for new AI server programs. * Develop, validate, and release Board Level Functional Test (BLT) programs. * Develop automated functional test sequences and pass/fail criteria. * Design, integrate, and validate functional test stations and fixtures. * Optimize test coverage and cycle time. * Support production test release and engineering documentation. **Test Software Development*** Develop automated test applications using NI TestStand and LabVIEW. * Develop software modules using Python and C/C\+\+ where applicable. * Integrate instrumentation, DAQ, and communication interfaces. * Debug and validate test software throughout NPI and production. **Hardware Validation*** Validate board functionality including power sequencing, DDR, PCIe, Ethernet, NVMe, BIOS, BMC, and firmware. * Support board bring\-up and engineering validation. * Troubleshoot hardware, firmware, and software related failures. **Liquid Cooling (LC) Validation*** Validate coolant distribution unit (CDU), cold plate, and manifold/QD integration on board\-level test stations. * Support leak detection and coolant pressure/flow validation during functional test. * Coordinate pre\- and post\-cold\-plate test sequencing with Mechanical/Thermal Engineering. * Troubleshoot thermal and liquid\-cooling\-related failures during board bring\-up and functional validation. **Production \& NPI Support*** Support EVT, DVT, PVT, pilot builds, and production ramp. * Support ECO implementation and product revisions. * Provide technical support to manufacturing during production. **Failure Analysis \& Continuous Improvement*** Perform Root Cause Analysis using 8D, 5 Why, and Fishbone methodologies. * Drive First Pass Yield (FPY), yield, and cycle time improvements. * Implement Statistical Process Control (SPC) and continuous improvement initiatives. **Preferred Qualifications:*** Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Computer, or Manufacturing Engineering. * 3\-5\+ years of experience developing board\-level functional test solutions in high\-volume electronics manufacturing (E3\); 6\+ years, including multi\-program or cross\-site scope, for E4\. * Experience with AI servers, networking, or enterprise computing platforms preferred. * Hands\-on experience with NI TestStand, LabVIEW, PXI instrumentation, and automated functional test systems. * Experience validating liquid\-cooled (LC) server platforms, including CDU, cold plate, and coolant hardware, is a plus. * Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional technical discussions and communicate effectively with Product Design, NPI, and manufacturing leadership. * Experience with data analysis/reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau is a plus. **Why Join Compal ?** At Compal, you’ll have the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge server technologies powering AI, cloud computing, and hyperscale infrastructure. You’ll join a rapidly growing manufacturing environment where innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence drive everything we do. This is more than a manufacturing role — it’s an opportunity to help shape the future of advanced technology production in the United States. \#BuildingTomorrow

jobs.title: Wastewater Design Engineer / Project Engineer
jobs.description: About INFRASTRUCTURE DYNAMICS INFRASTRUCTURE DYNAMICS is a next\-generation engineering, manufacturing, and infrastructure solutions company working to transform how water and wastewater systems are designed, built, and delivered. Our systems include modular wastewater treatment plants, pump stations, process equipment, and related infrastructure \- all developed with a focus on practical innovation, reliable performance, and sustainable water management. We are growing quickly and seeking individuals who are energized by solving water/wastewater infrastructure and environmental challenges and seeing the results of their work in the field. Our long\-term mission is bigger than any one project: help modernize water and wastewater infrastructure, improve the way systems are built and operated, and ultimately take better infrastructure solutions to communities that need them. Our goal is not simply to manufacture individual pieces of equipment. We are building a model around fully integrated water and wastewater infrastructure solutions — bringing engineering, equipment, fabrication, project execution, startup, and technical support together under one organization. Learn more about our mission, culture, and careers opportunities at INFRASTRUCTURE DYNAMICS We're building a company for people who want to challenge conventional approaches, solve difficult water and wastewater infrastructure challenges, work across disciplines, and see the direct impact of what they create. If you're looking for an organization where engineering, manufacturing, technology, water resource management and environmental stewardship come together — and where your work can directly influence how infrastructure is designed, built, and operated — INFRASTRUCTURE DYNAMICS may be the place for you. The Opportunity **What if engineering didn't stop at the drawing?** For many engineers, the traditional consulting model creates distance between the person designing a system and the system that ultimately gets built. You may develop calculations, specifications, plans, and drawings — but have limited opportunity to participate in fabrication, manufacturing, construction, startup, or operation. **This role is different.** At INFRASTRUCTURE DYNAMICS, our engineers work across the full lifecycle of the systems we develop — from concept and process design through detailed 3D engineering, fabrication, manufacturing, installation, startup, commissioning, and operation. You'll have the opportunity to see your designs become physical infrastructure, work directly with the people building and installing them, identify what works and what doesn't, and carry those lessons directly back into the next generation of our products and systems. You'll also have an opportunity to help shape the engineering systems, design tools, standards, and technical knowledge base that will support INFRASTRUCTURE DYNAMICS as we scale. We're looking for an engineer who enjoys water and wastewater engineering but wants to be **closer to the outcome — not just the design**. Someone who doesn't just want to ask: **“Does the design work on paper?”** but also: **“Can we build it efficiently? Can we install it reliably? Can we operate and maintain it? And how can we make the next one better?”** If you've spent your career designing infrastructure and have ever wanted to follow that design all the way through fabrication, construction, startup, and operation, **this may be the opportunity you've been looking for.** At INFRASTRUCTURE DYNAMICS, engineering doesn't end when the drawings are issued. **Concept → Design → Fabrication → Manufacturing → Installation → Commissioning → Operation → Continuous Improvement** Key Responsibilities * Perform engineering and design for wastewater treatment systems, pump stations, and related infrastructure. * Develop equipment layouts, piping arrangements, mechanical assemblies, fabrication details, and system configurations. * Create and modify detailed 3D models using Autodesk Inventor. * Develop fabrication\-ready drawing packages. * Prepare and review bills of materials, equipment schedules, and material takeoffs. * Translate approved project submittals into detailed production designs. * Coordinate pumps, blowers, piping, valves, tanks, instrumentation, controls, structural components, and ancillary equipment. * Review designs for constructability, manufacturability, maintainability, and completeness. * Help define logical fabrication and assembly sequences. * Coordinate technical questions from fabrication partners and field personnel. * Identify drawing, BOM, or design gaps before they become production problems. * Review vendor drawings and equipment information. * Participate in project design reviews and engineering QA/QC. * Support project submittal development and technical responses. * Assist procurement by establishing accurate equipment and material requirements. * Provide technical support during installation, startup, and commissioning when needed. * Help develop and improve standardized design methods, templates, libraries, and engineering automation. * Work with senior engineering staff to continuously improve INFRASTRUCTURE DYNAMICS' design\-to\-production processes. Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Civil, Environmental, Mechanical, Chemical, or a related engineering discipline. * Approximately 6\-8 years of relevant engineering experience, preferably involving wastewater treatment plants, pump stations, or process/mechanical systems. * Strong water/wastewater engineering experience. * Strong 3D mechanical\-design capabilities. * Experience with Autodesk Inventor, or substantial comparable parametric 3D CAD experience with the ability to transition quickly to Inventor. * Experience preparing detailed engineering and fabrication drawings. * Understanding of pumps, piping, valves, process equipment, instrumentation, and mechanical systems. * Ability to interpret plans, specifications, P\&IDs, equipment submittals, and vendor drawings. * Experience developing or reviewing bills of materials. * Strong technical problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Ability to manage multiple active projects and priorities. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. Particularly Valuable Experience * Municipal wastewater treatment or decentralized/packaged treatment systems. * Pump stations / lift stations and pumping systems. * Process piping and equipment skids. * Plastic fabrication, HDPE, or polypropylene systems. * Design\-for\-manufacturing and fabrication drawing development. * Instrumentation, controls, and PLC/control\-panel coordination. * Startup, commissioning, construction, or field engineering. * Autodesk Inventor\-based engineering workflows. Professional Licensure Professional Engineer licensure is preferred but not required. Relevant wastewater experience, technical capability, strong design skills, and the ability to develop fabrication\-ready systems are particularly important for this position. Location \& Work Arrangement This position may be based in the Salem / Roanoke Valley or Blacksburg / New River Valley areas in Virginia. INFRASTRUCTURE DYNAMICS is also open to a remote or hybrid work arrangement for the right candidate, particularly an experienced engineer who can work effectively within a collaborative engineering and project\-delivery environment. Because this position directly supports fabrication, production, field implementation, and customers, remote employees should expect periodic travel for project coordination, fabrication reviews, site visits, commissioning, and internal engineering/production meetings. How to Apply Interested? We would like to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a brief description of your relevant wastewater and 3D design experience to Careers@infrastructure\-dynamics.com. *INFRASTRUCTURE DYNAMICS is an equal opportunity employer.* Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Paid time off * Relocation assistance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Salem, VA 24153

jobs.title: Staff Systems Engineer - Camera
jobs.description: **About 1X** We're building humanoid robots that work in home \- doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. Simple, but it's not. To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, manufacturing \- at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe enough to live with your family. If you're inspired by this, you'll thrive here. We've been at this since 2014 and we're at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the hard work is in front of us. NEO is our flagship \- a home robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We're not demoing it \- we're shipping it. We're excited to meet you, if this excites you. If you've spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world \- this is that moment. We're scaling, we're hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time \- safely creating abundance for all. **About the Team** The Core team builds and owns the core C\+\+ infrastructure that NEO’s entire stack runs on, from sensor pipelines, motor control interfaces, networking, inter\-process communication, and the foundational libraries that ship on every robot. Our code executes thousands of times per second on hardware moving through the real world, and its correctness and performance directly determines what every other team can build and ship. If you want to work on the systems layer that makes physical AI possible at scale, this is that team. **Your Charter** Own the camera stack NEO sees through, from the sensor and lens selected for the robot to the calibrated, rectified frames every perception model consumes. This is critical\-path work: no vision model is better than the images it is handed, and nothing downstream survives a camera that is miscalibrated, badly tuned, or quietly dropping frames. You will own that path from vendor selection through end\-of\-line calibration on the production line and out to robots already working in homes. **Key Outcomes** * Own camera selection end to end: define sensor, lens, and module requirements with the hardware and perception teams, run the trade studies, and carry a choice through vendor engagement and bring\-up on real hardware * Deliver a camera pipeline that holds up in production: sensor drivers, multi\-camera synchronization and timestamping, and frame delivery that meets its latency budget without dropping frames or destabilizing timestamps * Tune the image path for machines rather than for people: exposure, white balance, and dynamic range chosen so perception models are accurate in real homes, including the low light and hard backlight a living room actually presents * Make calibration a production process, not a lab procedure: intrinsics and extrinsics calibrated on the line inside cycle time, validated automatically, monitored for drift across the fleet, and recoverable in the field **Key Competencies** * **Camera systems depth** understanding sensors, optics, and ISP as one system, and how an image travels a robotics stack from capture through transport, compression, and transformation to the model that consumes it * **Lives at the hardware boundary** debugging across MIPI CSI\-2, serdes links, I2C, PoE, and power and clock sequencing, and treating dropped frames, timestamp instability, and bandwidth limits as everyday failure modes rather than mysteries * **Calibration rigor** treating calibration as measurement with error bars, reasoning about tolerances and uncertainty, and knowing how a calibration error propagates into what a perception model gets wrong * **Thinks in fleets, not units** designing calibration and diagnostics that survive a production line at volume and robots already in homes, not just a bench with a careful operator **Minimum Requirements** * 5\+ years shipping camera or imaging software in production systems: robotics, autonomous vehicles, consumer devices, or AR and VR * Hands\-on experience bringing up image sensors on embedded Linux, including V4L2, MIPI CSI\-2, and the driver and device tree work that comes with it * Demonstrated experience with camera intrinsic and extrinsic calibration, including validating calibration quality rather than trusting a solver's output * Strong C\+\+ in performance\-critical systems, with the profiling and debugging habits to find where frames and milliseconds actually go **Preferred Skills** * Experience with ISP tuning and image quality evaluation, especially where the consumer is a perception model rather than a person * Experience taking calibration into manufacturing: fixture and station design, cycle time, yield, and failure analysis on build data * Familiarity with CUDA or GPU image processing and zero\-copy image transport between processes * Background in multi\-camera synchronization, stereo rectification, or camera\-IMU time alignment **What does a successful 1X Team Member look like** Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it's the one thing you can't get back \- because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect. **Compensation** $230K \- $285K Base \+ Equity **Benefits** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Generous paid time off, company holidays, and parental leave * 401(k) plan with company match (100% on the first 3% of contributions, 50% on the next 2%) * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) options * Commuter benefits (transit and parking) * Short\-term and long\-term disability, and life insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health, financial, and personal support * Onsite snacks and catered lunches **Equal Opportunity Employer** 1X is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, disability, military or veteran status, justice system impact, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Compensation Range: $230K \- $300K

jobs.description: For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. AiroQ generates test scenarios for IATA NDC APIs, producing tests that can be executed through SoapUI and integrated into modern engineering and QA workflows. The platform can be accessed through AI development assistants such as Claude Code, Kiro, and Windsurf using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), as well as through REST APIs. test cases and test data. * Implement API contracts, schemas, and runtime validation using OpenAPI and Zod. * Build integrations with AI development tools and assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Develop and maintain support for IATA NDC 17\.2 and 24\.1 API workflows. * Generate and validate XML/SOAP requests and responses for NDC testing. * Develop automated validations using XPath, Groovy, and SoapUI. * Design and maintain AWS\-based services using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, ECS Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, and CloudWatch. * Implement secure authentication and authorization using OAuth 2\.0, JWT, and Amazon Cognito. * Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation. * Implement logging, monitoring, error handling, and observability for production services. * Collaborate with QA engineers, developers, architects, and product teams to translate business and API requirements into automated testing capabilities. * Contribute to engineering standards, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and platform reliability. **Required Qualifications** * Strong software development experience with TypeScript and Node.js. * Experience designing and implementing REST APIs. * Strong understanding of API contracts, schemas, validation, and error handling. * Experience developing cloud\-native applications on AWS. * Experience with services such as Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, and CloudWatch. * Understanding of OAuth 2\.0, JWT, and API authentication/authorization. * Experience working with structured data formats including XML and JSON. * Strong understanding of automated testing and software quality practices. * Experience with Git\-based development workflows, code reviews, and CI/CD. * Ability to troubleshoot distributed applications and independently analyze complex technical problems. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI\-assisted development tools. * Experience building applications or tools using LLMs or generative AI. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock or Bedrock AgentCore. * Knowledge of IATA NDC, particularly versions 17\.2 and 24\.1\. * Experience with airline shopping, pricing, booking, servicing, or order\-management APIs. * Experience with SOAP, XML Schema/XSD, XPath, and SoapUI. * Experience writing Groovy scripts for SoapUI automation and validation. * Experience building test\-generation frameworks or API testing platforms. * Experience with Zod and OpenAPI. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly AWS CloudFormation. Technical Stack Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, MCP, REST, OpenAPI, Zod AI / Agent Integration: Model Context Protocol (MCP), Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AI coding assistants NDC \& Testing: IATA NDC 17\.2 / 24\.1, XML, SOAP, SoapUI, XPath, Groovy AWS: ECS Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, Bedrock AgentCore Infrastructure: AWS CloudFormation **What Success Looks Like** The engineer in this role will help evolve AiroQ into a scalable AI\-powered testing platform that enables engineering and QA teams to generate reliable NDC API test cases quickly, execute them through existing testing workflows, and increasingly incorporate automated testing into the software development lifecycle. Success will be measured by the quality and reliability of generated tests, expansion of NDC workflow coverage, platform stability and scalability, and adoption of AiroQ across engineering and QA teams. **What do we offer?** · Open culture and challenging opportunity to satisfy intellectual needs · Flexible working hours · Smart working: hybrid remote/office working environment · Work\-life balance · Excellent, dynamic and multicultural environment **About Accelya** Accelya is a leading global software provider to the airline industry, powering 200\+ airlines with an open, modular software platform that enables innovative airlines to drive growth, delight their customers and take control of their retailing. Owned by Vista Equity Partners long\-term perennial fund and with 2K\+ employees based around 10 global offices, Accelya are trusted by industry leaders to deliver now and deliver for the future. The company´s passenger, cargo, and industry platforms support airline retailing from offer to settlement, both above and below the wing. Accelya are proud to deliver leading\-edge technologies to our customers including through our partnership with AWS and through the pioneering NDC expertise of our Global Product teams. We are proud to enable innovation\-led growth for the airline industry and put control back in the hands of airlines. For more information, please visit www.accelya.com What does the future of the air transport industry look like to you? Whether you’re an industry veteran or someone with experience from other industries, we want to make your ambitions a reality!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Activated Insights, a Software\-as\-a\- Service (“SaaS”) leader in long\-term and post\-acute care, is hiring a **Senior Software Engineer**. Founded in 2008, Activated Insights is a software company serving North America’s fastest\-growing labor market—long\-term and post\-acute senior care. As the market leader, our technology, surveys, and training solutions are used by everything from mom\-and\-pop small businesses to billion\-dollar care organizations. Ultimately, our services impact the lives of hundreds of thousands of seniors every year. Today, with over 250 team members and over 7,000 customers that extend into over 23,000 sites of care, our products focus on employee engagement, ongoing education, resident and patient satisfaction surveys, and reputation management tools. **What Sets Activated Insights Apart:** We are at the heart of the healthcare industry's most dynamic sector, with an ever\-growing demand for post\-acute care and long\- term care to address the fastest growing segment of the US population. Our bond with healthcare providers draws compassionate, service\-driven team members, fostering a spirited, collaborative culture aligned on our mission to deliver exceptional experiences for our employees, our customers and the people in their care. A high performing executive leadership team with success in both public and PE companies, primarily in high\-growth companies focused on the long term and post\-acute care market. Backed by a private investment firm with 40\+ years of experience forging lasting partnerships across the healthcare industry. Why Is This Role So Special? The **Senior Software Engineer** will lead the engineering efforts with focus on improving employee and customer engagement in a high growth SaaS company. This role combines technical leadership with hands\-on development responsibilities. You will own the end\-to\-end software lifecycle \- from requirements gathering and system design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance. **What You’ll Do:** * Architect, design, deliver and maintain complex software solutions using various technologies: PHP, MySQL, AWS, Kubernetes. * Own all phases of the software development lifecycle: requirements gathering, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance * Implement DevOps best practices—CI/CD automation, IaC with Terraform, observability, and deployment to AWS (EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3\). * Apply AI\-driven development tools to optimize coding, testing, and documentation workflows. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Design, Data, and Security teams to align technical direction with company objectives. * Foster an engineering culture of learning, innovation, and ownership aligned with Activated Insights’ mission and values * Drive engineering objectives and KPIs across product delivery, team performance, software quality, and system security. * Champion security\-first development, enforcing secure coding, encryption, and threat\-aware deployment pipelines. * Effective communicator in remote work settings, with strong presence in virtual meetings and the ability to collaborate across time zones and functions * Lead sprint planning, task estimation, and delivery tracking to meet project milestones and product release schedules * Encourage and collaborative, respectful team environment that values knowledge sharing, innovation, and accountability **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of full\-stack software engineering experience, including hands\-on development with the Laravel framework * Proven expertise in PHP, MySQL, and JavaScript with frameworks such as Laravel. * Deep experience with cloud\-architecture, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines. AWS, Kubernetes, or security certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, CKA, CISSP) are a plus. * Experience working with REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP integrations, and scalable cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS) * Knowledge of secure authentication and authorization standards such as OpenID Connect (OIDC) and SAML * Proven track record delivering cloud\-native applications at scale in Agile environments * Ability to drive performance against team KPIs (delivery velocity, code quality, security, and uptime) * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools: Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc * Excellent collaboration and communication skills with a history of working effectively across teams and with external stakeholders * Self\-motivated, passionate about software development, and comfortable working independently in a remote\-first environment * Strong proficiency in writing, optimizing, and debugging complex SQL queries outside of ORM frameworks (e.g., Eloquent), including deep understanding of joins, aggregate functions, subqueries, indexing strategies, and query performance tuning. **Location:** * Remote in Florida, Idaho, Georgia, Utah, Texas, Minnesota, or North Carolina * This role may require occasional travel, including participation in company\-sponsored engineering offsites and training sessions, which are typically held 1–2 times per year.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: ### **Who We Are** We are a fast\-growing vertical SaaS company leveraging innovation and disruptive technologies to improve consumer experiences, outcomes, and predictability within the plastic surgery industry. Our team thrives on challenges, embraces change, and is dedicated to transforming how the industry operates. Our platform is what aesthetic medicine and plastic surgery practices run their business on, covering scheduling, clinical records, forms and consents, invoicing and payments, patient communications, and the marketing that sits in front of all of it. It is a multi\-tenant platform holding millions of patient records under HIPAA and GDPR, and we onboard new practices every month. **While we are a remote\-first company, we are currently only able to hire candidates located in the following U.S. states: CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MN, OK, OR, PA, RI, TX, UT, and WA. We hope to expand to additional states in the future.** ### **Who We’re Looking For** We are builders, and our managers build too. Leaders here write code, ship pull requests and review their team’s work every week, all the way up to the Head of Engineering. A manager owns a team’s outcomes from the first conversation to production: what ships, how well it works, and how the people who build it grow. We build with AI as the default, and our managers lead it by doing it. You stay current on how the best teams engineer with AI, try new tools and practices in your own work first, and bring to your team the ones that earn their place. As a Senior Software Engineering Manager you lead a product engineering team that works directly on the workflows our clinics run every day. You hire, coach and level engineers against a published bar, and you turn product intent into a plan the team believes in. You also take real work in the codebase: features, fixes and the hard reviews. Senior engineers follow you because they have seen your code. **Responsibilities** **Leading the team** * Lead a team of software engineers across time zones: one\-on\-ones, feedback, growth plans and performance conversations, held to the same bar for everyone. * Hire for the team and shape the hiring bar with the Head of Engineering. * Make quality the whole team’s job: reviews that teach, tests that mean something, and production behaviour the team watches as closely as its tickets. **Delivery** * Own the team’s delivery from problem to production, including planning, estimation, risk and release readiness. * Partner with product management to shape work before it starts, so stories arrive clear and the team builds the right thing the first time. * Lead incident response for your team’s systems and make sure every incident leaves the platform safer than it found it. **Building with AI, and leading by example** * Ship code yourself every week: features, fixes and improvements to the team’s tooling, built with coding agents. * Review the team’s pull requests and teach through them, holding AI\-drafted work to the same bar as any other. * Stay current on AI engineering practice, test new tools and workflows in your own work, and roll out what proves itself to your team and across the organization. * Grow the engineers who will lead after you. **Requirements** * 8\+ years building production software, including 3\+ years managing software engineers directly, with responsibility for hiring and performance. * You still write and ship production code as a manager, with C\# and .NET experience. * Angular, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes and AWS are a strong plus. * Daily use of coding agents in your own engineering work, and experience rolling AI engineering practices out to a team. * Teams that built or operated systems under HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2 or comparable regulation. * Experience leading distributed teams across time zones. * Written and spoken communication that works across time zones and with colleagues whose first language is not English. (Most of our engineers are in Latin America.) **Benefits** ### **What We Offer** At Adoreal, we believe in supporting our team’s well\-being and growth through comprehensive benefits and a collaborative, people\-first culture. As a globally remote company, we prioritize flexibility, inclusivity, and teamwork rooted in the Adoreal principles. **Benefits \& Perks:** * **Healthcare coverage** for you and your family * **401k Plan** * **Paid time off (PTO)** and **paid holidays** * **Company equity opportunities** * **Fully remote work environment** with flexible schedules * **Collaborative and thriving team culture** guided by Adoreal’s core values ### **Why Adoreal?** Joining Adoreal means becoming part of a high\-performing, ambitious team that works hard, achieves extraordinary results, and enjoys the rewards that follow. Every employee receives equity, aligning us all in our shared success. Promotions and growth opportunities are limitless, driven only by your performance and dedication to our core principles: * We do what is best for the company, not what is best for individuals of the company—we take pride in our work, but not in pride itself—the success of Adoreal is more important than our egos. * We always share relevant information and admit our mistakes freely and openly (even when it is worrisome or uncomfortable to do so). Candid communication and a solution\-oriented mindset is rewarded. * We innovate by finding the right problems, then solving them. We thrive on change that minimizes complexity and improves situations for our stakeholders. * We incentivize efficient results \& people over process and focus only on the work that creates the most value for our stakeholders. * We are quietly confident and openly humble, being tenacious in our quest to perform and inspire others with our thirst for excellence. * We do not bow up and knock down—we care about our teammates and treat all of them with respect, regardless of their level within the company. * We are steadfast in our pursuit to better our company, our colleagues, and ourselves. When we hire, we only hire people who bleed our principles and who will hopefully be our replacement one day. At this time, Adoreal is not offering visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must have current and valid authorization to work in the country where they are applying. We comply with all applicable employment and immigration laws, including U.S. regulations, and encourage applicants to verify their work authorization status before applying. Adoreal is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and fair workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable U.S. law (EEOC) or local employment regulations where we operate. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. Accommodations for disabilities are available upon request throughout the recruitment process. \*We are not working with search firms for this role, thank you\* **Recruitment Fraud Notice** Adoreal has become aware of fraudulent job offers being sent by people falsely claiming to represent us. To protect yourself: * Verify the sender's email address matches our official domain before responding. * Be cautious of offers that come with no prior application or interview process. * Never share personal details, banking information, or Social Security numbers as part of a job offer or interview. * Legitimate offers will never ask you to pay money upfront for equipment, training, or onboarding. * If something feels off — urgency, poor grammar, unusual payment requests — trust your instincts and pause before responding. If you receive a suspicious email or offer claiming to be from Adoreal, please don't respond to it directly. Report it as spam through your email provider and reach out to us at **Hello@adoreal.com** with any concerns.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Workload Safety)
jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. Affirm's engineering team is building a large\-scale, highly available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis. Affirm runs its workloads on more than 85 Amazon EKS clusters, and the number is growing. The Workload Safety team creates one set of standards for how workloads are configured and run, so Affirm can grow globally and still meet its availability and latency SLOs. The team identifies the industry best practices Affirm needs, drives their adoption across every engineering team on EKS, and enforces them through policy and automation so new workloads comply by default. As a senior engineer on the team, you will help set its roadmap, decide which standards matter most, and build a repeatable way to take each standard from research to enforcement across the fleet. **What you'll do** * Define and evolve workload safety standards for Affirm's EKS fleet, such as CPU and memory settings, workload isolation and placement, tolerance for disruption, graceful termination to name a few * Own each standard end to end: research and prototyping, white\-glove onboarding for early adopters, self\-service guidance for everyone else, and automation and policy guardrails that keep every workload compliant from day one * Lead cross\-team initiatives from design through fleet\-wide rollout, mentor other engineers, and set a high bar for design, code review, and operational readiness * Isolate workloads by criticality and resource profile so one misbehaving workload cannot degrade critical paths such as checkout * Fix stuck workloads and node lifecycle problems, such as pods that ignore termination signals, pod disruption budgets that block node cycling, and Karpenter timeouts that prevent bin packing and the removal of excess capacity * Determine the safe operating limits of each cluster (pod count, node count, API server request volume), keep clusters within them, and develop control plane scaling patterns for bursty workloads such as scheduled batch jobs and large deployments * Analyze workload resource profiles across the fleet (CPU, memory, disk, network) to guide EC2 instance type strategy, and automate that analysis as workloads change * Measure each standard's impact on availability, latency, risk, and cost, and use the results to prioritize the roadmap * Participate in on\-call for Kubernetes runtime issues across the fleet, and turn recurring failure patterns into roadmap items * Work closely with the teams that run services, batch jobs, and ML workloads on EKS, and with the deployment, capacity, and SRE teams * Keep up with new best practices from the Kubernetes community and adapt them to Affirm's needs **What we look for** * 5\+ years of experience running Kubernetes in production at scale, ideally Amazon EKS across many clusters * Deep understanding of Kubernetes resource management and scheduling: requests and limits, OOM and CPU throttling behavior, affinity and anti\-affinity, taints and tolerations, and topology spread constraints * Solid grasp of the pod lifecycle and disruption management, including graceful termination, pod disruption budgets, and node draining * Experience enforcing configuration standards through admission control and policy\-as\-code (for example, OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno) * Proficiency in Go or Python, including building production infrastructure software such as Kubernetes controllers, operators, or admission webhooks * Strong production debugging skills and a demonstrated ability to turn recurring incidents into systemic fixes * Track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple teams, driving adoption of shared standards, and mentoring other engineers * Experience quantifying the impact of infrastructure changes on availability, latency, and cost * Strong written communication, including standards and guidance that teams can adopt on their own * This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field. Pay Grade \- N Equity Grade \- 9 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job\-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195000 \- $255000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173000 \- $233000 \#LI\-Remote **Remote\-first with flexibility built in** Affirm is proud to be a remote\-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in\-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office\-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in\-person onboarding experience. **Benefits designed for you** Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: * Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. * Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. * Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. * Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We're committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we're happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description: Aline is building the resident lifecycle platform for senior living: one record that follows every resident from first inquiry through end of life. As part of our Data Platform team, you will build the data foundation behind that vision, giving operators a canonical, reliable record of their residents and communities. This is not just about better dashboards. The models you build become the ground truth that AI agents reason over, the layer that will one day flag a resident at risk, recommend the next best action, and act on it, not just report on it after the fact. You are building the foundation that both humans and agents will rely on to drive better care, retention, and outcomes. What You'll Do * Own and extend our dbt models on Snowflake, following medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) patterns * Manage CDC\-based ingestion pipelines (Fivetran and similar tools) landing data from transactional systems into Snowflake * Broaden Snowflake and dbt models to become the semantic layer for our reporting and analytics, evolving existing logic out of point tools like Power BI and into a single, governed source of truth * Build reliable, well\-tested gold\-layer datasets that support BI reporting and downstream AI/agentic workloads * Apply data modeling best practices (star schemas, SCDs) to support multi\-tenant SaaS reporting needs * Collaborate cross\-functionally with data operations, platform engineering, product teams and others * Write dbt tests and documentation so models are trustworthy and self\-explanatory for downstream consumers * Monitor pipeline health and data freshness, and build alerting so issues surface before they reach a report or dashboard * Keep an eye on Snowflake warehouse usage and query performance, and tune models/warehouses as the data volume grows * Work directly with stakeholders in Product, Sales, and Customer Success to turn reporting requests into well\-modeled data * Support row\-level security and data access design so multi\-tenant customer data stays properly isolated What We're Looking For * Strong SQL fundamentals and hands\-on Snowflake experience * Production experience with dbt; building, testing, and maintaining models at scale * Experience with CDC pipelines and ELT tools like Fivetran * Familiarity with Power BI, ideally including semantic model / measures work * Understanding of medallion architecture and how gold\-layer data supports both BI and AI use cases * Experience working in a multi\-tenant SaaS environment strongly preferred * Comfortable with git\-based version control and CI/CD for analytics code (dbt/SQL changes reviewed and deployed like software) * Working knowledge of an orchestration tool (dbt Cloud, Airflow, Dagster, or similar) for scheduling and monitoring pipelines * Python for scripting and automation around data workflows * Strong communicator who can translate technical modeling decisions for non\-technical stakeholders * Comfortable in a lean team environment where you may own a problem end\-to\-end rather than a narrow slice of it * Bonus: exposure to data ontology/semantic modeling for AI/agentic workloads * Bonus: familiarity with healthcare data privacy considerations (e.g. HIPAA) given the clinical data our platform touches

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Model Customization and Optimization)
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Senior FDE) on the Custom Model and Optimization team, you are the technical lead embedded inside a strategic customer, accountable for building, optimizing, and running the custom generative AI models at the heart of their business. You set the technical direction for model customization and optimization engagements, deciding what to build, how to measure it, and how it reaches production. You combine the technical depth of an AWS senior engineer with the urgency of a startup builder, using your judgment and ownership to deliver measurable business outcomes in quality, latency, and cost. Senior FDEs work on the hardest problems where models meet systems: building domain foundation models, post\-training frontier\-scale open\-weight models with reinforcement learning, and migrating large training and inference workloads onto AWS Trainium. They take on problems where the business problem itself is ambiguous, define the approach, and break it into workstreams others can own. They make long\-term architectural trade\-offs, balance customer urgency against sustainable design, and are trusted by customer engineering leadership as a technical peer. They raise the bar for the team through design reviews, code reviews, mentorship, and hiring, and they shape how AWS builds. Key job responsibilities Lead the technical engagement: Embed with the customer as the technical lead for their model customization and optimization program, spanning multiple workstreams. Partner with customer engineering and product leadership to frame the business problem, define success metrics and the evaluation bar, and set technical roadmap that moves from proof of value to production. Communicate trade\-offs, risks, and results clearly to executives and engineers alike. Requires up to 25% travel. Define the customization strategy: Decide the right path to the customer's quality, latency, and cost targets — prompting, distillation, supervised fine\-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning (including RL with verifiable rewards and multi\-turn agentic RL), continued pre\-training, task\-specific adapters, or building a domain foundation model. Own the data strategy, synthetic data generation, and evaluation methodology that make those decisions defensible, and drive them to production for patterns such as coding agents, vertical foundation models, and multi\-adapter serving. Architect training and inference systems at scale: Design distributed training and RL post\-training systems for large dense and mixture\-of\-experts models using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, Megatron\-LM, Miles, and verl, and production inference architectures using engines such as SGLang and vLLM. Architect RL interaction harnesses using frameworks such as NeMo Gym and OpenEnv, defining how agent workflows, tools, environments, and reward functions connect to training and evaluation. Set parallelism, precision, and serving strategies that balance throughput, latency, memory, reliability, and cost per token, and ensure the designs hold up under production load. Lead optimization on AWS AI chips: Lead migrations of training and inference workloads to AWS Trainium using the AWS Neuron SDK. Diagnose performance and accuracy\-parity gaps against GPU baselines, direct kernel\-level optimization where it matters, and work with AWS Neuron and service teams to close capability gaps. Turn benchmark evidence into recommendations that shape customer infrastructure and capacity decisions. Lead, mentor, and raise the bar: Provide technical leadership to a team of FDEs and scientists on the engagement, breaking ambiguous problems into well\-scoped workstreams and unblocking others. Mentor FDE IIs on model systems design and production ownership. Lead design reviews, provide high\-judgment code review, and actively participate in hiring and interviewing. Multiply impact across AWS: Identify patterns across engagements and turn them into reusable fine\-tuning recipes, evaluation frameworks, benchmarking tools, and reference architectures adopted by other teams. Influence the roadmaps of AWS services, including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, and AWS Neuron, with field evidence. Identify and shape opportunities to expand model customization and optimization within your customer and across similar customers. Oversee engagement execution: Own the delivery plan, set milestones, track progress against deadlines, and ensure the quality and completeness of all deliverables. Hold yourself and the team accountable for commitments made to the customer, escalate risks early, and adjust scope or resources when timelines are at risk. About the team ABOUT AWS: Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. The GME Finance team is establishing a Fintech team to build and operate systems that provide both financial reporting and operational analytic capabilities to GME Finance teams. We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to drive the team’s data strategy and vision. The data engineer will be responsible for design and build of the data infrastructure for automated and scalable platforms to support the reporting and forecasting requirements of GME finance teams. The data engineer will also lead and execute projects that build scalable data and visualization frameworks from multiple operational and financial datasets. The GME Finance team currently has a multi\-year roadmap that aim to deliver automated reporting solutions, accelerate predictive forecasting, and interactive analytic tools for our finance analysts. This role requires an individual with excellent data modeling, data architecture design, analytic visualization, ML modeling, and software development skills. A successful candidate will have the flexibility to execute on business intelligence projects while considering optimal and efficient data architecture.
