jobs.title: Quality Engineer, AI & Test Automation
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY** --------------- * The Quality Engineer, AI \& Test Automation helps modernize BSWH’s quality approach by moving beyond traditional manual testing toward automation\-first, engineering\-integrated, and AI\-enabled quality practices. * This role designs, builds, executes, and maintains automated test suites, validation utilities, evaluation assets, and quality reporting that improve release confidence and speed of delivery across digital products, enterprise applications, and AI\-enabled use cases. * The role partners closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data \& Analytics, AI Foundation, Ontology, Security, Privacy, Clinical, Operations, and other delivery teams to define quality expectations early and embed quality practices throughout the development lifecycle. * This role is expected to combine strong testing discipline with technical skills, including automation, API validation, data validation, CI/CD integration, quality metrics, defect triage, and emerging AI\-enabled testing practices. * The Quality Engineer, AI \& Test Automation reports to the Director of Quality Engineering and helps establish reusable practices that support safe, reliable, efficient, and scalable delivery. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE ROLE** ----------------------------------- ### **Quality Engineering \& Test Strategy** * Develop test strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, and quality approaches for software and AI\-enabled capabilities in partnership with Product, Engineering, Architecture, and business stakeholders. * Translate requirements, user stories, workflows, APIs, data dependencies, and operational expectations into clear test scenarios and quality validation plans. * Identify quality risks early in the delivery lifecycle and recommend appropriate validation approaches, including automated, manual, exploratory, integration, regression, performance, accessibility, or AI\-specific evaluation methods. * Provide clear release\-readiness input based on test evidence, defect trends, quality metrics, risk assessment, and stakeholder expectations. ### **Test Automation \& Engineering Practices** * Design, build, maintain, and improve automated test suites for API, UI, integration, end\-to\-end, regression, data, and workflow validation. * Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and delivery workflows so quality signals are available earlier and more consistently throughout the development lifecycle. * Create reusable test data, utilities, fixtures, scripts, and automation patterns that can be used across multiple teams and products. * Improve test reliability, maintainability, execution time, coverage, and signal\-to\-noise ratio by reducing brittle scripts and eliminating repetitive manual validation where practical. ### **AI\-Enabled Testing \& Evaluation** * Support testing and evaluation of AI\-enabled experiences, including agent workflows, generated responses, retrieval behavior, tool/API calls, escalation paths, guardrail behavior, and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * Help define evaluation datasets, expected behaviors, failure modes, scoring rubrics, regression scenarios, and quality thresholds for AI\-enabled capabilities. * Use AI\-enabled testing tools where appropriate to generate test cases, analyze logs, triage defects, identify coverage gaps, summarize results, and accelerate quality workflows. * Partner with AI Quality, Architecture, Engineering, and Product teams to validate that AI\-enabled capabilities are useful, reliable, explainable enough for the use case, and aligned to defined quality expectations. ### **Defect Management, Root Cause \& Continuous Improvement** * Identify, document, reproduce, triage, and communicate defects with sufficient technical detail to support efficient resolution by engineering teams. * Analyze defect patterns, escaped defects, quality trends, release issues, and production feedback to identify root causes and improvement opportunities. * Collaborate with engineering teams to improve testability, observability, logging, error handling, and diagnostic capabilities across applications and AI\-enabled workflows. * Contribute to retrospectives, quality reviews, and process improvements that reduce rework, improve release confidence, and increase delivery velocity. ### **Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Release Readiness** * Work closely with Product Managers, Senior AI Product Managers, Software Engineers, AI Engineers, Data Product Owners, Architects, Designers, Clinical and Operational stakeholders, and vendors/partners to align on quality expectations and release readiness. * Ensure quality criteria are embedded in requirements, design reviews, backlog refinement, development, testing, implementation, and post\-release monitoring. * Support production validation, monitoring handoffs, post\-release assessment, incident follow\-up, and quality reporting for assigned products and use cases. * Communicate quality status, risks, defects, test r pect quality at the end. * Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain quality risks, evidence, tradeoffs, and release recommendations to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Comfort operating in a regulated or high\-trust environment where safety, privacy, security, compliance, auditability, and customer trust are critical. **BENEFITS** Our competitive benefits package includes the following* Immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits * 401(k) savings plan with dollar\-for\-dollar match up to 5% * Tuition Reimbursement * PTO accrual beginning Day 1 Note: Benefits may vary based upon position type and/or level **MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS** ------------------------ ### **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or related technical field. * Equivalent combination of education and relevant technical experience may be considered. ### **Experience** * 5–8\+ years of experience in quality engineering, software testing, test automation, SDET, software engineering, AI quality, or related technology delivery roles. * Hands\-on experience designing and implementing automated tests for APIs, web or mobile applications, workflows, data validation, integrations, or end\-to\-end product experiences. * Experience working with engineering teams in agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, or modern product\-delivery environments. * Experience with defect triage, root\-cause analysis, test evidence documentation, release readiness, and quality metrics. * Exposure to AI\-enabled products, machine learning systems, large language models, conversational experiences, agentic workflows, automation, or decision\-support technologies preferred. * Healthcare, life sciences, financial services, or other regulated\-industry experience preferred but not required. ### **Required Technical Expertise** * Strong understanding of software testing concepts, including test design, test coverage, functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, data validation, exploratory testing, and release validation. * Hands\-on experience with test automation frameworks, scripting, test data, CI/CD integration, and defect management tools. * Ability to validate APIs, backend services, user interfaces, data flows, workflows, and enterprise integrations. * Programming, scripting, or data analysis skills, preferably Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, SQL, or comparable languages used to build or maintain automated test assets. * Familiarity with AI\-enabled testing and evaluation concepts, including prompt/response validation, model\-output evaluation, RAG or retrieval testing, agent workflow testing, hallucination risk, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Ability to use logs, traces, telemetry, monitoring, dashboards, test artifacts, and production feedback to investigate quality issues. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), Quality Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, Software Quality Engineer, AI Quality Engineer, or similar technically oriented quality role. * Experience building or maintaining automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, PyTest, Postman/Newman, JUnit, TestNG, or comparable frameworks. * Experience testing AI agents, copilots, chatbots, LLM\-powered applications, workflow automation, RAG systems, tool\-calling workflows, or other AI\-enabled capabilities. * Experience creating evaluation suites, golden datasets, scoring rubrics, regression tests, synthetic test data, or quality dashboards for AI\-enabled systems. * Experience with cloud, APIs, microservices, event\-driven systems, data platforms, analytics, observability tools, or modern application architectures. * Experience supporting quality engineering transformation, reducing manual testing dependence, or introducing AI\-enabled testing practices into product teams.

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Manager
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY** =============== The Senior Data Product Manager is accountable for ensuring assigned enterprise data domains are ready to power BSWH’s priority AI use cases. This role owns the quality, reliability, availability, usability, and lifecycle management of data products required by AI product, engineering, ontology, analytics, and operational teams. This role partners closely with AI Product, Engineering, Data \& Analytics, Knowledge/Ontology, Architecture, Security, Privacy, Operations, and domain subject matter experts to translate AI use\-case needs into clear data product requirements, data contracts, quality expectations, latency requirements, remediation priorities, and operating commitments. The Senior Data Product Manager ensures that data required for AI\-enabled products is trusted, governed, discoverable, fit\-for\-purpose, and operationally sustainable. The role is a critical bridge between AI use\-case teams and the data organization, helping ensure that data domains consistently meet current and future AI delivery needs. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE ROLE** =================================== **Data Domain Management \& Product Strategy** ---------------------------------------------- * Manage specific set of data domains required to support BSWH’s AI use\-case roadmap and related customer, operational, clinical, financial, or enterprise workflows. * Define the product vision, roadmap, backlog, and success metrics for assigned AI\-ready data products and domains. * Translate AI use\-case needs into clear data product requirements, including data elements, definitions, source systems, availability expectations, freshness requirements, lineage needs, and quality standards. * Prioritize data work based on AI use\-case value, delivery urgency, dependency risk, quality gaps, operational impact, and feasibility. * Create a clear roadmap for improving assigned data domains so they can reliably support current and future AI\-enabled products. **AI Use Case Enablement** -------------------------- * Partner with AI Product Managers, engineering teams, data teams, ontology teams, and operational stakeholders to identify the data required to power each assigned AI use case. * Ensure required data elements are available, understood, governed, and fit for AI consumption before key delivery milestones. * Clarify data dependencies, gaps, risks, and remediation actions required to enable AI use\-case teams to deliver safely and effectively. * Support translation of jobs\-to\-be\-done, user stories, agent requirements, and product acceptance criteria into data product requirements. * Ensure data products can support AI workflows that may require timely retrieval, reliable lookups, secure access, source attribution, and operational consistency. **Data Quality, Reliability \& Remediation** -------------------------------------------- * Define and manage data quality expectations for assigned domains, including completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, availability, lineage, and usability. * Identify and prioritize data quality gaps that create risk for AI use cases, customer experience, operational workflows, or decision support. * Partner with data engineering, source system owners, analytics, governance, and operational teams to remediate data issues and improve domain reliability. * Establish mechanisms to monitor data quality, data freshness, availability, and reliability across assigned domains. * Ensure recurring data issues have clear ownership, escalation paths, root\-cause analysis, and sustainable remediation plans. **Data Contracts, Access \& Operational Commitments** ----------------------------------------------------- * Define and maintain data contracts for assigned domains, including data definitions, ownership, access patterns, refresh expectations, latency requirements, lineage expectations, and downstream consumption needs. * Partner with engineering and architecture teams to ensure data access patterns support AI use\-case requirements, including APIs, data products, semantic models, retrieval layers, and governed consumption paths. * Ensure data products are discoverable, documented, understandable, and usable by approved consumers across AI, product, engineering, analytics, and operational teams. * Help ensure assigned data products meet agreed expectations for availability, freshness, performance, scalability, security, privacy, and operational support. * Coordinate with governance and security stakeholders to ensure sensitive data is accessed and used appropriately. **Cross\-Functional Prioritization \& Stakeholder Alignment** ------------------------------------------------------------- * Serve as the primary product manager for assigned data domains, aligning stakeholders around data priorities, tradeoffs, dependencies, and delivery commitments. * Facilitate prioritization across competing AI use\-case needs, source system constraints, data engineering capacity, governan lity for health and welfare benefits * 401(k) savings plan with dollar\-for\-dollar match up to 5% * Tuition Reimbursement * PTO accrual beginning Day 1 *Note: Benefits may vary based upon position type and/or level.* #### **Belonging Statement** We believe that all people should feel welcomed, valued and supported. **MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS** ======================== **Education** ------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Healthcare Administration, Analytics, or related field. * Master’s degree preferred. **Experience** -------------- * 10–15 years of experience in data product management, data ownership, analytics, data governance, data engineering, product management, or related technology/data roles. * 5–10\+ years of experience owning data products, data domains, analytics products, data platforms, or data\-enabled business capabilities. * Experience working with cross\-functional teams to define data requirements, prioritize data work, resolve quality issues, and deliver reusable data products. * Experience with data quality, data lineage, metadata, data definitions, source system analysis, data contracts, data access patterns, and production data reliability. * Experience partnering with product, engineering, analytics, governance, security, privacy, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver complex data\-enabled outcomes. * Experience supporting AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, digital products, customer\-facing workflows, or operational decision\-support capabilities preferred. * Healthcare, life sciences, financial services, or other regulated\-industry experience strongly preferred. **Required Technical Expertise** -------------------------------- * Strong understanding of enterprise data products, data domains, data quality practices, data governance, data lineage, and data lifecycle management. * Familiarity with modern data platforms, APIs, data pipelines, semantic layers, data catalogs, data quality tooling, metadata management, and operational data consumption patterns. * Ability to define data product requirements for availability, freshness, latency, refresh cadence, source attribution, access control, reliability, and downstream usage. * Understanding of AI\-ready data concepts, including trusted source data, semantic consistency, retrieval patterns, embeddings/vectorization concepts, knowledge/ontology dependencies, and governed consumption. * Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data engineers, architects, analysts, source system owners, and operational stakeholders to investigate and resolve data issues. * Strong understanding of privacy, security, compliance, and appropriate data use considerations for enterprise systems handling sensitive data. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ============================ * Experience serving as a data product manager, data product owner, data domain owner, data steward, analytics product owner, or product manager for data\-intensive capabilities. * Experience enabling AI, machine learning, data science, digital product, or operational workflow teams through trusted data products. * Experience defining or managing data contracts, service\-level expectations, quality metrics, data readiness criteria, or production support expectations for data products. * Experience with healthcare data domains such as patient, provider, location, scheduling, encounters, medications, claims, billing, clinical documentation, cost, operations, or customer engagement data. * Experience partnering with ontology, semantic layer, knowledge graph, or metadata teams to improve data meaning, contextualization, and reuse. * Experience working with data quality, cataloging, governance, master data management, API, cloud data platform, or analytics engineering tools. * Experience leading through ambiguity, cross\-functional prioritization, source\-system complexity, and evolving AI or analytics requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, AI
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY** --------------- * The Senior Data Scientist, AI executes data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, generative AI, agentic AI, evaluation, and advanced analytics work required to power BSWH’s priority AI use cases and workflow\-enabled solutions. * This role partners closely with AI Product Managers, Data Product Managers, AI Engineers, Software Engineering, Ontology and Knowledge teams, Quality Engineering, Clinical, Operations, Digital, Journey, Privacy, Security, and Governance stakeholders to translate business and clinical questions into rigorous data science solutions. * The role develops predictive and statistical models, LLM\- and agent\-based capabilities, analytical frameworks, evaluation approaches, outcome measures, and reusable AI/data science assets that help AI\-enabled products improve customer experience, operational efficiency, clinical workflows, personalization, decision support, and enterprise performance. * This role is expected to combine strong statistical and machine learning skills with hands\-on generative AI and agent engineering capabilities, practical product judgment, healthcare data fluency, and the ability to translate ambiguous problems into deployed solutions that work in real operational workflows. * The Senior Data Scientist, AI reports to the Vice President, Data Science and may operate as either a senior individual contributor or a small\-team technical lead, depending on assigned domain and portfolio needs. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE ROLE** ----------------------------------- ### **AI Use Case Data Science Delivery** * Translate AI use\-case objectives into data science problem statements, modeling approaches, analytical plans, success metrics, and execution roadmaps. * Develop predictive models, classification models, segmentation approaches, personalization methods, statistical analyses, causal inference approaches, optimization models, simulations, or other traditional data science methods, and combine them with LLM\- and agent\-based approaches when appropriate to support AI use cases. * Partner with product, engineering, data, ontology, and clinical/operational stakeholders to ensure data science work is aligned to real workflow needs and measurable outcomes. * Rapidly prototype, validate, iterate, and productionalize data science, generative AI, and agentic methods in partnership with engineering and platform teams, with a bias toward delivering working capabilities into real user workflows. ### **Model Development, Validation \& Evaluation** * Build, evaluate, tune, and monitor data science and machine learning models using appropriate statistical, ML, and AI methods. * Define model success criteria, comparison benchmarks, holdout strategies, validation methodologies, error analysis approaches, and ongoing monitoring expectations. * Develop evaluation approaches for AI\-enabled products, including performance measurement, quality thresholds, subgroup analysis, drift detection, fairness considerations, and operational impact tracking. * Ensure modeling outputs are interpretable, reliable, well\-documented, and appropriate for the risk and decision context of the use case. ### **Generative AI, Agentic AI \& Workflow Solution Delivery** * Design, build, evaluate, and deploy LLM\-powered applications and agentic solutions, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, structured outputs, reasoning workflows, and multi\-step agent patterns. * Build and orchestrate agents that combine enterprise data, analytical models, APIs, business rules, knowledge/ontology assets, and software tools to perform useful work across analytics, decision support, and operational workflows. * Select and apply appropriate agent architecture patterns, including single\-agent and multi\-agent approaches, routing, planning, delegation, memory/context management, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and deterministic workflow components where reliability requires them. * Develop and maintain agent tools, prompts/instructions, context and retrieval strategies, orchestration logic, guardrails, and interfaces that enable LLMs and agents to interact safely and reliably with enterprise systems and workflows. * Create evaluation suites for LLM and agent behavior, including task success, groundedness, factuality, tool\-use correctness, workflow completion, latency, cost, safety, robustness, and regression testing; use evaluation results to iteratively improve deployed capabilities. * Work directly with product, engineering, clinical, and operational partners to understand real\-world processes, rapidly prototype solutions in context, and evolve prototypes into production capabilities that measurably improve analytics or workflow execution. ### **Healthcare Data, Feature Engineering \& Analytical Assets** * Work with enterprise healthcare datasets, including clinical, operational, customer, scheduling, claims, financial, digital, journey, or other dat tools to complete multi\-step analytical or workflow tasks; experience integrating agents with APIs, data platforms, applications, or operational systems. * Healthcare, life sciences, payer, provider, digital health, financial services, or other regulated\-industry experience preferred but not required. ### **Required Technical Expertise** * Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with the ability to work across modern data science and AI engineering environments, build production\-oriented prototypes, integrate APIs/tools, and collaborate effectively with software and platform engineering teams. * Strong knowledge of statistics, machine learning, experiment design, causal inference, forecasting, classification, clustering, segmentation, optimization, or other relevant data science methods. * Experience with common data science libraries and tools such as pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, statsmodels, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable platforms. * Ability to design validation approaches, evaluate model performance, conduct error analysis, monitor drift, assess subgroup performance, and communicate model limitations. * Ability to work with structured and unstructured data sources, including healthcare, customer, operational, digital, or enterprise data products. * Hands\-on expertise with generative AI and LLM application development, including prompt/instruction design, RAG and semantic retrieval, embeddings/vector search, structured outputs, tool/function calling, context management, model selection, and LLM evaluation. * Experience building agents and agentic workflows using one or more modern orchestration frameworks or platform\-native agent capabilities; ability to design tool\-enabled, multi\-step workflows and determine when single\-agent, multi\-agent, or deterministic orchestration is appropriate. * Ability to design and implement agent tools and integrations that connect AI capabilities to enterprise data, APIs, analytical models, knowledge assets, and workflow systems, with appropriate authentication, permissions, guardrails, observability, and human review. * Ability to evaluate and monitor non\-deterministic AI systems using repeatable test cases and metrics for quality, groundedness, task completion, tool use, safety, latency, cost, and regression performance. * Working knowledge of software engineering practices relevant to production AI, including source control, testing, CI/CD, API integration, containers or cloud runtime patterns, and operational troubleshooting. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience building or evaluating data science methods for AI\-enabled products, digital health experiences, care navigation, scheduling, personalization, capacity, throughput, engagement, or operational workflow use cases. * Experience with healthcare data and standards such as EHR data, claims, clinical documentation, encounters, medications, labs, ICD\-10, CPT, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, HL7, or FHIR. * Experience creating reusable features, analytical datasets, model evaluation assets, golden datasets, quality checks, or data science templates that can be used across teams. * Experience with model and agent observability, MLflow or similar MLOps/LLMOps tooling, data/version control, automated model and LLM evaluation, runbooks, and production handoff practices. * Experience with agent/orchestration frameworks and AI platform capabilities (for example, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, cloud\-native agent platforms, or comparable frameworks), and with protocols/patterns for securely exposing tools and context to agents. * Experience applying data science to regulated or high\-trust decision contexts where safety, privacy, explainability, fairness, or auditability are important. * Experience mentoring junior data scientists, leading technical workstreams, or serving as a technical lead for cross\-functional data science projects.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer. **General Description:** The Data Insights (DI) team is seeking a highly motivated Senior Data Scientist to transform trusted enterprise data into AI\-enabled decision intelligence that drives faster, smarter, and more effective decisions across Clinical Development and Operations. Going beyond traditional data science and business intelligence, this role combines advanced analytics, AI, domain expertise, and product thinking to design, develop, and continuously improve scalable decision products, intelligent automation, and AI\-powered analytical solutions. As a hands\-on contributor, you will partner with business stakeholders, product managers, data engineers, software engineers, AI scientists, statisticians, and clinical experts to solve complex business challenges, identify high\-value opportunities, and translate insights into actionable decisions and measurable outcomes. Success will be measured not only by analytical excellence, but also by product adoption, business impact, AI\-enabled productivity gains, and the ability to turn data into meaningful decisions. jobs.title: Agentic Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Beazley Security** Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results. We’re comprised of top talent from private industry, government, intelligence, and law enforcement who are specialists in threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, offensive security, risk management, and cyber resilience. As a subsidiary of a specialty insurance giant, Beazley Insurance, we’ve been at the forefront of cyber insurance management and breach response activities for business clients in the US, UK, and Europe since 2017\. As Beazley Security, the company will have an expanded scope, leveraging nearly two decades of cyber incident experience, a strong services division, and a business strategy focused on growth, to realize our goals and deliver benefits to clients. As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We believe these values are essential to creating a strong and inclusive workplace culture, as well as to deliver world\-class cybersecurity solutions to our clients worldwide. As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges. **Summary** ----------- As the first Agentic Security Engineer on Beazley Security’s MDR Operations Team, you’ll help us build a new managed service: providing our clients with visibility, control, and response for the agents that run and execute on their endpoints and servers. You’ll work hands on with our agentic runtime control platform, helping us deploy it, continuously tune it, and ensure our analyst team is receiving actionable alerts that require immediate action and response. Reporting directly to the Director of MDR Operations, this role blends platform engineering, policy design, detection engineering, and analyst enablement. You’ll work with MDR analysts, Product, Software Engineering, Professional Services, and vendor partners to shape how the service is configured, how its findings are routed and reported, and how it expands its coverage as AI adoption and capability keeps moving. Ideal candidates bring experience from MDR/MSSPs, Software Engineering, or security product companies, along with hands on experience with Agentic applications such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, or Hermes. You know how hooks, skills, plugins, and MCP servers work because you’ve used them, and you’ve considered the risks that they introduce.### **Responsibilities** #### **Platform Deployment \& Management** * Deploy, configure, and maintain the AI security platforms that power our Managed AI Detection and Response solution, including rolling out the tooling through MDM or EDR and configuring the initial enforcement policies. * Manage the endpoint enforcement actions we run through the platform agent, including software removal and removal of MCP server, shell, and database integrations, with per\-client pre\-authorization and exclusion lists in place so enforcement never takes out business\-critical tooling. * Monitor platform health, coverage, webhook delivery, and enforcement\-action lifecycle state so gaps in visibility or delivery are caught before they become gaps in detection or missed reports. #### **AI Policy \& Configuration Engineering** * Translate client AI acceptable use policies, data handling requirements, and risk appetite into enforceable platform configurations under an “allow, ask, and deny” enforcement model. * Build and maintain standard enforcement baselines by client segment, including exclusion lists and pre\-authorized response actions we can take on clients’ behalf. * Tune client deployments and environment suppressions as usage patterns and feature adoptions evolve. * Keep policy changes documented, reviewed, and easy to understand. #### **Detection, Response, and Automation.** * Help build and tune the detection and routing logic that sends real threats to analysts for investigation and everything else to scheduled client reporting. * Use Python, platform APIs, and agentic tools like Claude Code to automate client onboarding, baseline policy deployment, enrichment, reporting, and common response actions so the service scales without adding labor. #### **Analyst Mentoring \& Enablement** * Serve as the MDR team’s subject matter expert on AI risk, AI tooling, and the platform stack behind AIDR. * Run and maintain analyst runbooks, promotion\-trigger guidance, and training materials for analyst queue handling. * Review analyst escalations with your peers to help identify areas of improvement or where additional guidance and training may be needed. #### **Technology Evaluation \& Service Development** * Track the AI threat landscape using the frameworks the service maps to, including MITRE ATT\&CK, MITRE ATLAS, the OWASP Agentic Top 10, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and turn what you learn into service capabilities. * Partner with MDR leadership and Product Engineering teams on the AIDR roadmap, and helping design the service as it grows. ### **Required Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, including at least 1 year in an engineering detection engineering, or automation role, preferably within an MDR, MSSP, or security product company. * Hands\-on experience with generative AI tools, AI agents, and extensions such as hooks, skills, plugins, and MCP servers, along with a deep understanding of associated risks, including misalignment, unexpected behavior, prompt injection, credential exposure, and malicious skills or plugins. * Hands\-on experience configuring policy\-driven security platforms such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR, DLP, CASB/SSE, or browser and endpoint agent security tools. * Proficiency with scripting or programming languages such as Python or PowerShell and experience working with REST APIs and webhook\-based integrations. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risk clearly to analysts and clients. * Experience mentoring, training, or reviewing the work of analysts or junior engineers. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with AI security, agent runtime control * Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the OWASP Agentic Top 10, MITRE ATT\&CK, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, or ISO/IEC 42001\. * Experience administering or securing enterprise AI assistants, LLM platforms, or agent frameworks. * Experience with enterprise EDR, SIEM, and cloud productivity security platforms. * Relevant security, cloud security, or AI governance certifications such as Security\+, CCSP, or IAPP AIGP. **Beazley Security Offers** * Competitive salary and bonus. * Flexible working arrangements. * Generous leave policies including 3 months paid parental. * 100% of employee\-only insurance premiums covered (healthcare, dental and vision). * Up to 5% matched 401k contribution. * Opportunities for career advancement and ongoing training. * Participation in industry conferences and events.

Built on over a decade of technological innovation, its integrated solutions deliver value across enterprise security performance, digital supply chains, cyber insurance, and data analysis. * We invented the cyber ratings industry in 2011 * Over 3500 customers trust Bitsight * Over 600 teammates are dispersed throughout Boston, Raleigh, New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and remote **About Bitsight** ------------------ Bitsight is a global leader in cybersecurity risk and third\-party risk management, helping organizations understand, manage, and reduce their cyber exposure and that of their vendors and partners. You'll sit at the intersection of engineering, data, and revenue strategy, connecting and automating the systems our sales teams rely on every day. AI\-native tools are starting to reshape what's possible in GTM, and you'll own that shift for us: what we adopt, what we build ourselves, and what we walk away from. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Support our AI\-native GTM roadmap: Help continuously evaluate emerging AI\-native GTM platforms and tooling, contribute to build\-vs\-buy\-vs\-integrate analysis. jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: **Job Description:** If you describe yourself as inquisitive, curious, analytical, passionate… And your approach is to work independently, be accurate, adapt to change \& meet deadlines…. And you are “that” person, whose friends and family members say you analyze everything… …then this job could be the right fit for you, so read on… What it is: We're looking for a candidate who has very strong analytical skills, a high attention to detail and is able to manage multiple projects in an ever changing small business environment. This individual must be self\-motivated and driven to excel. The majority of the time your job functions will include implementing and maintaining the day to day data collection processes. These data processes include the systems that load client files as well as the systems that produce reports for our clients. Furthermore, you will execute data analysis projects and prepare written \& graphical summaries and presentations for internal team and clients. Good verbal and written communication skills required. Reports to: Sr. Data Engineer **Technical Skills Required** * Advanced knowledge of Excel; Beginner to Intermediate knowledge of SQL or equivalent multi\-dimensional databases. * Experience using or calling APIs with tools such as Postman * Familiarity with Power BI or any other Business Intelligence tool (MicroStrategy, Looker, Tableau) is a plus * Experience with AWS or Microsoft Azure or other cloud services (S3, Redshift) is a plus * Familiarity with non\-relational databases (MongoDB) is a plus * Familiarity with Snowflake and/or DBT is a plus * Familiarity with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Gemini) is a plus **Character Qualities You'll Need** * Love numbers, math, formulas and have a basic understanding of statistics. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills * Able to manage multiple projects and adapt to change * Isolating and resolving all data errors and inconsistencies through root cause analysis and conducting data analysis. * Strong attention to detail * Must be comfortable interacting with persons of diverse backgrounds. * Good verbal and written communication skills * Enjoy collaboration, with a preference for face\-to\-face communication * Be self\-directed and self\-motivated * Have an ability to thrive in a team\-oriented environment * Be a good active listener and communicator **Job requirements:** * Education: Four year bachelor's degree * Experience: 0\-2 years * Travel: None * Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas at this time What to expect in your first year: The first 60 days, you are immersed in an intense learning stage. So, take advantage of one\-on\-one training before you have to fly semi\-solo. You will work closely with three lead Analysts \- first to shadow and learn, and then you will have your own client base. Our products run on a very consistent cycle so once you get past your initial learning curve you will have deadlines to meet as well as ad hoc projects that always surface. Often deadlines are almost on top of each other so you must be able to multi\-task. Your growth opportunities: You’ll learn a lot about our clients’ businesses, best people practices, financial performance metrics, and how to think strategically about business from some very smart and experienced people. We are a fast\-growing company and your contributions as Associate Analyst will empower the growth of the company as well as help you achieve personal success. The ability to discover \& develop your personal niche is available \& encouraged. Training: You’ll be trained primarily by two lead analysts and work closely with them on a day to day basis. You will also learn about our clients’ business and proprietary software, as well as our high level of standards and the company mission. Additional training on our data analytics tool set is available and encouraged. Training around Git, Snowflake, dbt, and how to leverage AI for efficiency will also be provided. Your Team: Our staff has as a committed work ethic and loves to crunch numbers and have fun together; they chat, joke \& tell stories. Relationships are strong. Your co\-workers will probably ask you about your favorite music group, favorite food (In and Out or Whataburger?), pet names, you know, the important things in life! Hours: This position is a salaried, full\-time position. Project/implementation deadlines will dictate your schedule to a large extent. It may take long hours and/or weekends to meet some deadlines. As we mentioned up front, you need to be passionate about what you do. Our Approach: We approach our clients’ businesses from an integrated perspective; their success means our success. And, we’re passionate about our business and our clients’ businesses – really passionate. We keep our clients for a long time and a part of the reason is because we learn the multiple aspects of their business from the inside out, as if it were our own. We are proud of the fact that we move the needle, building best practices and loyalty for our clients, but we know we couldn’t do that if we didn’t get in there and make sure our clients truly “get” it. We strive for zero\-defect in all our work as data integrity, security and quality is the cornerstone of our business. Your Working Environment: Fun and casual. Your team is hard working and focused upon doing great work for the client – but we never forget to have fun in the process. It will be fast paced, and deadline filled, and we all enjoy coming to work… most days. Our Values: Black Box Intelligence™ is a small group of professionals who consider each other family. Our CEO gets a rush out of seeing our employees blossom and grow. We are guided by a set of core values that are more than just a poster on the wall. * One Team \- I am more than my department and will behave as such * Do Good – I will leave it better than I found it * Dream Big – Big visions lead to big results; take risks * Ignite Fire – I am passionate about the restaurant industry and the people in it * Own It – I take ownership and am relentless in my pursuit of excellence * Inspire Trust – Every interaction inspires trust

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Sr I
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer****Hybrid \- Phoenix, AZ** **The Opportunity:** This role focuses on the Blackboard LMS, where we pride ourselves on creating well\-designed web and mobile solutions to support learners, instructors, and administrators. Blackboard enables learners and instructors to access online educational experiences anytime, anywhere. Our technology helps instructors breathe life into educational content, brings efficiency to day\-to\-day tasks, and provides tools to engage and assess every learner. We help motivate learners by promoting collaboration, communication, and connections with their peers and instructors. Primary responsibilities will include: * Working as a full\-stack developer on an agile team, contributing to planning and independently driving execution. * Participating in hands\-on technical design, coding, and implementation of product features and improvements, from approach through delivery. * Enhancing and supporting existing cloud\-based products. * Resolving the unique challenges of delivering and maintaining cloud\-based software, including diagnosing root causes in live production environments, minimizing downtime, and resolving client\-reported issues. * Proactively communicating progress to management and stakeholders and raising risks and issues in a timely manner. * Building and applying broad and deep knowledge of existing software architecture to inform technical decisions. * Mentoring junior team members and advising them on technical approaches. * Collaborating with cross\-functional team to solve challenging technical problems, evaluate options, and recommend innovative solutions. * Applying and upholding coding and testing best practices to deliver scalable, high\-quality software on time. * Applying AI technology and frameworks to enhance the quality and efficiency of the features and fixes delivered continuously to our customers. **The Candidate:***Required skills/qualifications:** Degree in Computer Science or a related field. * 5–7 years of experience with web application development. * Knowledge of modern front\-end frameworks and libraries (TypeScript/JavaScript) such as React, Redux, and Angular. * Strong experience designing, writing, and deploying scalable software using infrastructure as code. * Exceptional object\-oriented design and Java coding skills combined with knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL database design and integration. * Experience in AI\-assisted, spec\-driven development environments, leveraging AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. * Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, and algorithm analysis. * Demonstrated ability to apply appropriate software design patterns and identify performance anti\-patterns. * Experience with cloud\-based IaaS solutions (AWS preferred) and Platform as a Service (PaaS). * Knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed architecture principles. * Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Quick learner with strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Experience writing unit, integration, acceptance, and end\-to\-end tests. * Ability to work with a team of engineers on cross\-functional agile projects. * Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and demonstrated proficiency with API concepts and design. * Fluency in written and spoken English at CEFR B2 level or above. *Pay range is $115,700–$120,000/year depending on experience. We use national and industry\-specific survey data to assist in determining compensation. Additionally, we consider factors such as external market rate, budget for the role, and the compensation rates of current employees performing the same function. Some roles will have variable pay.* This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time. Blackboard is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, color, religion, national origin, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Blossom Health exists to **solve the mental health epidemic** in America by partnering with psychiatrists to expand access toaffordable, timely, clinically\-effective mental healthcare. Our **AI\-native care platform** is loved by hundreds of clinicians and thousands of patients. We trust engineers to figure out the best path forward \- without micromanagement. * **Talent\-dense team:** Work with a top\-percentile team built on mutual respect and admiration, with shared goals, motivations, and vision for the future. * **Real impact:** Your code will directly improve access to mental health care for thousands of patients and clinicians **What we're looking for:** =========================== * **Highly motivated, ambitious, and capable** \- looking to tackle a large, meaningful problem area * **Ownership mindset** \- thinking for the long\-term and placing the business and our customers first * **High velocity and high excellence** \- have a real sense of urgency to move quickly and take pride in the quality of your work * **An explorer** \- comfortable with ambiguity and autonomy, seeking to answer questions previously unasked, to leap into the unknown * **An optimist** \- you believe in a tomorrow better than today * **A builder** \- you take joy **What you'll do:** =================== * Build and ship **AI\-native product experiences** used directly by clinicians and patients * Design and develop **LLM\-powered systems and agents** that automate and augment complex healthcare workflows * Own AI features end\-to\-end, from prototyping and experimentation through production deployment, evaluation, and iteration * Build robust **evaluation, monitoring, and feedback systems** to continuously improve AI quality, reliability, and performance * Work across models, prompts, tools, retrieval systems, and application infrastructure to solve real\-world product problems * Move quickly from emerging AI capabilities to **production\-ready experiences that deliver measurable value** * Collaborate closely with clinicians and engineers to understand complex healthcare workflows and determine where AI can have the greatest impact **You'll thrive here if you:** ============================== * Have a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field * Have **2\+ years of professional software engineering experience** outperforming in high\-quality environments * Have experience **building and shipping LLM\-powered applications or AI products in production** * Are fluent in **Python and/or TypeScript** * Have worked with modern LLM APIs, agentic systems, tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, or similar applied AI patterns * Think rigorously about **evals, reliability, latency, cost, and failure modes**, not just whether a prototype works * Are comfortable moving across the stack and quickly experimenting with new models, frameworks, and techniques * Love autonomy, ambiguity, experimentation, and ownership * Are **authorized to work in the U.S.** and excited to be **in\-person in NYC** 5 days a week **Benefits:** ============= * Competitive salary, equity, growth opportunities * Best\-in\-class health, dental, and vision insurance * A focus on outcomes, not hours, with unlimited PTO * Team outings, offsites, and a sunny NYC office stocked with snacks Compensation Range: $150K \- $220K

jobs.title: Software Development and Support Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Software Development and Support Engineer** Blue Cardinal Home Services \| Dallas, TX (Galleria area) \| Full\-Time Most software engineers never see who uses what they build. Here you will. Blue Cardinal Home Services is a fast\-growing, PE\-backed group of HVAC, plumbing, and electrical companies across the U.S. We’re putting AI and smart engineering into how the trades run, from the call center to the service truck. We’re hiring a hands\-on, AI\-fluent engineer to build, deploy, and support the tools our companies use every day. You’ll write the code, go on site with the teams, see how the business actually works, and ship things that make a difference within weeks. If you like owning a project from start to finish and seeing real results, this is the job. **What You’ll Do** * Build and maintain full\-stack applications, backend services, APIs, integrations, and internal tools that serve multiple operating companies * Design reliable systems that scale across businesses with different workflows and different levels of tech maturity * Build automations and data workflows that save time and help operators make better decisions * Support our core platforms, including Five9 (call center), ServiceTitan with our custom AI add\-ons, and the integrations that connect them: configuration, user admin, troubleshooting, and keeping them running * Monitor production systems, fix issues fast, and make things more reliable over time * Travel to our partner companies to work alongside operators and vendors, learn their processes, and turn real problems into working software * Own projects from discovery through design, development, deployment, adoption, and ongoing support * Help set the engineering standards and practices as the team grows * Explain technical decisions clearly to developers and non\-technical people alike Requirements: **What You Bring** * 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience * A track record of building and maintaining production software in a backend or full\-stack role * Hands\-on Python experience * Experience with APIs, databases, data models, and web applications * Exposure to system design, cloud infrastructure, and production deployments * Fluency with AI development tools, and real experience using them across the whole lifecycle: design, coding, testing, review, documentation, and production support * Strong problem\-solving skills, including turning vague business problems into practical solutions * Good judgment on the tradeoffs between speed, maintainability, and design * Clear communication, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently * Genuine curiosity about how operating businesses work * *Bonus:* experience with ServiceTitan, Five9, or field\-service/home\-services software **Work Location \& Travel** * 1–2 days a week in our Dallas Galleria\-area office * About 10–15% travel to our operating companies (offices, warehouses, shops, and job sites). Expect a bit more during onboarding while you get to know the businesses. **Why Join Us** * Build AI\-powered tools that get used right away. No endless roadmap meetings. * High ownership and visibility in a growing, well\-backed company * See your work in action in the field, not just in a ticket queue * Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match; paid time off and sick time

jobs.title: Lead Shopify Engineer/Architect
jobs.description: **Description Overview** Body Art Alliance (BAA) is the house behind some of the most trusted names in tattoo, piercing and permanent makeup supply, including Killer Ink, Painful Pleasures, Ultimate Tattoo Supply, FK Irons, Perma Blend, World Famous Ink, NeoMetal and Anatometal. We sell to artists, studios and their clients across the US, UK and EU through Shopify and Shopify Plus storefronts, a Magento storefront for our international business, and B2B portals. We are moving our storefronts onto one shared Shopify platform and bringing ownership of it in\-house. You will architect that platform, lead the migrations onto it with an agency partner, and then own it: the code, the releases and the cost. This is a player\-coach role. You write production code and you lead the engineers and partners who build with you. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Architecture and roadmap. One base theme and back end, with brands expressed through presets, settings and metafields rather than forked code, and international handled through Shopify Markets. * Lead the migrations. Start with our UK/EU business moving from Magento to Shopify, then consolidate the remaining storefronts onto the same base. Plan, sequence and report on the program. * Manage development partners. Scope, estimate, review and accept agency work against written statements of work, track spend, and bring capability in\-house over time. * Integrations and data. Own the Shopify side of our NetSuite, Snowflake and GA4 connections so orders, inventory, pricing, customers and reporting stay clean. * Releases and platform health. Repository, environments, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring and peak\-season change freezes. Keep site speed, uptime, app count and platform spend moving the right way. * Build the team. Hire a small engineering team and an AI\-assisted workflow (Claude Code or similar) for specs, code, tests and first\-pass review, with engineers owning every release decision. **SKILLS:** * Shopify B2B, Markets, checkout extensibility and Shopify Functions * UK/EU ecommerce: VAT, localization and translation * Multi\-brand, wholesale or PE\-backed company experience * Headless or Hydrogen experience, with judgment on when not to use it **KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPI):** * 90 days: You know every store, integration and partner. Spend is baselined, the architecture is signed off and the international replatform is under way. * 7 months: International storefronts live on the new base. Releases run in\-house through the new pipeline. * 12 months: Remaining storefronts migrated in priority order. One platform, one release process, and development and platform spend below the starting baseline. **QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:** * 8\+ years in ecommerce engineering, including 5\+ years on Shopify Plus serving multiple brands or stores from shared code * Led a platform migration end to end, ideally Magento to Shopify (data, redirects, SEO, cutover) * Built or owned an ERP integration, ideally NetSuite * Led engineers and managed agencies or contractors to scope and budget * Writes production code today and uses AI coding tools daily **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Ability to travel about 10 to 15%, mostly UK/EU **HOW WE HIRE:** A conversation about a platform you architected, a review of a real theme pull request, and a working session on running several brands from one base theme. No algorithm puzzles

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Framingham, Massachusetts, United States of America Category: Engineering Job ID: R29312 Brand: Bose Corporation, U.S.A Posted Date: October 20th 2026 widget: Full time **Description** --------------- At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer\-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound. Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation. **Job Description** =================== **About the Role** ------------------ Bose is seeking a **Machine Learning Engineer** with expertise in Efficient AI and Edge ML to join our team. In this role, you will design, train, optimize, and deploy machine learning models for next\-generation audio products. You will work closely with embedded, DSP, compiler, hardware, and software engineers to bring AI capabilities to resource\-constrained devices. The ideal candidate has strong machine learning fundamentals, practical experience with efficient model development, and an understanding of Edge ML deployment constraints. Deep embedded systems expertise is not required. However, you should be able to understand deployment and integration feedback, identify model\-related limitations, and quickly iterate on model architectures and training methods to improve accuracy, latency, memory usage, and power efficiency. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, train, evaluate, and optimize machine learning models for consumer audio products. * Apply Efficient ML techniques, including quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, model compression, and efficient model architectures, to improve model efficiency while maintaining model quality. * Work closely with embedded, DSP, compiler, and hardware engineers to deploy and integrate machine learning models on resource\-constrained platforms, including DSPs, NPUs, microcontrollers, and ARM\-based systems. * Analyze deployment and integration feedback, identify model\-related issues, and rapidly iterate on model architectures and training methodologies. * Adapt models to address platform constraints such as unsupported operators, data\-type limitations, memory usage, latency, compute requirements, and power consumption. * Profile and evaluate model performance across accuracy, latency, memory footprint, model size, compute efficiency, and power usage. * Develop and maintain repeatable workflows for model training, conversion, compilation, simulation, validation, and performance analysis. * Collaborate across Machine Learning, embedded software, DSP, hardware, compiler, and product engineering teams to deliver production\-ready AI solutions. * Evaluate emerging ML technologies and AI\-assisted engineering tools that can improve model development, deployment, debugging, and optimization workflows. * Document experiments, technical findings, deployment learnings, and reusable engineering practices. * Mentor interns and co\-op engineers. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field. * Strong foundation in machine learning and deep learning, including model architecture design, training, evaluation, and optimization. * Working knowledge of Efficient ML techniques such as quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, model compression, and efficient model architectures. * Understanding of how model optimization techniques affect model accuracy, latency, memory footprint, compute requirements, and deployment compatibility. * Proficiency with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar. * Strong Python programming, debugging, and problem\-solving skills. * Working knowledge of C/C\+\+ and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working on embedded and production systems. * Understanding of Edge ML concepts and common resource constraints, including computation, memory, latency, and power. * Ability to analyze model behavior and troubleshoot issues across training, conversion, deployment, and integration workflows. * Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Hands\-on experience with quantization\-aware training, post\-training quantization, mixed\-precision inference, structured or unstructured pruning, operator replacement, or hardware\-aware model optimization. * Experience adapting model architectures or training workflows in response to deployment and integration constraints. * Experience deploying machine learning models on edge devices, DSPs, NPUs, mobile platforms, wearable devices, or other resource\-constrained systems. * Familiarity with deployment frameworks and toolchains such as TensorFlow Lite, TensorFlow Lite Micro, ONNX Runtime, TVM, MLIR, or vendor\-specific SDKs. * Understanding of deployment and performance metrics such as latency, memory footprint, model size, MACs, memory bandwidth, and power consumption. * Experience with audio ML, speech processing, acoustic sensing, or multimodal models involving audio. * Familiarity with LLM\- or agent\-based engineering workflows, including knowledge retrieval, tool calling, technical documentation analysis, structured data extraction, failure diagnosis, benchmark analysis, or optimization recommendations. * Experience building or evaluating AI\-assisted tools that improve ML development, deployment, debugging, or engineering productivity. * Curiosity about the interaction between machine learning models, software toolchains, and hardware platforms. \#LI\-Hybrid At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $141,000\-$193,950\.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic\-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II, Decisioning Studio Integrations Team
jobs.description: At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew. We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work\-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization. To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success. Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one\-of\-a\-kind vibrancy into our culture. If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you. #### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer II to join the Decisioning Studio Integrations team building BrazeAI Decisioning Studio™. Decisioning Studio is a reinforcement learning platform that runs continuous experiments to personalize customer engagement for each individual. Its results depend on the data it learns from and on the channels that carry its decisions to customers. Our team owns both. We ingest enterprise customer data of any schema and at a very large scale from warehouses, engagement platforms and other enterprise systems. We also deliver the recommendations from our RL pipelines across email, SMS, push, in\-app and other channels. These are high\-impact, customer\-facing features. In this role, you will: * Lead complex integration projects from design through build and rollout, and set technical direction for the Decisioning Studio integration platform * Design and build integrations with cloud data warehouses, customer engagement platforms and other enterprise systems, for both data ingestion and activation orchestration * Build ingestion pipelines that handle every way customers send data, including batch pulls, file drops, APIs and streaming, and accept arbitrary schemas without letting bad data reach our models * Build event\-driven, fault\-tolerant activation pipelines that deliver recommendations on schedule, recover cleanly from partial failures and never send twice * Design for multi\-region deployment and compliance requirements, including data residency and PII handling * Own your systems in production. Instrument them with Datadog, take part in the on\-call rotation, and take incidents all the way to the root cause * Work with data scientists, ML engineers and product managers to turn integration requirements into reusable platform capabilities * Mentor engineers and raise the bar for code quality, testing and design review #### **WHO YOU ARE** * 6\+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating distributed systems in production * A track record of technical leadership: owning complex projects end to end, making architecture decisions and setting direction for other engineers * Experience building data pipelines or integrations that move very large volumes of data between systems, including schema changes, backfills and partial failures * A strong grasp of event\-driven architecture and reliability patterns: message brokers such as Kafka, idempotency, retries with backoff, dead\-letter handling, and at\-least\-once versus exactly\-once tradeoffs * Proficiency in Python and SQL * Hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred) and Kubernetes * Experience with AI coding assistants, and the judgment to know when they help and when they don't * A clear communicator who works well with engineering, data science and product * A self\-starter who finds problems and works around obstacles without waiting for direction Bonus points: * Experience integrating with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift * Experience integrating with customer engagement platforms such as Braze, Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Klaviyo * Experience building multi\-region systems under data residency and compliance requirements * Experience running ML systems in production For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $156,364 and $279,957/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $172,000 and $306,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company. \#LI\-Hybrid s and World Report, a 2025 America's Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore. The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo. **BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization. Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you. We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we'd love to meet you **OUR AI\-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS** At Braze, we're committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI\-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process. This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II, Decisioning Studio Integrations Team
jobs.description: At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew. We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work\-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization. To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success. Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one\-of\-a\-kind vibrancy into our culture. If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you. #### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer II to join the Decisioning Studio Integrations team building BrazeAI Decisioning Studio™. Decisioning Studio is a reinforcement learning platform that runs continuous experiments to personalize customer engagement for each individual. Its results depend on the data it learns from and on the channels that carry its decisions to customers. Our team owns both. We ingest enterprise customer data of any schema and at a very large scale from warehouses, engagement platforms and other enterprise systems. We also deliver the recommendations from our RL pipelines across email, SMS, push, in\-app and other channels. These are high\-impact, customer\-facing features. In this role, you will: * Lead complex integration projects from design through build and rollout, and set technical direction for the Decisioning Studio integration platform * Design and build integrations with cloud data warehouses, customer engagement platforms and other enterprise systems, for both data ingestion and activation orchestration * Build ingestion pipelines that handle every way customers send data, including batch pulls, file drops, APIs and streaming, and accept arbitrary schemas without letting bad data reach our models * Build event\-driven, fault\-tolerant activation pipelines that deliver recommendations on schedule, recover cleanly from partial failures and never send twice * Design for multi\-region deployment and compliance requirements, including data residency and PII handling * Own your systems in production. Instrument them with Datadog, take part in the on\-call rotation, and take incidents all the way to the root cause * Work with data scientists, ML engineers and product managers to turn integration requirements into reusable platform capabilities * Mentor engineers and raise the bar for code quality, testing and design review #### **WHO YOU ARE** * 6\+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating distributed systems in production * A track record of technical leadership: owning complex projects end to end, making architecture decisions and setting direction for other engineers * Experience building data pipelines or integrations that move very large volumes of data between systems, including schema changes, backfills and partial failures * A strong grasp of event\-driven architecture and reliability patterns: message brokers such as Kafka, idempotency, retries with backoff, dead\-letter handling, and at\-least\-once versus exactly\-once tradeoffs * Proficiency in Python and SQL * Hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred) and Kubernetes * Experience with AI coding assistants, and the judgment to know when they help and when they don't * A clear communicator who works well with engineering, data science and product * A self\-starter who finds problems and works around obstacles without waiting for direction Bonus points: * Experience integrating with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift * Experience integrating with customer engagement platforms such as Braze, Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Klaviyo * Experience building multi\-region systems under data residency and compliance requirements * Experience running ML systems in production For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $156,364 and $279,957/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $172,000 and $306,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company. \#LI\-Hybrid s and World Report, a 2025 America's Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore. The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo. **BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
