jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellowship – Medical Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description: Site: The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc. Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not\-for\-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high\-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham. **Job Summary** APPLY BY EMAIL ONLY \- APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS BELOW One full\-time (40 hours/week) hybrid position is available. When applying, please indicate the track to which you are applying: * Computational Track (Ph.D. in a STEM discipline) * Clinician\-Scientist Track (M.D., Ph.D, or equivalent clinical degree) Application Deadline: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning October, 2026 and accepted until the position is filled. Anticipated Start Date: February, 2027 (flexible) Description The NEIL AND ELISE WALLACE STRATUS Center for Medical Simulation at BWH is committed to advancing medical education, patient safety, and healthcare outcomes through cutting\-edge applications of medical simulation technologies supported by innovative curricula, contemporary educational methodologies, continuous improvement, and rigorous, multidisciplinary research. At STRATUS, the Medical AI \& Cognitive (MAICE) Lab, led by Dr. Roger Dias, MD, PhD, MBA, brings together a multidisciplinary team of clinicians, engineers, psychologists, computer scientists, and educators, including collaborations with several scientists and institutions, nationally and internationally. The core mission of our research lab involves the use of cutting\-edge technologies to objectively measure and improve clinicians’ performance, with the ultimate goal of enhancing patient safety and improving clinical outcomes. Our projects have been funded by NASA, NIH, DoD, and NSF, leveraging machine learning and artificial intelligence to support high\-performance clinical care in a variety of settings, including emergency medicine, critical care, surgery, space, and military medicine. The Postdoctoral Fellowship in Medical AI prepares the next generation of researchers to bridge artificial intelligence and clinical care. Building AI that clinicians trust and use requires both technical depth and clinical insight, so the fellowship is open to candidates from two backgrounds who work side by side in interdisciplinary teams: * Computational Track – for graduates of doctoral programs in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) with a solid foundation in applying advanced ML/AI techniques. This track is ideal for early\-career scientists seeking experience in the healthcare field and the opportunity to apply AI/ML and software engineering to improve patient care and safety. Prior experience in healthcare or biomedical research is required. * Clinician\-Scientist Track – for clinicians (M.D., D.O., PhD, or equivalent) with research experience and a strong interest in medical AI. This track is ideal for clinicians who want to lead the design, clinical validation, and implementation of AI tools while building hands\-on data science and AI skills. This is a full\-time research position with no clinical duties. Fellows on both tracks are mentored by a multidisciplinary team of experts, gaining extensive knowledge and experience in diverse research areas including medicine, human factors, cognitive science, behavioral sciences, and aerospace and military research. Fellow follow an individualized development plan, with support for first\-author publications, presentations at national and international conferences, and applications for independent fellowships and career development awards. Responsibilities All fellows will: * Conduct research and development in the emerging field of medical AI, from study design through publication, in settings such as emergency medicine, critical care, surgery, space, and military medicine * Work with large multi\-source clinical datasets, including time\-series physiological data, demographics, behavioral and psychological assessments, video, audio, electronic health records (EHR), and clinical performance outcomes * Contribute to the development and evaluation of AI\-based medical simulation applications and real\-time clinical decision support systems * Lead first\-author manuscripts and conference presentations, and contribute to grant proposals * Collaborate closely with clinicians, engineers, and scientists, and help mentor students and junior team members Computational Track fellows will focus on: * Designing and developing software architectures and data pipelines for AI\-based solutions * Training, fine\-tuning, and evaluating ML/AI models, including neural networks, large language models, and computer vision models * Integrating AI models with large clinica on, Stata, SAS, or a similar tool * Demonstrated engagement with AI, data science, or digital health, such as a research project that used AI/ML methods, an evaluation of AI tools or large language models, or coursework or a certificate in data science, AI, or clinical informatics Preferred for the **Clinician\-Scientist Track**: * Completed residency or other clinical training, especially in emergency medicine, critical care, anesthesiology, or surgery * Advanced training in research methods, epidemiology, biostatistics, or informatics (e.g., MPH, MS, MMSc, or Ph.D.) * Programming experience in Python, including use of ML libraries * Experience writing IRB protocols, conducting prospective data collection, or doing healthcare simulation research **Salary and Benefits** The selected candidate will be appointed for two years, with the opportunity to renew the appointment for a third and/or fourth year pending performance review and funding. The salary range for this position is $71,750 to $73,544 annually. Benefits include comprehensive health insurance, optional dental, vision, and retirement plans, and reimbursement for conference travel related to fellowship projects. BWH is a Harvard\-affiliated teaching hospital, and the research fellow will be eligible for an appointment at Harvard Medical School. **Additional Job Details (if applicable)** IMPORTANT – APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS Please do not apply through the Workday “Apply” button. This position is being posted for informational purposes only. To be considered, please submit the following directly to the hiring manager by clicking the link below: * Cover letter (up to two pages) stating your track (Computational or Clinician\-Scientist), your research interests and relevant experience, and what you hope to accomplish during the fellowship * Current CV, including a full list of publications * Recent work sample (e.g., a first\-author peer\-reviewed manuscript or pre\-print; Computational Track applicants are encouraged to also include GitHub code or a software demo) * Candidates selected for an interview will be asked to submit two letters of recommendation pborges1@bwh.harvard.edu *Please note: Applications submitted through Workday will not be forwarded to the hiring manager and may not be reviewed*. **Remote Type** Hybrid **Work Location** 75 Francis Street **EEO Statement:** 2200 The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, military service, genetic information, and/or other status protected under law. We will ensure that all individuals with a disability are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. To ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Veteran’s Readjustment Act of 1974, and Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, applicants who require accommodation in the job application process may contact Human Resources at (857\)\-282\-7642\.**Mass General Brigham Competency Framework** --------------------------------------------- At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People\-Focused, half Performance\-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

jobs.title: Fire Protection Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** The Fire Protection Engineer, Senior position is responsible for the preparation of detailed Building Code and Life Safety Code analyses and analysis of fire detection, mass notification and suppression systems. Bristol Alliance of Companies (Bristol) is committed to building lasting relationships that reflect our hard work, ingenuity, and dedication to safety. Every employee has an impact on our success, which benefits the Native Culture, land, and people of the Bristol Bay region. Our values: People, Communities, Reputation, Teamwork, Trust, and Truth. **Essential Functions** * Responsible for the preparation of detailed Building Code and Life Safety Code analysis and analysis of fire detection, mass notification and suppression systems. Prepare designs and plans using AutoCAD, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), specifications, and cost estimates, in support of in\-house and Architect/Engineer (A\&E) design bid\-build and design\-build projects, for a wide range of new or rehabilitated DoW facilities and infrastructure projects. Analyze existing buildings and building egress systems to determine adequacy of egress and construction type for existing conditions and proposed changes to buildings and building occupancies. Investigate and recommend corrective measures for deficiencies in existing facilities. Typical design projects include Naval Shore Facilities, including multi\-story offices and quarters, hangars, hospitals, towers, aircraft overhaul facilities, piers, training facilities and a very wide diversity of other new and existing structures and facilities. * Analyze the applicability of fire protection innovative processes, systems, equipment, or techniques and implement such on projects and specifications. Demonstrate knowledge of the latest fire protection systems and methods of construction. Prepare correspondence, engineering studies, and technical reports regarding fire protection and Life Safety related topics. Apply knowledge of detection and suppression system components and how such components are correctly installed or incorrectly installed. Communicate effectively issues to technician level personnel responsible for the installation, testing, and maintenance of fire protection systems and system components. **Competencies** * Knowledge of DoD and Navy guide specifications, criteria and policy, industry codes and standards, and standard practices as related to fire protection engineering design, including the Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) codes and standards, International Building Code (IBC), International Mechanical Code (IMC), International Residential Code (IRC), FM Global Loss Prevention Data Sheets, Society of Fire Protection Engineer’s Handbook, and various other industry standards. * Provides independent, timely and professional fire protection engineering support, services and consultation for the planning, design, construction and maintenance of facilities for the Navy, Marine Corps, and other Supported Commands, including minor works projects, specific projects, special projects, military construction (MILCON), demolition, maintenance, space utilization and facilities development. Participates in conferences with project stakeholders and collaborates with other engineering and architectural disciplines to ensure system coordination and integration with specific project requirements. * Typical projects include: fire protection engineering services for life safety, type of construction, height and area requirements, separation distances, fire rated construction, spray\-applied fireproofing, firestopping, sprinkler systems, fire alarm systems, mass notification systems, clean agent fire suppression systems, base\-wide fire alarm reporting systems, water distribution systems, hydraulic analysis, fire modeling, and performance based designs of major size and complexity for use in government facilities, including multi\-story office buildings, steam plants, hospitals, housing, manufacturing, training, and similar structures. **Required Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree from an ABET accredited Mechanical Engineering or Fire Protection Engineering program. * Minimum of 5 years of Fire Protection System design including at least 1 year working on Capital Improvement projects for a Federal Agency. * Valid driver’s license. **Preferred Education and Experience** * Registration as Professional Engineer (PE) in the discipline of Fire Protection Engineering is desired. * Experience with Microsoft Project. **Work Environment** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Position may be subject to both inside and outside environmental conditions, noise sufficient to cause the worker to shout. * Position may be subject to a variety of physical conditions – proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electric current, working on scaffolding and high places, exposure to high heat or exposure to chemicals. * Position may be subject to atmospheric conditions – fumes, odors, dusts, mist, gases, or poor ventilation. * Position may be subject to close visual acuity to perform activities such as viewing a computer terminal and extensive reading. **Physical Qualifications** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. * Mobility: must be able to stoop, kneel, reach, walk, lift, grasp, feel, talk, hear, and perform repetitive motions. * Hearing: must be able to hear audible safety alarms. * Visual Acuity: must be adequate to perform above listed tasks in a safe manner and perform activities such as viewing a computer terminal and extensive reading. * Lifting: must be able to exert up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. **Benefits** Excellent salary and benefits package to include paid time off, paid holidays, comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, life, short\-term disability insurance, and 401(k) plan with employer match. **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement** Bristol companies are equal opportunity employers and offer any available positions to all, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, parenthood, pregnancy, marital status, or changes in marital status, in accordance with applicable state and federal laws. This applies to recruitment, placement, pay, benefits, training, employment status changes, social and recreational programs, and other conditions and benefits of employment. Bristol grants employment preference first to BBNC and Choggiung shareholders, their spouses, or descendants, and second to Alaska Native Corporation shareholders in accordance with P.L. 93\-638\. **Disclaimer** This job description is not intended to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. This job description is not a contract or employment. It does not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. All employment with Bristol is “at\-will” which means that Bristol or employee can terminate the employment relationship at any time with or without cause. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Kubernetes
jobs.description: **Please Note:** **1\. If you are a first time user, please create your candidate login account before you apply for a job.** **2\. If you already have a Candidate Account, please Sign\-In before you apply.** **Job Description:** -------------------- **Position Description** ------------------------ We are seeking a hands on, highly engaged Forward Deployed Engineer specializing in Kubernetes, platform modernization, large scale stateful workload migration, and enterprise AI infrastructure. In this role, you will be embedded directly alongside enterprise client teams throughout the entire end to end lifecycle of an engagement. From initial architecture, bare metal/legacy re platforming, and AI cluster setup to live in the field troubleshooting and production rollout. Because you are part of the core Engineering organization, you won't just file bug reports; you will write production code in the field, build prototype integrations, and channel those contributions directly back to our engineering teams across the Infrastructure Software Division (ISG) to help shape, prioritize, and accelerate high impact platform capabilities. This role sits directly within the Engineering Business Unit (BU), working side by side with product and core software teams. Unlike traditional professional services or post sales support roles, our Forward Deployed Engineering team operates as an extension of core engineering in the field. **Our Core Mission:** Reduce customer adoption friction, dramatically shorten software iteration cycles, and establish a high bandwidth, direct feedback loop between real world enterprise deployments and product development. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Direct Engineering to Field Collaboration:** Act as an embedded engineering liaison across the Infrastructure Software Division, working directly with core software architects, product managers, and enterprise client developers to eliminate deployment friction. * **Rapid Iteration \& Friction Reduction:** Identify recurring migration blockers and platform usability gaps in real world customer environments, rapidly building and testing field fixes to shorten feature iteration cycles from months to days. * **End to End Engagement Ownership:** Stay actively embedded with customer technical teams from pre migration discovery through go live and operational stabilization, ensuring successful platform adoption and high customer trust. * **Hands on Field Implementation \& Troubleshooting:** Work shoulder to shoulder with client engineers in production environments to write code, build manifests, debug live networking/storage/GPU failures, and optimize VKS performance. * **Engineering Feedback Loop \& Feature Prioritization:** Synthesize field tested code, architectural patterns, and customer pain points directly into core engineering requirements. Partner with product managers and core engineers to translate customer contributions into prioritized platform features. * **VKS \& AI Infrastructure Architecture:** Architect, deploy, and maintain production grade vSphere Kubernetes Service (VKS) clusters across VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) and hybrid cloud infrastructure, optimized for both general purpose compute and accelerated GPU/NPU workloads. * **Bare Metal \& Legacy Platform Migration:** Lead technical migration strategies transitioning enterprise platforms, massive bare metal environments, and legacy data stacks over to VKS or cloud native Kubernetes targets. * **Enterprise AI \& Inferencing Modernization:** Deploy, tune, and scale production AI inferencing workloads, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures, vector search, and model serving frameworks on Kubernetes using virtualized GPU resources (NVIDIA vGPU, MIG). * **Data Services \& Messaging Re Platforming:** Containerize, refactor, and migrate heavy stateful engines, message brokers (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ), distributed caches (Redis, Oracle Coherence, Hazelcast), and risk calculation/analytics platforms onto Kubernetes. * **Modern Data \& AI Stack Modernization:** Architect operator driven, cloud native deployments for data processing, orchestration, and distributed AI frameworks (Ray, vLLM, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Trino/Presto, Flink, Dask, Cassandra/ScyllaDB, Milvus/Qdrant). * **Multi Kubernetes Integration:** Guide clients evaluating or operating VKS alongside competing distributions (Red Hat OpenShift, Amazon EKS, Google GKE, Azure AKS, Rancher RKE/RKS). **Key Qualifications** ---------------------- * **Engineering Mindset \& Organizational Fit:** Deep alignment with product engineering workflows; experience functioning within or closely alongside core software/R\&D divisions rather than pure IT or professional services. * **Full Lifecycle Engagement Experience:** Proven track record of staying deeply engaged with customer technical leadership and developers across long term, complex engineering projects. * **Product Minded Engineering:** Demonstrated ability to translate raw technical customer requirements and field workarounds into clean product specifications and feature requests for core development teams. * **AI \& Accelerated Compute Infrastructure:** Hands on experience operating GPU accelerated Kubernetes nodes, model serving runtimes (vLLM, TGI, Triton Inference Server), vector databases (Milvus, Qdrant, Pgvector), and distributed AI orchestration (Ray, KubeRay). * **Distributed Systems \& Stateful Workloads:** Hands on experience containerizing and operating high throughput/low latency platforms:**Distributed Caching \& In Memory Grids:** Redis, Oracle Coherence, Hazelcast * **Compute \& Analytics Engines:** Risk calculation platforms, Hadoop (HDFS/YARN) * **Messaging \& Streaming:** Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pulsar * **Cloud Native Data \& AI Stack Depth:** Deep technical knowledge of deploying, tuning, and scaling containerized data services, AI engines, and orchestrators: * **Batch, Real Time \& AI Processing:** Ray, vLLM, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Dask * **Orchestration \& Workflow:** Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Argo Workflows * **Query, NoSQL \& Vector Engines:** Trino/Presto, Apache Cassandra / ScyllaDB, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, Milvus, Qdrant * **Multi Kubernetes Proficiency:** Technical depth across competing enterprise distributions (OpenShift, EKS, GKE, AKS, or Rancher RKE/RKS). * **Infrastructure as Code \& GitOps:** Advanced skills in Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes Operators (KPO), Cluster API (CAPI), and GitOps (ArgoCD, Flux). **Experience/Education:** Bachelor's degree preferred. Relevant year's experience in lieu of a degree may be considered. 12\+ years related experience required **Compensation and Benefits** The annual base salary range for this position is USD 110,800\.00 To USD 177,300\.00 As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. All subject to relevant plan documents and award agreements. Broadcom offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401(K) participation including company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company paid holidays, paid sick leave and vacation time. The company follows all applicable laws for Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence. **Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with local law.** **If you are located outside USA, please be sure to fill out a home address as this will be used for future correspondence.**

jobs.title: Hardware Infrastructure Engineer II
jobs.description: CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences. As CLEAR continues to expand its identity platform across physical and digital environments, our network of kiosks and connected devices forms the backbone of our member experience. Ensuring these systems stay secure, reliable, and always available is mission\-critical, and that's where you come in. We're looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Hardware Operations and Platform Engineering team. You'll be sitting at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineer and Embedded Systems Integration. You'll be architecting and maintaining the software layer that keeps thousands of Linux\-based kiosks online, healthy, and self\-healing, effectively operating a distributed server fleet at the edge. You'll own everything from OS image management to over\-the\-air (OTA) updates, device observability, and system recovery, while ensuring our biometric kiosks deliver a consistent, frictionless experience to every traveler, every time. ### ***What You Will Do*** * Architect and implement OS\-level watchdogs, process monitors, and self\-healing mechanisms to ensure devices automatically recover from failures (service restarts, reboots, or rollbacks). * Manage and enhance our OTA update framework to enable safe, atomic updates via A/B partition swapping and automated rollback when needed. * Develop and maintain Python\-based services that interact with connected peripherals (payment terminals, scanners, sensors) via vendor SDKs and serial interfaces. * Own and maintain our custom Linux image (via Yocto, Buildroot, bootc, rpm\-ostree, etc), managing systemd units, udev rules, and security policies for a locked\-down, production\-grade environment. * Build lightweight monitoring agents to stream logs, metrics, and telemetry (connectivity, performance, temperature) to centralized observability systems such as Datadog or Splunk. * Work closely with software, SRE, and field operations teams to identify pain points and develop scalable solutions that improve reliability and ease of maintenance. ### ***Who You Are*** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience administering embedded Linux systems * Strong proficiency in Python for system automation, service orchestration, and hardware communication. * Familiarity with A/B update mechanisms (RAUC, Mender, SWUpdate, or custom partition\-switching logic). * Experienced in serial communications (UART, RS\-232, USB\-serial) and SDK\-based hardware integration. * Deep knowledge of service dependencies, timers, and watchdog configuration. * Familiarity with network observability and remote device management at fleet scale. * Committed to operational excellence, focused on designing for resilience, testability, and safe rollback. * Collaborative, pragmatic, and curious; equally comfortable debugging a kiosk in the field or improving CI/CD for edge devices. ### ***Why You'll Love This Role*** * Massive impact: Your work ensures millions of travelers experience CLEAR's identity platform without disruption. * Unique technical challenge: Operate and scale a distributed edge infrastructure at the intersection of IoT and reliability engineering. * End\-to\-end ownership**:** From OS image to telemetry pipeline, you'll own the full stack of machine reliability. * Collaborative culture: Deep cross\-functional partnership with engineering and operations experts to create frictionless identity experiences. * Continuous learning: Work on modern Linux, OTA updates, and observability systems at enterprise scale. ### ***How You'll be Rewarded:*** At CLEAR, we help YOU move forward \- because when you're at your best, we're at our best. You'll work with talented team members motivated by our mission of making experiences safer and easier. Our offices are bright and energetic with an open concept and plenty of conference rooms and casual co\-working spaces. We also offer catered lunches every day and have fully stocked kitchens. Outside of the office, we invest in your well\-being and learning \& development with stipends and reimbursement programs. We offer holistic total rewards, including comprehensive healthcare plans, family\-building benefits (fertility and adoption/surrogacy support), flexible time off, annual wellness stipend, free OneMedical memberships for you and your dependents, a CLEAR Plus membership, and a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match. The base compensation range for this role is **$90,000 – $135,000,** depending on levels of skills and experience. This total compensation will include base salary and new hire equity package (in Restricted Stock Units) for this position at CLEAR. Additionally, this role will be eligible for refresh equity grants as part of our ongoing compensation program. Actual compensation will vary based on factors including, but not limited to, location, education, skills, experience, and performance. All stock based compensation will be subject to the terms and conditions of applicable agreements. *Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.* *CLEAR provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities or protected needs. Please let us know if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include, but are not limited to, time off, extra breaks, making a change to the application process or work procedures, policy exceptions, providing documents in an alternative format, live captioning or using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.* *We are committed to a transparent and secure hiring process. All communications related to this role will come directly from a CLEAR employee through valid CLEAR channels (e.g., a valid @clearme.com email address or verified CLEAR LinkedIn profile). jobs.title: Software Development Manager - CMAP/ERP
jobs.description: Overview: The Software Development Manager \- CMAP/ERP leads the engineering team delivering CMaP \- the rewrite of CPI Card Group's legacy ASI platform \- which serves as the connective tissue linking manufacturing operations, enterprise systems, and data. CMaP integrates the new Acumatica ERP, manufacturing tools, and the Databricks Medallion Lakehouse on AWS. Reporting to the SVP, Business Technology and Data, this is a hands\-on engineering leadership role responsible for managing a distributed development team, coordinating vendor delivery, and bridging legacy manufacturing systems with CPI's modern data and ERP landscape. The role is a key execution partner as CMaP progresses from MVP through production deployment, and it exists to ensure CPI modernizes the technology backbone of its payment card manufacturing and personalization operations on time and with production\-grade quality. Responsibilities: This is a people\-leadership role responsible for the CMaP engineering team (direct and matrixed), including offshore engineers and external vendor/contractor teams (e.g., Zensar). The role is accountable for delivery of the CMaP platform that bridges manufacturing operations, Monarch, and Acumatica, and underpins CPI's modernization of its payment card manufacturing and personalization technology backbone. The CMaP ERP Software Engineering Manager has leadership authority over the CMaP engineering team, its delivery plan, engineering standards, and day\-to\-day execution, and makes staffing, work\-allocation, and performance decisions within approved headcount. The role owns technical and delivery decisions for the CMaP platform and manages vendor and contractor delivery against milestones. Decisions involving material scope changes, new vendor commitments, changes to the headcount plan, or shifts in program timeline or regulatory risk posture are made in partnership with the SVP, Business Technology and Data.* Team Leadership and Delivery Management (30%) \- Lead, mentor, and manage the offshore (India\-based) engineering team, developing it into a primary execution arm for CPI's data and ERP initiatives. Set objectives, allocate work, manage performance, and cultivate a high\-performing, increasingly self\-directed team. * End\-to\-End Platform Delivery (25%) \- Own delivery of the CMaP platform rewrite across all milestones: the Databricks MVP (August 2026\), the H2 2026 launch, and Q1 2027 production deployment. Manage timelines, dependencies, scope, and quality to ensure reliable, on\-time execution. * Systems Integration and Data Governance (20%) \- Ensure CMaP operates as the connective tissue between the Acumatica ERP, the legacy Monarch environment, and the Databricks Medallion Lakehouse (Bronze/Silver/Gold). Ensure CMaP correctly consumes governed data definitions (e.g., UCID, Product Hierarchy) from the Databricks platform. * Vendor Coordination and Engineering Standards (15%) \- Coordinate vendor and flex\-team delivery (e.g., Zensar contractors), managing scope, capacity, and quality against defined milestones. Establish and enforce engineering best practices across CI/CD (GitLab), AWS environments, and data pipeline integration. * Risk Management and Cross\-Functional Partnership (10%) \- Identify and manage technical "known\-unknowns" early \- including billing automation and volume/scaling design \- as planned\-for workstreams rather than late surprises. Partner with Product * Development, IT/PMO, and data engineering to align delivery with business needs in a regulated card\-production environment. * Drive retirement of legacy platforms ahead of the 2028 end\-of\-support deadline. * Contribute to workforce and capacity planning for the offshore engineering team, including contractor\-to\-FTE strategy. * Support PCI/SOX compliance requirements applicable to the card\-production environment. Qualifications: * Strong hands\-on knowledge of AWS cloud architecture and data pipeline integration. * Proficiency with modern CI/CD practices and tooling (GitLab preferred). * Excellent communication skills and the ability to navigate cross\-functional and inter\-organizational dynamics. * Familiarity with Databricks (Medallion/Lakehouse architecture) and modern data governance concepts preferred. * Background in payments, card manufacturing/personalization, or a regulated production environment (PCI/SOX awareness a plus). * Experience bridging on\-prem legacy systems (e.g., Monarch) with cloud\-native platforms preferred. * Exposure to BI/visualization tooling (Sigma Computing, Power BI) a plus. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. * 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years managing engineering teams (with distributed/offshore teams). * Proven track record delivering complex platform builds or rewrites in a manufacturing, operations, or production environment. * Experience integrating with or building alongside ERP systems (Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar). * Demonstrated experience coordinating third\-party vendors and contractor teams against fixed milestones. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time **Company Overview:** CPI Card Group® is a payment technology company and leading provider of credit, debit and prepaid solutions delivered physically, digitally and on\-demand. CPI helps our customers foster connections and build their brands through innovative and reliable solutions, including financial payment cards, personalization and fulfillment, and Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) instant issuance. Learn more at www.cpicardgroup.com. **Benefits:** Competitive pay rates and an inclusive, empowering and rewarding culture. Solid benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Short Term Disability, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, FSA, HSA, Vacation and Holiday Pay, Tuition Reimbursement and 401(k) with a competitive company match percentage. CPI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets. A complete background including drug screen is contingent upon hire.

jobs.title: AI Engineer

The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), cloud technologies, and integrating AI capabilities into enterprise applications. **Key jobs.description: **Resp \& Qualifications** **PURPOSE:** Drives enterprise optimization by introducing capabilities (inclusive of all functions) for their domain of responsibility utilizing in\-depth knowledge and expert skills to advance domain strategies. Create and utilize architecture patterns and ensure alignment with IT strategies and reference architectures. Ensure target state alignment and integration across architecture domains. Ensure upstream alignment / traceability to business needs via business architecture and downstream alignment / traceability with solution building blocks. Leads the extension / enhancement of domain architecture strategies, standards, and guidelines. Identify and support development of reusable domain patterns. Disposition stakeholder comments / feedback received via project and non\-project channels. Ensures that regulatory and compliance issues are addressed in solutions. Leads architectural reviews for ServiceNow initiatives and serves as the primary architectural authority for complex platform decisions. Provides oversight of platform upgrades, release planning, application rationalization, instance strategy, environment management, and platform lifecycle management. Ensures solution designs appropriately balance business value, user experience, security, technical sustainability, supportability, and total cost of ownership. * Leads collaboration with other teams (business and technical), key stakeholders, and partners to understand needs to maximize architecture impact and address technical limitations. Leads the evaluation/selection of a solution / product design that aligns with IT / Domain strategies, standards, and guidelines. Partners with business stakeholders, product owners, platform owners, engineering teams, cybersecurity teams, infrastructure teams, and vendors to define ServiceNow capabilities and solution strategies. Facilitates architecture reviews, design workshops, governance boards, and strategic planning sessions related to ServiceNow capabilities and investments. * Leads research emerging domain trends to determine their relevancy and fit for the organization. jobs.title: AI Engineer, Developer Relations
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Sunnyvale, CA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Product Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry\-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU\-based hyperscale cloud inference services. This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real\-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation. Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting\-edge AI\-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi\-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high\-speed inference. **About the Role** ------------------ We’re looking for an AI Engineer who loves building with new models, experimenting with developer tools, and writing about what they learn. You’ll create prototypes that demonstrate what fast inference makes possible, optimize the harnesses around models, and turn your findings into technical content that helps other developers build. This is a hands\-on Developer Relations role on our DevRel team. Technical writing is a core part of the job. You’ll take projects from an interesting question through implementation, testing, and a clear explanation others can follow. You should be as comfortable debugging an agent workflow or comparing model behavior as you are writing a tutorial or presenting a demo. **What You’ll Own** ------------------- * **Technical writing:** Write blogs, tutorials, walkthroughs, and practical guides grounded in your own experiments. Explain how things work, why implementation choices matter, and how developers can reproduce your results. * **Prototypes and demos:** Find original ways to showcase Cerebras fast inference. Build sample applications, notebooks, and interactive experiences that make the benefit tangible. * **Harness optimization:** Build and improve the code and workflows around models, including prompts, tool use, context management, orchestration, and evaluation. Identify bottlenecks and test ways to improve speed, reliability, and output quality. * **Model experimentation:** Try new models and investigate their capabilities, limitations, and fit for different tasks. Compare behavior on realistic workloads and turn useful findings into examples and recommendations for developers. * **Evaluation and reproducibility:** Design practical tests, measure results, and validate technical claims. Make your code easy to run and explain the assumptions, tradeoffs, and limitations behind your conclusions. * **Launches and developer education:** Partner with Product, Engineering, and New Media to create technically accurate launch examples, workshops, and stories. Present your work and help developers understand how to apply it. * **Developer feedback:** Engage with developers, troubleshoot integrations, and turn recurring questions and friction into improvements to examples, documentation, and the product experience. **Skills and Qualifications** ----------------------------- * A strong portfolio of AI applications, prototypes, technical writing, tutorials, or other substantive developer\-facing work. * Hands\-on experience building with model APIs and debugging AI application workflows. * Excellent technical writing skills. You can turn a complex implementation or experimental result into a clear, useful explanation. * Experience working with agent harnesses or related workflows involving prompting, tool calling, context management, and evaluation. * An informed view of the AI developer ecosystem and curiosity about new models, frameworks, and emerging application patterns. * Strong technical judgment. You can design fair comparisons, verify results, and distinguish observations from assumptions. * Original ideas for demos and developer experiences, with a clear sense of what makes an example useful and engaging. * The ability to scope projects, ship independently, incorporate feedback, and collaborate with technical and creative partners. **Preferred Experience** ------------------------ * Experience optimizing latency, responsiveness, or reliability in AI applications. * Contributions to open\-source projects, developer tools, or publicly available technical examples. * Experience teaching developers through workshops, talks, or live demonstrations. **Portfolio** ------------- Please include links to code, prototypes, and technical writing you’ve created. Identify what you personally built or wrote, explain the problem you explored, and share the results or lessons learned. Cerebras Systems is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome different backgrounds and perspectives and strive to create an inclusive environment where people can learn, grow, and do their best work. **Why Join Cerebras** People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. With dozens of model releases and rapid growth, we’ve reached an inflection point in our business. Members of our team tell us there are five main reasons they joined Cerebras: * Build a breakthrough AI platform beyond the constraints of the GPU. * Publish and open source their cutting\-edge AI research. * Work on one of the fastest AI supercomputers in the world. * Enjoy job stability with startup vitality. * Our simple, non\-corporate work culture that respects individual beliefs. **Apply today and become part of the forefront of groundbreaking advancements in AI!** *Cerebras Systems is committed to creating an equal and diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe inclusive teams build better products and companies. We try every day to build a work environment that empowers people to do their best work through continuous learning, growth and support of those around them.*

Intelligence** or comparable OCR/document\-processing technology. * Experience with document classification and structured metadata extraction. * Experience working with unstructured content such as PDFs, scanned documents, and OCR\-generated text. * Experience designing search index schemas, metadata models, filters, and query strategies. * Experience with text chunking, embedding generation, vector indexing, and retrieval strategies. * Experience with prompt engineering and LLM integration. * Experience evaluating and tuning search relevance and AI\-generated responses. * Understanding of hallucination mitigation, grounding, citations, confidence scoring, and responsible AI practices. * Experience integrating AI/search services with REST APIs, Azure services, or enterprise applications. * Familiarity with Microsoft SharePoint, Microsoft Graph API, and Microsoft 365 environments. * Experience with Git\-based source control, CI/CD, testing, and deployment practices. * Understanding of secure cloud development, identity management, and least\-privilege access. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and technical documentation skills. * Ability to work closely with team and Government stakeholders. * Ability to successfully complete required FLRA personnel security vetting. **Preferred Certifications** * Microsoft Certified: **Azure AI Engineer jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Chooch helps build and run the best Computer Vision AI applications that make cameras intelligent, enhancing productivity \& revenues, while reducing operational costs. Chooch has been named a leading computer vision platform by IDC. **Role Description** We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (US\-based) to join our team. This is a full\-time, hybrid role with frequent hands\-on experience with customer projects in the Bay Area. The Machine Learning Engineer will be responsible for the successful design, accuracy, and backbone behind our Computer Vision AI applications. This includes data preparation, training, configuring neural networks, deploying networks in real customer locations, and refining computer vision algorithms for healthcare, manufacturing, and retail customers. This role requires frequent interaction with technical and non\-technical customers while working closely within our solutions engineering teams. The Machine Learning Engineering role has opportunity to grow, lead technical projects, and improve current processes while providing meaningful feedback to our product and solutions teams. **Product Description** Chooch AI is a computer vision platform that helps hospitals automate supply room monitoring and inventory management. Using fixed cameras and AI, the platform continuously tracks supplies in storage areas and updates on\-hand counts in real time. When inventory levels fall below defined thresholds, replenishment orders are automatically generated and sent to ERP systems, eliminating manual counts and barcode scanning. Hospitals using Chooch AI significantly reduce critical stockouts, optimize inventory levels, and improve supply chain staff productivity. By turning supply rooms into self\-managing systems, Chooch AI enables clinical and supply chain teams to focus more time on patient care. Responsibilities/What you'll do at Chooch: * Design, train and fine\-tune models for object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking and anomaly detection on real customer video and images. * Adapt pretrained and foundation models (YOLO\-family detectors, ViTs, CLIP\-style and vision\-language models) to new customer use cases with limited labeled data. * Own data pipelines end to end: curation, labeling guidelines, augmentation, synthetic data, and dataset versioning. * Optimize models for production and edge hardware using quantization, pruning, distillation, ONNX export and TensorRT, hitting agreed latency and accuracy targets. * Build evaluation suites with clear metrics (mAP, precision/recall, false\-alarm rates per camera\-hour) and catch regressions before release. * Deploy and monitor models in production, diagnose drift and failure cases, and close the loop with retraining. * Work with product, solutions engineers and customers to turn vague requirements into measurable model specs. * Write clean, tested, reviewed code and contribute to shared ML tooling. Nice to have * Experience with vision\-language models (CLIP, LLaVA\-style models) or open\-vocabulary detection. * Multi\-object tracking and video analytics (re\-identification, action recognition, temporal models). * Few\-shot learning, active learning, or synthetic data generation for low\-data domains. * MLOps tooling: MLflow or Weights \& Biases, Kubernetes, Triton Inference Server, CI/CD for models. * Domain experience in Healthcare, retail and supply chain, manufacturing inspection, workplace safety or video surveillance. Key Components * Model Development and Optimization: Design, develop, and optimize machine learning models for computer vision applications. * Data Management: Collaborate with ML engineers to ensure the collection, processing, and maintenance of high\-quality datasets necessary for model training and testing. * Algorithm Implementation: Implement state\-of\-the\-art computer vision algorithms to improve system accuracy and performance in real\-world scenarios. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely within the solutions engineering team to integrate machine learning models into the broader product and systems. * On\-Site Travel and Field Testing: Many of our projects are live deployments with major fortune 500 customers – testing new, innovative ML technologies. Traveling on site is sometimes needed to see the environment, test in the real\-world, and ensure the technology is operating as expected. * Performance Evaluation: Regularly evaluate the performance of computer vision models, using both qualitative and quantitative methods, and iterate to enhance accuracy and efficiency. * Research and Innovation: Understanding of the latest developments in machine learning and computer vision, applying innovative approaches and technologies to solve complex challenges. * Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions. * Problem\-Solving: Address and troubleshoot complex problems that arise during the development and deployment of computer vision systems. The ideal candidate should be deeply passionate about machine learning and its real\-world applications, particularly in improving and leveraging state\-of\-the\-art neural networks to make an impact. **Requirements** * 3–5 years of industry experience building ML systems, with at least 2 years focused on computer vision. * BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong Python and hands\-on experience with PyTorch (or TensorFlow) for training and debugging deep learning models. * Shipped at least one computer vision model to production, and can explain the trade\-offs made along the way. * Solid grasp of CNN and transformer architectures for detection, segmentation and classification. * Experience with OpenCV and image/video processing: decoding streams, preprocessing, augmentation. * Working knowledge of model optimization for inference (ONNX, TensorRT, quantization or similar). * Comfortable with Docker, Git, Linux and training on GPUs in a cloud environment (AWS/Azure). * Sound ML fundamentals: loss functions, overfitting, class imbalance, evaluation metrics and experiment design. * Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining model behavior to non\-ML stakeholders. **Benefits** Chooch offers extensive benefits including health, dental, vision insurance, 401K with 3% match, extensive PTO, and life insurance policies included.

jobs.title: VP, Principal Resilience Engineer
jobs.description: Chubb has made community\-scale climate resilience a strategic priority, with executive support and the resources needed to operate on a national scale. The Vice President, Principal Resilience Engineer will provide engineering leadership for Chubb ’ s Community Resilience Initiative, connecting building design, construction, and community\-scale mitigation with measurable reductions in damage, disruption, and insured losses. We are looking for an experienced, creative engineer who can move beyond code compliance to ask: What will meaningfully reduce long\-term risk for the community, at various scales of intervention, and how can we demonstrate that it works? The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in one or more perils, including wildfire, coastal and inland flooding, wind, and severe storms, together with a strong understanding of how buildings are designed, constructed, retrofitted, and maintained. Reporting to the Executive Vice President, Global Resilience and Risk Consulting, and working hand\-in\-hand with the Vice President, Community Resilience, the Principal Resilience Engineer will work across Chubb’s risk consulting, underwriting, catastrophe modeling, claims, and analytics teams, as well as with external stakeholders, including property owners, developers, community associations, local governments, and utilities. The Principal Resilience Engineer will be responsible for establishing the technical basis for verified risk reduction and modeled loss reduction that supports community\-scale resilience investments. They will be the technical backing to inform where verified risk reduction may support improved insurance availability, capacity, and responsible business growth, in collaboration with Underwriting, Actuarial, Catastrophe Modeling, and Risk Engineering. This position offers a flexible location, with travel expected to support project delivery in targeted communities and key stakeholder engagements. **Why This Role Matters** Communities need more than information about their climate risk. They need clear, technically credible guidance about which interventions will reduce losses. This is an opportunity to shape how engineering evidence translates into resilience investment and insurance confidence. The Principal Resilience Engineer will help communities understand what to do, help partners implement effective solutions, and help Chubb recognize meaningful risk reduction – supporting safer properties, stronger communities, and the responsible expansion of insurance in catastrophe\-exposed markets. **Responsibilities** * Serve as a senior technical authority on building and community resilience, bringing subject matter expertise in one or more natural catastrophe perils and coordinating specialists across other disciplines. * Lead field assessments and technical reviews to identify how buildings, sites, infrastructure, and surrounding conditions contribute to damage and loss. * Develop prioritized recommendations across property, neighborhood, and community scales, recognizing where individual building improvements depend on coordinated action beyond the property boundary. * Apply performance\-based engineering judgment to develop solutions that extend beyond minimum code requirements and account for future climate conditions, asset life, and uncertainty. * Translate recommendations into actionable scopes, design criteria, technical guidance, and implementation pathways for property owners and community partners. * Partner with catastrophe modelers and analysts to translate physical vulnerabilities and proposed mitigation measures into appropriate modeling assumptions and scenarios. * Assess whether modeled risk reductions are supported by engineering evidence, field conditions, and observed loss experience; identify limitations and additional validation needs. * Work with underwriting and risk consulting colleagues to define meaningful mitigation criteria, documentation, and verification requirements that can inform risk selection, capacity, and other insurance decisions. * Support evaluation of mitigation costs against potential reductions in damage, loss, and disruption, clearly communicating uncertainty and remaining exposure. * Establish consistent assessment methods, technical review processes, and quality standards that can be applied across communities while accommodating local conditions. * Explain technical findings and recommendations clearly to homeowners, community leaders, business partners, and senior executives. * Mentor colleagues and turn project findings into practical guidance that strengthens Chubb’s broader resilience capabilities. * Bachelor’s degree in civil, structural, coastal, environmental, fire protection, or another relevant engineering discipline. * At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in engineering design, construction, building performance, natural hazard mitigation, resilience, or related risk engineering work. * Active Professional Engineer (PE) license in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction. * Demonstrated subject matter expertise in one or more of the following perils: wildfire; coastal flooding; inland flooding; wind, including hurricanes; or severe storms, including hail and tornadoes. * Deep knowledge of building design and construction, including materials, structural and envelope systems, construction practices, retrofit methods, and common failure mechanisms. * Demonstrated ability to develop practical engineering solutions that exceed minimum code requirements and address long\-term performance under a changing climate. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to influence decisions across disciplines and organizations. * An entrepreneurial approach: comfortable defining problems, proposing a path forward, and adapting as evidence and requirements evolve. * Willingness to travel for site assessments, project delivery, and partner engagement. * Collaborative mindset with a willingness to learn, take direction, and contribute to team success. Strong attention to detail and follow\-through. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced degree in a relevant engineering discipline. * Experience assessing both individual buildings and the community systems that influence their exposure and performance. * Familiarity with catastrophe modeling, property insurance, underwriting, or loss prevention. * Experience working with residential communities, HOAs, developers, local governments, utilities, or public infrastructure owners. A record of advancing innovative approaches through technical standards, applied research, pilot projects, or professional leadership. * The pay range for the role is $158,550 to $229,950\. The specific offer will depend on an applicant’s skills and other factors. This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. Chubb offers a comprehensive benefits package, more details on which can be found on our careers website . The disclosed pay range estimate may be adjusted for the applicable geographic differential for the location in which the position is filled. Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance, and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is distinguished by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength, underwriting excellence, superior claims handling expertise and local operations globally. At Chubb, we are committed to equal employment opportunity and compliance with all laws and regulations pertaining to it. Our policy is to provide employment, training, compensation, promotion, and other conditions or opportunities of employment, without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, mental and physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, age, and pregnancy or any other characteristic protected by law. Performance and qualifications are the only basis upon which we hire, assign, promote, compensate, develop and retain employees. Chubb prohibits all unlawful discrimination, harassment and retaliation against any individual who reports discrimination or harassment.

jobs.title: Control Systems & Embedded Software Technical Leader, Acacia
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 11/29/2026 Meet the Team Acacia (part of Cisco) is the industry market leader and pioneer in high\-speed coherent optical transceivers and pluggable optical interconnects. Acacia’s revolutionary optical solutions are deployed across all major global hyperscale cloud providers and telecommunications networks, interconnecting data centers across metropolitan spans, thousands of kilometers of terrestrial fiber, and deep submarine links. With the explosive growth of artificial intelligence and machine learning workloads driving unprecedented bandwidth requirements, Acacia’s high\-speed optical transceivers are expanding into next\-generation data center fabrics and high\-performance compute clusters. In addition to powering deep\-space optical communication systems, Acacia is leading the client\-side optics market with breakthrough PAM4 DSP architectures, including industry\-first 1\.6T PAM4 DSP platforms. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
jobs.description: Description: **Job Title:** Principal Software Engineer, Platform Engineering **Job Type:** Full\-time **Location:** Hybrid \- Denver, CO (3 days on\-site per week) **About CloudBees** CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust. CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control\-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow. Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta\-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Visit us at www.cloudbees.com. **About the Role** The CloudBees platform is the foundation everything else is built on. When it works well, engineers ship faster, customers trust us more, and the product compounds. When it doesn't, every team feels it. This is that team — and the future of the platform depends on you. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Platform Engineering team, developing microservices using Go and running in AWS. You will be directing, leading, and contributing to build and operate the platform. You bring deep back\-end engineering expertise and, just as importantly, a product mindset — you understand that “platform is a product”, and that the quality of your work defines what we can build and what our customers will experience. You are excited about the future of software development with coding agents, and you have full\-embraced agentic AI for doing your everyday work. You ship production\-quality code, you design resilient systems that outlast you, and you have the judgment to know when to optimize for speed and when to optimize for correctness. You are fluent in the tradeoffs of distributed systems, curious about how the platform affects the full software delivery lifecycle, and you are committed to leaving things better than you found them. Requirements: **What You'll Do** Own the Platform Foundation: * Understand the existing platform code and architecture, forming a strong, evidence\-based opinion on its strengths, its weaknesses, and what to do about them. * Define the technical roadmap with measurable goals and sequence the work to deliver incremental value. * Write the hardest code yourself. Own the critical\-path refactors, the performance work, and the stability fixes. Bring the Team with You: * Earn the trust of an established team. Listen first, then show your reasoning and let the code make the case. * Guide teams through execution by setting direction, defining standards, and unblocking the hard problems. * Lead design reviews and code reviews with rigor and honesty. Make Quality the Default: * Establish development practices that hold up as the team and platform evolve: testing, interfaces, service boundaries, and release discipline. * Drive observability (metrics, structured logs, tracing) and use it to find root causes. * Write down architecture decisions and the reasoning behind them for the next evolution to learn and improve upon.. **You May Be a Good Fit If** * You have 12\+ years of relevant experience as a founding, principal, or staff engineer. * You have built and operated a complex microservices platform in production, and can explain what broke, why, and what you did about it. * You have extensive distributed\-systems experience, including concurrency, event\-driven architectures, message buses, and their failure modes. * You have taken over a complex codebase and measurably made it better. * You still contribute code that ships to production every week. **Your Mindset** * You think like a technical founder. You own outcomes for the whole system, not just your piece. * You have high emotional intelligence. You can critique a design without making it personal, and you change your mind when the data tells you to. * You prefer simple solutions to clever ones. * **Customer Obsessed** — You treat customer problems as your own and build relationships with the people behind the logo, not just the account. You can point to decisions you changed because of what a customer told you. * **High Agency** — You own problems beyond your job description and move without waiting to be asked. When the path isn't defined, you make the call and bring people with you rather than working around them. * ** esult, not just your slice of it, and you go beyond what's expected to get there. You work smart as well as hard, and you find real reward in building something demanding alongside people who do the same. * **Ship Excellence** — You hold a painfully high quality bar and keep raising it, while shipping with urgency instead of waiting for perfect. Every iteration is something you learn from. * **Direct Feedback** — You give honest, constructive feedback regardless of seniority or tenure, and you actively ask for it in return. You deliver it with enough care that people want to hear it from you. **Strong Candidates May Also** * Have led a simplification or stabilization effort on an existing SaaS platform. * Have built or operated CI/CD systems, workflow engines, or developer platforms. * Have contributed to open source in the Kubernetes, Tekton, NATS, Jenkins, or broader DevOps ecosystem. * Have background in identity and access management, multi\-tenancy, or regulated environments. * Have experience with LLM\-powered features or MCP tooling in production backends. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base Pay Range: $200,000 \- $230,000 annually In accordance with applicable law, this represents a reasonable estimated compensation range for this role. Actual compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location and may be more or less than the amount shown above. Outside of base compensation, CloudBees also offers stock options and variable bonuses. **What CloudBees Offers** * **Time that's actually yours.** Our BEE\-Flexible PTO policy folds vacation, sick time, and personal days into one unlimited plan. Plus paid U.S. holidays and 2 dedicated Bee\-Giving Days to volunteer for a cause you care about. * **Health coverage from day one.** You're eligible on your start date, not 90 days in. Choose from medical, dental and vision options designed to support your healthcare needs. Choose an HDHP plan and we will contribute to your HSA on top of your own pre\-tax contributions. * **Real money toward your future.** Invest in your future with a competitive 401(k) company match, offering both pre\-tax and Roth options to help you reach your financial goals. * **Protection we pay for entirely.** We fully fund your Life and AD\&D, Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability protection. Plus our Employee Assistance Program is fully covered too. * **Support for your headspace \- literally.** All Bees have access to a company\-sponsored Headspace account. Plus, a dedicated Care Concierge service in the U.S. so you never have to decode a benefits question alone. * **A home office that works.** A stipend every month toward your work\-from\-home setup in addition to the opportunity to work (hybrid for Denver, CO employees) in an office with your peers. * **Upside when we win.** Base salary is the floor. Our bonus plan rewards for the goals you deliver and the growth we drive together. * **People who sweat the craft.** A team that takes its work seriously and invests in each other's growth. * **A global, collaborative team** that lives by our values: Customer Obsessed, High Agency, Truth Seeking, Hard Work, Ship Excellence, Direct Feedback. **EEO Statement** CloudBees is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business need, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. **Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this position. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
