jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France. As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on\-site interview as part of the final stages of the process. We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have. We're transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics (including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data) accessible to every collector, old or new. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. We're looking for a Staff Applied AI Engineer to join the Applied AI function at Collectors. This is an embedded, build\-first role with portfolio\-level ownership: you'll own a full business domain, decide which problems in it are worth solving with AI, and build and ship the solutions end\-to\-end. You'll still prototype fast and prove value in business terms, but your impact compounds beyond your own builds: the patterns you establish, the assets you make reusable, and the roadmap you shape become the way the whole team ships in your lane. This is not a traditional software engineering role, and it's not an architecture\-only role either. We're looking for a product\-minded builder who leads through shipped work: someone who can walk into an unmapped business domain, earn the trust of its leaders, build the first few wins personally, and then turn those wins into a durable portfolio. You'll report to the Head of Applied AI. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in\-person collaboration. ### **What You'll Do** * Own a business domain, not just a use case. You'll be accountable for the AI opportunity across an entire lane (for example Operations, Marketplace, or Finance): mapping the workflows, sizing the opportunities, and deciding what gets built, in what order, and why. * Build the hardest use cases yourself. You spend the majority of your time hands\-on. You take the first, riskiest, or most technically demanding builds in your lane from prototype through production, adoption, and measured impact. * Turn one\-off wins into reusable patterns. You notice when three builds share a shape, extract the common asset (a connector, an eval harness, a workflow pattern), and make it something every builder on the team can pick up. * Define success up front and prove it at portfolio level. You instrument outcomes before you build, and you can stand in front of the domain's leadership and account for the cumulative value your lane has delivered. * Design for earned autonomy. You build agents with the traces, evals, and human\-in\-the\-loop gates that let them graduate to more autonomy on evidence, not on elapsed time, and you help set that standard for others. * Operate as a power user of frontier AI. Use Claude, OpenAI, and our orchestration platform daily as your primary tools, and bring a strong, current point of view on models, harnesses, and tooling that informs the team's platform choices. * Win trust at the leadership level. Your stakeholders are function leaders, not just operators. You navigate competing priorities, secure sponsorship, and keep skeptical partners engaged through delivery. * Multiply the builders around you. You review designs and code, unblock senior and mid\-level engineers, raise the hiring bar as an interviewer, and make the people around you measurably better. * Build production grade applications around AI systems. You can design and implement the application layer a  you hold yourself accountable for whether the portfolio moved the numbers, not just whether things shipped. * A force multiplier. You have a track record of making other engineers better through review, mentorship, patterns, or tooling, and people you've worked with would say so unprompted. * A clear communicator. You're equally comfortable with operators on the floor, engineers in review, and executives in a readout, and you can carry a room that started out skeptical. * A continuous learner. You believe staying excellent in this field means never standing still. You actively track the latest models, tools, and techniques as they ship, form your own view on what matters, and bring the best of it back to the team. Salary Range: *The salary range for this position is* $165,848\-$269,259\. *Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non\-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation, please ask your recruiter for details.* Reasons To Join Us: * Health Insurance: All full\-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision * Additional Benefits: Full\-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits * 401(K) Matching Plan: We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals * Vacation: All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time\-off. * Holiday Pay: All regular, full\-time employees are eligible for ten company paid holidays * Employee Discounts: Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions * Flexible Hours: Many of our teams offer flexible schedules with varying shifts and will work with you to accommodate your needs * Fun Working Environment: Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities Additional Resources: Collectors Tech Blog , PSA * Collectors uses e\-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States. We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e\-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. We never ask for personal information such as your bank account, Social Security numbers or National IDs, nor do we send or request payments for the purchase of business\-related equipment. If you suspect fraud, please reach out to interviewfraud@collectors.com. *We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We believe that a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills will better service the diverse community of collectors we support.* *If you require an accommodation to apply or interview with us due to a disability or special need, please email* *interviewaccommodation@collectors.com.* *U.S. residents: for disclosures relating to personal information we collect during the employment application and recruitment process, please see our* *Privacy Notice for U.S. Applicants* *.* For New York Residents: In connection with hiring, Collectors Universe, Inc. uses an automated employment decision tool (Brighthire) to assist in evaluating candidates. jobs.title: Senior Electrical and Controls Engineer

With roots in one of the fastest\-growing data center markets in the world, our growth is as intentional as our impact. **About Compu Dynamics Modular** Compu Dynamics Modular (CDM) is at the forefront of innovative modular solutions, specializing in Modular Data Centers (MDC), metal frame systems, and fully integrated enclosures. Our designs are scalable, efficient, and sustainable, tailored to meet the evolving needs of our clients in a dynamic industry. **Summary/Objective:** The **Senior Electrical and Controls Engineer** is a technical leader responsible for driving the design, development, and implementation of electrical and control systems across Compu Dynamics Modular's data center and commercial modular products. Project \& Product Development Support** * Guide electrical scope development during bids and conceptual design phases; assist in cost estimation and proposal generation. * Review and approve submittals, RFIs, and shop drawings; provide technical documentation and responses to client or inspector inquiries. * Support field activities including site surveys, system troubleshooting, and commissioning support. * Generate required installation and maintenance documentation **3\. Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Vendor Coordination** * Interface with clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders to resolve design issues and clarify technical requirements. * Coordinate vendor selections based on technical and performance requirements; manage relationships with manufacturer representatives. * Review external control schematics and ensure alignment with modular system needs. **4\. Field work may include exposure to active construction, elevated temperatures, and energized equipment. **Physical Demands:** Must be able to conduct site walks, climb ladders, and lift up to 25 pounds occasionally. Work hours follow the service department schedule and may include occasional overtime. **Travel:** Up to 15% travel may be required for site walks, commissioning support, or vendor meetings. **Required Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or similar field. * 10\+ years of experience in electrical engineering with an emphasis on commercial, industrial, or mission\-critical projects. * Expert\-level understanding of power distribution, control systems, and electrical code compliance. **Preferred Education and Experience:** * Professional Engineering (PE) license strongly preferred. * Certifications such as LEED, CEM, or CPD are a plus. * Modular construction or data center infrastructure design experience. **AAP/EEO Statement:** Compu Dynamics Modular, LLC provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law. **Compu Dynamics offers a comprehensive benefits package** that supports the health, well\-being, and growth of our team members. The AI Engineer II contributes to production\-quality AI applications and helps improve the consistency, safety, and usefulness of AI\-supported engineering workflows. **Responsibilities:** Develop AI Harness \& Platform Capabilities * Design, build, test, and maintain well\-defined AI platform components, services, connectors, and internal tools. * Implement model routing, prompt execution patterns, API integrations, and reusable utilities aligned to platform standards. * Improve reliability, performance, observability, and usability of AI engineering tools. * Support production operations for AI\-enabled services, including troubleshooting, monitoring, and issue remediation. * May be responsible for on\-call rotation and front\-line incident response for AI\-enabled production services, including triage, escalation, and remediation. jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: **For questions regarding this position, please contact the Recruiter listed in the Supplemental Information section.** **ABOUT THE POSITION** ---------------------- The County of Riverside’s District Attorney’s Office is seeking to fill a Software Engineer II to support the District Attorney Office in Riverside. The Software Engineering team within the Riverside County District Attorney’s office has designed and built a sophisticated software platform entirely in\-house to support the complex operations of a modern DA legal environment. The system spans multiple modules, including case management, transaction processing, reporting, data management, and real\-time integrations with external agencies, all tailored to meet evolving business and compliance needs. As a Software Engineer II, incumbents will play a key role in shaping and scaling this critical platform. Incumbents will work alongside a sharp, collaborative team with strong technical backgrounds in computer science and engineering; people who care deeply about code quality, system architecture, and long\-term impact. This is a unique chance to work on meaningful, large\-scale projects with the autonomy to innovate and the support of smart peers within a stable public sector environment. If you are looking for challenging work that truly matters, submit an application today! Applicants who are currently enrolled in their third or fourth year of college, majoring in computer science or computer engineering, are highly desired. Competitive candidates will have demonstrated experience in at least one of the following programming languages or frameworks: C\#, C\+\+, Angular, Java, JavaScript, and React.js. The Software Engineer II is distinguished from the Software Engineer I in that the latter is the entry\-level classification in the series. This class is further distinguished from the Senior Software Engineer in that the latter requires incumbent to lead the team responsible for developing and implementing complex algorithms, data structures, and data models. Advancement to the next level is obtained by competitive selection through an open recruitment. **Meet The Team!** The District Attorney of Riverside County, as the public prosecutor acting on behalf of the People, vigorously enforces the law, pursues the truth, protects those victimized by crime, exonerates the innocent, and safeguards the rights of all to ensure that justice is done on behalf of our community. The office’s staff of over 700 is comprised of prosecuting attorneys, sworn investigators, victim\-witness advocates, paralegals, investigative technicians, forensic analysts, and a wide range of information technology and supporting staff all committed to excellence and integrity in public service. We are, and we seek to maintain, a diverse workforce to match a diverse county. **EXAMPLES OF ESSENTIAL DUTIES** -------------------------------- * Develop and build software systems components, Web APIs and Services. * Understand existing design patterns in the software and follow existing code in implementing new features. * Contribute to front end design using TypeScript, SASS, Bootstrap and with backend development. * Troubleshoot front\-end software issues using browser debugging and monitoring tools. * Build intermediate level SQL queries, Stored Procedures, and help generate reports. * Maintain scheduled tasks on the server and scheduled jobs on the database. * Add intermediate level features into software systems. * Ensure software features continue to work properly after maintenance and testing. * Investigate and resolve software errors in the application using various troubleshooting tools. * Troubleshoot software issues that may arise in the development and testing environment. * Work closely with department representatives in the development of software programming applications and testing of new features. * Maintain software configurations, library publishing packages, NuGet packages and repositories. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** -------------------------- **Education:** Graduation from an accredited college or university with a bachelor's degree in computer science,computer/software engineering, information technology, or related technical fields. Applicants who have completed atleast three years of college education (90 semester units or 135 quarter units) in one of the mentioned fields maysubstitute additional qualifying experience in system analysis, software programming, or software engineering for theremaining required education on the basis of one year of relevant, full\-time experience equaling 30 semester units or 45quarter units of education. **Experience:** Two years of software engineering in web front end and backend development. Experience must be recent and continuous including hands\-on experience in a diverse array of programming languages such as .Net Core, C\+\+, C\#, TypeScript, SQL and frameworks including NodeJS, Angular. Additionally, proficiency in essentia ability **Schedule, Overtime, Standby/On\-Call, and Travel Obligations** The County of Riverside offers a variety of alternative work schedules, dependent upon department operations and needs. Certain assignments may involve overtime, standby/on\-call shifts, and/or travel; however, scheduling, shift assignments, overtime work, standby/on\-call duty, and travel obligations are subject to management approval, operational needs, and/or may be modified or discontinued at any time. Applicants should contact the assigned recruiter for additional information regarding the schedule, overtime and standby/on\-call expectations, and travel obligations. **Proof of Education** If using education to qualify or when requested by the recruiter, upload a copy of any license(s), official/unofficial transcript(s), degrees, and/or related employment documents to your NeoGov account at the time of application and before the closing date. Official or unofficial transcripts will be accepted. If your education was completed outside of the United States, you will need to provide a copy of your Foreign Education Equivalency evaluation from a member of the National Association of Credential Evaluation Services (NACES) or Association of International Credential Evaluators, Inc. (AICE). **Work Authorization Requirement** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. The County of Riverside does not participate in visa sponsorship programs, including H1\-B visas, and will not provide sponsorship for any employment\-based visas. **Equal Opportunity Employer** The County of Riverside is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is the policy of the County of Riverside to provide equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, ancestry, medical condition (cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, or denial of medical and family care leave, or any other non\-job\-related factors. **Pre\-Employment** All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of pre\-employment requirements including a criminal background investigation, which involves fingerprinting. (A felony or misdemeanor conviction may disqualify the applicant from County employment). A pre\-employment physical examination and background check may be required. **Probationary Period** As an Approved Local Merit System, all County of Riverside employees, except those serving "At Will," are subject to the probationary period provisions as specified in the applicable Memorandum of Understanding, County Resolution, or Salary Ordinance. Temporary and Per Diem employees serve at the pleasure of the agency/department head. **General Information** Current County of Riverside and/or current employees of the hiring department may receive priority consideration. Qualified candidates may be considered for future County vacancies. Job postings may close without notice based on application volume. Submit your complete application by the recruitment close date; no late applications are accepted. Ensure all relevant experience/education is reflected on your application/resume, as a failure to demonstrate position requirements may disqualify applicants. A description of job duties directly copied from the job classification or job posting will not be considered. Please read and follow any special application instructions on this posting. For additional instructions on the application process, examinations, Veteran's preference, pre\-employment accommodation or other employment questions, please refer to our web site, www.rc\-hr.com. jobs.title: Software Engineer V (Engineering Lead)
jobs.description: As the Engineering Lead for the Bank Processing project, you will own the technical design and hands\-on development of CrossLink’s bank processing platform. You will build backend services, integrate with banking partners, and deliver secure, reliable transaction processing from initial development through production. This role is primarily focused on architecture, coding, and technical problem solving, with the ability to guide and mentor one or two engineers as needed. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own the platform architecture and technical design, translating business and banking requirements into practical software solutions. * Personally develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and transaction processing workflows. * Design data models and processing logic for payments, disbursements, reconciliation, and reporting, with a focus on accuracy and auditability. * Implement validation, duplicate prevention, error handling, and recovery mechanisms to protect transaction integrity. * Work with the CTO, business stakeholders, compliance, IT, and banking partners to clarify requirements and resolve technical dependencies. * Establish code quality and testing practices; review contributions and document architecture, interfaces, and operational procedures. * Guide and mentor one or two engineers as needed, coordinating work and resolving technical blockers while remaining an active contributor. * Troubleshoot complex issues and support deployment, monitoring, performance tuning, and production readiness. * Communicate progress, technical tradeoffs, risks, and resource needs to management. * Perform other duties as required. **KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS** * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline required. * 5–10 years of software development experience, including ownership of complex backend systems from design through production. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently, explain technical decisions, and collaborate across departments. * Advanced programming skills in Java, C, C\+\+, Go, or an equivalent backend language, with substantial recent hands\-on coding experience. * Strong knowledge of backend architecture, API design, system integration, and reliable transaction processing. * Strong relational database and SQL skills, including schema design, transactions, query optimization, and data integrity; PostgreSQL experience preferred. * Proficiency in troubleshooting and debugging complex applications, including performance and production issues. * Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD, logging, and monitoring. * Ability to build secure systems that handle sensitive data. * Ability to lead technical work, review code, and mentor a small number of engineers while maintaining substantial individual development responsibilities. **ADDITIONAL PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience with banking, payment processing, financial systems, or refund transfer platforms. * Familiarity with ACH/NACHA files, settlement, and reconciliation. * Experience developing APIs and backend services in Golang. * Experience serving as a technical lead or mentoring engineers on a small project team. * Knowledge of IIS and .NET development. * Experience with AWS CodeDeploy and CodeBuild. * Familiarity with frontend frameworks such as React or Angular. * Experience working in an agile environment using Jira or similar tools. * Experience with the AWS ecosystem, including compute and deployment services such as EC2 and ECS.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Sensor Detection Platform (Remote)
jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** CrowdStrike stops breaches, and the sensor is where that fight happens first. The Sensor Detection Platform team builds the on\-sensor detection engines (behavioral pattern matching, process classification, and emerging on\-sensor inference) that execute detection logic on hundreds of millions of endpoints in real time, along with the infrastructure that lets detection engineers author, test, deploy, and manage that content safely across the entire Falcon fleet. We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead this platform. You will manage multiple teams responsible for the sensor\-side detection engines and template/pattern frameworks, the process and application classification systems that power features like Application Abuse Prevention and agentic\-workload identification, and the supporting infrastructure: content build and channel\-file delivery pipelines, feature\-flag and staged\-rollout controls, pre\-release validation and test environments, and the fleet health observability that keeps detection running reliably on customer endpoints. This is a high\-leverage role at the foundation of CrowdStrike's detection strategy. Every detection the company ships, whether endpoint, identity, or hybrid, ultimately executes through your platform, and every improvement you make translates directly into faster, higher\-quality protection for thousands of customers with zero tolerance for endpoint disruption. **What You'll Do:** * Own the multi\-year strategy, architecture, and roadmap for on\-sensor detection: execution engines, template and pattern frameworks, process classification, and the content delivery infrastructure that supports them * Lead and grow an organization of managers and senior engineers across multiple teams, owning the full talent lifecycle: hiring, coaching, performance, and succession * Be accountable for both detection efficacy and endpoint footprint (the CPU, memory, and I/O cost of detection on customer machines), including performance budgets, regression gates, and fleet health SLOs * Make shipping detection content to the fleet provably safe: pre\-release validation, staged channel\-file deployment, rollback, exclusion management, and end\-to\-end testing across OS platforms and sensor versions * Drive the evolution of on\-sensor intelligence, including process classification for AI and agentic workloads and the runtime foundations for on\-sensor model inference * Partner closely with detection content engineering, the core sensor organization, the Cloud Detection Platform, and product management to deliver a coherent hybrid sensor/cloud detection architecture * Reduce operational drag on the platform: drive down support escalation volume, keep test infrastructure trustworthy, and streamline release operations * Anticipate and manage escalations and cross\-team dependencies, and represent the platform in architecture and planning forums across the product organization * Drive annual operating plan and organizational planning for your area, and reflect CrowdStrike's culture in how your teams operate **What You'll Need:** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years managing engineering teams and 2\+ years managing managers * Deep endpoint experience: building and operating software that runs on customer endpoints at scale, including EDR/endpoint security agents, OS internals across Windows, macOS, and Linux, and the performance and compatibility discipline that work demands * Experience safely delivering software and content updates to very large distributed fleets, where a bad push is customer\-visible within minutes * A track record of being fully accountable for strategic outcomes over one\-to\-two\-year horizons, not just project delivery * Strong architectural judgment: you can engage credibly in design reviews, weigh efficacy\-versus\-footprint tradeoffs on constrained devices, and make build/buy/consolidate calls * Experience managing operational excellence for customer\-facing systems: incident response, release safety, fleet health monitoring, and escalation management * Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, including organizational change, competing priorities, and cross\-team dependencies * Excellent communication skills with executives, peers, and engineers * Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. **Bonus Points:** * Domain experience in detection engineering, malware analysis, or threat intelligence, including adversarial evaluation programs such as MITRE ATT\&CK evaluations * Experience with detection\-as\-code, content management systems, or rule/template authoring platforms * Experience with on\-device ML: model runtimes, inference on heterogeneous hardware, or resource\-constrained deployment of models * Experience integrating AI\-assisted or agentic workflows into engineering practice \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-DR1 **Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:** * Market leader in compensation and equity awards * Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs * Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge * Paid parental and adoption leaves * Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role * Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections * Vibrant office culture with world class amenities * Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program. CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy or pregnancy\-related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, status with regard to public assistance, or any other characteristic protected by law. We base all employment decisions\-including recruitment, selection, training, compensation, benefits, discipline, promotions, transfers, lay\-offs, return from lay\-off, terminations and social/recreational programs\-on valid job requirements. If you need assistance accessing or reviewing the information on this website or need help submitting an application for employment or requesting an accommodation, please contact us at recruiting@crowdstrike.com for further assistance. jobs.title: Lean Specialist
jobs.description: Description: Delta Electronics Mfg. Corp. headquartered at our vertically integrated facility in Beverly, Massachusetts, is a premier manufacturer of custom and standard high\-frequency RF, microwave, and millimeter\-wave interconnect solutions. For over 60 years, Delta has served top\-tier prime contractors and OEMs across the aerospace, defense, space, and semiconductor industries. Positioned for year\-over\-year growth in bookings and shipments, Delta is expanding its enterprise management structure to ensure execution discipline matches our technical capabilities. We are seeking a highly motivated Continuous Improvement professional to lead initiatives that enhance manufacturing performance within our Beverly, MA facility. In this role, you will drive improvements in throughput, quality, cost, and flow by applying Lean, Six Sigma, and data\-driven problem\-solving. You will partner with cross\-functional teams to map processes, implement solutions, and support key readiness and quality\-system activities. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, hands\-on manufacturing knowledge, and the ability to lead multiple improvement efforts. **Responsibilities:** * Lead and support Continuous Improvement Program initiatives to drive measurable gains in throughput, quality, cycle time, efficiency, and overall operational performance. * Collect, analyze, and report key manufacturing and quality metrics; identify performance gaps and develop data\-driven improvement plans. * Map current processes, define future\-state workflows, and implement improvements through value stream mapping, standard work, bottleneck analysis, takt alignment, and waste reduction. * Facilitate Lean activities including Kaizen events, 5S, Gemba walks, and structured problem\-solving sessions. * Support quality and readiness activities by developing and maintaining PFMEAs, Control Plans, SPC, APQP deliverables, and other process\-robustness tools. * Lead and manage small to medium cross\-functional projects, ensuring clear scope, timelines, risk management, and sustained results. * Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, and Quality to align improvement activities with production demand, factory constraints, and business objectives. * Conduct process observations and data reviews to identify root causes, reduce variation, and improve manufacturing reliability. * Prepare executive\-level summaries, visual dashboards, and updates for operations reviews and leadership forums. * Build capability across the organization by training teams on Lean, problem\-solving, and continuous improvement methods. * Evaluate ROI for improvement opportunities, validate results, and replicate best practices across products, processes, and programs. jobs.title: Software Integration Engineer
jobs.description: DESE's engineering teams support the development, integration, and advancement of complex software\-intensive systems that contribute to our nation's defense capabilities. We're seeking a proactive and collaborative Software Integration Engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, coordinating across engineering disciplines, and helping lead successful system integration efforts. This role is well\-suited for an engineer who understands software development and system interfaces but also excels at communication, organization, and technical coordination. You'll serve as a key software integration focal point, bringing together software, hardware, systems engineering, industry partners, and government stakeholders to ensure mission\-critical systems work together effectively. **Core Responsibilities:** * Serve as a primary software integration focal point, coordinating technical activities across software, hardware, systems engineering, and external organizations. * Lead cross\-functional technical meetings, interface discussions, and integration working groups while establishing clear objectives, agendas, action items, and follow\-up activities. * Independently manage technical assignments, schedules, and integration priorities while maintaining communication with program leadership and stakeholders. * Coordinate software integration activities from planning and interface definition through testing, execution, issue resolution, and closure. * Collaborate with engineering teams to define, interpret, and validate software interface requirements across system architectures. * Support software development lifecycle (SDLC) activities and coordinate integration milestones with Agile sprint delivery schedules. * Evaluate software messaging, data exchanges, and system communication interfaces to support reliable subsystem integration. * Support software interface testing and verification using simulation, emulation, and hardware/software integration environments. * Clearly communicate technical findings, integration risks, and recommended solutions to leadership, contractors, and government stakeholders. **Minimum Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * Experience supporting software development, software integration, system interfaces, or software\-intensive engineering programs. * Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including Agile development practices and sprint\-based delivery. * Demonstrated ability to coordinate technical activities and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical information to leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders. * Experience participating in or facilitating technical meetings, integration discussions, or engineering reviews. * Ability to independently organize priorities, track technical actions, and coordinate issue resolution. * Working knowledge of software interfaces, system architectures, and data communication concepts. **Highlighted Skills \& Experience:** * Technical Leadership: Experience serving as a technical focal point, facilitating meetings, coordinating stakeholders, and driving integration activities through completion. * Software Development Lifecycle: Understanding of SDLC processes, Agile methodologies, sprint planning, and software delivery coordination. * Software Interfaces: Experience defining, interpreting, documenting, and validating software interfaces and associated system requirements. * Messaging \& Data Structures: Familiarity with message content, structure, and formats, including bits, bytes, data encoding, and big\-endian/little\-endian representations. * Integration Environments: Experience with software emulation tools, Computer\-in\-the\-Loop (CIL), Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL), and other simulation or integration test environments. * System Communication: Familiarity with transmit, receive, and processing (TRP) rules and their impact on system performance and interface behavior. * Verification \& Validation: Experience supporting software interface testing throughout development, integration, and system\-level verification. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Experience coordinating with software, electrical, mechanical, systems engineering, industry contractors, and government stakeholders. * Defense Experience: Familiarity with Ground\-Based Midcourse Defense (GMD), missile defense systems, or similar aerospace and defense programs is preferred. **Why This Role Matters:** Complex defense systems rely on software that communicates and performs reliably across multiple platforms and subsystems. In this role, you'll help ensure critical software interfaces are defined, integrated, tested, and aligned across engineering teams. Your ability to bring people together, communicate technical challenges, and drive integration efforts forward will directly support the success of mission\-critical defense programs. **About DESE** For the past 44 years, DESE has provided industry\-leading technical and engineering solutions in the fields of Defense, Energy, Space, and Environment. As a small, family\-oriented business, DESE provides a compelling benefits package including a generous profit\-sharing plan, competitive salaries, and perhaps most importantly, the opportunity to work alongside talented professionals leveraging cutting\-edge technologies to solve complex and engaging problems. Why employees love working for DESE: At DESE, we are committed to creating a company that is known for its respect and care for employees. We understand that happy employees are what keeps our business going and we strive to provide the best opportunities for each individual working on our team! Here are a few reasons you will love working here: * Competitive health, dental and vision insurance with affordable premiums * Flexible work schedules * Two different flexible spending account options * Company paid life insurance with options for employee paid additional * Performance bonus program * Education reimbursement program * Company paid personal leave for approved philanthropic activities * Vacation, Sick \& Holiday leave * Robust 401k profit sharing plan * Opportunities for internal promotions * Employee referral incentive program * Rewards and gifts for service anniversaries Disability Accommodation for Applicants \- DESE Research, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and provides reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in its job application procedures. jobs.title: Staff Sales Engineer, Voice AI
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ USA \- Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Sales \- AE **Compensation** ---------------- * OTE 270k\-330k $185K – $230K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission This range is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills and experience. There may be instances where a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. Please note that the compensation details listed on US role postings reflect the base salary only and does not include bonus, equity or benefits. **Company Overview** ==================== Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion\-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real\-time APIs for speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS), and building production\-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300\+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice\-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self\-hosted and on\-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. **Company Operating Rhythm** ============================ At Deepgram, we expect an AI\-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day\-to\-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9\-to\-5\. **The Opportunity** ------------------- Enterprises are moving fast from transcribing conversations to automating them. Contact centers, healthcare, financial services and consumer brands are putting voice agents in front of their customers. The buyers range from CX leaders to platform engineers, and the deals turn on latency, reliability, cost per minute and whether the agent holds up in production. Deepgram is hiring a Staff Sales Engineer, Voice Agent to drive adoption of our Voice Agent platform globally. You’ll work alongside every Account Executive on the team as the technical lead on voice agent deals, and you’ll carry a quota for new Voice Agent logos and ARR. Most of your time is spent in front of customers: positioning Deepgram in discovery, winning the technical evaluation and getting customers to production. You report to the VP of Sales. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Win voice agent deals.** Lead discovery, technical qualification, architecture and proofs of concept for Voice Agent opportunities, and own the technical win from first call through production. * **Be the expert in the room.** Whiteboard how a customer's telephony stack (SIP trunks, PBX, CCaaS) connects to their voice agents and where Deepgram fits. Go deep on latency, turn\-taking, interruption handling, function calling, cost per minute and build vs. buy. * **Build what sells.** Ship demos, reference agents and integration patterns across LLMs, telephony/SIP, CCaaS platforms and orchestration frameworks that AEs and customers can use on day one. * **Carry the number.** Own a quota tied to Voice Agent growth and run your pipeline and forecast with discipline. * **Make the team better.** Create the positioning, competitive battlecards, objection handling and enablement that let every AE sell Voice Agent with confidence, even when you are not on the call. * **Bring the field into Product.** Turn patterns from deals into clear, evidence\-backed requirements for our API, SDKs and docs. * **Work the ecosystem.** Partner with CCaaS, telephony and LLM partners to build joint solutions and co\-sell plays. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 7\+ years in customer\-facing technical roles such as solutions engineering, sales engineering, solutions architecture or forward\-deployed engineering, ideally at an API, CPaaS, CCaaS or conversational AI company. * Hands\-on voice agent experience across the stack: telephony (SIP, WebRTC, PBX or CCaaS integration), orchestration (LLM agent frameworks, tool calling, real\-time streaming pipelines) and models (STT, TTS, LLMs). * You build. You've shipped demos, POCs or production integrations in Python, Node.js or similar, and you can show us something you've built. * A track record in revenue\-tied roles. You've been measured on technical wins, pipeline or quota, and you consistently hit your targets. * Comfort leading complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise deals with everyone from platform engineers to CX executives. * Clear communication. You can walk an engineer through a SIP call flow and a VP through a cost\-per\-minute business case in the same meeting. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Voice agents built on frameworks or platforms like Pipecat, LiveKit, Vapi, Retell or OpenAI Realtime * Contact center domain experience (Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, Talkdesk or similar) * Experience carrying an individual or overlay quota * Hands\-on work with MCP servers, agent harnesses or CLI tools, or open\-source contributions with real adoption * Familiarity with Challenger or a similar sales methodology * Experience selling across both self\-serve and enterprise motions ***Notice****: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @**deepgram.com* *email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.* Compensation Range: $185K \- $230K

jobs.title: Director, Data & Analytics Product Management
jobs.description: JOB SUMMARY The Director of Data \& Analytics Product Management is responsible for defining and executing the organization's enterprise data and analytics product strategy. This position leads a portfolio of data, analytics, reporting, and artificial intelligence products that expand the organization's ability to generate insights, share information, improve operational performance, and advance strategic objectives. The Director establishes the product vision, roadmap, investment priorities, and governance practices for the organization's data and analytics product portfolio. Working closely with executive leaders and stakeholders across business functions, operations, finance, and technology, the Director translates organizational needs into scalable, secure, and user\-centered data and analytic products and capabilities. This position leads a multidisciplinary team responsible for product management, data product engineering, analytics delivery, and related capabilities. The Director oversees the entire product lifecycle, including discovery, business case development, prioritization, design, development, implementation, adoption, performance measurement, and continuous improvement. The role ensures that product investments are aligned with organizational strategy, technical architecture, data governance requirements, and measurable business outcomes. The Director serves as a senior advisor to organizational leaders on data and analytic product opportunities, analytics capabilities, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, and approaches for increasing the value of the organization's data assets. The position also represents the data and analytics product function in enterprise planning, vendor engagements, and external partnerships. continuous improvement. * Lead the development and delivery of scalable data products, curated datasets, analytics applications, dashboards, data pipelines, APIs, decision\-support tools, and management standards and reusable practices for discovery, documentation, backlog management, release planning, testing, deployment, support, and product performance evaluation. * Partner with data or platforms with competing priorities and interdependent delivery teams. * Experience developing product visions, roadmaps, business cases, user requirements, prioritization frameworks, release plans, and product performance measures. * Demonstrated ability to translate organizational strategy and business needs into scalable data and analytics products. * Experience establishing product management operating models, governance practices, intake processes, prioritization criteria, and lifecycle standards. * Strong understanding of data architecture, data modeling, data integration, metadata, data quality, data governance, analytics platforms, and data lifecycle management. * Experience overseeing the development of data products, curated datasets, dashboards, analytical applications, APIs, data pipelines, or AI\-enabled solutions. * Working knowledge of agile, product\-led, and iterative development methodologies, including backlog management, user stories, and modern data and analytics environments. * Strong understanding of privacy, security, compliance, accessibility, licensing, and ethical considerations related to data and AI products. * Preferred * Master's degree in business administration, product management, data science, computer science, information systems, informatics, public health, health care administration, or a related field. * Formal product management training or certification, such as Pragmatic Institute, Product School, AIPMM, SAFe Product Management, Certified Scrum Product Owner, or a comparable program. * Experience working with medical or dental claims data, electronic health records, dental practice management systems, health care data standards, or other regulated health data. * Experience developing or managing external\-facing data products, data exchanges, customer portals, digital platforms, or subscription\-based data services. * Experience with cloud data and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable technologies. * Experience with modern analytics and business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Sigma, or comparable tools. * Familiarity with data product concepts such as data mesh, domain\-oriented data ownership, data contracts, APIs, semantic layers, and reusable data services. * Experience with DevOps, DataOps, MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, and version\-control platforms such as Git. * Experience developing or managing artificial intelligence, generative AI, machine learning, natural language processing, or intelligent automation products. * Knowledge of prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, model evaluation, responsible AI, and monitoring of AI\-enabled products. * Familiarity with statistical and analytical tools such as Python, R, SAS, or Stata. * Experience with user research, service design, design thinking, customer journey mapping, usability testing, and product adoption strategies. * Experience working in a nonprofit, health care, public health, insurance, research, or mission\-driven organization.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About depthfirst** -------------------- We believe that software is the foundation of modern civilization. Yet vulnerabilities threaten its integrity, security, and resilience. We are on a mission to secure the world's software. depthfirst is building intelligence to detect and remediate critical software vulnerabilities. We are training and scaling security AI agents to discover zero\-days vulnerabilities across large customer codebases and popular open source software. Our founding team includes deep expertise in data, infrastructure, security and LLMs with technical leaders from DeepMind, Databricks, Square, and Faire. We are looking for strong technical people who are interested in working at the intersection of AI, Security, and Infrastructure. **About This Role** ------------------- We’re looking for a Forward\-Deployed Engineer to help enterprise customers deploy and operate depthfirst in their environments. You’ll work directly with their security, infrastructure, and cloud teams to understand their architecture, navigate technical requirements, and own delivery from initial discovery through production readiness. You’ll design deployment architectures, troubleshoot complex systems, and write production code to unblock customers. Each environment brings different infrastructure, security, and operational requirements. You’ll help customers work through those constraints and partner with our engineering team to build the integrations and capabilities they need. You’ll also turn what you learn in the field into improvements that make depthfirst easier to deploy, operate, and scale across a wide range of enterprise environments. **You’re excited about this role because you will…** ---------------------------------------------------- * Own enterprise deployments from architecture and planning through installation, troubleshooting, upgrades, and operational handoff. * Work directly with customer security, infrastructure, and cloud teams to understand their environments and establish a clear path to production. * Solve deployment challenges across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, identity and access management, and application configuration. * Write code to unblock deployments, build integrations, and deliver new product capabilities. * Build tooling and automation for onboarding, deployment validation, upgrades, and ongoing operations. * Turn recurring customer needs into reusable platform improvements, working closely with our infrastructure, product, and security engineers. * Communicate technical tradeoffs, dependencies, and progress clearly, keeping customer and internal teams aligned. * Travel to customer sites as needed to support successful deployments. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Experience building and operating production systems in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, SRE, or a similar role. * Strong hands\-on knowledge of cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, including deploying, debugging, and operating applications in production. * A solid understanding of networking and cloud security fundamentals, including private connectivity, DNS, TLS, IAM, and access controls. * Ability to investigate problems across infrastructure and application boundaries, identify root causes, and implement fixes. * Proficiency in a language such as Go or Python, with experience shipping production code and automation. * Experience with infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, and observability. * Strong communication skills and an interest in working directly with customers. You can understand unfamiliar environments, explain technical decisions, and coordinate across teams. * Ownership and sound judgment when requirements are ambiguous or a deployment doesn’t fit an existing playbook. * Based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco. **Bonus Points For** -------------------- * Experience owning technical engagements with large enterprise customers as an FDE, SRE, platform engineer, or solutions engineer. * Deep experience with AWS and EKS, Helm, and Terraform or Pulumi. * Experience with multiple Cloud providers. * Experience deploying enterprise software into environments with strict networking, access, and security requirements. * Experience supporting varied customer architectures and integrating software with existing infrastructure and operational tooling. * Experience with AI platforms or security products. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive salary with meaningful equity. * Health, vision, and dental insurance. * Office lunch and dinner when working from our San Francisco office. * Direct impact on customer success and product direction. * The opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI and security. \- *depthfirst is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.* *To all recruitment agencies: depthfirst does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to depthfirst employees. depthfirst is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.*

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Personalization
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ DoorDash is looking for an Engineering Manager with an ML background to lead the Personalization engineering team. This team is responsible for building ML ranking and recommendation systems to maximize the value for consumers, merchants, and DoorDash. Our Personalization team is a part of our Core Consumer org which owns the top of the conversion funnel from the initial landing page all the way to checkout across platforms. Personalization is at the center of the team's mission. As DoorDash expands into new verticals and experiences like grocery, reservations, and going out, the challenge of helping consumers easily find what they want grows exponentially, so the opportunity is massive! In 2027, we're reimagining personalization from the ground up: an intent agent that predicts, at app open, what each consumer is here for; semantic understanding of every entity we rank; a blender that blends content from different verticals and business lines, like reservations, going out, and ads; and real\-time ranking that adapts as consumer signals happen. **About the Role** ------------------ You will lead a team of world\-class ML engineers redefining the personalization experience for DoorDash through cutting\-edge technologies. You will also be the key player in defining DoorDash's personalization strategy and technology roadmap. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Build an intent agent that makes granular predictions of what each consumer is here for the moment they open the app, and shapes the experience around it * Leverage cutting\-edge LLM and Deep Learning (GNN, MTL, Transformers) to augment DoorDash's personalization stack, starting with semantic understanding of every entity we rank, so our models understand what consumers want and what we offer, not just what they clicked before * Extend the blender to blend content from different verticals and business lines, like reservations, going out, and ads, balancing value for consumers, merchants, and DoorDash * Take personalization to real\-time ranking that reacts to consumer signals as they happen * Lead and grow a team of exceptional machine learning engineers delivering on end\-to\-end personalization experience with state\-of\-the\-art ML approaches * Work with Product, Design, and Business stakeholders directly across DoorDash to define the roadmap and vision for the team and deliver immense impact * Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting\-edge technologies, outside\-of\-the\-box thinking and teamwork * Build an outstanding team by coaching and empowering engineers through delegation, and applying your technical expertise to hold your team to the highest engineering standards * Scale the team by developing internal talent and attracting top external talent **We're excited about you because you have…** --------------------------------------------- * B.S., M.S., or PhD. in Computer Science or equivalent * 7\+ years of industry experience * Minimum of 2 years of leadership experience * Broad knowledge of machine learning with strong ML modeling foundation * Extensive experience in building user\-facing product and working directly with product managers * Strong communication skills and the ability to partner with teams spanning many disciplines * Ability to guide and grow an excellent engineering team in a rapidly changing business environment **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience leading the successful application of machine learning to real\-world ranking and recommendation problems * Experience with LLM\-powered agents, semantic representations of users and content, multi\-objective blending, or real\-time ML systems **About DoorDash** ------------------ Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. jobs.title: Principal AI Deployment Manager, Controller
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ We are a technology services company dedicated to helping organizations build and deploy cutting\-edge AI solutions. From generative AI and custom LLM integrations to predictive analytics and intelligent automation, we work across industries to bring real\-world AI applications to life. Our projects combine deep technical expertise with hands\-on client collaboration to solve high\-impact problems. **Job Summary** --------------- The Principal AI Deployment Manager, Controller brings controller\-level accounting depth to AI implementation work across finance teams. You will work with finance leaders and subject\-matter experts to understand how their processes and systems work today, identify where AI can improve them, and shape a practical path from discovery to an evaluated workflow. The work centers on order\-to\-cash, month\-end accounting close, and procure\-to\-pay. You will translate accounting policies, controls, system behavior, data needs, and exceptions into clear requirements, then partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to design and deliver a finance workflow that can be tested and reviewed. This is a client\-facing role for a controller who has implemented AI workflows and can connect finance judgment to technical delivery. Eliza works AI\-first and expects everyone in the company to use AI tools thoughtfully in their work. We move quickly, work through ambiguity, and stay accountable for outcomes. You will receive ownership of client problems, not a fixed script. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **1\. Lead finance process discovery** * Run working sessions with controllers, accounting teams, and other client SMEs to map O2C, close, or P2P workflows, including systems, controls, handoffs, and exceptions. * Establish the current\-state baseline and clarify what a successful outcome would mean to the finance team. * Assess process fit, data readiness, risk, and where human review or approval must remain. ### **2\. Translate controller needs into product requirements** * Turn accounting workflows and policy requirements into structured product requirements, decision rules, acceptance criteria, product roadmap, and test cases. * Prioritize opportunities by feasibility, finance impact, data quality, and implementation effort. * Make clear recommendations about where AI is useful, where standard automation is sufficient, and where a process is not ready. ### **3\. Partner on delivery with engineering** * Work closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to shape an MVP plan, clarify dependencies, and make tradeoffs across scope, quality, and timing. * Review workflow behavior against representative finance cases, including edge conditions, exceptions, reconciliations, and audit evidence. * Keep model limitations, data quality, access controls, and production\-readiness risks visible as work moves from prototype to deployment. ### **4\. Measure outcomes and guide adoption** * Define evaluation criteria and business outcomes with client SMEs before implementation and track results against agreed baselines. * Present findings clearly, separate measured results from hypotheses, and recommend what to improve or test next. * Build client confidence through accurate communication, practical training, and clear handoffs. ### **5\. Build reusable finance delivery practices** * Turn lessons from client work into reusable process maps, requirements patterns, evaluation methods, and implementation guidance. * Contribute controller expertise to finance\-focused discovery, solution design, and pursuit planning. * Raise delivery or client risks early and help set a high standard for finance AI work. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required** * CPA background and substantial controller or controllership experience. * Deep experience with ERP, accounting systems, or finance systems implementations and process change. * Strong working knowledge of core accounting and finance processes and underlying systems (e.g., order\-to\-cash, month\-end close, or procure\-to\-pay) * Evidence of implementing AI\-supported workflows in finance or accounting, with a practical understanding of AI capabilities and limitations. * Ability to translate accounting policy, controls, exceptions, and system behavior into requirements that engineering teams can implement and test. * Client\-facing communication skills and the judgment to ask precise questions, challenge assumptions, and explain tradeoffs clearly. * Ownership of outcomes through discovery, delivery, evaluation, and client review. ### **Preferred** * Controller experience in a PE\-backed company. * Experience with AI\-native ERP or finance automation platforms, accounting agents, or ERP integrations. * Finance transformation consulting or work across multiple priority finance processes. * Experience defining evaluation methods and controls for AI systems used in finance. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation (base salary \+ performance incentives tied to client outcomes). * Equity options in a growing AI services company. * Exposure to a wide range of industries and high\-impact AI problems. * Travel opportunities for on\-site client engagements (if desired) * Direct work with finance leaders on practical AI deployments that affect core accounting workflows. * Close partnership with experienced engineers and client subject\-matter experts. * The opportunity to shape how controller and accounting expertise informs AI delivery. * Meaningful ownership from discovery through measured client outcomes. * The opportunity to shape reusable methods for finance AI delivery. * Variety across finance processes, systems, and client environments. * A leadership role within a high\-growth OCFO practice develops.

jobs.title: Designer / Senior Designer
jobs.description: Epoch AI is looking for designers to help us turn complex research on AI into dashboards and data visualizations. We are open to two different areas of specialization: product and web design, or data visualization. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for a Designer to help us communicate our research. You will work with our design team and report to our Head of Design, designing the interfaces, dashboards, and visualizations behind projects like our AI Models database and Trends dashboard. This work directly shapes how our research is understood. We are hiring for two specializations and will consider candidates for either: * **Product and web design.** Focus on our website and interactive data products: information architecture, user flows, responsive interfaces, and the design system that holds them together. * **Data visualization.** Focus on how we present evidence: charts, interactive graphs, and visual explanations for reports, dashboards, and social media that make quant itative findings clear to non\-expert audiences. This role is fully remote, and we are able to offer contracts in many countries, but we have a strong preference for candidates in North and South American timezones. We invite anyone who is interested to apply, regardless of background, experience, or credentials. Please do not include a cover letter, photograph, or headshot of yourself, or any personal information that is not relevant to the role for which you're applying (including marital status, age, identity traits, etc.). **Applications are rolling.** ### **Practicalities** * **Location:** Remote. Strong preference for candidates in North and South American time zones * **Work Hours:** Flexible, with regular overlap with US Eastern working hours * **Travel Requirement:** Staff attend three in\-person retreats per year * **Compensation:** Annual salary of $100k–$140k USD for Designer; up to $170,000 for candidates hired at the Senior Designer level. Exact salary will reflect experience and location. Salaries are not restricted to USD; contracts and payments are usually in local currencies, converted at one\-year average exchange rates * **Application Deadline:** Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply early * **Reports to:** Head of Design ### **What You'll Own** * Design responsive user interfaces, graphs, and visualizations * Uncover design solutions to user and organizational needs * Create design specifications, mock\-ups, and prototypes to explore design concepts * Ensure adherence to design systems and visual consistency across our work * Collaborate with researchers, engineers, and communications staff to get work from concept to shipped * Depending on your interests and skills, you could get involved in other aspects of our work, such as contributing to our design library and conducting user research and usability testing ### **About You** ### **Must Haves** * 2\+ years of experience designing interactive digital products (5\+ for Senior Designer) * A portfolio demonstrating strong work in UI/UX design, data visualization, or both * Strong grasp of typography, color, and layout * Ability to work comfortably in Figma, including auto\-layout and components * Good judgment about what makes a design simple, clear, and consistent with an existing brand * Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment * Interest in Epoch AI’s work ### **Nice\-to\-haves** * Familiarity with Epoch AI’s research or related topics * Experience with scientific communication * Experience in illustration or branding * Familiarity with front\-end development (HTML, CSS, JS) * Experience with Python libraries like Matplotlib/Plotly or other data visualization programming tools * Good written communication skills If you don’t tick all these boxes but think you would be a great fit, please consider applying anyway! ### **Compensation \& Benefits** * Annual salary between $100,000–$150,000 USD, depending on location and experience. * Salaries are not restricted to USD, and contracts and payments are usually in local currencies. Conversions are based on one\-year average exchange rates. * Fully remote environment, including flexible work hours. * Competitive global benefits program, including a comprehensive health insurance program—including supplemental benefits specific to a local country, as available and mandated by local law—and life insurance and a pension plan, if applicable in your country. * Generous paid time off (PTO), including no specific limit on PTO with 30 days per year protected, unlimited personal and sick leave, and 4 months paid parental leave for permanent staff with at least 12 months of tenure (prorated parental leave if less than 12 months). * A flexible and generous expense policy for you to spend on equipment and a large range of productivity tools or learning/development opportunities, including unlimited spending on AI tools, subject to regulations and manager approval. * Paid work trips, including 3 staff retreats per year and relevant conferences. * Access to our very well\-equipped offices in Berkeley, California, including paid meals, snacks, gym, and more. All staff, independently of where they are based, have access to the office for at least 20 days each year. **Additional Information** -------------------------- While we welcome applicants from all time zones, we prefer candidates who overlap with UTC–4/5 (Eastern Time). We also prefer candidates who can travel: we hold three retreats per year, during which we record podcast episodes and other communication efforts. Please submit all of your application materials in **English** and note that we require professional level English proficiency. Epoch is committed to building an **inclusive, equitable, and supportive** community for you to thrive and do your best work. We’re committed to finding the best people for our team, so please don’t hesitate to apply for a role regardless of your age, gender identity/expression, political identity, personal preferences, physical abilities, veteran status, neurodiversity or any other background. Please **email** careers@epoch.ai if you have any questions about this role, accessibility requests, or if you want to request an extension to the application deadline. However, we will not review applications submitted to this email address; please submit your application through the link on this page. **About Epoch AI** ------------------ Epoch AI is a research institute that investigates trends in machine learning and the economic consequences of AI. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive, publicly accessible knowledge base on AI that informs policymakers, industry leaders, and society at large. We strive to achieve both rigor and accessibility to our work, as exemplified by some of our most successful projects, including our database of AI models and our AI trends dashboard. Our body of research includes our work on compute trends (IJCN 2022\), data scarcity (ICML 2024\), and algorithmic progress (NeurIPS 2024\). You can read more about our work and mission on our website and in this Time profile. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. disability. * 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province. * A home office stipend. * 401(k) for US\-based employees and RRSP for Canada\-based employees. * Paid parental leave. * A local in\-person meet\-up program. * Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto. *(Please note the above benefits \& perks are for full\-time employees)* ***Notice to Candidates:*** *To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages.
