jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Facilities Management eXpress** is looking for an **Engineer Manager** to join our team! At FMX, our Engineering Managers have a direct impact on our product, our people, and our culture. As manager of a Core Team, you’ll coach and mentor a talented group of software engineers, give them clarity on priorities and expectations, and help them grow technically and professionally while delivering high\-quality software for our customers. You’ll partner closely with product, design, QA, and other engineering leaders to align your team’s work with business goals and build a healthy, high\-performing, inclusive engineering culture. This is a player\-coach role. We want a manager who still loves to build: someone who stays close to the code, picks up bugs and non\-mission\-critical work alongside the team, and leads by example. You’ll also help shape how FMX builds software in an AI\-first world, setting the practices, tools, and standards that help our engineers ship faster without lowering the bar on quality. **What You’ll Do:** * **Lead and grow your team:** Give every engineer clarity on their role, responsibilities, goals, and the team’s processes, and clearly communicate changes to practices, priorities, and expectations. Provide regular coaching, feedback, and career guidance, and advocate for each person’s professional and technical growth. * **Build a strong culture:** Foster trust, accountability, and continuous improvement, where engineers feel valued, heard, and connected to FMX’s mission. Keep the team engaged with challenging, meaningful problems and help them see the customer impact of their work. * **Clear the path:** Actively remove blockers so the team works efficiently with minimal friction. * **Stay technical:** Keep a strong understanding of your team’s systems so you can guide architecture decisions and unblock engineers directly. Champion operational excellence, including observability, CI/CD health, and production readiness. * **Drive AI\-first development:** Evaluate, adopt, and set standards for AI\-assisted coding, code review, and testing tools. * **Shape the bigger picture:** Contribute to engineering leadership discussions, decisions, and process evolution; partner with product and design leads on priorities and long\-term vision; and help hiring teams identify, recruit, and onboard top engineering talent. **Requirements** What we're looking for: * 2\-4 years of engineering management or technical leadership experience, and prior experience as a software engineer, ideally in SaaS. * A builder’s mindset: you still enjoy writing code and will regularly contribute fixes, features, and triage work that isn’t mission\-critical. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-first development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, agentic workflows) and a point of view on best practices you can teach others. * This role requires working Eastern Time hours to join daily team meetings, so candidates should be based in or able to work on Eastern Time. * A proven ability to coach and grow engineers at every career stage, with strong, empathetic, and clear communication. * Experience improving engineering processes and development workflows, plus familiarity with agile practices and cross\-functional collaboration. * The ability to think strategically while attending to the details of day\-to\-day execution. * A passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams that value continuous learning and an excellent developer experience. * Enthusiasm for FMX’s mission and alignment with our core pillars: Teamwork, Excellence, and Integrity. **Nice to Have:** * Native mobile experience (Swift or Kotlin) * Cloud infrastructure experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP) * Infrastructure as code with Terraform * Containerization with Docker * CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance * Observability (logging, metrics, traces, and alerting) or SIEM experience **Our Tech Stack:** * .NET / C\# * React and TypeScript * React Native * Azure **The Hiring Process:** * **1\. Apply!** Submit your resume and brief application questions directly through our Workable portal to get started. * **2\. PeopleOps Phone Screen (30 min)** A introductory conversation to dive into your background, introduce you to FMX culture, and clarify core role expectations. This is also your chance to ask about compensation, benefits, and life at FMX. * **3\. Hiring Manager Conversation (60 min)** An in\-depth chat with our Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Come ready to discuss your experience, career goals, and ideal next steps, as well as to ask detailed questions about team dynamics and role expectations. * **4\. Final Interview (60 min)** A panel and peer interview designed to introduce you to key team members and explore technical alignment and collaborative fit. * **5\. Offer \& Onboarding** Once an offer is extended, we’ll initiate a standard background check to complete your onboarding process. **Benefits** **FMX Benefits** **\& Life at FMX:** * **Make a big impact:** You’ll have significant influence over the direction and future of our engineering teams, flagship product and company. We are scaling rapidly and there is a lot of room for advancement. * **Enjoy a collaborative culture and a close\-knit team:** We're a team of hard\-working, high\-fiving, friendly folks. We take collaboration, transparency, continuous improvement, and work/life balance seriously. * **Get to hire and work with the best:** We believe in building high\-quality, well\-designed products and that requires the best talent. You’ll have the opportunity to work with and grow a highly\-talented team. * **Learn and grow in your role and outside it:** At FMX, we’re committed to improving our professional and personal selves. We bring in industry\-experts as our advisors, provide leadership training, invest in team\-building activities, and have a training budget and incentive program. Our Engineering team also dedicates 10% of their time to learning or working on projects that interest them. * **Enjoy flexible working hours:** Have a dentist appointment at 8:30 AM? Need to tack on an extra 15 minutes at lunch to squeeze in that workout? As long as you're getting your work done then our working hours are flexible. * **Work from home:** At FMX we are remote first, but you’re welcome to use our office as you need. We have two all\-company events a year to ensure that you can put a face to that name and establish high\-trust relationships with your teammates and co\-workers. When you’re in the office, you can take advantage of our free snacks, beverages, and office kegerator. **Company:** While FMX is formally founded and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, on the day\-to\-day, we like to think of ourselves as headquartered “in the cloud”. We develop a cloud\-based, software\-as\-a\-service facility maintenance and management product. FMX serves education, property management, manufacturing, and other markets and is one of the fastest\-growing companies in its space. Check us out at: https://www.gofmx.com/ *Note: All other company requirements are documented in the FMX Employee Handbook.* FMX is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Staff AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **THE POSITION** Our roster has an opening with your name on it As a Staff AI Solutions Engineer at FanDuel, you will help us own the AI technical vision across the portfolio. Additionally, hold and evolve the technical vision across our governed agent layer, our strategy\-optimization engine, and our simulation environment. In this role you will make the architectural calls that set the team's direction and write the design docs and decision records that make those calls legible to everyone else. As well as, be the technical voice product that other teams trust. You will be expected to translate tradeoffs into decisions that they can act on and push back with evidence when a direction is wrong. If this describes you, read on – we want to hear from you! **THE GAME PLAN** Everyone on our team has a part to play Drive AI Into the Engineering Lifecycle * Drive the integration of our agent layer into the data engineering SDLC: requests arriving from Slack, Jira, GitHub, and PagerDuty, routed into a planning phase that produces scoped, reviewable tickets and a build phase that carries each ticket through spec, plan, build, test, PR, and documentation. * Build the environment that makes agentic engineering actually work: skills, specs, context scaffolding, shared memory, and progressive disclosure. * Extend governed, audited data access so agents operate under each user's own permissions against our data platform, with a limited blast radius by design. * Define the outer loop: continual learning, post\-run review, and agent self\-improvement that lands as reviewable pull requests rather than uncontrolled drift. Make Optimization a Product Capability * Advance our strategy\-optimization engine from proof of concept to a capability product teams request by name, and land it against real business metrics. * Partner with product to turn ambiguous business problems into optimizable ones: define the action space, the objective and utility weights that encode the tradeoffs we actually care about, and the guardrails and risk tolerance that keep the search honest. * Own the deterministic scoring backbone: versioned scorers, shared and immutable experiment definitions, blind holdout discipline. Ensure results are comparable, auditable, and cumulative across the team rather than trapped in one person's working directory. * Expand the engine to new scoring and optimization domains across the business, including generosity and promotional spend, module placement and ranking, and search relevance. * Bias toward interpretable strategies product partners can reason about, argue with, and implement without an external serving dependency. Prove Ideas Before They Ship * Mature our offline simulation environment so product hypotheses can be pre\-screened against synthetic personas built from real behavioral data, before committing scarce live A/B capacity. * Establish directional agreement between simulated and live outcomes as the credibility bar, and be honest with partners about where the simulation is and is not trustworthy. * Drive adoption of simulation as a standard input to experiment prioritization with our product partners. Turn Vision Into Work the Team Can Own * Act as the Team's technical lead: take strategic direction and decompose it into specs, skills, and tickets that individual engineers can own end to end without waiting on you. * Set the working model for an AI\-driven team. You define what a human specifies, what an agent builds, what a human reviews and raise the bar through code review, reusable patterns, and design review. * Mentor engineers across the US and Romania pods, and write clearly, since not all collaboration is synchronous. * Represent the team technically with partner engineering organizations, vendors, and external delivery partners on joint work. **THE STATS** What we're looking for in our next teammate * 8\+ years of software, machine learning, or AI engineering experience, including technical leadership of a system other engineers built on. * A track record of turning ambiguous business problems into measurable ones. Defining objectives, metrics, and guardrails alongside product partners rather than waiting to be handed a spec. * Demonstrated breadth: credible in a technical design review, in a product prioritization conversation, and in front of senior stakeholders. * Proven ability to decompose a vague strategic direction into workstreams that individual engineers can own autonomously. * Expert\-level Python in production settings: typing, testing, packaging, and performance awareness. * Hands\-on experience using agentic coding harnesses as real engineering tools, and designing the skills, context, tool access, and memory that make them effective. * Production LLM application experience. Agent orchestration, tool and function calling, structured output handling, and retrieval. * Strong optimization and experimentation background: search over strategy spaces, deterministic scoring, offline/online metric alignment, holdout discipline, and A/B design and interpretation. * Cloud\-native engineering on AWS, plus hands\-on work in a modern data platform such as Databricks. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent industry experience. * Knowledge of sports and/or experience working within a heavily regulated industry is a plus. **ABOUT FANDUEL** FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's \#1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance\-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV\+, its leading direct\-to\-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia. FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT). **PLAYER BENEFITS** We treat our team right We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO \& sick leave), annual bonus and long\-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more \- check out all our benefits here: **FanDuel Total Rewards**. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level. FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, "We are One Team!". As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com. ***The applicable salary range for this position is $159,000 \- $208,950 USD, which is dependent on a variety of factors including relevant experience, location, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. jobs.title: GNC Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: You will develop the guidance and control software that carries a flight vehicle from ascent through atmospheric entry and an autonomous runway landing. Your algorithms and C\+\+ code will be exercised in high\-fidelity simulation, hardware\-in\-the\-loop environments, and ultimately in flight. You will help maintain the six\-degree\-of\-freedom simulation that the broader program depends on for design decisions and mission confidence. If you value simple, testable software and want your work connected directly to vehicle performance, this role offers meaningful end\-to\-end ownership. **WORKSITE**: Onsite in Titusville, Florida **WORK SCHEDULE:** Full\-time; schedule based on program needs **PAY RATE:** Salary determined based upon experience **WHAT WE OFFER:** Paid sick leave based on state regulations after 90 days of employment Medical, dental, and vision coverage after a waiting period (60% paid by Fortuna) Free TeleMedicine and Mental Health support for all employees and their families. Additional voluntary benefits: Group Life Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Critical Care, Short\-Term Disability **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** Develop, integrate, test, and maintain flight GNC algorithms in C\+\+ for ascent, entry, terminal\-area energy management, approach, and autonomous landing. Build and maintain a high\-fidelity six\-degree\-of\-freedom vehicle simulation used for algorithm development, verification, and program decision\-making. Model vehicle dynamics, sensors, actuators, atmosphere, navigation inputs, and failure cases with appropriate fidelity for each phase of flight. Design and execute software\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop tests, analyze results, and resolve discrepancies between models, hardware, and expected performance. Collaborate with flight software, avionics, aerodynamics, propulsion, systems, test, and operations teams to define interfaces and verify integrated behavior. jobs.description: **Job Description** At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human\-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. Our locations feature a variety of work environments, including open workspaces and virtual connection platforms to inspire productivity and flexible collaboration. And we are proud to support employee volunteer interests and make it a priority to join together in efforts that give back to our communities. **The Role:** The Lab System Integration Engineering (LSIE) team is a part of a central engineering resource group that supports various battery, component, and propulsion test laboratories as well as vehicle garages in Pontiac, Warren, and Milford, Michigan. The Test Site Systems Engineer will directly support the Global Battery Systems Lab (GBSL), the Wallace Battery Cell Innovation Center (WBCIC), and the Root Cause Warranty Center (RWC) at the Warren Technical Center campus with a focus on the software environments and automation platforms that enable safe, efficient testing. The Global Battery Systems Lab (GBSL\-W) and Wallace Battery Cell Innovation Center (WBCIC) utilize various automation software systems to operate 24/7\. The Global Battery Systems Lab has testing capabilities that include traditional environmental testing, vibration, safety and abuse, exploratory development testing, and maintains commonality with GM’s battery lab located in Shanghai, China (GBSL\-S). The Wallace Battery Innovation Center houses battery cell test chambers, cell formation chambers, a material synthesis lab, a slurry mixing and processing lab, a coating room, an electrolyte production lab, and a forensics lab with material analysis equipment and advanced software The Root Cause Warranty Center (RWC) performs advanced diagnostic and failure analysis on returned components as well as full systems, using specialized test equipment, data analytics, plus forensic methods to resolve complex warranty issues. These labs and the results they produce are used by GM’s growing team of engineers working on advanced batteries and electrified vehicles, in support of the vision of a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions, and Zero Congestion. This role manages the lab software ecosystem for GBSL, WBCIC, and the RWC. The engineer will use enterprise automation tooling (e.g. Ansible, Baramundi) to provision test systems, manage fleets, execute software deployments, coordinate environment changes, maintain configuration records plus change records, and standardize how test sites use enterprise toolchains. The focus is on solutions that meet operator and lab needs while staying aligned with enterprise direction. The engineer in this position will design and standardize back\-end environments, deployment pipelines, Windows test\-fleet automation, and metrics pipelines that connect enterprise platforms to day\-to\-day lab operations while building a broad skill set across DevOps, site systems, and large\-scale test automation. **This is an onsite role at the Warren Technical Center to ensure direct engagement with lab operations, test systems, and partner teams.** **What You'll Do (Responsibilities):** * Support testing PC builds, related test software configuration, and deployments across GBSL/WBCIC/RWC in partnership with DevOps engineers. * Maintain software environments on critical test PCs by coordinating OS and security updates with IT while managing LSIE\-owned applications plus configurations. * Own lifecycle management for key test systems, including version control, compatibility planning, environment upgrades, and major platform migrations. * Own the metrics pipeline for lab test systems across Influx, Telegraf, Grafana, and test automation systems * Support and maintain LSIE’s test automation toolchain that underpins daily lab operations at GBSL/WBCIC/RWC.  g. jobs.title: Senior Scientist I, Computational Protein Design
jobs.description: **The Role:** Generate is seeking a creative and rigorous scientist to develop computational technologies and lead applied platform research that expand what protein therapeutics can do. You will develop reusable methods, scoring and evaluation tools, model benchmarks, agentic systems, and scientific workflows for protein design, engineering, and optimization. Your work will span creating new proteins, modifying existing molecules, and integrating molecular components to unlock new therapeutic applications. At Generate, model development, protein design, high\-throughput experimentation, structural characterization, and therapeutic development operate within one organization. This role offers the opportunity not only to advance computational methods, but to see them shape what proteins are built and tested, learn from rich in\-house experimental data, and contribute to medicines in our pipeline. We are looking for someone who is motivated by both technical innovation and its application to drug development. This role combines technology development with applied platform research. You will identify recurring scientific needs, lead research efforts, and turn successful approaches into durable capabilities with clear interfaces and validated performance. Working with program teams, biologists, and experimental scientists, you will test and refine these capabilities in relevant biological settings, establish proof of concept for new molecular properties and functions, and combine validated approaches to enable new therapeutic applications and pipeline programs. You will lead the computational research needed to establish feasibility, resolve technical risks, and make successful approaches reusable across targets and programs. **Here's how you will contribute:** * **Lead technology development and applied platform research.** Identify high\-value capability gaps and molecular or biological challenges, formulate testable hypotheses, and define research plans, milestones, and decision criteria. Drive projects from scientific question through computational implementation and experimental proof of concept to validated, reusable capabilities. * **Build and evaluate reusable protein engineering capabilities.** Develop computational methods for protein design, optimization, and interaction modeling using generative, predictive, and biophysical approaches. Create scores and benchmarks to assess sequences, structures, biological functions, and developability. Define intended uses, interfaces, assumptions, and success criteria across targets, molecular formats, and therapeutic applications. Build reproducible datasets and evaluation protocols that reveal strengths and failure modes, quantify uncertainty, and guide appropriate use. * **Engineer and validate new molecular capabilities.** Partner with assay, structural, and experimental scientists to design informative molecular libraries and iterative design–build–test–learn studies. Demonstrate control of properties such as binding specificity, conditional activity, molecular assembly, stability, or developability. Analyze experimental readouts, distinguish signal from noise, diagnose failures, and use the results to improve methods and establish where they generalize. * **Scale scientific capabilities.** Partner with machine learning and engineering to translate platform and application needs into model objectives, evaluation criteria, and data requirements. Stress\-test new models and work with engineers to turn successful research into reliable, maintainable software. * **Build agentic systems for therapeutic protein design.** Develop agentic systems and multi\-agent workflows that connect scientific information, generative and predictive models, internal data, analysis tools, and experimental results to formulate hypotheses, propose designs, evaluate evidence, and recommend informative next steps. Establish mechanisms for enabling human oversight, traceability, and rigorous measures of reliability. * **Enable new therapeutic applications.** Work with application teams to combine validated capabilities into approaches that address consequential molecular or biological challenges. Establish technical feasibility in therapeutically relevant settings, assess performance against appropriate references, and test whether an approach can support multiple targets or programs. Generate evidence that informs advancement or discontinuation, target selection, and nomination of differentiated therapeutic programs. * **Transfer and disseminate successful approaches.** Turn research outcomes into documented methods and reference workflows that other teams can use and interpret reliably. Support adoption by application and program teams, and translate lessons across projects into improvements that benefit the broader platform. **The Ideal Candidate will have:** * **Strong scientific and quantitative foundations,** with practical fluency in modern machine learning and computational meth e studies, and using results to guide decisions. * **Strong hands\-on computational skills,** including Python, modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX, and experience contributing reliable code in a shared environment. * **Strong understanding of protein structure, sequence–structure–function relationships, molecular interactions, and biophysics,** with the ability to reason critically about computational predictions and experimental evidence. Relevant experience may include protein or antibody engineering, molecular modeling, structure\-guided optimization, generative design, or related approaches. * **Strongly valued:** Experience building LLM\-enabled agents, scientific copilots, or multi\-agent systems for therapeutic design or scientific hypothesis generation and testing, including tool use, planning, evaluation loops, human oversight, and assessment of reliability. * **A PhD in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline,** with at least three years of industry experience following completion of the PhD, and a demonstrated ability to lead consequential technical work with substantial independence. * **Background:** Candidates may come from computational protein design or engineering, computational biology, machine learning, biophysics, or adjacent quantitative disciplines. The strongest candidates will combine scientific depth with a platform mindset and a desire to see their work tested experimentally and used to create new therapeutics. **Who Will Love This Job:** You bring scientific creativity, strong technical judgment, and disciplined execution to open\-ended problems. You value reliability, reuse, and clear evidence; collaborate with a low\-ego approach; and move comfortably between original research, robust implementation, and experimental learning. You can distinguish an exploratory result from a validated capability, make clear recommendations from incomplete evidence, and connect technical progress to therapeutic opportunities. **Location:** This role is based in our Somerville, Massachusetts office with flexibility for hybrid work. \#LI\-HM1 **About Generate Biomedicines** We are a clinical\-stage generative biology company pioneering the AI revolution in drug design and development. We are advancing a new approach to drug creation—one grounded in the ability to design proteins with defined biological intent. By integrating machine learning with large\-scale experimentation, this approach aims to reduce the uncertainty, time, and cost associated with developing protein\-based medicines. Founded in 2018, we are advancing a growing pipeline of clinical and preclinical programs across multiple disease areas and protein modalities. By unifying computational design and clinical development within a single operating model, we translate this approach into clinical\-stage programs and are leading a shift from traditional drug discovery toward systematic drug generation. At Generate:Biomedicines, we collaborate across disciplines in new ways to invent and innovate. We bring diverse perspectives to a shared goal of delivering better medicines to patients in need, faster, guided by our values and leadership behaviors. Generate:Biomedicines is **committed to equal employment opportunity** regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. ***Recruitment \& Staffing Agencies****: Generate:Biomedicines does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Generate:Biomedicines or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by the Company's internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Generate:Biomedicines and the Company will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.*

jobs.title: Operations Planning and Analytics Engineer II-IV
jobs.description: **Operations Planning and Analytics Engineer II\-IV** ***Turn Grid Data into Analytics That Strengthen Planning and Operations*** Georgia System Operations Corporation (GSOC) is seeking an Operations Planning and Analytics Engineer II\-IV to develop analytical products, automated workflows, and applications that support Operations Planning. The role contributes to economic dispatch, production cost modeling, load and renewable forecasting, transmission analysis, and resource adequacy studies for GSOC and its Member cooperatives. This is a hands\-on engineering and analytics opportunity for candidates who enjoy solving complex operational problems with data, software, and power\-system knowledge. Depending on level, the position will grow from contributing to established analytical solutions to independently owning complex workflows, applications, and technical projects. **This is an onsite position and it is not eligible for visa sponsorship** **What You'll Do** As an Operations Planning and Analytics Engineer II\-IV, you will help build, operate, and continuously improve analytical solutions that support grid planning and operational decision\-making. You will: * Design, develop, and support analytical solutions for solar and load forecasting, economic dispatch optimization, transmission congestion analysis, production cost modeling, and resource adequacy studies. * Develop and maintain data workflows, Python applications, SQL data models, and reporting solutions that support Operations Planning. * Apply engineering practices including version control, code review, testing, documentation, deployment, and Agile methods. * Monitor production analytics workflows for accuracy, performance, and availability and help resolve issues affecting analytical deliverables. * Build validation, monitoring, and error\-handling into automated workflows. * Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort through automation, process consolidation, and modernization of legacy tooling. * Maintain technical documentation, data lineage, and knowledge needed to support reliable, repeatable analytical processes. * Collaborate with Operations Engineering, Transmission Planning, Member Services, Information Technology, and Control Center teams to define requirements and deliver useful analytical solutions. * Translate complex analytical results into clear findings for technical and business audiences. * Support the evaluation and implementation of third\-party analytical software and contribute technical input to vendor\-management activities. * Contribute technical documentation and analytical support for regulatory compliance and audit activities. * Evaluate emerging tools and techniques, including AI\-assisted development, machine learning forecasting methods, and modern data\-platform capabilities, where they can provide operational value. **What You Bring** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related technical field. An equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered. * For Level II: 2\+ years of relevant experience * For Level III: 4\+ years of relevant experience * For Level IV: 6\+ years of relevant experience with progressively deeper ownership of complex technical work. * Proficiency with Python and SQL appropriate to the level of the role, with the ability to develop maintainable analytical solutions. * Experience with Databricks or a comparable modern cloud data platform. * Experience with data visualization and reporting tools. * Working knowledge of software development lifecycle practices, version control, testing, documentation, and Agile methods. * Knowledge of power\-system operations concepts such as economic dispatch, load forecasting, transmission constraints, or production cost modeling, or the ability to develop this expertise. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, written, and verbal communication skills. * Ability to manage priorities and deliver reliably in a collaborative environment. **Preferred Qualifications** **Power Systems \& Utility Analytics** * Experience delivering analytical solutions in a utility, energy, or comparably complex operational environment. * Familiarity with utility modeling and operational systems including SCADA and EMS. **Advanced Analytics \& Development** * Knowledge of energy optimization solutions, machine learning, or AI solutions, including forecasting or operational applications. * Experience with modern cloud data platforms and production analytical workflows. **Credentials \& Compliance** * Professional Engineer (PE) license, Engineer in Training (EIT) certification, or relevant technical certifications. * Experience supporting NERC, FERC, or SERC compliance activities. **Advantages of Working at GSOC** Working at GSOC means more than just a job\-it's an opportunity to apply engineering, analytics, and application\-development skills to real operational and planning challenges. **Grid\-Focused Analytics** Work on forecasting, economic dispatch, transmission analysis, production cost modeling, resource adequacy, and other analytical products used by Operations Planning. **Technical Growth Across Levels** Progress from contributing to established solutions at Level II to broader technical ownership at Levels III and IV, with increasing responsibility for complex analytical work. **Modern Tools \& Methods** Work with Python, SQL, cloud data platforms, automation, and emerging approaches such as machine learning and AI\-assisted development. **Cross\-Functional Impact** Partner with Operations Engineering, Transmission Planning, Member Services, Information Technology, Control Center staff, and other stakeholders on solutions that support operational needs. **Work Environment \& Benefits** This position supports Operations Planning in a collaborative professional environment. Over 1 million homeowners have benefited from our simple, fast, and frictionless technology that makes the adoption of these products more affordable, accessible, and easier to understand. Thousands of professionals deploying home efficiency and solar solutions rely on GoodLeap’s proprietary, AI\-powered applications and developer tools to drive more transparent customer communication, deeper business intelligence, and streamlined payment and operations. Our platform has led to more than $30 billion in financing for sustainable solutions since 2018\. GoodLeap is also proud to support our award\-winning nonprofit, GivePower, which is building and deploying life\-saving water and clean electricity systems, changing the lives of more than 1\.6 million people across Africa, Asia, and South America.### **Position Summary** The Staff Security Engineer, Security Operations is responsible for protecting GoodLeap’s cloud environments, applications, endpoints, and corporate systems through detection engineering, incident response, and security operations. This role builds and tunes detections, leads investigation and response for security incidents, and manages the security tooling that provides visibility across cloud, identity, endpoint, and email. The Staff Security Engineer will design and build AI agents and automation that reduce time\-to\-detect and time\-to\-respond, and will establish monitoring of AI activity across the enterprise, including AI tools, agents, and integrations used by employees and engineering teams. This role works closely with software engineers, infrastructure, IT, and compliance partners to ensure security controls are consistently applied and operationally effective. Additionally, the Staff Security Engineer develops security requirements, conducts security risk assessments, evaluates security services and technologies, maintains incident response plans and runbooks, and provides mentoring to the security team and partner engineering teams. This role will own endpoint detection and response (CrowdStrike) and email security as these capabilities are brought into the security function. ### **Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities** **Detection Engineering \& Monitoring** * Design, build, test, and tune detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and email telemetry using detection\-as\-code practices mapped to MITRE ATT\&CK. * Manage security logging, SIEM, and alerting pipelines. * Establish monitoring of AI activity, including AI tools, agents, MCP integrations, and API keys, to detect data exposure, misuse, and anomalous behavior. * Reduce time\-to\-detect through applied threat intelligence and sensor enrichment. **Incident Response** * Lead investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery for security incidents. * Serve as incident lead for significant events and coordinate with legal, compliance, and leadership on regulatory notification obligations. * Maintain incident response plans, playbooks, and runbooks. * Conduct tabletop exercises and post\-incident reviews that drive lasting control improvements. **Security Tooling, Automation \& AI Agents** * Deploy and manage the security operations toolset, including cloud security monitoring, WAF, DDoS protection, IDS, EDR (CrowdStrike), and email security. * Build AI agents and automation for alert triage, enrichment, investigation, and response. * Review results from vulnerability scans, penetration testing, and other sources for true positives and propose remediation or mitigating controls. * Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on AWS cloud security and consult on the secure design of cloud\-based systems. **Mentorship \& Leadership** * Provide mentorship and guidance to the security team and partner engineering teams on detection, response, and security operations practices. * Share in\-depth understanding of company and industry methodologies, policies, standards, and controls. * Help build the security team and lead efforts to mature GoodLeap’s security operations capability. ### **Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities** * In\-depth knowledge of Amazon AWS, including security configuration, logging, and tooling (e.g., CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub). * Hands\-on experience in detection engineering, including SIEM query languages and detection\-as\-code. * Hands\-on experience in incident response, including log analysis and host and cloud investigation. * Familiar with the MITRE ATT\&CK framework and OWASP Top 10\. * Knowledge of network and web related protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, TLS). * Experience with, or ability to quickly ramp on, EDR platforms (CrowdStrike Falcon preferred). * Experience with, or ability to quickly ramp on, email security (phishing, BEC, DMARC/SPF/DKIM). * Experience building automation in Python or a similar language. * Experience building or integrating LLM\-based agents and workflows. * Understanding of AI\-specific risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agent permissions. * Experience working in a SOC 2, PCI\-DSS, or ISO control environment. * Proven ability to combine business acumen, technical acumen, and process expertise to assess requirements and alignment. * Strong communicator across verbal, written, ticketing, and messaging channels. * Able to prioritize and deliver on multiple tasks independently with a strong bias toward action in a fast\-paced environment. * GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, CCSP, CISSP, CrowdStrike, or comparable certifications are a plus. Base pay range (CA, WA, NJ, MA, DC, NYC) per year: $184,100 \- $212,500 Base pay range (all other US locations) per year: $167,400 \- $193,200 In addition to the above salary, this role may be eligible for a bonus and equity. **Additional Information Regarding Job Duties and Job Descriptions:** Job duties include additional responsibilities as assigned by one's supervisor or other managers related to the position/department. This job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and other skills required for the position. The Company reserves the right at any time with or without notice to alter or change job responsibilities, reassign or transfer job position or assign additional job responsibilities, subject to applicable law. The Company shall provide reasonable accommodations of known disabilities to enable a qualified applicant or employee to apply for employment, perform the essential functions of the job, or enjoy the benefits and privileges of employment as required by the law. **If you are an extraordinary professional who thrives in a collaborative work culture and values a rewarding career, then we want to work with you! Apply today!** We are committed to protecting your privacy. To learn more about how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information during the application process, please review our **Employment Privacy Policy** and **Recruiting Policy on AI**. jobs.title: WordPress Developer
jobs.description: **Love building new things—but also get a weird amount of satisfaction from tracking down the one plugin, line of code or integration causing everything to misbehave? Hiebing is looking for a curious and resourceful Web Developer who’s excited to build smart digital experiences, solve unfamiliar problems and keep growing alongside a collaborative team. WordPress will be at the center of the role, but your work—and your opportunity to make an impact—will extend well beyond it.** Hiebing is seeking a curious, motivated and innovative WordPress Developer who is eager to build intelligent solutions in a fast\-paced, collaborative team environment. Our team values learning, support and innovation, creating a culture where developers can grow, contribute and have fun doing great work. WordPress development and maintenance will be at the center of this role, but we’re looking for someone who is equally energized by troubleshooting an integration, helping implement tagging, debugging an email or figuring out something they haven’t encountered before. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter who is curious, resourceful and motivated to find answers independently. They see unfamiliar challenges as opportunities to learn rather than barriers and are comfortable moving between different types of digital work as client and team needs evolve. This role will initially be divided between new WordPress development and maintenance for existing clients, with the potential to create new capabilities and offerings for our clients and eventually lead the WordPress development practice at Hiebing. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop, enhance and maintain WordPress websites, including block editor/Gutenberg development, theme customization, plugin configuration and integrations. * Troubleshoot and resolve website issues, including plugin conflicts, third\-party integrations, browser and device inconsistencies, and performance problems. * Support ongoing website maintenance, landing pages, forms, content migrations and other digital enhancements across multiple client properties. * Assist with analytics and tagging implementations using tools such as Google Tag Manager and GA4, including implementation, troubleshooting and QA. * Support email development and production needs, including building and modifying HTML emails, troubleshooting rendering or template issues, and conducting technical QA. * Implement and troubleshoot marketing technology integrations, including forms, analytics, consent management, email platforms and other third\-party tools. * Work within Git\-based development workflows and follow established practices for commits, branching, pull requests, releases and documentation. * Collaborate with developers, digital strategists, project managers, designers and other team members to solve problems and deliver high\-quality work. * Maintain security, accessibility, performance and quality standards across development work. **Required Skills and Experience** ---------------------------------- * 2–3 years of professional web development experience, with meaningful hands\-on WordPress theme development experience. * Comfort using GitHub Copilot for AI\-assisted development and as part of the problem\-solving process. * Strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript fundamentals. * Working knowledge of PHP and WordPress development. * Experience with WordPress themes, plugins, Gutenberg/block editor and common marketing\-site integrations. * Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills. * Experience working with Git\-based version control. * Ability and willingness to work across different types of technical assignments rather than specializing exclusively in one area. * Resourceful and comfortable researching unfamiliar problems and identifying solutions independently. * Self\-motivated, with the ability to take ownership of work and follow it through to completion. * Curious and eager to learn new technologies, platforms and approaches. * Familiarity with analytics, tagging and marketing integrations, including GA4/GTM, consent tools, A/B testing, email providers and CDPs. * Accessibility awareness, including WCAG fundamentals, and experience implementing accessible UI patterns. * Able to manage multiple priorities and shift between projects in a fast\-paced environment. * Collaborative, dependable and committed to producing high\-quality work. **Nice\-to\-Have Skills and Qualifications** -------------------------------------------- * WooCommerce or Shopify experience, including checkout optimization, payment and shipping plugins, and catalog organization. * Comfort with WP\-CLI, Composer, deployment automation and modern WordPress build pipelines. * Experience implementing WordPress hardening practices, including secure configuration, plugin governance and least\-privilege access. * Familiarity with unit testing or automated regression testing. * Hands\-on experience with Email on Acid or Litmus to create visual and brand consistency across email devices and clients. **You’ll Thrive Here If…** -------------------------- * You enjoy building new digital experiences—and making existing ones work better. * You see an unfamiliar technical problem as something to investigate, not something to avoid. * You’re willing to dig into documentation, test possible solutions and ask thoughtful questions when needed. * You can move comfortably between development, maintenance, troubleshooting, analytics, tagging and email work. * You take ownership of your work and care about seeing it through from initial request to final QA. * You balance speed with thoughtful attention to security, accessibility, performance and quality. * You’re curious about AI and emerging technology while still bringing your own judgment and problem\-solving skills to the work. * You believe the strongest solutions come from developers, strategists, designers and project managers working together. **Where You’ll Work** --------------------- This position is based in Hiebing’s Madison, Wisconsin office. Collaboration is an important part of how we work at Hiebing. This position follows our hybrid work model, which includes working from the Madison office each Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, with the option to work remotely Thursday and Friday. Candidates who do not currently live within commuting distance should be willing to relocate to the Madison area. **Why Hiebing?** ---------------- At Hiebing, you’ll work alongside smart, kind and incredibly talented people who genuinely enjoy making each other’s ideas better. You’ll collaborate across disciplines, support regional and national brands and have the opportunity to build digital experiences that matter—for our clients, their audiences and each other. We’re a place where curiosity is celebrated, craftsmanship is respected and thoughtful judgment is just as valuable as bold ideas. We believe in speaking in data, Dreaming in Color and never settling for the expected. You’ll be challenged to grow, encouraged to explore new technologies and supported by teammates who believe the best work is always built together. We’re insight\-driven ideamakers who give a damn—about the work, our clients and one another. Our We Before Me philosophy reminds us that the strongest work is never about one person; it’s about what we build together. If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, sharing what you learn and using technology to create smarter, more meaningful experiences, you’ll feel right at home here. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Hybrid work environment with the option to work remotely Thursday and Friday * Competitive medical, dental and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match and profit sharing * Paid parental leave * Generous paid time off, including your birthday off * Professional development funding and ongoing learning opportunities * Opportunities to give back through meaningful pro bono work and community involvement * Investment and partnership opportunities * Dog\-friendly office * A culture built around curiosity, collaboration and our We Before Me philosophy **Work Authorization** ---------------------- Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. c4qzoQJ6CL

jobs.title: Security Engineer, ML Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Why work at Higgsfield AI?** Higgsfield AI is the fastest\-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M\+ users worldwide, 6M\+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI\-powered video creation and next\-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high\-impact team shaping the future of AI\-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like. **About the role:** Higgsfield AI is looking for a highly technical, hands\-on ML Security Engineer to join Higgsfield Security and own security across our GPU clusters and AI/ML infrastructure, from model training to inference and production deployment. In this role, you will work as part of the Security team and closely with our ML and Infrastructure teams to design, implement, and operate security controls that protect models, data, and underlying infrastructure. Your core responsibilities will include securing GPU compute environments, assessing infrastructure and AI/ML vendors, and enforcing security requirements through technical controls, deployment policies, and verified remediation. We're looking for someone who combines deep security engineering expertise with a practical, solutions\-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across cloud environments, Kubernetes, Linux, and GPU infrastructure, and understands how to balance security, performance, and reliability in a fast\-moving AI environment. This role carries direct ownership of GPU infrastructure security and the security requirements that third\-party providers must meet to support Higgsfield’s workloads and data. **What you'll do:** **AI/ML \& GPU Infrastructure Security** * Own the security of GPU clusters supporting distributed training and production inference across cloud and rented datacenter environments. * Harden GPU hosts, operating systems, drivers, container runtimes, Kubernetes clusters, and workload scheduling configurations; reduce privileged access and unnecessary exposure. * Secure distributed training environments and GPU workloads through isolation, access controls, and data movement restrictions. Validate isolation between tenants and workloads across compute, networking, and storage, including shared GPU environments where applicable. * Design and implement controls to protect sensitive datasets, model checkpoints, weights, and customer data. * Strengthen inference security through tenant isolation, service authorization, secure model loading. * Partner with ML and Platform Engineering teams to integrate security into infrastructure design and development workflows. **Vendor Security Assessment \& Enforcement** * Lead technical security assessments of GPU infrastructure providers, datacenter operators, and other AI security vendors that process Higgsfield data and support AI workloads. * Evaluate vendor architecture and evidence covering tenant isolation, privileged access, data handling and retention, use of customer data for model training, encryption, vulnerability management, and incident response. * Translate security requirements into enforceable technical controls, including approved configurations, and continuous checks for configuration drift. * Track internal and vendor security findings to closure with accountable owners and deadlines, validate remediation, and escalate unmet requirements. Document any approved exceptions with compensating controls and expiration dates. **Cloud \& Platform Security** * Design, implement, and maintain security controls across Linux, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, networks, and third party datacenter environments. * Secure infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and access to third\-party infrastructure providers. Restrict and audit vendor and administrator access to cluster management interfaces and production systems. * Implement least\-privilege access, workload identity, secrets management, encryption, and auditable access controls. * Identify and remediate vulnerabilities and configuration risks across production systems, including GPU hosts, drivers, and container runtimes, coordinating changes with infrastructure owners to maintain service reliability. **Security Operations \& Risk Management** * Develop and maintain detection and response capabilities for infrastructure and AI\-specific security threats, including unauthorized GPU workloads, privilege escalation, and suspicious data transfers. * Investigate and respond to potential credential compromise, unauthorized data access, model theft, and compromised workloads. * Partner cross\-functionally to implement practical security improvements that account for the performance, scalability, and reliability requirements of GPU workloads. **Requirements:** * Strong hands\-on experience in Security Engineering, Infrastructure Security, Platform Security, or a related technical discipline. * Deep understanding of Linux, Kubernetes, networking, and cloud infrastructure security. * Practical experience securing or operating GPU clusters or distributed AI/ML infrastructure, with an understanding of training and inference workloads, GPU drivers and runtimes, and workload isolation. * Experience designing and implementing security controls across complex, distributed production environments. * Strong knowledge of identity and access management, workload isolation, encryption, secrets management, and least\-privilege principles. * Experience conducting technical vendor security assessments, evaluating supporting evidence, and driving remediation with external providers. * Ability to identify, investigate, and remediate security vulnerabilities and infrastructure threats. * Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Go, or Bash. * Experience partnering with Infrastructure, Platform, or ML Engineering teams to implement security solutions. * Strong technical ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to prioritize security risks in a fast\-paced environment. * A hands\-on, collaborative approach with the ability to independently drive security initiatives from design through deployment, verify that controls work in production, and hold internal teams and vendors accountable for agreed security requirements. **Compensation \& Benefits** * We offer a competitive and thoughtfully structured compensation package designed to align with impact, experience, and long\-term growth. * **Base Salary:** The anticipated salary range for this role is **$200,000 \- $300,000**, depending on experience, skills, scope, and location. * **Bonus:** This role is Bonus eligible and may participate in the Company's discretionary annual bonus program. * **Equity:** In addition to cash compensation, employees are eligible to participate in the company’s stock option program and share in Higgsfield’s long\-term growth. * **Benefits:** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and additional benefits and perks. * The opportunity to work on ambitious AI products alongside a highly experienced, fast\-moving, and international team. * Significant ownership, direct impact, and opportunities for professional growth as the company scales. This is a **hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area**. jobs.title: Facilities Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** The Facilities Engineer is responsible for supporting, planning, and executing plant projects involving mechanical, electrical, structural, and utility systems. This position serves as the site’s Electrical Subject Matter Expert (SME) and ensures that all electrical installations, maintenance activities, and system upgrades comply with NEC/NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, OSHA, and internal Howmet standards that exceed regulatory requirements. The role provides engineering leadership for capital projects, electrical power distribution, safety compliance, and reliability improvement initiatives. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** **1\. Project Engineering \& Execution** * Lead capital and facility improvement projects from concept through commissioning, including scope development, cost estimation, scheduling, and milestone tracking. * Integrate stakeholder manufacturing and processing requirements into equipment selection, facility layouts, and utility planning. * Evaluate feasibility of new equipment or modifications, considering cost, space constraints, schedule, technical requirements, and operational impacts. * Prepare, review, and maintain engineering documentation including equipment specifications, drawings, and installation requirements. * Supervise electrical and mechanical contractors and provide technical direction to maintenance personnel during project implementation. * Conduct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), benchmarking, and vendor site visits as required (up to 25% travel). **2\. Electrical Power Distribution (Primary Focus)** * Serve as the plant’s electrical technical authority, responsible for the design, sizing, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electrical power distribution systems (e.g., 480V 3‑phase, switchgear, feeders, MCCs, grounding/bonding, overcurrent protection). * Plan electrical system capacity for new and existing operations, including load calculations, conductor and device sizing, and system coordination. * Lead and oversee arc‑flash, short‑circuit, and coordination studies; ensure labeling, documentation, and study intervals comply with applicable standards. * Maintain accurate and current one‑line diagrams, electrical system documentation, and equipment labeling. **3\. Electrical Safety, Code Compliance \& Contractor Oversight** * Lead implementation and continuous improvement of the Electrical Safety Program in alignment with NFPA 70E requirements, including energized work controls, PPE standards, approach boundaries, and training. * Ensure electrical installations comply with NEC/NFPA 70, OSHA requirements, and Howmet Environmental, Health \& Safety (EHS) policies that exceed minimum code. * Oversee contractor adherence to all safety, compliance, and quality expectations during electrical installation and maintenance activities. * Participate in audits, inspections, and corrective‑action planning to improve facility electrical safety and regulatory compliance. **4\. Reliability, Maintenance Support \& Documentation** * Lead or support preventive and predictive maintenance for electrical distribution systems; prioritize and coordinate repairs to maintain system reliability and operational continuity. * Provide advanced troubleshooting assistance for equipment and facility systems to minimize downtime and improve overall equipment effectiveness. * Support structured maintenance practices including LOTO, job briefings, energized work permits, and safe‑work‑practice adherence. * Initiate purchase requisitions for maintenance supplies, spare parts, and electrical components. * Prepare engineering reports, updates, KPIs, and risk assessments for leadership review. **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical field; or equivalent experience. * Minimum 3 years of engineering experience in a manufacturing, facilities, or industrial environment. * Strong working knowledge of electrical theory and systems, including 480V 3‑phase distribution. * Demonstrated experience with electrical safe work practices, including the use of meters, verification of absence of voltage, and energized work protocols. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings (P\&IDs, one‑lines, equipment drawings). * Proficiency with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and standard office software. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to communicate technical information across levels and functions. **Preferred** * Experience implementing or supporting NFPA 70E programs. * Familiarity with NEC article families commonly applied in industrial settings (110, 240, 250, 430, 500–506\). * Exposure to arc‑flash studies and power‑system modeling tools such as ETAP, SKM, or EasyPower. * Professional certifications (PE, PMP, CFM) are a plus. **Physical Requirements** * Frequent walking and communication throughout the facility; occasional standing, climbing, kneeling, or crawling. * Ability to lift and move up to 25 lbs. * Adequate visual acuity for close, distance, and peripheral work tasks. **Work Environment** * Primarily plant‑floor and facilities environment with exposure to industrial equipment, electrical systems, noise, heat, and manufacturing processes. * May require off‑shift support during installations, outages, or urgent maintenance activities.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Agentic SOC
jobs.description: **What We Do:** Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact. Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote\-first team working to make enterprise\-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That's why we build our technology in\-house and back it with a 24/7 human\-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection. Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other. **Reports to: Director, Engineering** **Location: Remote US, Only** **Compensation:** **$215,000 to $240,000 base plus bonus and equity** **What You'll Do:** Huntress is building an Agentic SOC. When our detection pipeline raises a signal, an LLM\-based agent picks it up and investigates it end\-to\-end. It gathers telemetry across our products, reconstructs what happened, and makes a well\-documented determination about whether the activity is malicious. Over time, it will take on more of the work itself, growing from resolving routine cases to acting fast when it finds an attack and handing analysts cases with the evidence already assembled. We're hiring a Principal Software Engineer to head this effort. This system is meant to augment our analysts, not replace them. It takes the high\-volume, repetitive work off their plates so they can focus on complex cases and hands\-on keyboard intrusions where human expertise matters most. It also reduces toil in the rest of their day by using LLMs to pre\-process the output of the tools analysts use constantly, so they start from a clear picture instead of raw telemetry. This isn't a chatbot bolted onto a dashboard. The system investigates a large volume of signals a day across thousands of customer organizations. Many signals are benign, but some are live intrusions where minutes matter. The telemetry the system reads comes from environments in which attackers are actively operating. Because the system makes real decisions, like closing an investigation or isolating a host, it has to be right, it has to show its work, and it has to know when to hand off to a person. As the technical lead, you'll own the system's architecture and direction. That means deciding how an investigation is structured, where deterministic code ends and model reasoning begins, what the agent can and can't touch, how we know it's working, and which decisions it makes on its own as it proves itself. You'll work closely with SOC analysts, detection engineers, product, and other engineering teams. You'll go deep in the code and help the engineers around you grow. Your work will directly shape how Huntress scales protection for the 99%. We make full use of AI coding tools to enable you to accelerate your development. We don't cap token usage. We expect you to use AI and all tools responsibly. **Responsibilities:** * Own the architecture of agentic investigation. You help define how signals move from detection into investigation, how investigation state is managed, how tools are designed and exposed to agents, and what a finished investigation contains: the verdict, the timeline, the scope, and the evidence behind every claim. When the team is stuck between options, you make the call, and the foundations you set are what others build on for years. * Build agents that investigate like a strong analyst. You work alongside our SOC and product researchers to learn how experienced analysts actually triage and investigate, then turn that into agent behavior: which questions to ask, which evidence to gather, when to dig deeper, and when to stop and hand off to a human. * Take toil off analysts' plates. Beyond full investigations, you build LLM\-powered pre\-processing for the tools and data sources analysts rely on every day. It summarizes, correlates, and highlights what matters, so analysts spend their time on judgment instead of assembly. * Bring a security mindset to the agent itself. The agent reads attacker\-influenced data, runs across thousands of customer tenants, and can take action in customer environments. You design as if someone is trying to manipulate it, because someone will. Trust boundaries, tenant isolation, and auditability are part of the architecture from the start. * Treat evaluation as a core part of the product. You define how we measure whether an investigation is correct, we ant time as the technical lead on production systems * Hands\-on experience designing, shipping, and operating LLM\-based agents in production, covering tool use, context management, structured output, guardrails, and evaluation, along with a clear\-eyed understanding of how they fail * A track record of building evaluation for non\-deterministic systems, such as labeled datasets, offline evals, and regression gates, and of measuring quality over time rather than at launch * A security mindset: experience building systems that handle untrusted input, enforce multi\-tenant isolation, and produce an audit trail that holds up under scrutiny * Experience building systems that make automated decisions with real consequences, and the judgment to know what to automate and what to leave to people * Curiosity about how security analysts think and work, and a willingness to spend real time learning from them * Deep backend expertise in distributed systems, queues, and durable workflows, and concurrency, with a track record of designing for throughput and correctness under load * Strong skills in one or more backend languages and the ability to pick up new ones quickly. Our primary stack is Ruby on Rails, and we expect you to become fluent in it * Experience with AWS, Azure, or other public cloud environments, and with data stores such as Postgres and Redis * Experience with AI coding tools, such as Claude Code * BS or MS in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience **Bonus Points:** * Experience working in or building for a SOC, incident response, threat hunting, or detection engineering. It isn't required, but it helps a lot, because we build these workflows around how our analysts actually investigate * Familiarity with endpoint and identity telemetry and with attacker tradecraft * Experience attacking or adversarially testing ML or LLM systems * Experience with Ruby on Rails **What We Offer:** * 100% remote work environment \- since our founding in 2015 * Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays * 12 weeks of paid parental leave * Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans * 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution * Life and Disability insurance plans * Stock options for **all** full\-time employees * One\-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office * Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance * $75 USD/month digital reimbursement * Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth *Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.* *We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.* *We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes.* **Accommodations:** *If you require reasonable accommodation to complete this application, interview, or pre\-employment testing or participate in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to* *accommodations@huntresslabs.com**. Please note that non\-accommodation requests to this inbox will not receive a response.* *Huntress uses artificial intelligence tools to assist in reviewing and evaluating job applications, including resume screening, skills assessment, and candidate matching and comparisons. These AI tools support our human recruiters in the initial review process, but do not make final hiring decisions without human involvement. By submitting your application, you acknowledge this use of AI in our recruitment process. When our detection pipeline raises a signal, an LLM\-based agent picks it up and investigates it end\-to\-end. It gathers telemetry across our products, reconstructs what happened, and makes a well\-documented determination about whether the activity is malicious. Over time, it will take on more of the work itself, growing from resolving routine cases to acting fast when it finds an attack and handing analysts cases with the evidence already assembled. This system is meant to augment our analysts, not replace them. It takes the high\-volume, repetitive work off their plates so they can focus on complex cases and hands\-on keyboard intrusions where human expertise matters most. It also reduces toil in the rest of their day by using LLMs to pre\-process the output of the tools analysts use constantly, so they start from a clear picture instead of raw telemetry. This isn't a chatbot bolted onto a dashboard. The system investigates a large volume of signals a day across thousands of customer organizations. Many signals are benign, but some are live intrusions where minutes matter. The telemetry the system reads comes from environments where attackers are actively operating. Because the system makes real decisions, like closing an investigation or isolating a host, it has to be right, it has to show its work, and it has to know when to hand off to a person. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Agentic SOC team, you'll build and ship core parts of this system. You'll work closely with the team's technical leads, SOC analysts, product researchers, and product managers. You'll own significant pieces end\-to\-end, from an ambiguous problem to a production feature you can show is working. They summarize, correlate, and highlight what matters, so analysts spend their time on judgment instead of assembly. * Measure what you ship. You build and extend the evaluations that tell us whether the system is getting better or worse, and you back your changes with evidence rather than a handful of good\-looking examples. * Build with a security mindset. The agent reads attacker\-influenced data, runs across thousands of customer tenants, and can take action in customer environments. You think about how what you build could be misused or manipulated, and you design for it. * Build for production. You write reliable, observable, cost\-conscious code that behaves well when models are slow, wrong, or unavailable. You operate what you build and help keep the system healthy as new detections and products come online. * Collaborate and raise the bar.
