jobs.title: Staff Structural Engineer, Building Product Development
jobs.description: ICON is seeking a Staff Structural Engineer to own and advance structural engineering as a product development discipline \- translating deep structural expertise into the requirements, rulesets, and technical resources that make ICON's building products \& systems designable, verifiable, and executable at scale. This role serves as ICON's primary structural product development authority \- develop the structural engineering logic into the requirements, tools, and technical guidance that enable ICON's Divisions, its Customers, and external partners to deliver cutting\-edge printed structures with precision and confidence. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** #### **Structural Technical Authority** * Serve as ICON's primary structural engineering subject matter expert for its Building Products and Systems, providing senior\-level technical input and direction to ICON's Technology product teams, Divisions, external partners. * Develop, maintain, and evolve structural engineering requirements, design standards, and calculations as ICON's structural system configurations and product portfolio expand into new market types, building uses, and climate zones. * Act as a structural technical resource for complex structural questions from cross\-functional teams, escalated customer engagements, and development partners working with ICON systems. * Ensure structural engineering product development work maintains alignment with applicable structural building codes and design standards (ACI, ASCE, TMS etc.), and appropriate product testing for code compliance and product requirements testing are sufficiently scoped and defined. * Serve as the primary structural technical escalation point for ICON's Building Products \& Systems — resolving structural questions and out\-of\-spec conditions that exceed the independent resolution capacity of ICON's customer support teams. * Interface with the Building Regulatory Affairs team on code compliance pathways. #### **Structural Product Development** * Own the translation of structural engineering expertise into scalable rulesets, design workflows, and structured technical documentation that enable ICON's structural systems to be replicated consistently by customers across a range of projects, and market geographies. * Define structural engineering requirements and provide technical input for BuildOS products and review their implementation, serving as a structural engineering subject matter expert in software product development workflows. * Identify gaps in ICON's structural product systems and develop frameworks to close them — documenting findings, proposing solutions, and driving resolution across the relevant cross\-functional teams. * Maintain a current, structured workplan for all assigned structural product development initiatives using Jira and related project management tools; proactively surface structural risks, dependencies, and timeline pressures to BACS leadership before they become blockers. * Maintain a structured intake from ICON's customer support teams for field\-surfaced structural conditions, SEOR\-identified edge cases, and applied project outcomes — translating recurring patterns into product development requirements and closing the gap between applied experience and the validated product system. * Review and support the development of technical content and structural design guidance — including standard details, design requirements, and application frameworks — for customers and customer teams working with ICON systems. * Provide deep structural technical support to consultant teams working with ICON's Divisions on research and development projects. * Collaborate and receive feedback from ICON's Divisions to incorporate feedback into the structural development of ICON's building products, product\-level structural integration, ensuring field experience and lessons learned flow back into building product \& systems. #### **Field Engagement \& Installation Support** * Represent ICON's structural engineering capabilities in internal technical forums and external conversations with customers, regulatory bodies, and industry partners as needed. * Periodic field visits to ICON field installations, and partner locations to observe installation performance, surface structural product development inputs, and validate design assumptions against real\-world conditions; typically no more than one to two overnight trips per engagement. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or related discipline * Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) in at least one U.S. jurisdiction * 12 or more years of structural engineering experience; 8 or more years with a Master's degree * Demonstrated experience working across multidisciplinary teams in fast\-paced, cross\-functional environments * Strong command of ACI, ASCE, and TMS design codes and their application across building types and jurisdictions * Proven ability to translate complex structural engineering concepts into clear documentation, technical guidance, and product requirements * Track record of managing multiple workstreams and driving technical initiatives to completion without close supervision * Proficiency with industry\-standard structural engineering tools, including finite element analysis software (CSI Suite — ETABS and SAP2000\), calculation documentation platforms (MathCAD), Excel\-based engineering calculation workflows, and Revit for structural documentation and coordination **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Graduate degree in Structural Engineering or related discipline * Experience with productized building systems and/or non\-traditional construction methods (modular, prefabricated, 3D\-printed, or similar) * Exposure to software\-enabled design workflows and/or engineering logic automation in a product development context * Experience supporting customer\-facing technical engagements in a design\-build or AEC technology environment * Background in computational design, numerical methods, or structural programming * Familiarity with sustainability aspects of structural material systems, including embodied carbon and life cycle jobs.title: Principal AI Operations Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: The Principal AI Operations Engineer reports to the Sr. Director, AI Center of Excellence, in the Technology Department. This role defines how AI systems at Inspira Financial are instrumented, measured, monitored, and evidenced, and drives adoption of those standards across the enterprise, spanning both vendor\-provided and internally built AI capabilities. Primary duties include building the enterprise telemetry and observability standard for AI systems; designing evaluation, drift detection, and agent guardrail frameworks; translating AI risk and compliance frameworks into operational controls and audit evidence; maintaining the enterprise AI system inventory; and teaching other engineering teams to adopt these standards independently. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Define the enterprise telemetry standard for AI systems, covering traces, prompts, tool calls, retrieval, tokens, latency, and cost, built on a vendor\-neutral schema such as OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions. * Build the logging and observability layer that provides the AI Center of Excellence, business units, and the AI Governance Committee with a single view of AI activity across custom applications, agent platforms, and vendor\-embedded AI. * Integrate AI telemetry with enterprise log aggregation, application performance monitoring, security monitoring, alerting, and incident response platforms to support operational visibility, investigation, and audit retention. * Establish retention, redaction, masking, and access patterns for AI conversation and trace data that satisfy privacy, records retention, and legal hold obligations. * Publish reference implementations and starter kits so teams adopting the telemetry standard inherit a working path. * Design the evaluation framework for AI systems, including golden datasets, offline evaluation harnesses, automated and LLM\-as\-judge scoring, and regression gates in CI. * Define drift criteria for each class of AI system and build detection for output quality degradation, retrieval decay, input distribution shift, and silent model updates from providers or vendors. * Build runtime guardrails and boundary enforcement for agents, including tool and action authorization, scope and spend limits, escalation paths, human\-in\-the\-loop triggers, and hard\-stop conditions. * Establish the AI incident model, including severity taxonomy, detection, alerting, rollback, postmortem process, and conversion of incidents into new test cases. * Translate NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, model risk management practice, and applicable privacy and recordkeeping obligations into operational controls engineers can implement. * Build the evidence layer that automates capture of artifacts needed for internal audit, external examination, and client due diligence. * Integrate AI operational data with governance, risk, and compliance platforms to support continuous control monitoring, automated evidence collection, risk reporting, and audit readiness. * Maintain the operational AI inventory across custom builds, agents, integrations, and vendor AI features, including an owner, risk classification, and control coverage for each entry. * Define the assurance pattern for vendor AI, including required telemetry, attestations, detection of vendor model changes, and compensating monitoring. * Build metric frameworks connecting AI usage, quality, cost, and risk posture to business outcomes, and report these to CoE leadership, business unit leaders, and the AI Governance Committee. * Own token and platform cost visibility and attribution by team and use case and lead resulting optimization work. * Run working sessions, document patterns, review designs, and coach teams through their first fully instrumented AI deployment. * Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Privacy, and Security to incorporate feedback from the risk triad and ensure adequate detection, response, and mitigation measures are in place. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** Minimum required: * Bachelor of Science in Engineering or Computer Science * Relevant certifications are a plus: Datadog Certified Professional, Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer for BigQuery ML, or PagerDuty’s AI Ops * 8 or more years of telemetry\-driven engineering experience, including 2 years operating LLM, ML, or agentic systems in production, with hands\-on ownership of instrumentation and monitoring. **Skills \& Abilities:** * Production\-grade proficiency in Python and SQL, including building tooling, pipelines, and services other teams depend on. * Demonstrated experience in AI evaluation and observability, including eval harnesses, tracing, scoring, drift detection, and guardrails. * Working command of at least one AI risk or governance framework, such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act, or model risk management practice, and the ability to convert it into controls and code. * Experience operating in a regulated environment where logging, retention, evidence, and access control are enforced rather than aspirational. * Ability to influence without formal authority across engineering teams, legal counsel, and executive stakeholders. * Financial services, healthcare, benefits administration, or other regulated industry experience preferred, particularly environments handling PHI, PII, or fiduciary data. * jobs.title: Senior IT Systems & Infrastructure Engineer (Cloud, Security & AI)
jobs.description: About the Role ITCS is a South Florida managed services provider that designs and supports custom IT solutions for our clients rather than a one\-size\-fits\-all menu. We are looking for a Senior Systems \& Infrastructure Engineer we can point at any project or client environment and trust to own it end to end: networking, on\-premise and cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365/Azure, and AI. Our clients are increasingly asking us for AI solutions, and we want this engineer to help lead that practice alongside traditional infrastructure work. This is a true generalist\-at\-a\-senior\-level position. One week you may be redesigning a client's network and firewall stack, the next migrating on\-premise servers to Azure, then leading a security hardening project, then scoping and rolling out Microsoft Copilot or a custom AI workflow for a client, then building an automation that saves the team hours. You will take projects from scoping and design through implementation and documentation, while also serving as the Tier 3 escalation point for our support team. **Location requirement:** This position is primarily work\-from\-home with onsite visits to clients throughout Fort Lauderdale, Boca Raton, and West Palm Beach. Candidates must already reside in our service area and have reliable transportation. **What You Will Do** * Lead client infrastructure projects from planning and design through implementation, cutover, and documentation. * Design, deploy, and support network environments: firewalls, Layer 3 switching, routing, VLANs, VPN (site\-to\-site and remote access), Wi\-Fi, and SD\-WAN. * Build and manage Windows Server environments (2019 through 2025\), Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, certificate services, clustering, and virtualization. * Architect and execute cloud projects in Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, including on\-prem\-to\-Azure migrations, Entra ID, Intune, Conditional Access, and email migrations from other platforms to Microsoft 365\. * Implement and maintain security controls across client environments: EDR/MDR, SIEM, Zero Trust access (e.g., Zscaler), MFA/SSO (SAML/OIDC), vulnerability remediation, email security, and backup and disaster recovery. * Serve as the Tier 3 escalation point for the support desk, resolving complex issues and mentoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 technicians. * Help build and deliver our AI services practice: meet with clients to identify practical AI use cases, assess data readiness and governance, and scope, pilot, and deploy solutions such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, AI\-powered automation and workflow tools, and secure use of ChatGPT/Claude\-type assistants. * Advise clients on responsible AI adoption: data access and permissions, information protection and DLP, acceptable\-use policies, and keeping client data out of unmanaged AI tools. * Automate recurring work with PowerShell and AI\-assisted tooling; use AI tools daily for scripting, log and data analysis, documentation, and proactive maintenance. * Communicate directly with client stakeholders, from end users to executives, via phone, email, and in person. Explain issues and resolutions clearly and provide professional recommendations. * Document everything: tickets, resolutions, runbooks, network diagrams, and client inventory records in our PSA/RMM and documentation platforms. * Contribute to standards, process improvements, and the technology roadmap for both ITCS and our clients. * Participate in a scheduled on\-call rotation; occasional evening or weekend work for maintenance windows and project cutovers. **Required Skills and Experience** We expect a strong, hands\-on foundation in each of the five areas below. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every one, but you must be able to take ownership of a project in any of them. * **Experience:** 7\+ years in IT infrastructure/systems engineering, with at least 3 years at a Tier 3 or project\-lead level. MSP experience strongly preferred. * **Networking:** Proven hands\-on experience designing, configuring, and troubleshooting firewalls, Layer 3 switches, routing, VLANs, VPNs, and wireless. Comfortable with packet captures and root\-cause network troubleshooting. Experience with at least one major platform (Fortinet, Cisco/Meraki, SonicWall, Palo Alto, Ubiquiti, or similar). * **Infrastructure:** Expert in Windows Server 2019–2025, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, certificate authorities, server clustering, and storage. Working experience with Hyper\-V and/or VMware. Experience with backup and disaster recovery platforms and tested recovery procedures. * **Cybersecurity:** Practical experience implementing security controls: EDR/MDR (e.g., Arctic Wolf, SentinelOne, Huntress), Zero Trust/SASE (e.g., Zscaler), MFA and SSO/SAML, Conditional Access, email security, patch and vulnerability management, and security baselines (CIS/NIST). Able to lead incident response and client security assessments. * **Cloud:** Strong experience with Microsoft Azure infrastructure and networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN gateways, VMs, Azure Files, backup) and Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID, Intune). Experience performing on\-prem\-to\-Azure and email\-platform\-to\-M365 migrations. Exposure to AWS and Google Workspace. * **AI and Automation:** Demonstrated use of AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in daily engineering work: scripting, troubleshooting, log/data analysis, documentation, and automation. Hands\-on experience deploying at least one AI solution in a business environment, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or other agent builders, or AI\-driven workflow automation, including the data governance and licensing work that goes with it. Able to explain AI capabilities and limitations clearly to non\-technical clients and translate business problems into practical, secure AI use cases. Strong PowerShell skills (creating, modifying, and executing scripts). * **Professional:** Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical audiences, including executives. Patient, professional, and personable with end users. Strong project management, time management, and documentation habits. Able to work independently without onsite supervision and to prioritize multiple concurrent projects. * **Logistics:** Reside in the Fort Lauderdale / Boca Raton / West Palm Beach area with reliable transportation and the ability to travel locally as needed. Available for scheduled on\-call and occasional after\-hours work. Must be able to pass a Florida Department of Law Enforcement (FDLE) background check. **Preferred Qualifications** * Certifications such as Microsoft AZ\-104 / AZ\-305 / SC\-300, CCNA / CCNP, Fortinet NSE 4\+, CompTIA Security\+ / CySA\+, or CISSP. * Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Linux, and macOS in a managed environment. * Experience with compliance frameworks relevant to our clients (HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, cyber\-insurance requirements). * Experience with PSA/RMM and documentation platforms (e.g., ConnectWise, Datto/Autotask, NinjaOne, IT Glue, Hudu). * Experience building Copilot Studio agents, Power Automate / n8n / Zapier AI workflows, or lightweight integrations with OpenAI, Anthropic, or Azure OpenAI APIs. * Experience with Microsoft Purview, sensitivity labels, and DLP as they relate to Copilot and AI readiness. * Microsoft AI certifications (AI\-900, AI\-102\) or equivalent. Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $145,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Retirement plan Work Location: Hybrid remote in Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301

jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ This is a role on the Business Disruption Team at Intuit. We are a high\-octane, entrepreneurial group on a mission to build net\-new disruptive products and supercharge our existing ecosystem with AI\-first technologies. We operate like a nimble startup within the broader Intuit organization. You will be working alongside an elite, dynamic mix of seasoned Intuit veterans and brilliant newcomers to the company. This is a team composed of proven leaders with deep track records of success across the organization. By combining deep institutional knowledge with fresh, disruptive perspectives, we create an environment where you will be challenged, mentored, and inspired to do the best work of your career. We are looking for an exceptional Full\-Stack Software Engineer who thrives in ambiguity, operates with a high degree of autonomy, and moves with blistering speed. In this role, you won't just be writing code, you will be leveraging the latest AI coding tools to dramatically accelerate your output, running rapid experiments directly with customers, and bringing zero\-to\-one concepts to life. If you are a builder who loves to ship fast, learn continuously, and have a lot of fun doing it, you belong here. **Responsibilities** * Rapid Development \& Execution: Design, build, and ship full\-stack software solutions with an intense focus on velocity and getting things done. * AI\-Accelerated Engineering: Extensively leverage AI coding assistants and modern tooling to write, test, and deploy code faster and more efficiently than traditional methods. * Customer\-Centric Experimentation: Work on the front lines with end\-users to conduct rapid product experiments, gather real\-world feedback, and iterate quickly based on data. * Autonomous Navigation: Operate comfortably in a fast\-paced environment with a high degree of ambiguity, taking extreme ownership of your projects from inception to launch. * Disruptive Innovation: Build entirely new, AI\-native products from scratch while also identifying ways to accelerate existing Intuit products with cutting\-edge tech. **Qualifications** * Technical \& Craft Expertise: Proven experience as a Full\-Stack Software Engineer building modern, scalable applications across both the frontend and backend. Typescript \+ Python is what we use. * AI Tooling Fluency: Hands\-on experience and deep comfort using AI coding tools. Have the ability to clearly express your intent and exercise good judgement to direct AI to produce clear and maintainable code (not AI slop). * Startup Mentality: An aggressively entrepreneurial spirit with a track record of moving fast, cutting through red tape, and delivering results quickly. * Customer Obsession: A strong desire to be close to the customer, with demonstrated experience running A/B tests, prototypes, or rapid user experiments. * Adaptability \& Autonomy: The ability to self\-direct, pivot rapidly when hypotheses are disproven, and thrive in an unstructured, highly ambiguous environment. * Growth Mindset: A relentless appetite for learning new technologies, taking calculated risks, and having a blast while building the future. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $140,500 \- $190,000

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Data Scientist
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB219885 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function of Position** The Senior Clinical Data Scientist will be part of the Ion business unit. The Ion endoluminal system is Intuitive's robotic platform for minimally invasive biopsy in the peripheral lung, with an initial goal of improving the early diagnosis of lung cancer. The Senior Clinical Data Scientist sits at the intersection of clinical science and data science within the Ion business unit, translating clinical questions into rigorous, data\-driven analyses that inform product strategy, evidence generation, and business decisions. This role reports to the Managing Staff, Clinical Data Science. The individual in this role will partner with clinicians, cross\-functional teams, and data engineering to design and execute a clinical data science strategy — defining hypotheses grounded in customer needs, identifying appropriate data sources, conducting quantitative analyses, and communicating results that demonstrably impact patient outcomes and business objectives. Unlike a purely clinical or purely technical role, this position demands both deep clinical understanding of the Ion platform and hands\-on proficiency in modern data science methods and tools. Success requires a strong technical foundation in Python or R, statistics, and causal reasoning; the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast\-evolving clinical and commercial landscape; and exceptional skill in communicating complex findings clearly — especially through polished visual presentations and well\-organized documentation. **Essential Job Duties** * Work with internal and external stakeholders (including clinicians, administrators, and policymakers) to identify data\-centric needs in the clinical space and translate them into prioritized research questions with testable hypotheses. * Design, implement, and validate quantitative analyses in Python or R — applying appropriate statistical, machine learning, and causal inference methods to Ion device logs, clinical studies/registries, insurance claims databases, and EHR/EMR data — to test hypotheses. * Translate analyses into decision\-useful stories, tailoring them to diverse groups of stakeholders — from technical peers building product, to senior leadership defining strategy, to external physicians looking to improve efficiency. * Demonstrate impact through internal/external reports, presentations, dashboards, peer\-reviewed publications, and customer\-facing deliverables. * Partner with cross\-functional teams to assist with the design and execution of global clinical and economic evidence strategies, including designing and supporting clinical trials. * Support regulatory submissions by structuring and validating clinical datasets to meet FDA and EU MDR compliance standards. * Create and maintain well\-organized, reproducible codebases with clear documentation, version control, and consistent coding standards. * Catalyze a data\-driven culture internally — champion the use of data to generate compelling evidence and ultimately build a better product. ### **Qualifications** **Required Skills and Experience** * 6\+ years of experience with Master's degree or 4\+ years with PhD in a quantitative, scientific, or engineering field (e.g., biostatistics, epidemiology, data science, computer science, biomedical engineering, public health, or a related discipline). MD with quantitative research experience also accepted. * Experience with Python or R for data analysis, statistical modeling, and visualization. * Working knowledge of SQL for querying and managing structured datasets. * Demonstrated experience with causal inference methods and study design. * Experience working with device\-generated log data, clinical study/registry data, and claims/EHR\-style databases. * Experience with causal inference in a healthcare or medical device context. * Experience using platforms such as Snowflake  * Self\-starter attitude with the ability to manage multiple priorities, operate independently, and deliver under ambiguity. * Track record of peer\-reviewed publications or conference presentations in clinical research or data science. * Experience in medical devices or other regulated industries. * Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ISO 14155 (clinical investigation of medical devices), and data privacy regulations (HIPAA/GDPR). * Familiarity with the lung cancer landscape (screening, diagnosis, treatment). ### **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. jobs.title: Agentic-First Software Engineer (Relocate to Miami)
jobs.description: Jiffy.com is seeking Agentic\-First Software Engineers (Snr/Staff/Principal) with deep hands\-on experience orchestrating AI coding agents to ship production software at pace. Reporting directly to an Engineering Manager and working closely with Product, GM's and other cross functional teams, you will lead the charge on delivering end\-to\-end features across our e\-commerce platform from storefront and checkout to internal tools and platform services while running multiple AI\-driven work streams in parallel. At Jiffy, engineers no longer write code by hand: every line that reaches production is produced, tested, reviewed, and deployed by coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) under the direction of a human orchestrator. This role is perfect for an individual contributor who has already internalized the shift from “typing code” to “directing agents,” has strong architectural taste and review instincts, and wants to help define what an AI\-native engineering org looks like. You will thrive here if you are a systems thinker, a builder by nature, and someone who gets more done by managing five parallel agents well than by writing a single function perfectly. **At this time, Jiffy is not able to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa (e.g., H\-1B) for this position. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.** ### **Key Responsibilities** * Orchestrate AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) across 3–6 concurrent work streams spanning features, refactors, bug fixes, and investigations using worktrees, sub\-agents, and background tasks to maximize parallel throughput. * Own features end\-to\-end: translate product intent into clear specifications, decompose work into agent\-executable plans, drive agents through implementation, review every diff critically, run QA, land PRs, and verify production health. * Design and architect scalable, reliable systems across our stack Rails 8 / Solidus e\-commerce, GraphQL APIs, React 19 front end, Kubernetes infrastructure holding the architectural and judgment calls that agents cannot make. * Raise the quality bar on AI\-generated code by catching hallucinated APIs, enforcing secure and idiomatic patterns, and pushing back on output that is technically working but structurally wrong. * Build and evolve Jiffy’s internal AI tooling: author skills, rules, prompts, MCP integrations, and evaluation harnesses that make the whole engineering org faster. Contribute to our shared .ai/ skills and rules library. * Operate with production rigor: drive agents to produce meaningful test coverage (RSpec, Vitest, Playwright), monitor deploys, respond to incidents, and fully own the services you ship. * Partner cross\-functionally with Product, Design, Ops, and peer engineering teams to define and ship features; participate in architecture and code reviews; mentor engineers on AI\-native workflows and orchestration patterns. * Continuously identify where remaining manual work (QA, ops runbooks, data investigations, migrations) can be replaced by agents, and automate it. **Requirements** ### **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping production systems at scale. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or equivalent) as a primary development tool. This is mandatory. You must be able to walk through real features, refactors, or investigations delivered through agent orchestration — not occasional autocomplete usage. * Proven ability to run multiple agents in parallel and manage concurrent work streams without losing quality, context, or accountability. * Strong software design fundamentals: OO design, API design, data modeling, distributed\-system reliability, and performance. * Proficiency in at least one server\-side language (Ruby, Python, Go, Java, or equivalent) and one modern front\-end stack (React / TypeScript or equivalent), with the expectation that agents produce the code while you direct, review, and validate it. * Experience with relational databases (Postgres / MySQL), SQL, and building or consuming REST or GraphQL APIs. * Elite code\-review skills: the ability to read, critique, and correct diffs at speed is the core competency of an AI\-first engineer. * Strong written communication — clear intent, clear PR descriptions, clear prompts. In an AI\-first org, writing is the programming interface. * A high level of integrity, accountability, and ownership, with a commitment to excellence across every deliverable. * Desire to work in a fast\-paced, ambiguous, high\-autonomy environment. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * AI Tooling Builder: Experience authoring or extending AI developer tooling — custom skills, slash commands, MCP servers, sub\-agents, evaluation harnesses, or prompt libraries used by a team. * E\-commerce Depth: Experience with Ruby on Rails and Solidus / Spree, or other large\-scale e\-commerce platforms. * Modern Front End: Experience with React 19, TypeScript, GraphQL (Apollo), Tailwind, and modern state management (React Query, XState, Jotai). * Cloud Native Operations: Experience operating services on Kubernetes (Istio, KEDA, Flagger) and modern observability stacks * Automated QA at Scale: Experience driving agents to maintain and extend test suites with Playwright, Vitest, and RSpec. * AI\-Native Leadership: Track record of mentoring engineers on AI\-native workflows, publishing internal patterns, or leading an organization through the shift away from manual coding. * Measurable Throughput Gains: Documented improvements in features\-per\-week, cycle time, or review time directly attributable to AI adoption. * High\-Growth Environment: Experience shipping in a fast\-paced, agile environment at a high\-growth startup or tech company. **Benefits** **What We Offer** The base compensation for this role is expected to range from $150,000 \- $265,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including skills, experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. Total compensation may include base salary, performance\-based bonuses, equity, and benefits. Final offers are tailored to each candidate and take into consideration their background and years of experience. * Comprehensive Benefits: Full medical, dental, and vision coverage, with a portion of premiums paid by Jiffy. * Retirement Planning: 401(k) * Wellness Support: Annual wellness benefits to help you stay healthy and balanced. * Tools for Success: Choice of MacBook or PC laptop, plus equipment for your home office setup. * Perks \& Extras: Annual credit of $200 to use on our website plus more team merch drops than you will know what to do with! * Professional Development: Annual stipend to support your learning and career growth. **EEO** Jiffy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Jiffy considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

jobs.description: **About the Role** We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to develop and apply modern machine learning and artificial intelligence across a range of products and business problems. The ideal candidate combines strong computer science foundations, rigorous experimental judgment, and the ability to turn advances in AI into reliable systems with measurable business impact. The work spans document intelligence, multimodal systems that combine text, images, and structured data, and the adaptation of foundation models using proprietary datasets. These models support complex workflows in regulated financial services, where accuracy, explainability, data governance, reproducibility, and careful evaluation are essential. You will work across the full machine learning lifecycle: framing problems, developing datasets, building and evaluating models, running large\-scale experiments, and partnering with engineering teams to bring successful solutions into production. A central part of the role is turning successful approaches into reusable AI capabilities, patterns, and components that can support multiple teams and use cases rather than creating a separate one\-off solution for every problem. **What You'll Do** * Identify high\-impact opportunities for machine learning and AI in partnership with product, engineering, operations, and business teams. * Design, train, fine\-tune, and evaluate machine learning and deep\-learning models. * Work with foundation models across language, vision, and multimodal applications. * Develop robust datasets, features, training pipelines, and evaluation frameworks. * Run efficient experiments on GPU infrastructure and improve model quality, speed, and cost. * Compare alternative modeling approaches and make clear recommendations based on empirical results and business impact. * Build reusable modeling components, evaluation frameworks, and implementation patterns that accelerate work across teams and projects. * Establish clear interfaces and standards that allow other teams to adopt proven AI capabilities without rebuilding the underlying modeling work. * Build models and supporting systems that are reproducible, testable, and suitable for production use. * Partner with ML and software engineers on deployment, monitoring, reliability, and ongoing model improvement. * Communicate results, limitations, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Stay current with advances in machine learning and determine when emerging techniques are mature enough to create practical value. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience developing machine learning solutions, including experience taking models beyond initial experimentation. * Strong programming and deep\-learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Experience training or fine\-tuning transformer\-based, vision, or multimodal models. * Experience working with GPUs and understanding the practical constraints of model training and inference. * Ability to work with large, complex, and imperfect datasets. * Demonstrated ability to own open\-ended problems from initial investigation through implementation and measurement. * Demonstrated ability to generalize successful solutions into reusable capabilities rather than one\-off models. * Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field. * Experience with distributed training, model optimization, quantization, or parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning. * Experience deploying and monitoring machine learning models in production. * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, distributed data processing, and modern ML development platforms. * Experience building AI systems in regulated, risk\-sensitive, or high\-stakes environments. * Contributions to applied research, open\-source projects, patents, or production AI products. **What Success Looks Like** * You turn ambiguous business needs into well\-defined machine learning problems and measurable success criteria. * You build models that improve real customer or operational outcomes, not only offline metrics. * You make thoughtful tradeoffs among model quality, complexity, latency, reliability, and cost. * You create reusable foundations that jobs.description: Job Title Cloud Data Engineering \& AI Tech Lead **Division:** Corporate IT, Data \& AI **Location:** New York, NY **Reports To:** Data \& AI \- Domain Analytics Lead **Who We Are:** For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted its energy, innovation, and scientific excellence solely to one business: Beauty. Our goal is to offer each and every person around the world the best of beauty in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility to satisfy all beauty needs and desires in their infinite diversity. At L'Oréal, our IT teams design and build solutions to ensure high performance for all our business sectors by imagining new ways of doing things, from designing websites to building algorithms and predicting new trends. They can be found leading teams towards a more connected and digitalized future in IT retail, e\-commerce, CRM, data, AI, cybersecurity, Cloud and E\-Marketing. You never stop learning at L'Oréal IT because things change at the speed of light! Come join our dynamic team! **What You Will Do:** L’Oréal is driving a massive Beauty Tech Transformation roadmap, designing and implementing next\-generation Data Products to accelerate business growth across Commerce and Supply Chain. As a Tech lead, you will design, build, and optimize scalable, secure, and reusable data products on Google Cloud Platform. You will combine strong hands\-on data engineering expertise with practical AI engineering experience to make governed enterprise data available for analytics, reporting, and natural\-language insight experiences. You will work closely with Data Architects, BI Developers, Data Scientists, Product teams, and business stakeholders to build reliable data foundations, standardize metric definitions, and enable trusted data access. This role requires strong technical ownership, a hands\-on delivery mindset, and the ability to mentor engineers while driving engineering standards. What You Will Do * Design, build, and maintain scalable, reusable, and cost\-efficient data pipelines and data products on Google Cloud Platform. * Develop resilient ETL/ELT pipelines supporting batch, near\-real\-time, and streaming data workloads across a modern Medallion architecture. * Build and optimize enterprise data models, including dimensional models and Star/Snowflake schemas. * Design and implement solutions using BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Workflows, and Terraform. * Optimize BigQuery performance, cost, reliability, and governance, including partitioning, clustering, query optimization, row\-level security, and column\-level security. * Build reusable APIs, services, and engineering utilities using Python, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Run, and CI/CD pipelines. * Partner with Data Architects, BI Developers, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions. * Support the development and optimization of governed semantic layers and standardized business metrics in Looker and other reporting environments. * Establish and promote best practices for data quality, testing, observability, documentation, metadata, lineage, deployment, and operational support. AI\-Enabled Data Engineering * Turn governed data into clear, natural\-language answers that enable teams to explore insights safely and efficiently. * Design, build, and optimize Skills, AI Agents, and conversational workflows that translate business queries into accurate and understandable insights. * Develop and operationalize AI\-enabled patterns such as Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Text\-to\-SQL, agentic workflows, and tool\-based AI orchestration. * Connect governed BigQuery datasets and the Looker semantic layer to AI\-enabled solutions, ensuring consistent metric definitions and trusted business logic. * Build robust tools, workflows, guardrails, monitoring, and evaluation frameworks to reduce hallucinations, improve answer quality, and help prevent unauthorized data exposure. * Partner with Data Science and AI teams to productionize AI and machine learning use cases by building reliable, governed, and scalable data foundations. Agile Delivery \& Technical Leadership * Translate broad business epics into clear, developer\-ready technical stories, tasks, and acceptance criteria. * Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, design reviews, and iterative delivery. * Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, engineering standards, code reviews, and delivery guidance. * Mentor Data Engineers and partner teams, supporting their technical growth and consistent adoption of engineering best practices. **What We Are Looking For:** **Required Qualifications:** * 7\+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, analytics engineering, or related technical roles. * 4\+ years of hands\-on GCP experience, designing and implementing production\-grade data so ience working in Agile delivery environments and translating business needs into actionable technical requirements. * Strong communication, collaboration, and technical problem\-solving skills. * Work authorization on a continuous, ongoing basis. Sponsorship is not offered for this role. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Strongly preferred: Experience working with Commerce data domains, including related data structures, metrics, reporting, and operational processes. * Experience with Power BI, DAX, Tableau, Looker Studio, or other enterprise BI and visualization platforms. * Experience with AI evaluation, prompt engineering, LLM observability, model safety controls, or responsible AI data\-governance patterns. * Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification. * Exposure to ReactJS or development of lightweight internal web applications. Applying engineering and scientific principles to the evaluation and solution of technical problems in a creative manner unique to each project. **About the Role:** * Responsible for design and implementation of system software, from concept phase through design transfer / product launch. * Act as a mentor for new or lower\-level software Engineers, as well as for * all the members of the development team. * Train junior software engineers. * Assist in the collection and documentation of user requirements, software development plans, software development time estimates, and resource efforts. * Integrate and support communication between different software development teams, projects, system engineering, Operations/Mfg., and the larger R\&D team. * Complete software design and development documents in compliance with Laborie QMS, ISO and other relevant standards. * Work with the Software Test Team to develop test methods/cases, unit testing and/or V\&V pass criteria and where viable assist with the development of automated test scripts. * Design modular software that is flexible and appropriate to a growing, multi\-year program. Anticipate the software needs of future products and extensions. * Manages assigned work items according to provided priorities. * Maintains high standards of software quality by closely following the department's Quality Plan. * Estimates progress and reports on status of assigned projects. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science and/or equivalent and 10\+ years of experience. * Solid track record of designing and developing production ready software, knowledge of software implementation best practices and deployment strategies * Practical programming experience developing software (at least one modern OO language) for a medical device (IEC 62304\). * Experience with unit\- and integration\-level testing and automated testing is recommended. * Experience in the following areas: * C\#/.NET/ SQL/Entity Framework/ADT/WPF/WCF/Unit Testing (NUnit, Moq) * Visual Studio /MS SQL Server * Automation Build, Testing and Deployment (TestStack. White and/or CodedUI) * TFS and related API * Strong knowledge of design patterns and OO concepts * Ability to quickly learn new technology and apply knowledge to solve technical and business problems. * Highly organized with well\-developed time\-management skills and processes for managing multiple priorities. * Strong analytical and quantitative skills. * A meticulous working style with the ability to focus on details while holding the end goal in clear sight. * Strong technical writing capability and excellent oral communication skills. * Motivated self\-starter with the ability to determine when to act and when to ask for support. * Ability to work both independently and within a team in a fast\-paced, changing environment. **Why Laborie:** Our Mission every day is to operate as a world\-class specialist medical company making and advancing technologies that preserve and restore human dignity. narratives, sequences of operation, points lists, alarm matrices, cause\-and\-effect diagrams, and controller requirements. * Define automation for central cooling plants, heat\-rejection systems, pumps, heat exchangers, CRAHs, CDUs, liquid\-cooling loops, valves, and associated equipment. * Design system behavior for startup, shutdown, maintenance, component failure, utility loss, and recovery. * Establish requirements for sensors, actuators, meters, control panels, PLCs, DDC controllers, gateways, and operator interfaces. * Define BMS integration, mechanical telemetry, trending, acceptance testing, commissioning, integrated systems testing, and cooling\-system bring\-up. * Troubleshoot control\-loop instability, sensor errors, communication failures, nuisance alarms, and sequence deficiencies. * Incorporate commissioning results and operating lessons into future designs and control standards. * Travel to project sites, manufacturers, and partner facilities as needed. **You** * Have experience designing or commissioning mechanical controls for data centers, mission\-critical facilities, central plants, or industrial environments. * Understand chilled\-water, condenser\-water, heat\-rejection, air\-cooling, and liquid\-cooling systems. * Can develop and review sequences of operation, P\&IDs, control diagrams, wiring diagrams, points lists, and functional test procedures. * Understand PLC, DDC, and BMS architectures and common protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, and OPC UA. * Have experience with instrumentation, sensor selection, control loops, alarms, interlocks, and equipment safeties. * Understand how mechanical systems should respond during equipment failures, power events, and changing thermal loads. * Can translate operational requirements into clear, testable control behavior. * Communicate effectively with engineers, programmers, vendors, commissioning teams, and facility operators. * Hold a bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, controls, or systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have** * Experience with hyperscale, colocation, HPC, or AI data centers. * Experience controlling factory acceptance testing, integrated systems testing, and live facility bring\-up. * Familiarity with ASHRAE, ISA, and data center controls standards. * Experience using trend data or analytics to diagnose and optimize mechanical\-system performance. **Salary Range Information** The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. **About Lambda** * Founded in 2012, with 500\+ employees, and growing fast * Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In\-Q\-Tel (IQT), KHK \& Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove * We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG * Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers * We offer generous cash \& equity compensation * Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents * Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles * 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees) * Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use **Equal Opportunity Employer** Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. development. * Participate in project work as appropriate to maintain practical design knowledge and provide hands\-on technical support. **What You'll Bring to Landform.** You are an experienced site design. * Active Professional Engineer (PE) license in Minnesota or the ability to obtain Minnesota licensure within an agreed timeframe. * Extensive technical knowledge of grading, stormwater management, drainage, utilities, site design, and construction documentation. * Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D and familiarity with efficient design and documentation workflows. * Experience reviewing engineering plans and identifying technical issues, coordination gaps, a ** * Lead planning projects, including project management, community engagement and design * Lead public meetings and other community engagement efforts * Advocate for planning processes within a multidisciplinary environment * Actively participate in marketing and business development for the studio * Lead preparation of ordinance updates, master plans and comprehensive plans * Provide planning support to other Studios and their development clients. * Prepare site investigation due diligence reports * Support other Planners with municipal clients * Review development applications on behalf of municipal clients, including preparation of staff reports * Prepare development applications and narratives for the other Studios * Prepare ordinance updates, master plans and comprehensive plans. * Provide planning support to other Studios and their private development clients. **Let's talk about your prioritizing a job well done, and the importance of environmental sustainability. **A few of our benefits include the following:** * Health * Dental * Vision * Life/Disability * Paid holidays * FTO * 401K employer contribution * Technology reimbursement * Professional registration renewal fees * Educational allowance * Supplemental life * Mental health care * Career Advancement * Profit\-sharing * Charitable gift matching * Fun and flexible hours (4 x 10\-hour day option) * Volunteer time * Free lunch or snacks * Employee Assistance * Job training * Tuition assistance **Plus, here are a few of birthday \& anniversary celebrations * Volunteering opportunities * Networking opportunities * Professional development * Socially responsible * Diversity Commitment * Pledge to thrive * Fair chance building ML systems in production. * Strong software engineering fundamentals and clean, maintainable, production\-grade code. * Experience building and scaling ML training and inference pipelines, jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Offboard Python Application
jobs.description: Latitude AI (lat.ai) is building the future of Ford's autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in\-house developed hands\-free ADAS platform will debut on the all\-new Ford Fathom in 2027\. When you join the Latitude team, you'll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – ***all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.*** As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif. **Meet the team:** The Virtual Test Ecosystem (VTE) team ensures that our simulation (fully synthetic) and resimulation (replay engine using vehicle logs) workflows run efficiently and reliably at large scale. We use a mix of open source and cloud provider services to implement a processing framework that's cloud\-agnostic as well as capable of running on\-prem. The results of these simulations is business\-critical for us \- they're used in order to allow autonomy developers and testers to do large\-scale safety and performance testing of changes prior to in\-vehicle testing. We interact with engineers throughout the onboard and offboard stack in order to ensure smooth end\-to\-end capabilities. **What you'll do:** * We run vehicle simulations at unprecedented scales in order to ensure we're releasing a safe product. You'll support this via improvements to our sim/resim cloud framework and applications that run on this framework. In terms of implementation, this involves a lot of Python coding, interacting with open source packages and various AWS/GCP services. In terms of analysis, we're constantly looking for bottlenecks that limit scalability or otherwise hinder performance. You'll put together benchmarking to identify these spots and associated dashboards to track and summarize the information. Then armed with that information, you'll implement solutions to increase efficiency. * It's not enough to have a framework that is functional \- it needs to be intuitive and easy to use. We take our best guesses at this, but things evolve over time based on user interaction \- both direct feedback as well as realizing how users are accidentally misusing or misinterpreting the results. VTE supports autonomy, systems, test, and a variety of other teams across the organization. Having an eye for how the system is being used, what users need, and a willingness to engage with these users on future improvements is critical. * We also can't build it all, so we want to make the framework well\-documented and as self\-serve as possible for others to extend it (while being there to answer questions). For example, when there's a new portion of the autonomy stack, we want that autonomy team to be able to update resim to add it in themselves so that they can iterate quickly. * In order to run logs through resim, we need to first know what logs are interesting. You'll contribute to the ecosystem of how we manage storing and searching for these logs efficiently, including how we automate indexing the interesting actors and interactions in a scene and how we determine our dataset coverage. * Once we've run resim, we want to do something with the updated logs. Frequently this involves metrics to analyze the AV's performance; these metrics could range from low\-level performance of a particular detector in the stack to if the AV is meeting high\-level business objectives. You'll both work on the sim/resim cloud framework implementation to make this easy for all developers to add in their metrics and support the metrics implementation themselves as needs arise. **What you'll need to succeed:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field and 4\+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2\+ years of relevant experience, or PhD) * Expertise in writing Python code that's efficient, well\-documented, and well\-tested * 2\+ years' experience writing scalable applications that execute in a cloud or HPC environment * 2\+ years' experience writing software that interacts with AWS and/or GCP services * Familiarity with NumPy and scientific programming * Willingness and desire to learn how onboard and offboard components interact with each other and propose solutions to improve how developers and testers work with both systems **Nice to have (optional):** * C\+\+ development experience * Experience with Kubernetes **What we offer you:** * Competitive compensation packages * High\-quality individual and family medical, dental, and vision insurance * Health savings account with available employer match * Employer\-matched 401(k) retirement plan with immediate vesting * Employer\-paid group term life insurance and the option to elect voluntary life insurance * Paid parental leave and Adoption/Surrogacy support program * Paid medical leave * Unlimited vacation and 15 paid holidays * Daily lunches, snacks, and beverages available in all office locations * Pre\-tax spending accounts for healthcare and dependent care expenses * Pre\-tax commuter benefits * Monthly wellness stipend * Backup child and elder care program * Professional development reimbursement * Employee assistance program * Discounted programs that include legal services, identity theft protection, pet insurance, and more * Company and team bonding outlets: employee resource groups, quarterly team activity stipend, and wellness initiatives Learn more about Latitude's team, mission and career opportunities at lat.ai! The expected base salary range for this full\-time position in California is $150,320 \- $225,480 USD. Actual starting pay will be based on job\-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Latitude employees are also eligible to participate in Latitude's annual bonus programs, equity compensation, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements. Candidates for positions with Latitude AI must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is available for this position. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status.

jobs.description: #### **About the Job:** AI\-powered workflows are only as good as the customer data underneath them. LaunchDarkly helps engineering teams ship software faster and more safely through feature management, experimentation, and AI delivery tooling. As our GTM Data Governance Manager (MDM), you will set the rules that make our core customer data (accounts, contacts, subscriptions, and users) accurate, consistent, and trusted across Salesforce, our billing and finance systems, marketing automation, product usage data, and the data warehouse. This is an individual contributor role with real ownership of the data model and its standards. You will partner with Data Engineering, GTM Systems, Finance Systems, Legal, and Security to put those standards into production. Your work is the foundation for reliable reporting, accurate territory and segmentation, clean pipeline attribution, and the AI workflows that depend on high\-quality data. #### **Responsibilities:** * Own the MDM roadmap and operating model for the account, contact, and organization hierarchy domains. * Define golden record rules: matching, merging, survivorship, and parent/child hierarchies across CRM, billing, product, and support systems. * Set data governance standards, including ownership, stewardship roles, definitions, and quality SLAs, in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success. Run the processes for onboarding new data sources, handling change requests, and managing lifecycle events such as mergers, acquisitions, and customer reorganizations. * Design and monitor data quality rules, scorecards, and dashboards covering completeness, accuracy, duplication, and timeliness. Drive remediation and report data health, risks, and progress to leadership with clear metrics and business impact. * Specify integration patterns and acceptance criteria across Salesforce, the data warehouse, and enrichment providers, and work with Data Engineering and GTM Systems to build them. Recommend build vs. buy for MDM, identity resolution, enrichment, and data quality tooling. * Provide trusted, well\-documented data products for analytics and AI use cases. Act as the data owner with Legal and Security on PII handling, GDPR and CCPA requirements, retention, and access controls. * **Who You'll Work With:** Data Engineering and GTM Systems build pipelines and Salesforce configuration. Legal and Security own privacy and security decisions, and you inform them as the data owner. You own the rules, standards, and acceptance criteria that tell everyone else what "correct" looks like. #### **Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of experience in data management, data governance, data engineering, or analytics, including 2\+ years leading MDM or data quality programs. * Hands\-on experience designing match, merge, and survivorship rules and golden record or hierarchy models, with results you can describe. * Experience with Salesforce data models and CRM data quality at scale. * Experience building and operating a data governance framework: policies, stewardship models, and SLAs. * Ability to translate business needs into data requirements and explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders. * A track record of delivering cross\-functional programs without direct authority. * **Nice to Have** + Experience at a B2B SaaS company with a product\-led or hybrid sales motion, including mapping product users and workspaces to CRM accounts. + Familiarity with enrichment and firmographic data, entity matching approaches, and ML\-assisted or LLM\-assisted matching and cleansing. + Working knowledge of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and security frameworks such as SOC 2\. **Pay:** *Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones\* for Level 4:* * Zone 1: *San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle* \- *$152,900* *\- $210,210*\*\* * Zone 2: *Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago \- $137,600* *\- $189,200*\*\* * Zone 3: *All other US locations \- $129,900* *\- $178,640\**\* *LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.* * *Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.* *\*\*Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.* #### **About LaunchDarkly:** Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. You'll also have the opportunity to strengthen your software engineering skills by working alongside experienced engineers in a collaborative, learning\-focused environment. **How You'll Make an Impact** ----------------------------- * **Support and improve endpoint platforms:** Maintain and troubleshoot endpoint management solutions, including Microsoft Intune, Iru, and ManageEngine Endpoint Central, while supporting Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices. * **Automate endpoint management:** Develop and maintain PowerShell and Python scripts and API integrations to reduce manual work, improve consistency, and streamline endpoint operations. * **Build and maintain deployment pipelines:** Support CI/CD pipelines that validate, package, test, and deploy applications, scripts, and policies through test and pilot rings into production. * **Strengthen endpoint security and compliance:** Implement and maintain security baselines, encryption, endpoint detection and response (EDR), Conditional Access, and device compliance policies in partnership with Information Security. * **Improve reliability and visibility:** Monitor endpoint health, patching, and compliance metrics; maintain dashboards and alerts; troubleshoot issues; and support incident response and root cause analysis. * **Apply engineering best practices:** Maintain endpoint configurations as code in Git, participate in code reviews, validate changes before broad deployment, and create documentation that supports reliable operations. **Who You'll Work With** ------------------------ You'll join the Endpoint Engineering team within Digital Workplace, working alongside senior engineers who will help you develop your technical and software engineering skills. You'll collaborate with Information Security, Identity \& Access Management, Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Service Desk, and Productivity Apps teams to deliver secure, reliable endpoint experiences across LendingTree. The team emphasizes collaboration, code review, automation, documentation, and repeatable engineering practices. You'll have opportunities to contribute to larger endpoint initiatives while taking ownership of assigned work and learning from experienced teammates. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 4\+ years of related experience supporting enterprise endpoints across Windows and macOS. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Intune and a macOS mobile device management (MDM) platform, such as Iru, Jamf, or a similar solution. * Experience writing automation scripts, with PowerShell required and some experience in Python or another general\-purpose programming language. * Working knowledge of Git, including commits, branches, and pull request workflows. * Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and pipelines, such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. * Experience working with REST APIs, ideally Microsoft Graph, and an understanding of REST/JSON integrations. * Experience packaging and deploying applications to managed endpoints. * Understanding of Entra ID, Conditional Access, device compliance, endpoint security baselines, disk encryption, and EDR solutions such as Microsoft Defender. * Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows 10/11 and macOS, with familiarity in iOS and Android device management. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills, particularly across endpoint, enrollment, and policy issues. * Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **What Will Help You Thrive** ----------------------------- * **Product mindset:** You think about the endpoint as a product and the employee as the customer, focusing on reliability, security, and user experience. * **Automation mindset:** You look for opportunities to eliminate repetitive tasks, improve consistency, and make endpoint operations more efficient. * **Eng  identified, monitored, and addressed proactively. * Incidents are investigated thoroughly, root causes are documented, and improvements are implemented to prevent recurring issues. * Technical documentation and runbooks remain accurate and useful for engineers and end users. * You become a trusted contributor to the Endpoint Engineering team, delivering assigned work while continuing to grow your engineering skills. **Life at LendingTree** ----------------------- We're a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that's curious, creative, and always ready to roll up our sleeves and get things done. You'll work alongside smart, driven people who care about doing great work — and about helping each other succeed. We believe the best ideas come from different perspectives, and we're committed to creating a workplace where people feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to make an impact. You'll have the trust and flexibility to do your best work, the opportunity to take ownership and try new things, and teammates who genuinely enjoy working together. And while we work hard, we don't take ourselves too seriously. We celebrate wins, recognize great work (our GSD — Get Stuff Done — Award is a fan favorite), and make time to have some fun along the way. Come grow with us, make an impact, and help us build what's next. **What We Offer** ----------------- We want you to feel supported at work and beyond. Our benefits and programs are designed to help you stay healthy, recharge, plan for the future, and bring your best to whatever matters most to you. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) matching * Generous time off * Wellness programs and resources * Annual performance bonus eligibility **About LendingTree** --------------------- As the nation's leading online financial marketplace, LendingTree lets consumers shop and compare offers for personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, insurance, and more. We help people find the best fit so they can make the right financial decision at the right time. Our founder, Doug Lebda, started LendingTree in 1996 after his own frustrating house\-hunting experience. What began as a simple idea to make loan shopping easier has grown into a platform that empowers millions of people to make smarter financial decisions every day. **The Details** --------------- **Base Pay:** 90k\-100k plus annual performance bonus The base pay offered may vary based on internal factors, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. **Incentive Compensation:** Eligibility and details to be confirmed for this position. **Work Location:** Seattle, WA. This position requires attendance at our office three days a week. **Work Authorization:** This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must not require employer sponsorship now or in the future to begin or continue employment. **Everyone Belongs Here** ------------------------- LendingTree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion (or creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an application, please email us at humanresources@lendingtree.com. This job post is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all essential responsibilities, skills, tasks, or requirements associated with this position.
