jobs.title: Data Engineer II
jobs.description: Overview: **WE ARE HIRING!** **Data Engineer II** **About Us** At Lewis Energy Group, we are a vertically integrated exploration and production (E\&P) company and a leading natural gas producer in South Texas and across the nation. With operations in South Texas and Mexico, we take pride in our long\-standing commitment to excellence, innovation, and community engagement. What sets us apart is our family\-oriented work culture, built over decades of dedication and teamwork. This culture drives the passion we bring to our work and the positive impact we strive to make in the communities where we operate. The **Data Engineer II** will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the organization’s data platform on Microsoft Fabric. This includes developing data pipelines using Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, and PySpark notebooks; writing and optimizing T\-SQL. Assists with the migration of on\-premises SQL Server databases and ETL/ELT processes to Fabric. Build semantic models that support Power BI reporting, ensuring data quality and governance, and managing changes through source control and deployment pipelines. Works closely with business users and stakeholders, communicating technical information in a clear and accessible way. Responsibilities: **Data Pipeline Development*** Design, build, and maintain data pielines in Microsoft Fabric using Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and notebooks to move data from source systems into Lakehouses and Warehouses. * Develop data transformation and processing logic in Python and Pyspark within Fabric notebooks, including working with Delta tables and handling large or complex datasets. * Develop and optimize T\-SQL code, including stored procedures, views, and transformation logic, to support data processing and reporting needs. * Apply data modeling best practice, such as medallion architecture and star schema design, to organize data in OneLake for performance and ease of use. * Monitor pipeline runs, troubleshoot failures, and put alerting and error handling in place so that data is delivered on time and accurately. **SQL Server to Fabric Migration*** Assess existing on\-premises SQL Server databases, SSIS packages, and scheduled jobs to plan their migration to Microsoft Fabric. * Rebuild or refactor legacy ETL processes as Fabric\-native pipelines and PySpark notebooks, improving performance and maintainability. * Coordinate with the team and stakeholders on migration timelines to minimize disruption to reporting and operations. **Semantic Model Support*** Build and maintain semantic models that serve as the foundation for PowerBI reports, including relationships, measures, ontology, and Direct Lake or Import configurations. * Partner with report developers and business users to understand reporting requirements and turn them into well\-structured datasets. * Tune data models and queries to improve report performance and refresh reliability. * Communicate technical concepts, data limitations, and project status clearly to non\-technical stakeholders, helping them understand and make effective use of available data. **Data Quality, Governance, and Operations*** Implement data quality checks and validation rules to catch issues before they reach end users. * Manage workspace organization, access permissions, and security settings in Fabric in line with company data governance standards. * Use source control (Azure DevOps/Git) and deployment pipelines to manage changes across development, test, and production environments. * Create and maintain clear documentation of data sources, pipelines, models, dictionaries, and business logic. Qualifications: **Education and Experience** ============================ Bachelor's degree from a four\-year college or university; minimum two years of related experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **Work Location:** Onsite \- Candidates must be able to work full\-time from our San Antonio office.**Required Technical Skills** ============================= * Demonstrated ability to design relational and dimensional data models, including fact and dimension tables, keys, relationships, referential integrity, and historical changes. * Strong T\-SQL skills for complex joins, transformations, query tuning, and troubleshooting. * Hands\-on experience building and supporting integrations across databases, APIs, or file\-based sources, including scheduling, incremental processing, and recovery. * Ability to validate data completeness and accuracy, reconcile source and target results, and investigate duplicates and broken relationships. * Experience using Python or a comparable scripting language for data processing or automation, and version control for maintainable development. * Ability to translate business requirements into documented models and explain technical decisions clearly; willingness to learn unfamiliar platforms. **Preferred Experience (Preferred)** ==================================== * Power BI semantic models, Power Query, DAX, or comparable business intelligence tools. * Microsoft SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, or comparable database and integration technologies. * Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL, Synapse Analytics, Databricks, or Azure DevOps. * Oil and gas production data, SCADA, telemetry, time\-series data, IoT or Streaming data. **Your benefits** Lewis Energy Group appreciates the hard work and dedication you bring to our team every day. To do our part, we are committed to keeping your benefits affordable and beneficial for you and your eligible family members. Lewis Energy Group strives to provide benefits that meet your needs, are easy to understand and use, and provide excellent value for affordable costs. * Insurance: Medical/Dental/Vision/ Basic Life and AD\&D/and other benefit options to meet your personal needs * Retirement: 401K with immediate matching contribution * Annual Discretionary Bonus * Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Free, confidential support for you and your dependents * Wellness \& Company Events throughout the year Equal Opportunity Employer Lewis Energy Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

jobs.title: Senior / Principal Materials Scientist, AI Safety
jobs.description: **Your Impact at LILA** We're building a talent\-dense, high\-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety\-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer\-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems. We are seeking a materials scientist to map risk across the material sciences domain: you will connect deep materials expertise with dual\-use risk assessment to help safeguard increasingly capable scientific AI. You will investigate how advances in materials research could change harmful capabilities, including established and emerging threats. **What You'll Be Building** * Map misuse risks by connecting material properties, processing and functional performance (across a range of materials domains) to harmful applications, including emerging or overlooked uses of scientific advances. * Assess how physical feasibility, processing complexity, manufacturing requirements and actors' resources affect the plausibility and likelihood of misuse, including which constraints AI could change. * Distinguish established capabilities, plausible future developments and weakly supported hypotheses, revising assessments as evidence changes across models, tools and automated laboratories. * Identify gaps in expertise, commission targeted scientific input with the expert\-program team, and integrate specialist findings into a coherent assessment of the risk landscape. * Translate dual\-use judgments into policy boundaries, evaluation priorities and mitigation requirements that support beneficial materials research. * Work with threat modelers, evaluation researchers and engineering and experimental colleagues to assess capabilities, interpret red\-team findings and evaluate safeguards. **What You'll Need to Succeed** * Deep expertise (a PhD, or comparable experience) in materials science or a closely related discipline, with a strong grasp of the relationships between structure, properties, processing and applications. Relevant backgrounds include particulate, porous and formulated systems; and structural and functional materials, including thin films, electrochemical materials and metals and alloys. * Substantive experience assessing dual\-use risks in a relevant area, with a strong understanding of harmful applications such as nuclear proliferation, radiological misuse, weapons\-related capabilities (e.g. energetics) or other consequential materials risks. * Sound judgment about physical possibility, practical feasibility and uncertainty, together with the ability to investigate risks beyond your immediate specialism. * The ability to identify appropriate specialists, evaluate technical evidence and synthesize contributions across scientific and security disciplines. * Clear scientific communication, independent research judgment and an ability to collaborate across science, engineering and policy. **Bonus Points For** * Prior experience applying materials or related physical\-science expertise to AI safety through one or more of: threat analysis, evaluations or red teaming, or mitigation design. * Experience commissioning specialist research or assessing emerging technologies across disciplinary boundaries. * Experience with computational materials science, advanced manufacturing or automated synthesis and characterization. **About LILA** Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard\-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves. LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai. Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply. **We're All In** Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy. **A Note to Agencies** *Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science's internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.*

jobs.title: Data & AI Governance Manager
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** Loansure serves the US mortgage industry. We license property and consumer data, receive loan outcome data from lender clients, and use both to build audiences, scoring models, and AI agents that help lenders fund more loans. Data is the product, so how it is governed directly affects what we can build and sell. The Data \& AI Governance Manager makes that data safe to use and easy to trust: who can reach it, what we are permitted to do with it, whether it is documented, and how a change in one place affects everything downstream. A working foundation is in place in Snowflake. This role turns it into a program that holds up under client security reviews, emerging AI regulation, and third\-party due diligence. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the CTO, working across engineering, data, product, and performance marketing. **Position Responsibilities:** Access and the governed read path * Design Snowflake role\-based access control for people, applications, and AI agents, and manage roles, grants, and policies as code with peer review rather than manual changes. * Maintain semantic views as the single governed read path for analytics and AI; certify semantic models and business definitions written by the data and BI teams. * Run quarterly access reviews with named approvers and retained evidence, and enforce separation of duties between who builds, who approves, and who deploys. * Detect and close access gaps created by ingestion and tooling, such as grants lost when tables are recreated. Data rights, inventory, and classification * Build and maintain the data inventory and data rights register: for each source, its origin, contract, permitted and prohibited uses, sensitivity, retention, and approved consumers. * Enforce purpose limits in the data architecture, such as keeping client\-supplied data separate from licensed data where the terms of use differ. * Author and implement data classification, retention, and AI data use standards using Snowflake tags, masking policies, and row access policies. AI and agent data governance * Run the production review gate for AI agents, MCP servers, and skills: what data each may reach, through which role, and with what evidence. * Maintain the data side of the AI system inventory: which systems use which data, and whether they influence decisions about consumers. * Trace training data and model features back to permitted sources, in partnership with the data science team. * Set the data standard that citizen\-built apps and dashboards must meet, tiered by the impact of their output, and verify apps against it. Metadata and operating model * Maintain the business glossary, data dictionary, and lineage in a form both people and AI tools can use. * Analyze source and schema changes before they reach dashboards, models, or agents, and document the impact for affected teams. * Define and report data governance KPIs. * Document every control as a runbook another engineer can operate, so no control depends on one person. * Maintain a governance evidence package that answers client security reviews and due diligence requests. What Success Looks Like: * 30 days: current access model mapped from Snowflake roles, grants, and access history; existing controls, open governance tickets, and past decisions documented; priority data domains and their stakeholders identified. * 60 days: runbooks written for every existing control; access\-as\-code tooling selected and the approach approved; agent review gate defined and agreed with the agent team; data inventory started for the priority domains. * 90 days: one schema or role family managed as code with peer review; agent review gate applied to new agent and MCP releases; data inventory and rights register drafted for the priority domains, with open items noted where contracts or counsel input are pending; first quarterly access review completed. * 12 months: all roles and grants managed as code; sensitive columns classified and enforced with tags and masking; quarterly access reviews running with evidence; glossary and lineage covering the semantic layer; AI system inventory current. **Qualifications:** * 6\+ years in data engineering, data architecture, or analytics engineering, including 3\+ years implementing data governance controls hands\-on. * Expert SQL and Snowflake: role hierarchy design, secure and semantic views, object tagging, masking and row access policies, access history, and object dependencies. * Experience managing access as code (Terraform, schemachange, or similar) with CI\-based review. * Experience governing data used by AI or ML systems, such as semantic layers, text\-to\-SQL, LLM agents, MCP, or feature pipelines. * Python for automation and analysis. * Has built a governance program from an early stage at a small or mid\-size company, without a dedicated platform or team. * Clear writer who can turn policy into enforceable controls and explain them to non\-technical data owners. * Plus: regulated consumer or financial data (GLBA, FCRA, state privacy laws) and third\-party data licensing terms. * Plus: Snowflake Cortex Analyst, or moving semantic definitions from a BI tool into a warehouse\-native semantic layer. * Plus: NIST AI Risk Management Framework or DAMA\-DMBOK; mortgage or lending industry experience.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Lunon is an AI\-native consulting firm in New York City, backed by General Catalyst. Most companies don't need another deck about AI. They need an engineer who can walk in, understand the operation, and ship. That's what we do: we embed engineers inside the business and stay until the software runs without us. Our open\-source research system ranks first on DeepResearch Bench. The team is young and moves fast. Everyone here has a wide skill set, works with the newest tools as they land, and owns what they ship end to end. Nobody hands you a ticket. You own an engagement end to end: understand the business, decide what gets built, build the hard parts, and lead a Forward Deployed Engineer who builds with you. First up: helping an ERP company make its product AI\-native. * *Fully remote, US\-based. Lunon is headquartered in New York City.* **What you'll do** ------------------ * Sit with the client's team, find where AI moves their numbers, and decide what ships first. * Design and build the systems: LLM workflows with human review, extraction from messy business data, and agents that act on real records. * Run it in production. Reliability is yours. * Say no to work that won't pay back. * Hand it off so the client's team can run it on their own. **What you'll need** -------------------- Experience matters here. We judge it by what you've shipped and kept running, not by a number of years. * You've owned a production system end to end, including when it broke. * You've shipped LLM features that real users depend on. * You've worked at a company with a high engineering bar and know what good looks like. * You've changed what you built because a stakeholder pushed back. * You can explain a technical decision to a CEO and to a junior engineer in the same meeting. * You use AI coding tools every day and judge the result by the system and its output, not the language. **Nice to have** ---------------- Apply even if none of these are true. * You've built on or integrated with an ERP, CRM, or accounting system. * You've shipped extraction or search over messy business documents. * You've done consulting, agency, or forward\-deployed work and know how to be useful in someone else's building on day two. **How we hire** --------------- * A 30\-minute conversation with the team about what you've shipped and what we're building. * A technical deep\-dive on one system you owned, from the business problem to production. * A working session on a real client problem with the team. * References, then an offer. We aim to finish in two weeks. **Beware of recruitment fraud.** All official correspondence comes from a lunon.ai email address. We will never ask you to share bank account information, cash a check, or purchase equipment as part of the hiring process. Compensation Range: $140K \- $160K

The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e\-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy. **About the role** ------------------ The Senior Deployment Engineer owns a site and is the definitive expert on its state — from as\-built conditions to open risks. From construction through commissioning to sustainment handoff, you are the technical authority on the ground — executing within the system the Deployment Lead defines, with full autonomous authority over site\-level decisions — gate advancement, sequencing tradeoffs, and contractor direction — without requiring sign\-off. You will work closely with trade contractors, Deployment Engineers on your site team, and the Deployment Lead. The Deployment Lead provides day\-to\-day field direction and is your primary escalation point for cross\-site issues and decisions that exceed site authority. You will interface directly with customer facilities and operations teams at key milestones — commissioning readiness reviews, SAT, and sustainment handoff — coordinated through various other teams including, but not limited to Project Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software, Sustainment, and Customer Success. In practice, that means diagnosing unexpected site constraints — power, network, building conditions — and re\-sequencing commissioning without losing the week. Isolating intermittent network instability across RF layout, DHCP planning, switching, and compute when the system won't stabilize. Catching SAT readiness risk late and recovering the plan before it becomes a customer miss. The common thread: ambiguous problems, real stakes, no one telling you the answer, and a permanent fix required. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- * Own end\-to\-end site delivery from construction through commissioning to sustainment handoff * Hold and enforce the commissioning readiness gate — reject advancement until evidence\-based acceptance criteria are met * Surface every deployment's learnings — escapes, as\-built deltas, playbook gaps — with enough context for the Deployment Lead to systematize them into program\-wide improvements * Coach Deployment Engineers on rigorous gate execution and the standard of evidence required to advance commissioning milestones; set the quality bar for deployment artifacts across the site team * Manage sequencing and scheduling across trade contractors to keep site progress on track * For decisions that exceed site authority, escalate to the Deployment Lead with a complete decision packet: evidence, root\-cause hypothesis, proposed options, and a clear decision ask **Ideal Candidates** * 5\+ years of industry experience * Proven cross\-functional leadership: you've driven delivery across trades, internal engineering, and customer teams without formal authority over them * Experience directing technicians or junior engineers on a site team — setting task direction, reviewing work quality, and closing gaps through coaching * Ability to read electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, wiring diagrams, and construction blueprints * Experience building and enforcing gate\-driven QC and objective evidence capture * Strong trade contractor management: scheduling, sequencing, and holding quality across multiple trades on a live site * Comfortable executing independently in high\-ambiguity environments and adapting on the fly **Nice to have:** * Network and IT infrastructure bring\-up: DHCP/IP planning, Wi\-Fi/AP layout, onsite compute preflight * Experience in industrial, robotics, or automation environments * Safety systems commissioning: machine guarding, E\-stop circuits, safety controller bring\-up; comfort in partially energized environments * Demonstrated ability to scale field processes and train others into them * Familiarity with industrial controls and electrical panel\-building * Familiarity with forklift certification and comfort around heavy equipment **A Final Note:** ----------------- If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. jobs.title: Tech Manager, Data Engineering - AI and Support
jobs.description: **Be part of an amazing story** Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work. **Job Overview** The Tech Manager, Data Engineering leads the development, governance, and delivery of scalable data products that advance Macy’s enterprise technology and business strategies. The Tech Manager ensures teams build high\-quality, reliable data pipelines and solutions that meet the evolving needs of analytics, data science, and business operations. This role establishes engineering best practices, fosters cross\-functional collaboration, and drives outcomes that enhance data accessibility, integrity, and innovation across the organization. **What You Will Do** * Hire, mentor, and coach engineering talent to build strong, high\-performing teams. * Guide teams to align architectures, standards, and technical strategies with enterprise frameworks. * Cultivate a collaborative, product\-focused engineering culture grounded in Agile practices. * Define priorities, strategies, and delivery approaches across assigned data engineering portfolios or domains. * Oversee the execution of data pipelines, integrations, ETL processes, and data quality frameworks. * Ensure compliance with data governance standards and enterprise architecture guidelines. * Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities. * In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned. **Skills You Will Need** **Programming \& Data Tools:** Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and modern ETL/ELT frameworks to build scalable and reliable data solutions. **Technical** **Leadership**: Ability to guide engineering direction, elevate team performance, and foster cross\-functional alignment. **Stakeholder** **Management**: Skilled at communicating complex technical concepts clearly to business partners and senior leadership. **Strategic** **Thinking**: Ability to prioritize and execute initiatives that advance enterprise technology and business objectives. **Agile** **Delivery**: Experienced in applying Agile methodologies to drive iterative development, transparency, and predictable outcomes. **Innovation** **\&** **Continuous** **Learning**: Demonstrates curiosity for emerging technologies and inspires teams to adopt innovative approaches. **Data** **Governance** \& **Compliance**: Ensures adherence to data governance standards and enterprise architecture guidelines while maintaining high\-quality pipelines. **Collaboration** **\&** **Culture**: Cultivates a collaborative, product\-focused engineering culture that supports high\-performing teams. **Who You Are** * Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. * 8\+ years of experience building comprehensive cloud\-based data pipelines in a large organization. 2\+ years leading cross\-functional projects. * This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities. * Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs. **What We Can Offer You** Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! Prioritize your well\-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. jobs.title: GenAI Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description: Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled GenAI Fullstack Engineer to join our innovative and dynamic team. This position requires onsite 5 days/week **GenAI Fullstack Engineer \| About the Role** As a GenAI Fullstack Engineer, you will design and build scalable enterprise applications that combine robust Java\-based backend engineering with modern Generative AI capabilities. You will work across Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Python, FastAPI, LLMs, RAG, and Vector Databases to develop production\-ready AI services and integrate them with enterprise applications. The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer who has expanded into hands\-on GenAI engineering and can develop secure, scalable solutions spanning traditional backend services, AI orchestration, enterprise knowledge retrieval, and LLM\-powered applications. **GenAI Fullstack Engineer \| Day\-to\-Day** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and REST APIs using Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Spring Security, and Spring Data/JPA. * Build and integrate production\-grade GenAI and LLM applications, connecting AI services with existing Java/Spring Boot enterprise applications and business systems. * Design and implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, semantic search, context retrieval, reranking, and response generation. * Develop AI services and orchestration components using Python and FastAPI, leveraging frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or Hugging Face to support reusable enterprise AI capabilities. * Implement and optimize Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, FAISS, or ChromaDB to enable enterprise knowledge retrieval and semantic search. * Integrate LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Claude, Gemini, or Llama, applying prompt engineering, response evaluation, guardrails, and optimization techniques to improve solution accuracy and reliability. * Build secure and observable AI/backend services by implementing authentication, authorization, exception handling, logging, monitoring, API security, and production\-grade engineering standards. * Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and CI/CD pipelines, collaborating with architects, data engineers, developers, and business teams to deliver reliable and scalable GenAI solutions. **GenAI Fullstack Engineer \| Skills \& Experience** * Strong software engineering 3\+ years experience with Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and REST APIs, including hands\-on experience designing scalable and distributed enterprise backend applications. * Hands\-on experience developing production GenAI/LLM applications, including LLM integration, prompt engineering, response evaluation, and enterprise AI use cases. * Strong production experience with RAG architectures, including embeddings, document ingestion, chunking, semantic retrieval, reranking, context construction, and RAG quality optimization. * Strong working knowledge of Python and FastAPI, with experience building AI/ML services and integrating Python\-based AI components with Java/Spring Boot applications. * Hands\-on experience with Vector Databases and GenAI frameworks, such as Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, FAISS, ChromaDB, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or Hugging Face. * Experience with cloud and modern deployment practices, including AWS, Azure, or GCP, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, observability, and production deployment of AI services. * Additional exposure to Agentic AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI guardrails, LLMOps, Kubernetes, knowledge graphs, multimodal AI, and event\-driven microservices is advantageous.

jobs.title: Sr. Cost Control Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mariana Minerals** ========================== Mariana Minerals is a software\-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making. **The role** We are hiring a Cost Control Engineer to own the cost baseline, the forecast, and change control on Mariana's capital projects. You will build the cost breakdown structure, convert the sanctioned estimate into a control budget, track commitments and actuals, and produce the forecast at completion that the business plans against. The role sits between engineering, procurement, construction, and finance — the path where a commitment becomes an accrual becomes an invoice becomes a capitalized asset — and your job is to make sure the number is the same in all four places. Cost control here is not a monthly report assembled by hand. The reporting is expected to come out of the system and building that pipeline is as much the job as running it. **What you'll do** * Set the baseline. Build the WBS and cost breakdown structure with the planner and estimator, convert the sanctioned estimate into a control budget, and lock it * Track commitments and actuals. Purchase orders, subcontracts, change orders, and field costs, reconciled to the ERP every month with no unexplained variance * Forecast. Maintain estimate to complete and estimate at completion by control account, with the basis for each forecast written down rather than carried in your head * Measure earned value. Set rules of credit with the planner, measure physical progress, and report cost and schedule performance at a level where someone can act on it * Run the trend and change process. Identify potential changes early, quantify them, route them for approval, and keep the approved budget log clean * Manage contingency drawdown. Track contingency and management reserve against the risk register and report what is left honestly * Produce cash flow. Maintain the project cash flow and funding curve for finance and treasury * Verify payments. Review contractor invoices and progress claims against measured progress and contract terms * Report. Create, issue and present the project cost report and the dashboards leadership actually opens * Automate the pipeline. Cost data should move from the ERP, procurement, and the schedule into the report/dashboard without re\-keying. Build the connections, the reconciliations, and the exception checks that catch a bad number before a person does **Desired qualifications** * Education. BS in engineering, construction management, finance, or a related field * Experience. 5–12 years of project cost control on capital projects in mining, minerals, refining, chemicals, power, or heavy civil. Senior candidates will have owned cost on a project above $100M total installed cost * Earned value in practice. You have applied earned value management on a live project, not only in training, and can describe where it broke down * Systems. Hands\-on with a project cost management system such as EcoSys, InEight, Prism, or Procore, and with an ERP such as SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite * Data fluency. Advanced Excel, plus SQL, Power BI, or Python at a level where you build your own reporting instead of requesting it * Change discipline. You have run a trend and change management process end to end and can say what you would do differently * Accounting interface. Comfortable with commitments versus actuals, accruals, capitalization, and funding authorization mechanics * Certification. AACE Certified Cost Professional or Certified Cost Technician, or PMI credentials, are a plus **Our culture is built on four principles:** -------------------------------------------- **Everyone Gets Home Safe.** We never put speed or cost ahead of people. **Extreme Ownership.** We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions. **Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate.** We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale. **Share Your Legos.** We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions. **Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!** Compensation Range: $140K \- $180K

jobs.title: Field Engineer - Data Center
jobs.description: Overview: **Company Summary****MasTec Utility Services** delivers critical infrastructure construction and engineering services for power delivery, gas, and water customers, specializing in overhead and underground electric distribution for power delivery systems, gas distribution construction for gas systems, and turnkey solutions for a variety of water, sewer, and civil infrastructure projects. Backed by the strength of decades of experience, unrivaled industry skills, and a deep commitment to core values, MUS delivers safe, innovative, and environmentally responsible services that provide extraordinary value to clients. MasTec Utility Services is a purpose\-driven company. Our core values guide our strategy, performance, and culture. We believe in maintaining an environment where team members can make an impact, grow, and thrive. A place where they find meaning and purpose in doing the important work of ensuring communities have the vital energy, light, and communications to prosper. Our culture is inclusive and welcoming. Our teams are empowered with abundant training, tools, and opportunities to follow their curiosity and ambitions. Everyone has an equal chance to advance. Everyone is supported, respected, and challenged to be their best. We’re always looking for talented and dedicated people to join us and love where they work. MasTec Utility Services is a proud subsidiary of MasTec (NYSE: MTZ), a Fortune 500 Company ranked by Energy News\-Record as one of the leading contractors in the country. MUS is part of the MasTec Power Delivery segment. We are certified as a minority\-controlled company by the National Minority Suppliers Development Council (NMSDC). Our rich diversity of people and ideas makes us a stronger, more innovative organization. **Job Summary** The Field Engineer is part of the project management team responsible for overseeing and managing construction projects, ensuring they are completed safely, efficiently, and according to plans and specifications. This involves a range of tasks, including project planning, resource management, quality control, and communication with stakeholders. Site Engineers work on the project site(s) they are supporting. **\*\*\* MUST be technology saavy i.e. computer, tablet, etc. \*\*\*** Responsibilities: * **Planning and Preparation:** * Reviewing project plans and specifications: analyze drawings, specifications and other technical documents to understand the project requirements and identify potential issues. * Conducting site surveys and assessments: evaluate the site's conditions, identify potential hazards, and ensure the site is suitable for construction. * Preparing site reports and documentation: maintain accurate records of site activities, progress, and encountered issues. * **On\-site Management and Supervision:** * Overseeing construction activities: provide oversight to subcontractors and workers to ensure compliance with project plans, specifications and adherence to safety regulations. * Project schedules and budgets: aid in monitoring timelines and costs as phases of construction proceed. * Managing resources: monitor the delivery and use of materials and equipment ensuring efficient resource allocation. Work with materials management team to organize received materials. * Ensuring quality control: inspect work in progress to ensure it meets the required standards and specifications. Assure that QA/QC checklists and reports are completed, accurate and delivered to appropriate stakeholders. Assure collection of as\-builts drawing redlines and construction progress photography. * Troubleshooting and problem\-solving: front line resource to address technical difficulties, design changes, or other issues that arise during construction. Liaison between construction and engineering when for issues that must be elevated to offsite resources. * **Communication and Coordination:** * Communicating with project stakeholders: liaise with clients, architects, engineers, contractors, and other team members to keep everyone informed of project progress and address any concerns. * Collaborating with other professionals: work closely with other engineers, designers, and specialists to ensure the project is executed effectively. Communicate arising field concerns back to technical staff that may not elevate to a problem, or other issue. * Preparing reports and presentations: communicate project status, issues, and solutions to relevant parties, including management and stakeholders. Complete schedule updates. * **Safety and Compliance:** * Enforcing safety regulations: aid safety personnel in ensuring that all workers on\-site adhere to health and safety regulations and guidelines. * Managing environmental impact: may also be involved in assessing and mitigating the environmental impact of the construction project. Qualifications: **Skills \& Abilities:*** Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. * High attention to detail and the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment on multiple projects. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to multitask and manage time effectively in order to meet deadlines. * Self\-starter and able to work in a team atmosphere. * Proficient in Microsoft Office. **Physical Demands:*** Ability to work within a physically demanding work environment including extended periods of standing and walking, frequent sitting, kneeling, bending, crouching, reaching, stopping and climbing. * Work will be performed in both indoor and outdoor environments in all weather conditions. * Ability to lift up to 50 pounds on a regular basis. **Education and/or Work Experience:*** Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in related field. * 6 months to a year of experience in construction, preferred. **Physical Demands and Work Environment** This job operates in a field environment. This role routinely requires extended periods of bending, squatting, climbing, kneeling, pushing, pulling, lifting, lifting in awkward positions, standing, and twisting. Also, working in inclement weather conditions, such as extreme heat, extreme cold, rain, ice, snow, and wind. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. This position is physically active, with lifting required. Must be able to bend and lift and carry up to 50 pounds. Clarity of vision at 20 feet or more or 20 inches or less, with the ability to judge distance and space relationships. Precise hand\-eye coordination. Ability to identify and distinguish colors. *Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. The Company reserves the right to revise or change the job duties as the need arises. Management reserves the right to change the description, duties, or work schedules to accommodate individuals with disabilities.* Benefits available include Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability and Life insurance, a 401k plan and Employee Stock Purchase plan. MasTec is a publicly traded company MTZ (NYSE). Equal Employment Opportunity: The Company’s policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, sex, gender, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law and EEOC regulations. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.description: Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30\+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP\-1 care programs purpose\-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com **An award\-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:** * TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026\) * Fortune Change the World (2024\) * CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024\) * Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024\) * Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024\) * Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023\) * Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024\) ### **About the Role:** We're looking for a conversational AI UX writer and voice partner who can define what Maven's product and AI agents sounds like. You'll be the expert eye on the language across our product—from navigation to CTAs, clinical modules to our AI agents: calling out when copy could be clearer or more compelling, or an agent response is too clinical, emotional, or complex. You'll also help shape how we position and showcase AI in the product, including how we educate members about it and how we write disclaimers. Just as importantly, you'll write and refine UX copy for core member experiences, such as care plan screens and AI agent intro and onboarding screens. This is a hands\-on, high\-autonomy role for someone who has worked in both UX product copy and conversational AI and understands the nuances of prompting and its limitations. You will partner directly with Engineering, who owns prompts and configuration, as well as Clinical and Product to bring a single, consistent point of view on voice, tone, taxonomy and language, and to hold a high bar for usability, clinical integrity, clarity, and the right amount of empathy in a health context. This position is expected to last 3 months, with the potential to extend based on business needs and fit. The expected commitment is 20 hours per week. ### **What You'll Do:** **AI voice, tone \& language** * Review real AI agent conversations and give expert feedback on tone, emotional register, reading level, and word choice (e.g., "this is too emotional," "let's use simpler words to explain this," "we missed a chance to be more empathetic") * Define and champion what AI at Maven sounds like, translating our brand voice into clear language principles that work within the realities and limits of LLM\-generated responses * Synthesize voice and language feedback coming from many places (Clinical, Product, Engineering, Brand, coaches) into a clear, prioritized set of themes, and act as the decision\-maker when the team needs one voice * Work with Clinical and Engineering to find conversations where a theme went well and where it didn't, workshop them with users, and distill the findings into what Engineering needs to improve prompts and evaluations (Engineering owns prompts and configuration) * Advise on the anatomy of agent responses (e.g., when to offer options, when to ask a follow\-up question, how to structure a reply) and recommend patterns for Engineering and Clinical to implement and approve * Partner with product, engineering, clinical, and legal/compliance teams to translate requirements into clear language guidance **Product \& UX copy, including AI positioning** * Position how we showcase AI in the product, including how we introduce AI to members, how we handle education, and how we write disclaimers and expectation\-setting language * Write and refine UX copy for in\-product experiences such as care plan screens, AI agent intro and onboarding screens, navigation and CTAs, empty and error states, and in\-app education * Craft language that is empowering and action\-oriented, balancing clinical accuracy and compliance with a human, non\-alarming Maven\-branded tone * Work within design systems and with product designers to balance copy density, hierarchy, and usability * Name pro perience reviewing real conversations or user feedback and distilling them into clear themes and recommendations that engineering teams can act on * Exceptional writing and editing instincts, especially for sensitive, emotional, or clinical subject matter, including calibrating empathy, tone, and reading level * Experience applying and evolving brand tone \& voice guidelines for product/UX copy and AI/agent conversation * Ability to synthesize feedback from many stakeholders (clinical, compliance, product, engineering) and drive to a single point of view without losing clarity or voice * Naming experience (product, feature, or program naming), including a structured approach to generating, screening, and recommending names as needed * Comfort working independently, managing your own time within a part\-time schedule, and communicating progress clearly * Strong judgment about when AI should answer, defer, or escalate, with help from the internal team ### **Engagement Details** The compensation for this role is $90\-100 per hour for 20 hrs a week. From evaluating project requirements to seeing your designs applied in the field, you'll gain valuable experience supporting projects across commercial, industrial, and private\-sector environments. If you enjoy solving problems, working with technical designs, and seeing the impact of your work firsthand, this is an opportunity to grow your engineering career with an industry\-leading crane and lifting solutions provider. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Engineer Real\-World Solutions:** Review project drawings and plans, perform engineering calculations, and evaluate design feasibility to support safe and effective lifting operations. * **Develop Crane and Rigging Plans:** Create crane layouts, rigging details, and lift plans for a variety of commercial, industrial, and private\-sector projects. * **Design and Model:** Use AutoCAD and other drafting tools to develop 2D drawings and 3D models for crane configurations, structural components, and equipment installations. * **Collaborate Across Teams:** Work with architects, engineers, contractors, customers, sales professionals, and field personnel to understand project requirements and develop practical solutions. * **Perform Engineering Calculations:** Prepare ground\-bearing pressure calculations for crawler cranes and outrigger\-supported cranes, along with other project\-specific engineering analyses. * **Support Tower Crane and Hoist Installations:** Evaluate installation requirements, review structural considerations, and help develop effective equipment installation plans. * **Communicate Technical Information:** Prepare drawings, design reports, project documentation, and technical presentations for customers and internal stakeholders. * **Support Project Execution:** Help monitor project progress, visit job sites, and observe equipment installations to better understand how engineering designs translate into field applications. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as business needs require. **What You Bring** ------------------ **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * Engineer in Training (EIT) certification preferred. **Experience** * 0–4 years of relevant engineering experience. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply. **Technical Skills** * Basic to intermediate proficiency in AutoCAD; 3D AutoCAD experience is a plus. * Foundational knowledge of structural analysis and engineering calculations. * Basic familiarity with AISC steel construction standards and structural connection design. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, and communication skills. * Ability to interpret technical drawings and translate project requirements into practical engineering solutions. * Willingness to learn, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and develop technical expertise. **Work Environment and Travel** ------------------------------- This position combines office\-based engineering and design work with occasional field exposure. Limited travel is expected to visit project sites and observe or support equipment installations. The role may require walking on active job sites, climbing, bending, crouching, kneeling, and working outdoors in varying weather conditions. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. This position may require access to refinery and industrial job sites in Texas. Employees assigned to these sites must comply with applicable site\-specific safety and access requirements, including participation in random drug testing through DISA as required for refinery work. Compliance with applicable drug testing requirements is a condition of working at these sites. **Why Maxim Crane Works?** -------------------------- Join a team that supports some of the most complex lifting projects in the industry. At Maxim, you'll have the opportunity to apply your education, build practical engineering experience, collaborate with experienced professionals, and contribute to projects where precision and problem\-solving matter. Whether you're beginning your engineering career or building on your first few years of experience, Maxim offers an opportunity to develop your skills in a specialized and rewarding industry. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- Maxim Crane Works is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against employees or applicants for employment based on race, color, religion, creed, sex, national origin or ancestry, age, sexual orientation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

capacity, and production needs. ### **Data and AI leadership** * Oversee Data Engineering, Data Management, AI Engineering, DataOps, and MLOps through the Senior Manager, Data Engineering \& AI and other leaders. * Establish the data and AI engineering lifecycle from data acquisition and management through production deployment, monitoring, governance, and retirement. * Improve the reliability, capabilities. * Establish a culture of accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, continuous learning, and “We, Not I” behavior. * Create career paths for engineers, architects, data professionals, AI engineers, and technical leaders. * Set expectations for inclusive leadership, thoughtful decision\-making, and transparent communication. * Balance near\-term delivery with long\-term capability development and technical sustainability. **QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, data science, or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree preferred. * Minimum 12 years senior leadership experience across software engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, technology platforms, or a closely related enterprise technology domain. * 5\+ years of technical people leadership and experience leading through managers or senior technical leaders. * Demonstrated success designing and operating technology organizations through growth, transformation, platform modernization, or operating\-model change. * Strong understanding of software engineering, cloud platforms, data platforms, AI/ML engineering, integration, DevOps, reliability, security partnership, and production operations. * Experience translating business strategy into technology strategy, organizational design, investment priorities, and measurable execution. * Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, talent leadership, and change\-leadership skills. * Ability to lead through influence across Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Finance, Operations, vendors, and business stakeholders. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience scaling an enterprise engineering, data, and AI organization in a complex or regulated environment. * Experience with modern data platforms, AI/ML platforms, MLOps, cloud\-native engineering, enterprise integration, or platform engineering. * Experience with Palantir Foundry or comparable platforms is helpful but not required. * Experience transitioning from contractor\- or partner\-led delivery to an internal engineering operating model. *McCarthy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veteran status.* ***NOTICE TO EXTERNAL SEARCH FIRMS:*** *McCarthy’s Talent Acquisition Team is the* ***only authorized representative*** *permitted to engage with external search firms, staffing agencies, or other third\-party recruiting partners. jobs.title: AI Architech
jobs.description: About Meeru AI Meeru AI is building an AI\-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP\&A leaders. We deploy on customer terms — **SaaS multi\-tenant, SaaS single\-tenant, and on\-premises** — across **AWS, Azure, and GCP**. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance. The Role We are looking for an **AI Architect** to help design and build the **intelligence engine** at the core of our platform, and the **conversational AI agents** that sit on top of it and serve answers **deterministically**. Our output sits adjacent to externally reported financials. "Sounds plausible" is never good enough. The engine you help architect turns connected enterprise data into answers that are computed, reproducible, and traceable to verified source data — not improvised by a model. The agents that sit on top interpret what a user is asking, route it to the engine, and present the result in natural language without ever inventing the substance of the answer. This is a deeply hands\-on architecture role. You set technical direction for the engine and agent layer, partner closely with US\-based AI leadership and the Staff AI Engineer on grounding and evaluation rigor, and raise the bar for how deterministic, auditable AI gets built across the team. What makes this role different * **Deterministic by design** — the engine computes answers from verified data. The same question against the same data returns the same grounded, explainable answer. * **A clear separation of concerns** — the engine reasons and decides; the conversational agents orchestrate and narrate, but never fabricate the substance. * **Auditable end to end** — every answer traces back to its source data and the logic that produced it, because our customers' auditors will ask. **Deploys in customer clouds** — including managed LLMs in\-VPC, so customer data never leaves their environment. **Requirements** * **Senior or staff\-level applied AI/ML experience.** You have shipped production AI systems, not just prototypes, and have led the technical direction on at least one of them. * **Deep fluency in modern LLM patterns.** Hands\-on experience with retrieval\-augmented jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: About Meeru AI Meeru AI is building an AI\-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP\&A leaders. We deploy on customer terms — **SaaS multi\-tenant, SaaS single\-tenant, and on\-premises** — across **AWS, Azure, and GCP**. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance. The Role We are looking for a **Senior AI Engineer** to build the AI and intelligence layer — and help uphold the discipline that keeps it honest. Our output sits adjacent to externally reported financials, so "sounds plausible" is not good enough: everything the AI produces must be grounded in, and traceable to, verified data. You'll build the machine\-learning models that learn each customer's patterns, the LLM and agentic systems that produce grounded natural\-language output, and help uphold the rigor that keeps that output faithful. You own significant pieces of the layer end\-to\-end, working closely with our Staff AI Engineer and evaluation engineer, and you build per\-customer models without leaking the very signal they're meant to detect. This is a hands\-on engineering role. You turn designs into robust production systems, measure quality rigorously, help turn user feedback into durable improvements, and grow toward staff\-level technical ownership. **Requirements** * Build per\-customer ML models that learn normal vs. anomalous behavior on time\-series and operational data, using statistical baselines and gradient\-boosted models (LightGBM/XGBoost) with strict anti\-leakage discipline. * Build a template\-first natural\-language generation layer that is strictly grounded in verified data, using guardrails and structured output to prevent hallucinated or unsupported statements. * Implement agentic orchestration (LangGraph or equivalent) with verification and human\-confirmation checkpoints. * Integrate managed LLMs running inside customer clouds (AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI). * Partner with an evaluation engineer to gate grounding, hallucination, and faithfulness checks in CI. * Turn user feedback into durable model and system improvements. * Ship production Python services with SQL/warehouse access (Snowflake, PostgreSQL) in containerized, customer\-hosted deployments. ### **Nice\-to\-Have** * Finance or accounting domain experience (fintech, FP\&A, ERP, audit, financial close). * Feature\-attribution experience (e.g. SHAP), along with an understanding of its limits. * Human\-in\-the\-loop systems and feedback loops. * Hands\-on work with Bedrock, Vertex AI, or Azure OpenAI in VPC or private deployments. * Zero\-inflated or sparse\-event modeling.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Embedded BSP/Kernel (Robotics OS)
jobs.description: Meta Robotics Studio builds consumer humanoid robots that bring Meta's AI into the physical world. Our robots run on NVIDIA Jetson Thor with Meta\-designed carrier boards and JetPack OS. The Robotics OS team owns everything between the silicon and the robot learning stack. jobs.description: ### **Who we are** The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. physical acquisition channels * Partner directly with Growth Marketing and Finance leaders to optimize unit economics, justify marketing spend against gross profit targets, and set channel\-level growth goals * Collaborate with analytics and data engineering teams to establish event tracking requirements, build scalable growth data pipelines, and develop automated executive dashboards * marketing, performance media, or adtech * Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL for complex data manipulation, statistical modeling, and predictive analytics * Deep domain expertise in growth measurement frameworks, multi\-touch attribution, cohort retention modeling, and LTV/CAC dynamics * Hands\-on experience with statistical experimentation and causal inference techniques such as A/B testing, geo\-testing, synthetic controls, and media mix modeling * Strong business acumen with a track record of partnering with senior executives in Growth, Product, and Finance to drive measurable bottom\-line growth * Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills to make complex data stories intuitive and actionable * Experience leveraging AI tools to transform static workflows into responsive, high\-output processes ### **While not required, these are a plus:** * Experience with cloud platforms, including AWS S3, SageMaker, and Airflow * Experience with cloud data jobs.description: **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. AI agents are becoming part of how work gets done, and adversaries are learning to attack them and to attack with them. This role exists to protect those systems and to make sure we can detect, contain, and recover when they are targeted. As a Staff AI Security Engineer, you build the tools, solutions, architectures, and frameworks that secure our sanctioned AI estate and defend against agentic threats across their full lifecycle, from prevention through response and recovery. This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role on the Cyber Defense and Resiliency team, working with the Senior Manager, Technical Network Security. You spend most of your time building, and your work sets the technical direction that others follow. You operate where emerging AI capability meets practical security engineering! On one side you build and operate the protective controls that keep our approved AI solutions safe to use. On the other you translate novel agentic attack patterns into working defenses, automated response actions, and reusable frameworks that the broader organization can adopt. You are comfortable moving fast in an area where the playbooks are still being written, and you bring rigor to a space that rewards it. **Responsibilities:** * Build and harden security tools that protect AI agents, model\-backed services, and supporting infrastructure by securing system configurations, access, and integrations. * Operate and mature AI guardrails, including in\-line model protections, prompt\-injection defenses, and data\-loss prevention, in partnership with AI enablement and governance teams. * Design detection capabilities for agentic threats, including prompt injection, tool/function abuse, identity and credential misuse, data exfiltration, and agent memory or context manipulation. * Develop automated, machine\-speed response and containment tools with tiered authority for reversible and irreversible actions. * Enable rapid, scalable revocation of compromised agent access and credentials, while restoring agent configurations, tool registries, and supporting services to a known\-good state. * Create and document reusable architectures, reference designs, and frameworks that enable consistent security and defense of agentic systems across the organization. * Partner with detection and response, threat intelligence, platform engineering, and AI enablement teams to operationalize solutions and serve as a technical authority who strengthens jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: **About Middle River Power** Middle River Power (MRP) is a private equity\-sponsored energy platform specializing in the investment and asset management of U.S. power generation facilities. With over 8 GW of natural gas, coal, battery storage, and solar assets across multiple states, MRP is committed to safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Backed by experienced leadership and a data\-driven approach, MRP fosters a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. We value talented individuals who bring curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to excellence. **Position Summary** Middle River Power is seeking an experienced, hands\-on **Network Engineer** to design, maintain, and secure the network infrastructure supporting our Chicago corporate office and growing portfolio of power generation and battery storage facilities across the United States. Reporting to the Director of Information Technology, this position will partner closely with IT, Operations, plant personnel, and external service providers to ensure reliable connectivity, network security, and standardized infrastructure across our fleet. The Network Engineer will primarily support Midwest and East Coast facilities, with additional support for West Coast operations as needed. The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise, experience managing multi\-site networks, and a proactive, solutions\-oriented approach to working in a fast\-paced, private equity\-backed environment. **Key Responsibilities** **Network Operations \& Infrastructure** * Administer, monitor, and troubleshoot corporate and plant networks, including firewalls, switches, wireless infrastructure, routing, VPNs, and WAN connectivity. * Serve as an escalation point for network\-related issues, including participation in after\-hours support and scheduled maintenance. * Manage network connectivity providers, troubleshoot service interruptions, and maintain reliable remote connectivity between plant facilities and control locations. * Monitor network performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and support infrastructure reliability across multiple locations. **Network Security \& Compliance** * Maintain firewall configurations, network segmentation, and secure remote access across corporate, plant, vendor, and external networks. * Implement and support IT/OT network segmentation using VLANs, security zones, and the Purdue Model. * Administer privileged and vendor remote access, including access reviews and restrictions. * Support vulnerability remediation, firmware updates, security assessments, and applicable NERC CIP Low Impact compliance requirements. **Network Standardization \& Projects** * Develop and implement standardized network designs across facilities, including firewall redundancy, connectivity diversity, and hardware configurations. * Support the transition from legacy network infrastructure, including Cisco equipment, to a standardized Fortinet environment. * Configure, test, and deploy network equipment while coordinating installations and cutovers around approved maintenance windows. * Lead network onboarding and integration activities for newly acquired facilities and support broader IT modernization initiatives. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Documentation** * Partner with Operations and plant leadership to coordinate network changes in accordance with site safety procedures, operational requirements, and change management processes. * Collaborate with managed service providers, equipment vendors, and internal stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver projects. * Maintain accurate network diagrams, device inventories, configuration backups, port maps, and change documentation. * Ensure network infrastructure supports business continuity, operational reliability, and long\-term organizational growth. **Required Qualifications** * 5–7 years of hands\-on network engineering experience, preferably supporting multiple locations or distributed infrastructure. * Strong experience with next\-generation firewalls, preferably Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer); experience with Palo Alto or Cisco also considered. * Proficiency in routing, switching, VLANs, OSPF/BGP, VPNs, NAT, DHCP/DNS, and wireless networking. * Experience implementing network segmentation, firewall policies, and secure remote access solutions. * Working knowledge of network monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and configuration management tools. * Strong technical documentation, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to collaborate with technical and nontechnical stakeholders and manage competing priorities. * Willingness to travel regularly to plant facilities and work safely in industrial environments. * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting industrial or operational technology (OT) networks, including SCADA, DCS, PLC, or historian environments. * Background in power generation, utilities, energy, or similar critical infrastructure industries. * Familiarity with NERC CIP, IEC 62443, and Purdue Model network architecture. * Fortinet NSE certification (NSE 4 or higher), CCNA, or CCNP. * Experience with FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiPAM, and Cisco\-to\-Fortinet migrations. * Exposure to Microsoft Azure networking, Microsoft 365, and Entra ID. * Experience integrating networks following acquisitions or supporting multi\-site infrastructure expansion. * Familiarity with scripting or network automation using Python or PowerShell. **Technical Environment** MRP operates a combination of corporate IT and industrial network infrastructure, with an ongoing focus on standardization and security. * Network \& Security: FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiPAM, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, and Cisco. * Connectivity: Fiber, broadband, cellular, satellite, and site\-to\-site VPN. * Cloud \& Identity: Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Intune. * Security Monitoring: Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, and Darktrace. * Operational Technology: Networks supporting DCS, SCADA, PLC, and AVEVA PI systems. **Work Environment \& Travel** * Based in MRP's Chicago corporate office, with approximately 30–40% travel to power generation and battery storage facilities. * Travel requirements may increase during site onboarding, infrastructure upgrades, or network cutovers. * Standard business hours with occasional after\-hours support, on\-call responsibilities, and scheduled maintenance windows. * Plant visits may require personal protective equipment (PPE), safety training, and work in industrial or outdoor environments. **Compensation \& Benefits** Middle River Power offers a competitive base salary commensurate with experience, along with eligibility for an annual performance\-based bonus. Our comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, paid time off, paid holidays, and additional company\-sponsored benefits. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Middle River Power is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
