jobs.title: Senior Biomedical Engineer
jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 28 Oct 2026 At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world. **About the Role** ================== As a member of the MiniMed’s – Continuous Glucose Monitoring Sensor R\&D team the Senior Biomedical Engineer will contribute to the development of biosensing technologies and manufacturing with emphasis on glucose sensing. The Senior Engineer will be heavily involved in technology design, manufacturing process, and optimization. This individual in this role will develop deep understanding of how wearable electrochemical sensors function, including how electrode geometry, enzyme loading, membrane stacks and tissue interface govern sensor performance, manufacturability, and reliability. This foundational sensor knowledge is critical in ensuring that statistical model development and analytical frameworks reflect true sensor physics. The individual in this role will contribute to the development of key elements of design transfer into manufacturing, including applying statistically robust methods for defining and refining in\-process check specifications, statistically justified sample size determination, and substrate rejection criteria, working cross functionally with other engineering, quality and regulatory teams. As part of continuous improvement activities, the individual in this role will develop understanding of and apply machine learning tools to improve upon current process monitoring technologies. The work will focus on technologies and methods that enable improved sensor design and manufacturability. This Senior Biomedical Engineer will partner cross functionally to highlight insights from real\-world sensor performance data, driving continuous sensor improvement initiatives and directly informing next\-generation sensing platform designs. This role is intended for an experienced technical contributor who can independently plan experiments, execute, analyze data, generate documentation and effectively communicate the results to internal and external stakeholders including upper management to assist in driving development efforts. Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned. * Key contributing member within a multidisciplinary team to support design transfer activities, including defining and refining statistically robust in\-process check specifications, statistically justified sample size determination, and rejection criteria. * Key contributing member of a team in developing and applying advanced statistical analysis and data\-driven investigations to support sensor process optimization, performance modeling, and manufacturing decision\-making. * Ensures execution of detailed engineering analyses \& documentation to support design development and support process transfer. * Applies first\-principles understanding of glucose sensor behavior, including electrochemistry, enzyme\-mediated sensing, mass transport, membrane design, tissue interface, interferents, drift, and stability. * Applies data analysis and statistical methodologies to generate insights on sensor performance, drive experiment design and project next steps. * Applies analytical tools, including statistical learning methods where appropriate, to support defect detection, classification, and sensor process monitoring improvements. * Applies data management and data visualization best practices for building data pipelines and analytics tools. * Utilizes technical skills associated with Six Sigma, Lean, DRM/DFSS and other appropriate continuous improvement techniques. * "\> "\>undefined * Work with other engineers and technicians to execute experimental designs and analysis. * Mentors scientists and engineers to promote rigorous experimental design, and strengthens first\-principles technical decision making within the team. Ensures work is performed in compliance with applicable quality system requirements, design controls, medical device standards, and regulatory expectations. * **Basic Qualifications** Bachelor’s degree with 4\+ years of relevant experience; or advanced degree with 2\+ years of relevant experience. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in glucose sensor, biosensor, electrochemical sensor, wearable sensor, or related medical device sensor development with working knowledge of how sensor design parameters (e.g., electrode geometry, enzyme loading, membrane stacks) affect sensor performance, reliability, and manufacturing feasibility. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience in sensor design, first\-principles problem solving, structured experimentation, and data\-driven decision making. * Demonstrated expertise in advanced statistical methods: DOE, ANOVA, mixed\-effects models, hypothesis testing,  each role. **Benefits \& Compensation** ============================ **MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package** At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life. Salary ranges for U.S (excl. PR) locations (USD):$124,000\.00 \- $212,000\.00 For roles located in California, Seattle WA, Washington DC, Boston MA, and New York City, the salary range is $124,000\.00 \- $212,000 USD. Actual compensation may vary based on factors including experience, education, certifications, skills, market conditions, internal equity, and geographic location. Compensation and benefits information pertains solely to candidates hired within the United States (local market compensation and benefits will apply for others). At MiniMed, we are committed to supporting the well\-being and financial security of our employees. Regular employees working 20 or more hours per week are eligible for a robust benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, as well as access to a Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, life insurance, long\-term disability leave, and a dependent daycare spending account. In addition, all regular employees enjoy incentive plans, a 401(k) plan with company match, short\-term disability coverage, paid time off and holidays, participation in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and access to our Employee Assistance Program. Eligible employees may also benefit from our Non\-qualified Retirement Plan Supplement and Capital Accumulation Plan, subject to IRS minimum earnings requirements. Please note that “regular employees” refers to those who are not temporary staff, such as interns, and some benefits may not apply to employees in Puerto Rico. For further details about our comprehensive benefits, we encourage you to visit the link below. MiniMed Benefits Overview **About MiniMed** ================= MiniMed is a full\-stack insulin delivery company dedicated to supporting people living with diabetes through every step of their journey — when and how they need it. For more than 40 years, we’ve been committed to redefining what’s possible: intelligent dosing systems designed for real life, predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and always on support when it’s needed most. jobs.title: Staff AI Solutions Engineer - Nuclear & Safety
jobs.description: As a global leader in radiation safety, detection and measurement, Mirion Technologies is advancing radiation safety through innovative technologies and solutions. Mirion's Nuclear \& Safety business group builds the hardware, software, and services that keep nuclear power plants, laboratories and research facilities, defense operations, and radiation\-hazard workplaces safe and effective. We're investing in a small, high\-impact team of embedded AI Solutions Engineers who will sit inside our Nuclear \& Safety business units and turn everyday operational friction across manufacturing, quality, service, and back\-office workflows, into measurable efficiency gains using modern AI. This is not a research role and not a central\-platform role. You will spend most of your time with the people who run the business (i.e. plant managers, quality engineers, field service leaders, product managers), finding the highest\-leverage problems and then personally designing, building, and shipping the solution. Your toolkit spans the full range of applied AI: computer vision for visual inspection and image\-based QA, spectral and sensor\-data analytics, basic software development, and agentic AI / LLM\-based automation for decision support and workflow orchestration. You'll report directly to the Chief AI and Digital Officer, giving you a direct line to enterprise AI strategy while you operate with the autonomy of a startup engineer inside a public, nuclear\-regulated industrial company. What You'll Do Find and frame the opportunity * Embed within the Nuclear \& Safety business unit, attending their staff meetings, walking their production floor, shadowing their field service and quality teams to fully understand the business and landscape of problems * Build a first\-hand map of where manual, error\-prone, or slow processes are costing time and money. * Translate ambiguous, non\-technical pain points ("our detector inspection and QA review takes too long," "we can't keep up with service tickets") into scoped, buildable AI solutions, and build the business case for prioritizing them. Build and ship * Design and deploy solutions for use cases such as automated visual inspection of detectors and assemblies, defect and anomaly detection, spectral and sensor\-data analysis, and image\-based quality verification. * Design and deploy agentic AI systems (LLM\-based agents, workflow orchestration, and automation) to reduce manual effort in manufacturing, service, quality and compliance documentation, and other back\-office functions. * Own the full lifecycle: rapid prototyping, pilot with real users, hardening for production, and handoff or ongoing support, leveraging shared enterprise services and without waiting for a large team to do it for you. Communicate and drive adoption * Present progress, trade\-offs, and results in plain business language to business counterparts (plant managers, quality leaders, and executives who don't have an AI background) and adjust your approach based on their feedback. * Define and track the metrics (cycle time, error rate, cost, throughput) that prove a solution is actually working, and course\-correct quickly when it isn't. * Lead change management and light training so solutions get adopted, not shelved. Operate within the broader AI function * Partner with the Chief AI \& Digital Officer and central AI/Digital team to stay aligned on architecture, security, data governance, and tooling standards, and to bring reusable patterns back to the center. * Apply appropriate rigor for a regulated nuclear environment (nuclear quality assurance, validation, documentation, export controls, cybersecurity) in partnership with Quality, Regulatory, and Compliance colleagues. What Success Looks Like in Year One * At least 2–3 AI\-driven solutions in production, each tied to a measurable operational KPI (time saved, defect reduction, cost avoidance, throughput gained). * A trusted, self\-sustaining relationship with business unit leadership. They should come to you with problems rather than reaching out to the CAIDO, directly. * A reusable playbook or pattern (for computer vision, for agentic workflows, or both) that can be extended to other Nuclear \& Safety business units or replicated by peer AI solutions engineers. What You Bring Required * 5\+ years shipping production software or applied ML/AI systems, with real users depending on what you built. * Experience in software engineering and cloud\-based application development and deployment * Hands\-on experience building agentic or LLM\-based systems (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or a comparable custom agent framework), including prompt design and retrieval\-augmented approaches. * Strong core software engineering: Python, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), APIs, and enough MLOps/DevOps fluency to get something into production and keep it running. * A demonstrated track record of high agency. Ideally a history of projects you identified, scoped, and delivered with minimal direction, not just tickets you executed that were assigned in JIRA. * Excellent communication skills with non\-technical audiences. Strong ability to clearly explain what a model does and doesn't do without jargon, and knowledge of how to build trust with non\-technical operators. * Comfort with ambiguity and autonomy. You will often be the only AI/software person in the room and working daily with those with little\-to\-no AI skills. You will be part of a team of centralized peers with strong skills but will operate independently to deliver business\-unit\-specific results. Strongly Preferred * Hands\-on experience building computer vision solutions (e.g., OpenCV, PyTorch or TensorFlow, image classification/detection/segmentation pipelines), or ML on spectra, waveforms, and sensor time\-series data. * Experience in Azure or AWS, Databricks, and Claude/OpenAI integration via AWS Bedrock or Azure Foundry * Experience in a regulated industry — nuclear power, defense, medical devices, or industrial manufacturing under a formal quality system (e.g., ISO 9001, 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, NQA\-1\). * Prior experience as an embedded, business\-facing, or "forward\-deployed" engineer, solutions engineer, or applied AI generalist, rather than a purely research\-facing ML role. * Domain exposure to nuclear power plant instrumentation and controls, radiation detection and measurement, gamma spectroscopy, health physics, or radiation safety and monitoring workflows. Why This Role * Direct visibility with the Chief AI \& Digital Officer and a real hand in shaping how AI gets built and scaled across Mirion Nuclear \& Safety. * The rare combination of startup\-style autonomy and ownership with the stability, resources, and mission of a global public company protecting workers, communities, and the environment. * A builder's role. You will ship things that change how people work, not produce slide decks about how AI might someday help. **Mirion Technologies (NYSE:** MIR) is a global leader in radiation safety, science, and medicine, protecting people and the planet from the harmful effects of ionizing radiation. Mirion Nuclear \& Safety powers Nuclear Power Plants, Laboratory \& Research (including spectroscopy and scientific analysis), Radiation Safety \& Monitoring, and Defense. Mirion offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes Vacation \& PTO Time, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching, HSA and FSA options, life and disability insurance, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness resources, and several voluntary benefits including legal assistance, identity protection, and pet insurance.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agent Policy Fabric
jobs.description: The Agentic Safety Engineering team is building Agent Policy Fabric (APF), an enterprise governance layer for AI agents. APF combines signed policy, runtime verification, policy projection, credential mediation, and audit records to help govern the actions agents take across enterprise systems. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help turn the APF proof of concept into diligent production software. You will build, implement, test, and operate features in policy verification, runtime integration, or conformance testing. Working with experienced platform and security engineers, you will own a defined feature or subsystem and help ensure that policy decisions are accurate, integrations are reliable, and failures are handled safely! Join us! **What You'll Be Doing:** * Build policy\-verification features: Implement components of the Runtime Policy Verifier and authorization APIs, including signed policy validation, freshness and revocation checks, rollback protection, and binding decisions to the correct subject and runtime context, following reviewed security contracts. * Implement policy projection: Translate canonical APF policy into runtime\-specific rules and adapter constraints. Handle unsupported policies and partial updates safely so runtimes admit work only when the required policy has been accepted. * Develop runtime integrations: Work with OpenShell and other runtime engineers to implement and test agreed interfaces for policy consumption, runtime context, admission decisions, and audit events. Document interface behavior and raise gaps or conflicting assumptions for resolution. * Strengthen correctness and conformance: Build fixtures, compatibility tests, negative tests, and property or fuzz tests that exercise policy behavior, integration boundaries, and failure paths. Investigate defects and turn findings into regression coverage. * Deliver production\-ready components: Add observability, measure performance, debug reliability issues, and contribute to rollout plans and operational documentation for the components you own. * Contribute technical judgment: Write focused design documents, explain implementation tradeoffs, participate in code and security reviews, and work with platform, Identity, and Product Security partners to resolve issues within your scope. Help the team deliver: Break work into achievable turning points, communicate dependencies and risks, review code, and share knowledge with other engineers. * **What We Need To See:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, with 5\+ years of relevant industry experience in systems software, backend services, distributed systems, security engineering, or policy infrastructure. * Strong programming skills in at least one of Rust, Go, C\+\+, or Python, with experience delivering maintainable, tested production code. * Experience building and delivering services or systems components, including API design, integration, debugging, and error handling. * Practical experience implementing security controls, such as authorization checks, signature verification, or credential handling, and the ability to reason about trust boundaries and safe failure behavior. * Working knowledge of Linux, service\-to\-service interfaces, automated testing, CI, and software release workflows. Ability to own engineering work through design, implementation, validation, and delivery; communicate technical tradeoffs clearly; and collaborate effectively through design and code reviews. * **Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:** * Experience with policy engines or authorization systems such as OPA/Rego, Cedar, Zanzibar\-style systems, or runtime enforcement frameworks. * Experience with signed artifacts, trust\-root distribution, key rotation, revocation, or tools such as Sigstore, TUF, or in\-toto. * Familiarity with AI\-agent runtimes, sandboxed execution, tool\-call governance, MCP\-style routing, or credential isolation. * Experience with protobuf/gRPC, schema evolution, backward\-compatible APIs, or cloud and enterprise deployment environments. Use of property testing, fuzzing, or other adversarial testing techniques to find security and correctness defects. * Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America's drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high\-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands\-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment. As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We're hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years. **What you will be doing** Neros builds drones for the modern battlefield. As a Senior Software Engineer on our Application team, you will build the tools and integrations our operators and engineers rely on. Mission planning and control software, desktop tools, and the connections between our systems and external command \& control and situational awareness systems. You'll own major pieces end to end, from design to production software that keeps working when the network drops or the systems around it change. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain applications and integrations for operators and engineers — mission planning and control, configuration and monitoring tools, and connections to external command\-and\-control and situational\-awareness systems * Build cross\-platform desktop and web applications (Windows, Mac, Linux) * Own the interfaces your software depends on — data models, APIs, and external specifications that are incomplete or changing * Design software that behaves correctly when connectivity is intermittent or unavailable * Build test harnesses and simulators to verify software without access to live partner systems or hardware * Write unit and integration tests for your software, partnering with our test organization on system and field testing **You should have the following** * 7\+ years of experience designing, building and deploying production software * Deep expertise in **TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust** or another modern application language * Track record **owning significant software end to end** — from design to production, and after launch * **Application** experience — cross\-platform desktop (Electron, Qt, or similar) or modern web shipped to real users * Solid **networking fundamentals** — TCP/UDP, message framing and serialization, and designing for unreliable or high\-latency links * Experience **working through interfaces you didn't control** — protocols, message formats, and APIs owned by another team or organization * Experience building test harnesses or simulators for systems you couldn't test against directly **Nice to have** * **Production experience in more than one language** is a strong plus * **TAK ecosystem** — ATAK plugins (Java/Kotlin), WinTAK plugins (C\#), TAK Server, Cursor on Target * **MAVLink** or other drone/robotics protocols * Military or defense C2 or situational\-awareness systems * Geospatial and mapping — coordinate systems, datums, and map rendering * Real\-time operator interfaces — live telemetry, video, and many\-vehicle displays * Embedded or device\-facing software — applications that talk directly to hardware * Android development * You fly — FPV, RC, or drones generally **US Salary Range** $180,000 – $252,000 USD The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. jobs.description: **Job ID:** 18984 **Alternate Locations:** **Newell Brands** is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® \- and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Our culture is built on values in action: Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership, and Leadership. The Hardware and Embedded Engineering Manager leads DYMO’s Electrical, Mechanical, and Firmware Engineering functions and serves as the technical authority for the integrated hardware platform across new product development and sustaining engineering. The role translates system requirements into coordinated hardware architecture, subsystem requirements, interfaces, and technical decisions across electrical, mechanical, and firmware disciplines, ensuring the complete hardware solution meets requirements for performance, reliability, connectivity, safety, manufacturability, and cost. The manager retains direct technical authority for electrical engineering while leading and integrating the Mechanical and Firmware technical authorities responsible for detailed architecture and design within their respective disciplines. The role technically directs and challenges Original Design Manufacturer\-developed hardware solutions and ensures compliance with DYMO requirements and acceptance criteria. This is a highly hands\-on technical role, with at least 80% of time spent as an individual contributor focused on electrical engineering and/or firmware development and no more than 10–20% dedicated to functional management. The manager partners closely with the Systems Engineer/Product Architect, who owns overall product architecture, system requirements, hardware, firmware, and software allocation, cross\-system interfaces, system integration, and final system\-level technical acceptance. \#LI\-MC2 **Responsibilities** * Serve in a hands\-on manager role, spending at least 80% of time as an individual contributor focused on electrical engineering and/or firmware development. * Lead integrated hardware architecture across Electrical, Mechanical, and Firmware Engineering, translating system requirements into coordinated hardware requirements, subsystem allocations, interfaces, and acceptance criteria. * Serve as DYMO’s integrated hardware and embedded technical authority, owning hardware architecture, requirements allocation, cross\-discipline interfaces, critical technical decisions, and acceptance criteria while retaining direct technical authority for the electrical subsystem. * Define and control critical electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and firmware interfaces, including power and charging, motors and motion control, printhead control, sensors, thermal management, connectivity, electromagnetic interference and compatibility, displays, mechanisms, media handling, and hardware/firmware communications. * Lead the Electrical, Mechanical, and Firmware Engineering organization, establishing clear technical ownership, technical depth, and accountability for engineering results. * Direct Original Design Manufacturer hardware and embedded development across electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and firmware, ensuring designs meet DYMO architecture, requirements, interfaces, engineering standards, and acceptance criteria. * Lead critical hardware design reviews covering mechanical and electrical designs, firmware architecture and code, component selections, design for manufacturability, and verification evidence. * Own hardware and embedded connectivity architecture and requirements, including Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, wireless modules, antenna integration, radio frequency performance, grounding and shielding, electromagnetic compatibility, range, throughput, and connection stability. * Ensure designs meet performance and reliability requirements, including component derating, tolerance analysis, thermal behavior, immunity, emissions, electrical safety, and foreseeable operating conditions. * Own hardware\-level failure resolution and technical readiness, challenging root\-cause conclusions and ensuring corrective actions and objective verification before acceptance. * Provide technical leadership for component obsolescence, substitutions, regulatory modifications, cost reductions, and sustaining changes. * Apply automation and artificial intelligence\-assisted methods to test\-log analysis, anomaly detection, failure\-pattern identification, and engineering knowledge capture. * Standardize proven architectures, components, interfaces, design rules, and reusable test methods while evaluating emerging technologies for future product platforms. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; advanced degree preferred. * 12\+ years of experience developing complex embedded electromechanical products, with deep electrical engineering expertise and technical leadership across mechanical engineering, firmware, connectivity, and system integration. * Deep electrical engineering expertise with the ability to make architecture and design decisions across power, embedded electronics, wireless and radio frequency technologies, electromagnetic compatibility, connectivity, sensors, motors, and electromechanical systems. * Demonstrated ability to translate system requirements into hardware and subsystem requirements, interfaces, architecture, design decisions, and measurable acceptance criteria. * Demonstrated success leading integrated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and firmware development from requirements and architecture through validation, certification, mass production, and sustaining engineering. * Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams while maintaining clear technical ownership and accountability. * Experience directing Original Design Manufacturers, suppliers, and external engineering partners developing high\-volume products. * Strong technical judgment and ability to make evidence\-based decisions involving performance, reliability, safety, cost, quality, and schedule. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex electrical risks, design tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical teams and business leaders. Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well\-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments. Newell Brands and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and comply with applicable employment laws. jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer (IAM)
jobs.description: **About Nu** ============ Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human\-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page **About the Role** Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. This is a senior individual\-contributor role with organizational\-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi\-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution. The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands\-on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate. **What You’ll Be Responsible For** * Defining, communicating, and executing a multi\-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. * Lead organization\-wide authentication migrations that span heterogeneous surfaces — browser, operating system login, CLI tooling, and API\-level integrations — across thousands of employees, multiple device ecosystems, and distributed work environments, producing measurable outcomes: authentication success rates above 99%, material reductions in per\-authentication time, support exception rates below 1%, and return on investment within weeks of enforcement. * Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service\-to\-service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows. * Translating least\-privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization\-wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time. * Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits. * Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence. * Designing and facilitating large\-scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement. * Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization. * Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control. ### **We Are Looking for a Person Who Has** * Solid professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management. * Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi\-year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid\-course corrections. * Expert\-level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, SAML 2\.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). * Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production\-quality code in at least one general\-purpose programming language. * Demonstrated ability to model identity\-related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions. * A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer. * Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non\-technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators. **Nice\-to\-have** * Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks. * Hands\-on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak. * Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third\-party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure. * Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi\-cloud environments. * Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open\-source tooling, or participation in standards bodies. **Location for this opportunity (City, Country)** ------------------------------------------------- * Miami, United States * Palo Alto, United States * Washington DC, United States **Our Benefits** * Opportunity of earning equity at Nu * Medical Insurance * Dental and Vision Insurance * Life Insurance and AD\&D * Extended maternity and paternity leaves * Nucleo \- Our learning platform of courses * NuLanguage \- Our language learning program * NuCare \- Our mental health and wellness assistance program * 401K * Saving Plans \- Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account * Work\-from\-home Allowance * Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable. * Compensation range: 200 \- 240k \+ RSUs **Work Model for this Role** ---------------------------- **Hybrid 2\-3 times/week:** Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu\-hybrid\-work\-model/ Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers. To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Lead Data Platform Engineer** **Dallas, TX \| On\-Site \| 5 Days/Week** **About the Role** We are seeking a **Lead Data Platform Engineer** to serve as the technical owner of our enterprise data platform. This is a hands\-on engineering role responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving the platform that delivers trusted data for business operations, reporting, and analytics. You will establish engineering standards, guide technical decisions, and ensure the platform is reliable, scalable, secure, and operationally resilient. Success in this role requires technical depth, ownership, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset. If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, building production\-grade platforms, and raising the engineering bar for those around you, we'd like to meet you. **What You'll Own** * Own the architecture, engineering, reliability, security, and day\-to\-day operation of the enterprise data platform. * Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, and Snowflake. * Design and evolve scalable logical and physical data models that support analytics, reporting, and operational decision\-making. * Design, implement, and maintain modern data transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent, promoting reusable, testable, and maintainable data models. * Establish engineering standards for data modeling, transformation, testing, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and operational support. * Build reusable ingestion and transformation patterns that simplify onboarding new data sources and reduce long\-term maintenance. * Implement automated testing, data quality validation, lineage, and observability across the platform. * Optimize platform performance, scalability, and cloud resource utilization while balancing operational cost and business value. * Implement CI/CD practices that enable reliable, repeatable deployments and controlled platform changes. * Ensure sensitive data is managed in accordance with HIPAA and organizational security standards through governance, auditing, and access controls. * Partner with application, analytics, and business teams to deliver trusted, production\-ready data solutions. * Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and engineering best practices. * Continuously improve the platform by identifying opportunities to automate, simplify, modernize, and reduce technical debt. **Technical Expertise** **Required** * 6\+ years of professional experience designing and supporting production data platforms. * Strong experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, and Microsoft Azure. * Hands\-on Snowflake experience, including: + SQL development + Streams \& Tasks + Performance tuning + Incremental data processing + Security and RBAC * Strong SQL Server and advanced T\-SQL development skills. * Experience designing scalable ETL/ELT architectures and production\-grade data integration solutions. * Strong data modeling experience, including dimensional modeling and designing performant, maintainable analytical data structures. * Hands\-on experience with dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks (such as SQLMesh, Coalesce, Dataform, or similar), including model development, testing, documentation, and deployment. * Experience implementing Git\-based source control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment practices. * Experience designing reliable production platforms with monitoring, observability, automated testing, error handling, and recovery strategies. * Understanding of cloud performance optimization, platform scalability, and FinOps principles. **Preferred** * Python for automation, testing, or engineering utilities. * Experience working in healthcare or other regulated industries. * Experience with Azure DevOps or similar DevOps platforms. * Experience leading technical initiatives or serving as the technical owner of an enterprise data platform. **What We're Looking For** We're looking for an engineer who thinks like a platform owner. You are someone who: * Takes end\-to\-end ownership and accountability for production platforms. * Is curious, continuously learns, and seeks better ways of solving problems. * Builds scalable, maintainable, well\-tested solutions rather than one\-off implementations. * Values clean architecture, reusable components, and engineering discipline. * Balances engineering excellence with practical business outcomes. * Understands that reliability, security, performance, observability, and cost efficiency are equally important in a production platform. * Enjoys mentoring others, sharing knowledge, and establishing engineering standards. * Communicates effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. * Takes pride in leaving systems better than you found them. **Technology Stack** * Microsoft Azure * Azure Data Factory (ADF) * Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2\) * Snowflake * SQL Server / T\-SQL * dbt (or equivalent transformation framework) * Git \& CI/CD * Python (Preferred) **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * Demonstrated experience owning or leading production data platforms. * Experience working with regulated data environments such as HIPAA, PCI, or SOX is preferred.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world. We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire. **Job Summary** =============== Lead the engineering team behind the Orbis AI portfolio — the Agent Catalog, the OSINT Agent Harness, and Pulse Analytics — and be accountable for what it puts in front of users. You will grow a team of software and research engineers, set the cadence that turns applied research into deployed capability, and hold the line on the accuracy, explainability, and reliability that mission work demands. This role exists because Orbis AI is measured on capability delivered to users, not on experiments run. **Travel**: Up to 20% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Lead, coach, and grow a team of software and research engineers, owning hiring, onboarding, performance, and career development. * Own the team's delivery commitments end to end — scope, sequence, and land work each cycle, surfacing status and risk early rather than at the deadline. * Drive the research\-to\-product path: set direction with product management, define what a result must demonstrate to become a roadmap commitment, and stop work that is not paying off. * Enforce the Orbis AI product principles — accuracy and trustworthiness, security and data sovereignty, rapid iteration, deploy anywhere, explainability, and performance — in design review rather than after release. * Establish engineering standards that hold under pressure: design and code review, testing, observability, on\-call, and incident follow\-through. * Guide architecture for systems that must run in cloud, on\-premises, and edge environments from a single codebase. * Clear cross\-team blockers — dependencies, interface contracts, and competing priorities — with the product teams that consume Orbis AI capabilities. * Travel up to 20% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2\+ years directly managing engineers * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience * Track record of delivering meaningful product surfaces on committed timelines * Technical depth in distributed systems, backend services, or AI and data platforms sufficient to lead design review credibly * Demonstrated ability to grow engineers, including leveling, performance conversations, and hiring against a bar * Clear written and verbal communication with both engineering and non\-engineering audiences * Willingness to travel up to 20% **Desired Qualifications** ========================== * Experience managing teams building agentic AI, LLM\-backed products, or knowledge\-representation and retrieval systems * Experience managing or partnering closely with applied research, and judgment about when a result is ready to productize * Experience shipping software into constrained environments such as on\-premises, disconnected, or edge deployments * Familiarity with containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes) across cloud, on\-premises, and edge targets * Prior experience in a government, national security, or otherwise regulated environment * Experience with high\-performance analytics or data\-intensive systems operating close to the user and the data **Physical Requirements** ========================= * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Participation in virtual and in\-person meetings * Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions * **Travel**: Up to 20% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration. **Orbis Benefits** Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team. **Orbis Locations** Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full\-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens. Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field. jobs.title: Founding Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **About Onescreen** Onescreen is the modern platform for out\-of\-home advertising — making it easier for brands and agencies to plan, buy, and measure OOH campaigns across thousands of vendors and formats. We move fast, operate lean, and hold ourselves to a high standard on every campaign we run. **About the role** You'll be the founding ML engineer who owns our matching algorithms from exploration through production and the data platform that feeds them. You'll design and ship the models that rank OOH inventory against advertiser personas, markets, and dayparts. You'll own our data warehouse shape and the pipelines that fill it. You'll publish the ranking and matching APIs that downstream products, agents, and automation surfaces consume. **What you'll do** * Design and ship matching and ranking models for OOH inventory: candidate generation, re\-ranking, geospatial\-aware scoring. * Own the data warehouse layer end to end: staging, marts, feature pipelines, freshness, lineage. * Stand up offline and online evaluation infrastructure — measure the gap between them, don't assume it. * Publish ranking and matching APIs for product surfaces, with latency and quality SLOs. * Instrument model monitoring: drift detection, prediction distribution, feature freshness, retraining triggers. ### **Qualifications** **The hard requirement:** you have owned a production ranking, matching, or recommendation system end\-to\-end. You chose the model, designed the features, made the evaluation methodology calls, and were on the hook when it drifted. We care about that ownership scope more than years on a résumé — title and compensation are scaled to your demonstrated expertise. Beyond that: * Strong production Python (NumPy, Pandas, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy). * Strong SQL and modern data warehouse experience (BigQuery preferred). * Real ranking and matching modeling fluency — learning\-to\-rank, retrieval and re\-rank patterns, not just classification. * Evaluation methodology rigor: holdouts, leakage prevention, online vs. offline gap measurement. * Comfort owning the data pipeline as well as the model. * Bias toward shipping. Clear writer. Self\-directed. #### **Nice to have** * Geospatial data experience (H3, PostGIS, GeoPandas) * Mobility or location data experience * Embedding\-based retrieval (pgvector, FAISS, vector databases) * Bandits, contextual bandits, or online learning * A/B testing infrastructure design * Causal inference * dbt * Ad\-tech or OOH domain familiarity

This role focuses on identifying and eliminating reliability risks through a combination of equipment reliability engineering and process optimization. The position plays a critical role in linking mechanical condition, process variability, and failure modes, driving proactive interventions that improve asset availability, reduce unplanned downtime, and optimize lifecycle performance. Close collaboration with Maintenance, Operations, and Engineering is essential to advance defect elimination, risk mitigation, and asset health strategies. Rocky Mountain Steel Mills is committed to maintaining and promoting a safe, healthy and injury\-free environment. It is required for all jobs. **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own and continuously assess the asset health of mechanical systems using condition monitoring data and process indicators, identifying degradation patterns by correlating equipment condition (vibration, temperature, oil analysis, wear) with process variables (load, throughput, variability), and developing and implementing strategies to improve asset stability and operating envelope control. * Lead reliability improvement and defect elimination efforts for mechanical systems, systematically identifying and resolving chronic failures, and facilitating comprehensive Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) that incorporates both mechanical and process\-related contributors to drive sustainable performance gains. * Develop and optimize preventive and predictive maintenance strategies for mechanical assets using RCM and FMEA principles, ensuring maintenance activities are aligned with actual asset health, criticality, and failure modes to maximize reliability and operational effectiveness * Lead the development and advancement of condition monitoring and diagnostic programs for mechanical assets (including vibration, oil analysis, thermography, ultrasonics, and NDT), interpreting data to diagnose failure modes and drive corrective actions, while deploying AI\-driven technologies to continuously monitor critical asset health and optimize Remaining Useful Life (RUL). * Integrate process reliability with mechanical asset performance by partnering with Operations to identify process\-driven reliability risks (e.g., instability, overloading, improper operating conditions), and defining and optimizing operating windows to protect equipment and enhance overall reliability. * Provide reliability engineering expertise in capital projects and equipment design, ensuring reliability, maintainability, and lifecycle cost effectiveness are embedded into new installations and modifications to support long\-term asset performance. * Leverage data analysis and reliability modeling to enhance mechanical asset performance, utilizing KPIs and statistical tools (MTBF, MTTR, Weibull analysis, SPC) to identify trends and failure patterns, and translating data into actionable insights that drive continuous reliability improvement. Support risk and asset strategy for mechanical systems, contributing to asset criticality assessments and lifecycle asset management (LCAM) strategies, while prioritizing maintenance and capital investments based on risk, asset condition, and business impact to optimize long\-term reliability and performance. * **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering required * 7\+ yrs of experience in reliability, maintenance, or process engineering in an industrial environment * Experience in steel or similar process\-based manufacturing environments / Six Sigma Green Belt or higher Required or obtained within the first year of employment * **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES** * Strong understanding of: Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), jobs.title: Data Integration Engineer (Utility Operations)
jobs.description: **Data Integration Engineer** Utility Operations Over J Consulting connects engineering information, operational processes and data for utility and infrastructure clients. We are hiring a hands\-on developer who can take ownership of inherited workflows and turn disconnected data into reliable, maintainable outputs. You will work in a small delivery team, report to the CEO, and collaborate directly with analysts, engineers and operational users. The role combines practical development, data reconciliation and independent execution within agreed scope. Employment: Full\-Time Employment Location: Downtown Los Angeles, CA **What you will own** ===================== * Translate operational questions into a bounded delivery plan with sources, target outputs, business rules, acceptance checks, dependencies and an estimate. * Diagnose inherited spreadsheets, scripts and workflows. Map dependencies and failure points, preserve required behavior and make one improvement at a time where appropriate. * Write and maintain SQL, Python and Excel or Power Query transformations. Map fields, match identifiers and reconcile input to output across disconnected datasets. * Connect approved systems using APIs, database connections or automated file transfers. Handle authentication, schema changes, retries, duplicate delivery and partial failures. * Expose missing, invalid, conflicting, stale or misidentified data. Maintain mappings, data definitions, exception records and traceable approved resolutions. * Use version control, review, meaningful tests and monitoring. Maintain reproducible environments, protected configuration and safe rerun and recovery procedures. * Document setup, dependencies, checks and operating instructions. Demonstrate that another colleague can run and support the work. * Ask precise questions, explain limitations, raise scope and capacity risks early, and measure operational value. Coordinate changes with Engineering, Operations and IT. Engineering judgments, security and infrastructure approvals, live equipment changes and commercial commitments remain with their designated owners. Support hours, priorities and concurrent assignments are agreed for the work. **What you must bring** ======================= * At least five years of relevant professional experience in data integration, workflow automation, data engineering or software delivery, including recent hands\-on development. * Strong SQL, including joins, type handling, nulls, duplicate detection and validation. Advanced Excel with repeatable Power Query transformations or an equivalent tool. * Practical Python: read, debug, modify and test existing Python workflows, including code you did not write. Other scripting languages are valuable additions. * Practical API or systems integration, including authentication, schema or data contract concepts, failure handling and source\-to\-target reconciliation. * Personal delivery of at least two operational integrations or automations, including an inherited workflow you improved and supported. Explain your contribution, checks and result. * Git or equivalent version control, reproducible setup, controlled changes and documentation another person has successfully used. * Independent execution of scoped work, reliable follow\-through, respectful teamwork and a constructive response to review. Maintain existing tools willingly and escalate unresolved rules early. A relevant degree is useful; equivalent demonstrated professional experience is equally relevant. The experience minimum applies overall, not separately to every tool. **Experience that strengthens your application** ================================================ IoT and telemetry experience is a valued differentiator. Show how you connected or supported device data, handled asset identity, timestamps, units or freshness, and helped an operator make a useful decision. Lack of this experience does not disqualify an otherwise qualified candidate. Other useful experience includes utility or regulated work; materials, supply chain or asset data; SAP, Maximo or GIS; Power BI, Power Apps or SharePoint; PDF/OCR; cloud or containers; and Jira workflow configuration. Track requirements and exceptions reliably; a specific tracking platform is not a hiring gate. **Early success and selection** =============================== By day 30, independently operate one selected existing workflow with accepted checks and recovery instructions. By day 60, operate a second workflow and complete a tested handover. By day 90, demonstrate a measured operational improvement. These milestones use bounded assignments with required access and reviewer support. Provide a résumé and two brief examples of work you personally delivered. Use sanitized examples or descriptions and protect employer\-confidential information. Finalists complete a paid, time\-limited exercise and a live review. Agreed Pacific\-time collaboration is required. Reasonable adjustments to the selection process are available.

jobs.title: Senior Facilities Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra\-low\-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore. The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries. ### **About the Job** Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean's harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention. Panthalassa is expanding across multiple sites to support manufacturing, testing, R\&D, and land\-based compute. As new power arrives at each site, it has to be distributed safely and reliably, in a way that can keep growing without rework. As our Senior Facilities Electrical Engineer, you will own the electrical distribution systems inside our facilities, from the main service switchgear to the loads it serves. You will be Panthalassa's technical authority for how our buildings are powered: setting standards, reviewing designs, planning cutovers in operating facilities, tracking capacity, and keeping systems safe and reliable long after energization. You'll work closely with our Senior Power Infrastructure Engineer, who brings new utility service to each site. You take it from there. This role is about owning facility electrical systems over their lifetime, not installing individual tools or production equipment. Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. ### **Responsibilities** * Own the electrical distribution systems at each site, including customer\-owned medium\-voltage equipment once energized, and serve as the owner's technical authority for how they are designed, modified, and operated. * Track usable capacity across switchgear, transformers, feeders, and panels, and provide measured demand and capacity data to inform site\-level power forecasts and upgrade plans. * Translate manufacturing, test, R\&D, and compute needs into distribution plans and phased facility upgrades that scale without rework. * Set owner\-side design standards for distribution equipment, standby and backup power, labeling, documentation, and maintainability. * Lead technical review of designs, power system studies (short\-circuit, coordination, arc\-flash), equipment selections, submittals, and field changes with engineers of record and contractors. * Coordinate electrical design with cooling, controls, space planning, and operations, particularly for high\-density compute and power\-intensive test loads. * Plan and lead shutdowns, cutovers, and energizations in occupied facilities with minimal disruption to operations. * Diagnose power quality issues, failures, and reliability risks; set maintenance priorities by system criticality and plan for spares and replacements. * Own the electrical safety program, including energy control/LOTO, arc\-flash labeling, and NFPA 70E practices, in partnership with EH\&S and Site Operations. * Maintain accurate single\-line diagrams, panel schedules, equipment records, and capacity information across all sites. * Evaluate the condition and capacity of electrical distribution during due diligence on prospective facilities. ### **Required Qualifications** * A degree in electrical engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience owning electrical systems in complex facilities. * At least five years of responsibility for electrical distribution systems in industrial, manufacturing, laboratory, data center, or similarly technical facilities. * Owner\-side, facility engineering, or engineer\-of\-record experience with a facility's distribution system as a whole, not only individual equipment installations. * Experience with low\- and medium\-voltage distribution, including transformers, switchgear, panelboards, and protective devices. * Experience leading shutdowns, cutovers, or upgrades in operating facilities. * Ability to develop and review single\-line diagrams, panel schedules, electrical drawings, and power system studies. * Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70E, and OSHA electrical safety requirements. * Experience directing external designers and contractors through design, installation, and commissioning. ### **Desired Qualifications** * Experience with standby generation, UPS, or energy storage systems. * Experience with data center, high\-density compute, or power\-intensive test facilities. * Experience building or running arc\-flash and electrical maintenance programs (NFPA 70E/70B). * Experience owning electrical systems across multiple sites. * Professional Engineer or Engineer\-in\-Training certification. The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed. ### **Additional Requirements** * Travel to vendors and test sites as needed * Intermittently able to work longer hours and weekends to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work\-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours. ### **Compensation and Benefits** If hired for this full\-time role, you will receive: * Cash compensation of $160,000 \- $210,000\. * Equity in the company. We're all owners and if we're successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation. * A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: + Flexible paid time off + Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold\-level PPO plan for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long\-term financial support if you become disabled) + Ability to contribute to tax\-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA * Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed). ### **Location** This is an on\-site position. Our offices, lab, and shop are located inPortland, Oregon.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Fullstack
jobs.description: PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI\-powered pathology. Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. We have a track record of success in deploying AI algorithms for histopathology in translational research, pathology labs and clinical trials. Rigorous science and careful analysis are critical to the success of everything we do. Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems and making a huge impact on patient outcomes. We believe in using the best tool for the job and are constantly evaluating our tech stack. Our current tools include: * Python * Vue.js * Django \+ DRF * Docker * AWS: EKS, S3, RDS/PostgreSQL, SQS, MSK/Kafka **The Opportunity** ------------------- We're looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to be a technical leader on the team building AISight, our digital pathology platform used by pathologists and labs worldwide. This is a fullstack role, but we don't expect equal depth everywhere. We want someone with deep expertise in either frontend or backend who works comfortably across the whole stack. You will set technical direction for the platform, take on our hardest cross\-cutting problems, and raise the bar for the engineers around you. * You will own the architecture of major areas of the platform and drive technical strategy in line with the product roadmap, balancing near\-term delivery against long\-term scalability and maintainability. * You will lead the design and delivery of complex, multi\-team initiatives from ambiguous problem definition through production. That means writing and reviewing technical designs, finding risks early, and making tradeoffs explicit. * You will stay hands\-on, writing production code on the most critical and technically demanding parts of the system. * You will set and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, observability, security and performance across codebases, and drive improvements to our development practices and tooling. * You will work with product, design, machine learning, infrastructure, QA and regulatory teams to make sure the software we ship is reliable, protects data integrity and patient data, and meets the requirements of a regulated medical device environment, including design controls and validation. * You will mentor senior and mid\-level engineers, grow technical leadership on the team, and help shape how we hire and onboard. * You will represent engineering in conversations with customers, partners and stakeholders, explaining complex technical concepts to non\-experts. **Who You Are (Required)** -------------------------- * You have a BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a closely related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * You have 8\+ years of full lifecycle software development experience, including significant time in a senior or technical lead role. * You have a track record of architecting and shipping large\-scale production systems, and of leading technical initiatives across team boundaries. * You have deep expertise in at least one of these areas, and working proficiency in the other: * Backend: designing and building Python\-based applications and APIs (Django or FastAPI), data modeling, relational databases (PostgreSQL) and distributed or event\-driven systems. * Frontend: building writing, sound judgment and collaboration, not authority. * You have excellent communication skills and can work effectively with a distributed team and with non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred** large image and data visualization (e.g., whole\-slide image viewers, WebGL or canvas rendering). * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitLab CI). * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience with an infrastructure\-as\-code framework (e.g., Terraform, CDK). * Experience integrating ML models or AI\-powered features into production applications. This is a hybrid position based in Boston, MA. Relocation benefits are not available for this position. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location Boston, MA is $146,250 – $224,250\. jobs.description: **About Patronus AI** --------------------- Patronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human\-aligned AGI. * Actively participate in backend programming, debugging, application development, and code reviews. * Provide technical direction and oversight to internal developers and external technical resources. * Work closely with company leadership to prioritize development initiatives and translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Establish sound development practices, documentation, testing procedures, and deployment processes. * Evaluate existing architecture and recommend improvements that increase reliability, performance, security, and scalability. * Manage development priorities and help ensure projects are delivered on schedule. **Linux Server Administration \& Infrastructure** * Administer, maintain, secure, and troubleshoot production Linux server environments. * Monitor server health, resource utilization, uptime, and application performance. * Diagnose and resolve server, application, networking, and infrastructure issues. * Configure and optimize web servers and supporting services. * Implement appropriate server security, patching, monitoring, backup, and recovery practices. * Support application deployments, production releases, and infrastructure improvements. * Respond to urgent production issues and help minimize service interruptions. **Backend Development \& API Integrations** * Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot backend application functionality. * Build and support JSON/REST APIs and integrations with internal and external systems. * Diagnose application errors, integration failures, and performance bottlenecks. * Work with existing custom codebases and improve their maintainability and reliability. * Support integrations between e\-commerce websites, internal applications, vendors, and third\-party services. **Database Development \& Optimization** * Work extensively with Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and other SQL\-based database environments. * Troubleshoot database performance, inefficient queries, and data\-related application issues. * Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and database integrations. * Support database architecture, data integrity, security, and reliability. * production issues affecting website functionality, performance, and customer experience. * Support web server configuration, application deployment, and ongoing production operations. * Collaborate with business stakeholders to implement new website features, integrations, and operational improvements. * Help ensure our platforms remain secure, reliable, scalable, and available. Required Qualifications * 10\+ years of professional software development and/or systems engineering experience. * Demonstrated experience leading software development projects or technical teams. * Advanced Linux server administration, troubleshooting, security, and performance optimization skills. * Strong backend programming skills, including the ability to understand, debug, and improve existing applications. * Significant experience with Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, SQL development, and database performance troubleshooting. * Experience developing, maintaining, and integrating JSON/REST APIs. * Strong understanding of web server configuration, deployment processes, and production application support. * Experience supporting established, custom\-built e\-commerce websites or other business\-critical web applications. * Familiarity with application architecture, version control, testing, and software deployment practices. * Ability to troubleshoot complex issues spanning application code, databases, servers, and integrations. * Strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a team. * Dependability, accountability, and willingness to respond to urgent production issues when necessary. Preferred Qualifications * Experience modernizing legacy applications without disrupting ongoing business operations. * Familiarity with e\-commerce order processing, ERP systems, inventory management, and payment integrations. * Experience managing production web infrastructure and improving website security. * Familiarity with cloud hosting, infrastructure monitoring, automation, and CI/CD processes. * Experience in a growing, entrepreneurial, mid\-sized company. * Proven ability to balance hands\-on technical contributions with team leadership and project management.
