jobs.title: Associate Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Provectus is a **Premier AWS partner** and an **Anthropic Preferred Partner** at the forefront of applied AI, helping enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide. Our work centers on two verticals — Financial Services \& Insurance and Healthcare \& Life Sciences — where we deploy five pre\-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code. You'll learn the customer's job before you automate it. Most AI projects fail the same way: someone gathers requirements, someone writes a spec, and a team ships a workflow nobody uses. We think the requirements step is the bug. So we remove it. As an **Associate Forward Deployed Engineer,** you'll join each engagement paired with a Senior FDE. Together you'll spend time alongside the client to understand their workflow and business needs. Then you'll help rebuild that work from first principles, and write real production code for it. You won't start from zero: every engagement begins from a Blueprint that has already shipped for a customer in that industry, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. This role is for early\-career engineers who want to learn how AI gets deployed in the real world — and who'd rather learn by building than by watching. ### **What You'll Need:** * A degree in computer science, engineering or another STEM field * 0–2 years of experience; internships, co\-ops and research * You built projects, where you integrated AI as a part of your SDLC (internship, research or hackathon entry) that you can walk us through in depth: what worked, what broke, and what you'd change * Hands\-on Claude Code basics * Strong programming fundamentals in Python or TypeScript * Curiosity and speed of learning — you pick up unfamiliar subjects quickly and ask good questions, especially about how real businesses work * Good commication skills \- ability to explain complex technical subjects to non\-engineers * Willingness to spend real time learning a client's job before you write code. It's the most unusual part of this role, and the most valuable * Location \& Work Arrangement: This role requires **working on\-site from our New York office 3 days per week** ### **Great If You Have:** * Cloud basics: AWS/Azure/GCP, containers, CI/CD AI/ML coursework or foundations * Comfort with ambiguity — our engagements start open\-ended by design Interest or coursework in financial services, insurance, healthcare or asset management * Data pipelines or SQL; classical ML or MLOps (PyTorch, SageMaker, MLflow); infrastructure\-as\-code * Open\-source contributions, hackathon projects or public writing on applied AI * Claude certification or AWS certification ### **What You'll Learn:** * How to deploy LLM and agentic systems into regulated production — banks, insurers, health systems * How to build evaluation harnesses: defining what "working" means, then measuring it * Cloud delivery on AWS Claude Code in production, working toward Claude certification * A real business domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset management * How to work with clients: their operators, engineers and executives ### **Your first 90 days:** * Foundations — onboarding into our Blueprints, our delivery stack (Claude Code, AWS) and how we build evals, plus a primer on your first client's industry * The seat — join an engagement with your senior FDE. jobs.title: Managing Director USA (f/m/d)
jobs.description: **Description** =============== QuantumDiamonds is looking for an exceptional **Managing Director USA** to lead the next stage of our growth in the US semiconductor market. Our quantum sensing\-based inspection systems are already being deployed with leading semiconductor players across the US, Asia, and Europe. With a growing installed base and wafer\-level evaluations progressing with major semiconductor manufacturers, we are entering an exciting new phase: scaling commercial adoption of our QDm.1 systems while bringing our technology from the failure analysis lab closer to the semiconductor production line. As Managing Director USA, you will drive both ambitions. *On one side, you will turn existing customer deployments and technical evaluations into repeatable equipment sales, strategic accounts, and long\-term partnerships. On the other side, you will help advance our lab\-to\-fab development agreements*, working with Tier 1 semiconductor manufacturers to enable wafer\-level inspection. This is not a traditional country management role. You will be our senior commercial and strategic representative in the US, combining direct customer engagement, business development, and organizational leadership. You will work closely with our founders and engineering teams in Munich, with substantial ownership of how QuantumDiamonds grows in one of our most important markets. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, where we already have customer deployments, you will build on existing relationships, open new opportunities, and develop the local organization needed to support our expanding business. We are looking for *someone with deep semiconductor industry expertise, strong commercial instincts, and a genuine builder mentality*. Someone who can navigate complex equipment sales, engage credibly with senior engineering leaders, and turn breakthrough technology into a scalable business. **Who we are** ============== Founded in 2022 as a spin\-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three\-dimensional current maps within multi\-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top\-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long\-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale \- and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. **Why join QuantumDiamonds?** ============================= **Picture this:** ----------------- * Quantum sensors that see *inside* the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. * Nobel\-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. * Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. * An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. **Still unsure about why joining us?** -------------------------------------- * You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. * From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. * Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. * You’ll be part of a high\-growth company backed by top\-tier investors. **Let’s make the invisible visible!** ------------------------------------- **What will you do** ==================== ### **Own commercial growth of our lab systems** * Own the US commercial strategy for our lab systems, called QDm.1, turning existing installations, customer evaluations, and market interest into repeatable equipment sales. * Develop and expand strategic accounts across semiconductor manufacturers, advanced packaging companies, failure analysis labs, and other relevant customers. * Lead complex equipment sales cycles, from initial engagement and technical qualification through commercial negotiations, purchase orders, and follow\-on business. * Build strong relationships with technical decision\-makers, budget owners, and procurement teams, understanding what drives investment decisions and how to move opportunities forward. * Develop a reliable sales pipeline, clear account plans, and realistic forecasts, with accountability for commercial performance and revenue growth. * Identify opportunities to expand our installed base through additional systems, new customer sites, and broader adoption within existing accounts. * Work closely hand\-in\-hand with existing local distributors for cross\- and upselling opportunities ### **Own existing JDAs with Tier 1 US chipmakers moving from lab to fab** * Strengthen relationships with leading US semiconductor manufacturers to advance technical evaluations eally within semiconductor capital equipment, metrology, inspection, test, or failure analysis. * **Proven success selling complex semiconductor equipment**, including managing long sales cycles, strategic customer evaluations, technical qualifications, and multimillion\-dollar commercial opportunities. * Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging technologies, including HBM, chiplets, 2\.5D/3D integration, or related electrical failure analysis and debug workflows. * Familiarity with semiconductor fabs, wafer\-level processes, or inline inspection and metrology, with the ability to understand how new technologies move from technical evaluation towards manufacturing adoption. * An established network within the US semiconductor ecosystem, with relationships among relevant technical leaders, engineering decision\-makers, and strategic accounts. * Demonstrated ability to grow strategic accounts, build commercial pipelines, and convert early customer interest into sustained business. * Experience building or scaling a business, commercial organization, or customer\-facing team, ideally within an international technology or semiconductor equipment company. * Sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with semiconductor engineers, applications specialists, and R\&D teams, while translating complex technology into compelling commercial value. * Entrepreneurial mindset and a hands\-on leadership style, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-growing company where structures and processes are still evolving. * Strong commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and the ability to navigate complex customer organizations and stakeholder environments. * Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills, with the confidence to represent QuantumDiamonds at senior executive level and collaborate closely with our Munich headquarters. * **Based in or willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area**, with flexibility to travel frequently across the US and regularly to our headquarters in Munich. **Our benefits** ================ * **Mission:** At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products \- we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. * **Impact \& growth:** This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. * **Team \& culture:** We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off\-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. * **Well\-being \& balance:** Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation annually, in addition to US company\-observed public holidays. We also offer a flexible paid sick leave policy, because taking care of your health should never come at the expense of your vacation days. * **Learning \& development:** Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills. * **Ownership \& participation:** As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together. **About us** ============ QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen\-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2\.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing\-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

Certification Preferred Position Overview We are seeking a detail\-oriented **Civil Design Engineer** to support civil engineering design, site development, and plan production for a variety of land development and infrastructure projects. Key Responsibilities Civil Engineering Design \& Drafting * Prepare, develop, and revise civil engineering plans and construction documents using AutoCAD and Civil 3D. * Produce site plans, grading plans, drainage plans, utility layouts, profiles, engineering details, and technical drawings. * Perform stormwater management, drainage, and hydrologic calculations using HydroCAD or comparable software. * Assist with wastewater and septic system design and supporting documentation. * Support roadway, driveway, site access, and utility design. * Prepare engineering calculations, technical exhibits, and supporting reports. * Translate engineering concepts and project direction into accurate, coordinated plan sets. * Maintain drawing standards, organized project files, and high\-quality design deliverables. Permitting \& Regulatory Support * Prepare plans, exhibits, and technical documents required for municipal, state, and environmental permitting. * Assist with responses to municipal review comments, regulatory requirements, and peer\-review feedback. * Update plans based on client feedback, agency comments, and internal reviews. * Coordinate with environmental and permitting professionals to ensure designs address applicable site constraints and regulatory requirements. * Participate in site visits, field investigations, and municipal meetings as needed. Professional Development * Develop independent civil engineering design capabilities through hands\-on project experience and mentorship. * Pursue Engineer\-in\-Training (E.I.T.) certification, if not already obtained, and work toward Professional Engineer (P.E.) licensure. * Build skills in technical coordination, project execution, and client communication. * Progress toward greater technical responsibility and potential Project Management opportunities. Types of Projects * Residential and commercial land development * Subdivisions and redevelopment projects * Municipal and public infrastructure * Site planning and permitting * Stormwater management and drainage systems * Wastewater and septic systems * Coastal and waterfront developments * Trails, parks, and recreational facilities * Environmental restoration and resiliency projects Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field preferred. * Approximately 2\+ years of relevant experience in civil engineering, civil design, site development, or land development preferred. * Demonstrated experience with AutoCAD; proficiency in Civil 3D strongly preferred. * Ability to read and interpret surveys, engineering plans, and technical documentation. * Working knowledge of site grading, drainage, stormwater management, and land development design. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate, high\-quality plan production. * Excellent organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams. Preferred Qualifications * Engineer\-in\-Training (E.I.T.) certification. * Experience preparing civil/site plans using survey data. * Experience with HydroCAD or comparable stormwater modeling software. * Familiarity with Massachusetts land development, permitting, and municipal approval processes. * Exposure to wastewater design, utility coordination, and construction documentation. Compensation \& Benefits * Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications. * Performance\-based bonus opportunities. * Health, dental, vision, and life insurance. * Retirement savings program. * Paid vacation, holidays, and personal/sick time. * Continuing education, professional development, and E.I.T./P.E. licensure support. * Hands\-on mentorship from experienced engineers and multidisciplinary professionals. * Opportunities for career advancement and increased technical and project management responsibilities. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a motivated civil engineering professional who enjoys hands\-on design and drafting, has a strong foundation in site development, and is eager to grow technically. Candidates with AutoCAD/Civil 3D experience, an understanding of survey\-based plan production, and familiarity with stormwater design and Massachusetts permitting will be especially well suited for this role. **Interested candidates are encouraged to apply with an updated resume.**

jobs.title: Lead Engineer (Full-Stack) | Regenics LLC
jobs.description: **The short version** Regenics is a health clinic and telehealth company based in Los Angeles: a nationwide telehealth platform for weight management, hormone optimization, peptides, and longevity care, plus a 5,000 sq ft health\-optimization clinic in the West San Fernando Valley (moving to a new space in Woodland Hills). We are building our own platform, and we need one person to own it. This is not a role on an engineering team. You are the engineering team. You report directly to the founder. The platform is built with AI\-assisted development, and you will work the same way: you direct the AI, you review everything it writes, and you own what ships. There is no Product Manager. You decide what ships and you ship it. **The honest state of things** The platform is a from\-scratch rebuild on Cloudflare Workers that is already running in staging: about 36,000 lines of JavaScript, 50\+ database migrations, 40\+ Playwright end\-to\-end flows, a complete patient funnel, patient portal, provider workspace, back office, encrypted PHI, and first\-party analytics. We built it fast, with AI, on a very small team, and it has never had a full\-time owner. Payments still run in mock mode, the pharmacy integration is a stub, and the systems it replaces (a WordPress site and a contractor\-built platform) still carry live patients until we cut over. Your job is the last 20%: make it real, make it safe, and move the business onto it. Then keep it moving. **The stack** * Cloudflare Workers (JavaScript), one Worker serving the site and the API * D1 (SQLite) with versioned migrations, KV for rate limiting, R2 for documents, Analytics Engine, Cron Triggers * Static multi\-page front end: HTML and vanilla JS from a custom Node build, PWA with a service worker * Playwright for end\-to\-end QA * Authorize.net payments, Resend email, passkeys (WebAuthn), magic links, TOTP for staff * Per\-record AES\-GCM encryption for patient data, audit log on every PHI read and write **What you will own** * The platform end to end: code, database, deploys, secrets, monitoring, uptime. When something breaks at 6 p.m. Friday, it's yours. * Provider prescribing logic: the review\-and\-approve flow that decides what gets prescribed. This is the most important code in the company and the first thing you'll be asked to get right. * Payments going live on Authorize.net, including refunds and the TRT prepay rules * Pharmacy integrations: 5–6 partner 503A pharmacies, routed by state and medication, most by API, some manual * Lab ordering (Quest) and charting sync (DrChrono) * Migrating patient and order data off WordPress and the previous platform, then the production cutover of regenics.com onto the new build * The member app: wrapping the platform for iOS and Android, with in\-app purchasing * The in\-platform sales CRM, fulfillment dashboard, and corporate\-accounts dashboard * Delivery: the backlog, priorities, weekly status to the founder, and a small bench of contractors on milestones during the transition **First 90 days** * Days 1–15: take over the repo, Cloudflare account, secrets, and deploys; stand up CI; review the provider prescribing logic line by line; take Authorize.net live * Days 15–30: first pharmacy API live; data migration plan executed; cutover rehearsed on staging * Days 30\+: regenics.com cut over to the new platform; app wrapper in review; written recommendation to the founder on team shape and the six\-month roadmap **You should have** * 6\+ years building and running JavaScript web applications in production, including payments * Serverless or edge experience: Cloudflare Workers ideal; Lambda, Vercel or Deno Deploy count. You'll be reviewing and extending a live Workers codebase from week one. * Shipped AI\-generated code to production and can describe, specifically, where it fails and how you catch it * Taken over a codebase you didn't write and lived with it * Run a backlog and a release cycle for a small team without a PM * HIPAA or another regulated\-data environment (fintech counts) * A track record at small companies where you were one of one to three engineers * Able to work on\-site in Woodland Hills five days a week **Nice to have** * Cloudflare D1, KV, R2, or Durable Objects in production * Healthcare integrations: pharmacy APIs, Quest or LabCorp, DrChrono or another EHR, telehealth video * Authorize.net * Shipping a web app to the App Store and Play Store (Capacitor, PWA wrappers, or native) * Data migration out of WordPress or WooCommerce **What you get** * Base $120,000–$145,000 depending on experience, with a comp review after 90 days * Ownership of a real platform with real patients, not a feature on someone else's roadmap * Direct access to the founder and the business. No layers. * Health benefits, paid time off, and a clinic membership **How we hire** * 30\-minute call * Paid take\-home on a sanitized copy of the actual platform, 4–8 hours, $600\. AI tools welcome; we grade what you catch, not what you type. * On\-site at the clinic: we review your take\-home together, you pair live on a real ticket, and you meet the people you'll work with * Two references * Offer within 48 hours of the on\-site Whole process runs about one week. **To apply** Send your resume, a link to something you built that's live, and three sentences on the last time you took over someone else's code: what was wrong with it and what you fixed first. Applications without the three sentences won't be read. Regenics is an equal opportunity employer. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $145,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Employee discount * Health insurance * Paid time off Application Question(s): * When was the last time you took over someone else's code? * What was wrong with it? * What did you fix first? Work Location: In person

Based onsite in our Madison area facilities, you'll work closely with local business teams while leveraging the resources, expertise, and career opportunities that come with being part of the broader Madison Air organization. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing enterprise infrastructure and core systems that support business operations. As a member of the Unified IT Operations team, you will help drive enterprise alignment through shared standards, secure operating practices, and reliable service delivery. Responsibilities: The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the health, security, stability, and continuous improvement of enterprise systems and infrastructure services. This role serves as a technical lead for core platforms, supports operational excellence through standards and partners with cross\-functional teams to deliver reliable technology solutions that align with business and security requirements.### **Core Responsibilities** * Implement, administer, and support enterprise server, storage, virtualization, and cloud infrastructure platforms. * Manage and maintain Windows Server environments, directory services, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, file services, and core infrastructure components. * Support Microsoft 365 initiatives and Azure Entra ID, access controls and hybrid integration. * Administer endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune and Autopilot to support secure device provisioning, configuration, compliance, and lifecycle management. * Manage virtualization platforms and compute environments in VMware or Hyper\-V, to ensure availability, performance, and resiliency. * Monitor health of infrastructure, review alerts, refresh initiatives in accordance with change and security standards. * Partner with cybersecurity teams to implement system hardening, vulnerability remediation, secure configuration baselines, and * Experience participating in infrastructure projects, site deployments, platform modernization, and standards development.

jobs.title: Data & AI Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Build What Matters at RevStar** **Position:** Data \& AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) * **Reports To:** Product Manager/Engineering Lead * **Location**: Remote (AZ, DC, FL, GA, IA, IL, ME, NY, NJ, SC, TX, VA) * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time W2 **Job Summary** At RevStar, we build cutting\-edge cloud, data, and Generative AI solutions that transform how enterprise organizations operate. As an Advanced AWS Consulting Partner, we don’t just deliver code—we solve complex business problems, modernize legacy infrastructure, and deploy production\-grade cloud native and AI applications that drive real business value. Above all, our team operates on three core principles: * **Self\-Mastery:** We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve. * **Ownership:** We own outcomes, not just effort. * **Shared Destiny:** We rise or fall together. As an FDE, you are both a master cloud builder and a trusted technical advisor. You will own the full delivery lifecycle for high\-impact enterprise accounts—architecting resilient cloud\-native environments, modernizing legacy infrastructure, and deploying state\-of\-the\-art AWS Generative AI (Amazon Bedrock, Q, SageMaker) architectures. Partner with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Infrastructure/Engineering, and client development teams to translate complex business goals into high\-performing AWS solutions. * **Cloud Migration \& Application Modernization:** Lead large\-scale migrations from on\-premises data centers or legacy platforms to AWS (using AWS Application Migration Service, Database Migration Service, etc.) and re\-architect legacy monolithic applications into modern serverless or containerized architectures. * **AWS Generative AI \& Machine Learning:** Architect and deploy enterprise GenAI and ML workloads leveraging Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Vector Databases (OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector), and custom RAG implementations. * **Drive Platform Adoption \& Growth:** Partner with RevStar account leadership to identify new, high\-value cloud workloads within client accounts, driving AWS consumption expansion and clear ROI for client executive stakeholders. * **Technical Mentorship \& Practice Building:** Coach and mentor Cloud Engineers and Solutions Architects. Drive internal RevStar accelerators, reusable Terraform modules, AWS Well\-Architected Review frameworks, and cloud delivery best practices. **Requirements** Qualifications \& RequirementsTechnical Expertise:* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in Cloud Architecture, DevOps/SRE, or Software Engineering with a focus on AWS. * 3\+ years in a client\-facing consulting, Solutions Architecture, or Forward Deployed Engineering role. * Deep AWS Core Expertise: Mastery across core AWS services (IAM, VPC, EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFront, Route 53\). * Infrastructure as Code (IaC) \& CI/CD: Expert\-level proficiency in Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation, along with automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline). * AWS GenAI \& Data Services: Practical experience with Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Glue, Redshift, or OpenSearch for building data platforms and AI solutions. * AWS Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional required. Specialty certifications (Security, Machine Learning, Data Analytics) are a plus. Client \& Business Acumen:* Enterprise Track Record: Proven experience leading technical delivery for Fortune 500 or mid\-market enterprise clients (Healthcare, Financial Services, Retail, or SaaS). * Consulting \& Communication Skills: Outstanding verbal and written communication; adept at whiteboarding complex architectures, building working POCs/demos, and presenting to C\-level executives. * Growth Mindset: Ability to spot technical expansion opportunities, conduct AWS Well\-Architected Reviews, and advocate for cloud modernization to expand account footprint. **Benefits** * **Paid Time Off** – Take the time you need to recharge and stay productive. * **Remote\-First Working Environment** – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team. * **Comprehensive Health Coverage** – Medical, Dental, Vision * **401(k) Retirement Plan** – Plan for your future with access to a company\-sponsored 401(k) program. * **Annual Learning \& Development Stipend** – Invest in your skills with conferences, certifications, or courses. * **Peer Mentorship \& Coaching** – Learn from experienced engineers, product managers, and architects to accelerate your growth. * **Professional Growth Opportunities** – Exposure to cutting\-edge AWS GenAI, data, and cloud technologies across diverse industries. * **Company Outings \& Volunteer Opportunities** – Build relationships and give back to the community. * **Collaborative, Innovative Culture** – Work alongside top talent in a fast\-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative. **Equal Opportunity Employment** At RevStar, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate them, we support them, and we thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our customers, and our community. RevStar is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. **Reasonable Accommodations** RevStar is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering - VALORANT, Player Dynamics
jobs.description: Riot engineers bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas but also value the opportunity to work in many broader domains. As a Software Engineering Manager on the Player Dynamics team, you'll also dive into projects that focus on team cohesiveness and cross\-team goals. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary leadership team to lead a small, passionate team of developers in the delivery of exciting new features for VALORANT and our players. **VALORANT is Riot's take on a character\-based tactical shooter (for more info on VALORANT** **click here****!)**. In this role on the VALORANT Player Dynamics team, you will be responsible for building and improving the full stack of Player Dynamics features in VALORANT: from scalable backend services to performant game client and server tech. You'll own the technical direction for how VALORANT features are built, scale, and are operated in production. You will collaborate heavily with Design, Data Analytics, and Product Management to build in and out of game systems that create new and exciting ways to engage with VALORANT. All the systems you design and build will bring players together and ensure their gaming experience is safe and free of disruptive behavior. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Create, review, and reframe an engineering vision with the team and key stakeholders including the Technology, Product, and Process Leads. * Be excited to span the entire VALORANT tech stack \- from our golang services and infrastructure internals, to our game client in C\+\+ and UE5 blueprints. We're not looking for someone who's an expert across the board, but if you want to stick to your expertise / comfort zone this position may not be for you. * Implement server infrastructure in support of new features. * Collaborate effectively with art, design, and other disciplines within game development. * Identify, recruit, interview, and hire software engineers to help teams scale effectively. * Provide technical expertise throughout the product life cycle including design, implementation, and delivery of features while continuously improving the software engineering quality and efficiency. * Build and manage strong relationships between disciplines * Lead, grow, and coach team members to build talent over the long term * Demonstrate a high bar of craft excellence for your team * Cultivate your team's culture of collaboration, creativity and passion for game making * Partner closely with shared teams at Riot that provide cross game capabilities for things like player inventory **Required Qualifications:** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience as a Software Engineer * 2\+ years experience directly leading an engineering team either as an Engineering Manager or Technical Lead \& mentor. * 1\+ years of experience with C\+\+ * 1\+ years professional experience building distributed systems at scale * Experience working in the games industry * Familiarity working in an agile environment * Experience collaborating across departments and disciplines to create solutions. * Interest in developing high reliability systems that players use to acquire content **Desired Qualifications:** --------------------------- * 6\+ years of experience * 2\+ years of C\+\+ experience * Experience working on competitive multiplayer games * Experience with Unreal Engine * Deep Engagement with the Shooter Genre * Experience with social or player dynamics systems, in games or not *For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision\-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!* **Our Perks:** -------------- Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our **benefits pages** for more information. At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you're working directly on a new player\-facing experience or you're supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we're better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we're looking forward to your application. *It's our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. jobs.title: Lead Marketing Engineer
jobs.description: At Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. It's big, it's bold, and we're already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. If you're ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value. **THE WORK:** Ripple is hiring a Lead Full Stack Engineer, Marketing to join our growing team. You will assume a vital, strategic role in establishing the technical vision and framework for Ripple's marketing technology platform. Through creating dynamic, high\-performing, and globally scalable experiences, you will directly boost our go\-to\-market efforts and support our internal teams. This role is perfect for an AI\-forward engineering leader who thrives where technology, growth marketing, and data converge. Operating at a Staff/Lead level, you will partner closely with Growth, Marketing Operations, and Data teams to invent scalable solutions. These solutions will allow fast experimentation, increase user acquisition, and gather actionable analytics. You will lead by example through hands\-on coding, system development, and cross\-functional leadership. jobs.description: We are seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to play a foundational role in building and deploying our next\-generation Large Driving Model (LDM) for the Rivian Autonomy stack. To solve this, we are leveraging massive\-scale Machine Learning powered by millions of miles of driving data. In this highly impactful role, you will own a full vertical of the LDM lifecycle, from large\-scale data curation and post\-training pipelines through to rigorous evaluation to implement and perfect specific, advanced driving capabilities. As a Staff Engineer, you will lead the AI strategy for these capabilities, serving as a primary technical authority. Your work will directly translate to the daily experience, comfort, and safety of our customers, which is critical to the core mission at Rivian. Establish best practices for the broader LDM team. * **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Display the ability to influence technical roadmaps and foster consensus across perception, planning, and platform teams, even during challenging technical discussions. * **Production Focus:** Take charge of deploying, supervising, and enhancing the real\-world, on\-road performance of your models as they transition from the development phase into customer vehicles. * M.S. or Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field. * 7\+ years of industry experience working on complex, production\-grade Machine Learning systems, with a track record of operating at a Staff or Lead level. * Expert\-level knowledge and hands\-on experience with Python and PyTorch. Experience with large\-scale distributed training frameworks is highly preferred. * Deep expertise in state\-of\-the\-art foundation models, post\-training paradigms (fine\-tuning, alignment), and approaches for perception, prediction, or planning in the autonomous driving or robotics space. * Proven ability to own full ML data verticals, demonstrating mastery over data curation, synthetic data generation, and building robust evaluation frameworks for complex behavioral models. * Solid foundational understanding of linear algebra, geometry, optimization, algorithms, and data structures. * Exceptional communication skills with a demonstrated ability to set technical direction, guide the team toward it, and build consensus in a fast\-paced environment. * Passionately motivated to take ambiguous, complex ideas from development and validation all the way to a verified, shipping product. * Hands\-on approach: Proactively identifies systemic gaps, writes critical path code, and fills in technical voids where needed. * Prior experience with Automotive Self\-Driving stacks or similarly complex, safety\-critical Robotics Systems.

jobs.description: **About Us** ============ **Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. This role also supports agent governance and lifecycle management through Agent 365\. This hands\-on role focuses on implementing declarative and prompt\-based agents, custom\-engine agents, and enterprise integrations while helping customers establish governed, scalable environments for agent development and lifecycle management. Responsibilities include configuring Power Platform environment strategies, implementing zoned governance, developing agents across Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry, and supporting secure agent operations across Power Platform and Azure. The role also supports Agent 365 onboarding activities, including configuring conditional access policies, enabling agent lifecycle workflows, and implementing key governance and security capabilities across the Microsoft 365 admin center, Microsoft Entra Agent ID, Microsoft Purview, and Microsoft Defender. jobs.title: Junior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview:** ARE you a junior software engineer who wants to understand how software actually works, not just how to make it compile? Are you the type of person who reads the stack trace before asking, who wants to know *why* the system is built the way it is, and who would rather learn from engineers with decades of production scars than from a tutorial? If you are early in your career and craving the kind of environment where you become exceptional rather than merely employed, this could be the opportunity for you. **About Sound Decisions:** This position is posted by Sound Decisions Recruiting on behalf of a client. Sound Decisions is a technical recruiting firm led by a software engineer, focused on matching engineering talent with strong teams. **Written From the Perspective of Our Client:** We focus on building highly scalable, reliable merchant payment technologies using the latest, most reliable technologies and engineering practices. We use modern AI tools to accelerate implementation, improve documentation and increase test coverage. AI is an engineering aid, not a substitute for judgment, communication, review or accountability. Our philosophy is explicit: AI exists to make the engineers already here more capable as they grow, and it is judged on whether it does. The core belief is that we grow through great minds, discussions and collaborations, and success is driven through a series of great judgments and decisions by people who love the craft of creating software. This role exists to give you Silicon Valley startup experience inside a structured, deliberate learning environment: a small senior team, real production scope early, and the time and mentorship to develop into an exceptional engineer. Your purpose in the first year is to develop a great understanding of the craft and excellent debugging skills, so that you become the bulwark between what AI produces and what reaches a customer. **What experience we're looking for:** * Working knowledge of software development fundamentals: data structures, complexity, state, and how a request moves from a browser to a database and back. We care more about how you reason than how long you have been paid to do it; there is no minimum years requirement. * Experience with, or demonstrated ability to learn, TypeScript and full\-stack web development. * Familiarity with Git and the core concepts of pull requests, merging, branching and code review. * A decent level of maturity with AI coding tools: you have used them on in personal or open source projects, you have been burned by them at least once, and you can describe what you check before you trust the output. * The ability to work independently on defined tasks while asking for help when appropriate, and the judgment to tell the difference. * Comparable experience counts. Building backend or full\-stack applications with Node.js and TypeScript is directly relevant; Scala and functional programming are valuable but not required. (Note: this experience does not have to come from a professional setting, but the expectation is that it can be delivered at a professional level.) **We expect** **You are learning Managing Up (working with your lead and senior engineers):** * Develop how to understand priorities: know which ticket matters this week and why. * Learn to provide solutions, not just problems: arrive with what you tried, what you found, and what you think. * Learn to anticipate needs: if a change touches the portal, you already checked who consumes it. * Build credibility: small promises kept, every time. **You will develop and learn** **The craft:** * How to debug from first principles: read the trace, form a hypothesis, isolate, prove it, then fix it. This is the skill AI cannot do for you and the one that makes you valuable. * How production payments software is designed for correctness under rules that change. * How a functional\-programming codebase (Scala) thinks, and why a type system is a design tool rather than a chore. * How to get precise, measurable output from AI tooling: clean instructions, scoped sessions, verification before merge. * How to write documentation and tests that a stranger can trust six months later. **What behaviors define success in this role:** * Attention to detail and the ability to spot ambiguities * proficient managing your time and accountable for your actions. * Great at communicating: clear writing and speaking in all channels, an active listener, and the wisdom to understand (OR ask) the forum in which ideas and concepts should be challenged. * Able to explain what you built and why to a senior engineer and to a business counterpart without hiding behind jargon. * Able to work with guidance, balance multiple activities, and meet deadlines, and to take instruction and turn it into shipped code without needing it repeated. * Operating with integrity. * Considerate of who's in the room and who needs to be in the room. * Taking notes in meetings for yourself and  open\-source experience building full\-stack applications, APIs, integrations or workflow automation. * Prior experience in a startup or similarly fast\-moving environment. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools with a willingness to learn responsible review, testing and security practices. * Fintech or e\-commerce domain exposure. **Shared values:** * The team understands that a bug can take hours and a new feature can take minutes with AI, and has the ability to weigh those efforts correctly. Lines of code does not make the engineer, nor do shiny new buttons. * Committed to developing implementations of repeatable success through coding standards, knowledge repositories for AI, and implementing reliable, consistent solutions. * Retrospective learning on what can be done better in the future. * A dedication to quality assurance using the latest tooling, and a commitment to higher reliability and coverage through research\-driven, best\-practice implementations. * A commitment to delivering value to our customers through great engineering. **Role responsibilities:** * Contribute to software development across multiple projects and languages. * Maintain existing systems and implement new features in a full\-stack capacity. * Help translate product and business workflow requirements into practical software solutions. * Support prototyping of new products and integrations, including reference implementations and UML\-based integration mappings. * Create and maintain clear User Guides, API documentation, and implementation documentation. * Write unit, functional, and automated tests with guidance from senior engineers. * Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate learning, coding, debugging, documentation, and test creation, and validate everything they produce. * Participate in Git\-based code reviews and apply feedback constructively. * Follow the concepts of an agile process and contribute to planning, delivery, and continuous improvement. * Communicate clearly, raise risks early, and collaborate with teammates across engineering and product. **Day\-to\-day:** This role carries a full\-stack title and, since everyone here uses AI first, a good share of the work is maintenance across the stack: understanding existing code, extending it safely, and keeping the services that consume our common libraries and present data to merchants reliable. Early on you will work closest to the portal and the outlying services; as you learn the system you will take on non\-architectural tickets end to end, front end and back end, and you will be in the room for the design discussions that shape them. **Interview Process (estimate 4\-5 weeks):** * SD Screening * SD Ran Technical Discussion (not a coding test) * SD Ran Behavioral * First Client Interview * Technical Discussion \+ Working Session * CEO Meeting * In\-Person Fly Out Meeting (where a member of the engineering team will come and spend time in person) **Benefits that matter to you** **Medical/Dental/Vision:** * Our client covers 85% of the employee premium for medical, dental and vision and 30% of the Dependents premium. Medical benefits are provided by Anthem Blue Cross PPO. * Basic Life Insurance * Long\-term disability * FSA * Participation is available on the 1st of the month after the start date **Team Travel \& Events:** * Twice a year travel for inperson events with the team. **Remote Work Benefits:** * Monthly shared workspace reimbursement * Monthly work from home expense reimbursement **Retirement:** * A 401k and Roth IRA provided by Betterment. * All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in the plan after 1 month of employment. * Our client has a 100% match of the first 2% of deferred compensation to eligible employees. **Vacation Policy:** * Unlimited planned vacation days **Company\-wide day off:** * Each quarter everyone in the company takes 1 day off **Growth \& Mentorship:** * A dedicated focus and environment to help you develop into a great engineer.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Data Replication Engine (C++ / Databases)
jobs.description: **About Stelo** --------------- For over 30 years Stelo's products have freed organizations from the complexities and difficulties of static data pipelines. Our software is an enterprise\-class data replication tool that delivers data dynamically from anywhere to anywhere for BI analysis, reporting, and prediction, or for managing business operations, B2B interactions, and supply chains. Stelo combines powerful, purpose\-built software with world\-class service and support. From end\-to\-end expertise and problem ownership to deep knowledge of all operating systems, platforms, and database systems, Stelo gets customers up and running and keeps them there. **Stelo Software Engineer** --------------------------- Stelo is hiring a Software Engineer to work on the engine behind our data replication platform: the software that moves live data between Db2, Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks, for customers who depend on it every day. The engine is built in C\+\+ and Java, and you will work in both. Our ideal candidate is a database engineer first and a strong C\+\+ programmer second. What sets this work apart is the database knowledge it demands. You understand how databases work, from the SQL on the surface to the drivers that carry it to the transaction logs underneath. We especially value experience with IBM Db2\. You work independently on a small remote team and own what you build through to production. You also use AI coding assistants as real leverage, as we do every day. You know what to build, you review generated code critically, and you prove it correct before it ships. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, build, test, and maintain core components of the replication engine, from capture through apply. * Integrate with a wide range of sources and targets: Db2, Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL; cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Kafka and Microsoft Fabric. * Keep replication correct, resilient, and fast across on\-premises and cloud environments, and tune data movement across CPU, memory, I/O, and network. * Work with support, QA, and product to investigate complex customer issues and ship robust, timely fixes and enhancements. * Help shape design decisions for the platform, including the internal APIs, data structures, and abstractions that simplify cross\-database support and configuration. * Write well\-documented, testable code, and review your teammates' code. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Strong SQL and a working understanding of database internals, such as transaction logs, recovery, locking and isolation, query execution, or replication. jobs.description: **Platform Reliability** ------------------------ **Level:** Staff (MTS 4\) · **Reports to:** Chief AI Officer, later the Senior Engineering Manager **The role.** Make our own platform dependable and scalable, working with the Principal Engineer. This is reliability engineering for Horizon AI’s software rather than for the GPU fleet, though the two meet when our agents are the ones being trusted with fleet actions. **You will** * Build the caching layer that stops every agent tool call from hitting external systems directly * Implement event streaming so services stop depending on synchronous HTTP chains * Harden agent dispatch: health checks, circuit breakers, retry semantics, and observability that distinguishes failure from degradation * Build observability of our own platform: service\-level metrics, tracing across services, and alerting we act on * Contribute to the orchestration migration and to infrastructure\-as\-code * Improve deployment practice: canary, traffic shifting, and real rollback **You have** * Production experience making distributed systems reliable: caching, queuing, circuit breaking, backpressure, timeouts, idempotency * Comfort in Python and containerized environments, with real exposure to Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration * Experience with event streaming and with the failure modes each option brings \- Observability depth: metrics, distributed tracing, and the judgment to alert on symptoms rather than causes * A record of shipping reliability improvements with measurable before and after **Nice to have:** durable workflow orchestration, blue/green and canary deployment at scale, performance profiling of Python services

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platform Lead (Horizon AI)
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **Data Platform Lead** ---------------------- Horizon AI is building the operating system for how organizations run themselves. The first step is autonomous data centers. A fleet of AI agents senses the state of STN’s GPU infrastructure, reasons about what it finds, and increasingly acts on it. This is running in production against real fleet data, not a prototype. Agents already take action where the risk is bounded and the outcome is verifiable. Everything riskier arrives as a recommendation for a human, and the work is moving decisions from the second category into the first, one class at a time, on evidence rather than optimism. Data centers are the proving ground, not the destination. We start here because infrastructure is measurable and unforgiving: an agent is either right, or the fleet tells you it was wrong. What we build here generalizes, and we know where it goes next. **Level:** Principal (MTS 5\) · **Reports to:** Chief AI Officer **The role.** Build the data foundation the platform reasons over. Today our agents assemble a picture of the fleet by querying several separate systems, and we cannot prove wider autonomy because we do not systematically capture how humans decide. You fix both. **The problems you inherit** * Fleet state is scattered across a relational store, a DCIM system, and multiple time\-series and monitoring systems. Each has its own query path. There is no unified model. \- No decision\-capture pipeline exists. We record what agents did, but not what operators saw, concluded, and chose. That record is the evidence base for granting agents wider autonomy. * Our retrieval pipeline is document\-oriented rather than fleet\-state\-oriented. * We consume telemetry from systems other teams operate, where retention and granularity are tuned for dashboards rather than for learning from history. **You will** * Design and build the fleet knowledge model: assets, topology, configuration, and current state, queryable by an agent in one call rather than five * Build the decision\-capture pipeline, and instrument the operator workflow so we accumulate labelled human decisions from day one * Own the data access layer that abstracts telemetry sources, so we can keep consuming today and build our own collection if that stops scaling * Negotiate our requirements with the teams who own the telemetry: signals, granularity, retention, raw event access * Own the scale path, including vector index behaviour and the analytics separation a growing schema will eventually need **You have** * Strong data modelling judgment, particularly modelling physical or infrastructure domains as something queryable * Experience with time\-series and event data at scale, including cardinality and retention trade\-offs * Depth in PostgreSQL, including vector search, and comfort with a large evolving schema \- Enough infrastructure literacy to know what a fleet actually is: nodes, GPUs, fabric, schedulers, power. Familiarity with DCIM tooling is a strong plus * A bias toward shipping a usable model early over designing a complete one **Nice to have:** GPU fleet or HPC exposure, DCGM, Slurm, entity resolution across inconsistent sources

Our technologies help detect faults, prevent equipment damage, and reduce the impact of power outages. Our mission is to make electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical. Employees contribute to practical, high\-quality solutions used every day, where attention to detail and quality directly support the reliability of the electric grid. **Location:** **Nampa, ID** – This position is located in Nampa, ID. Mechanical Engineering Technician I: $31\.00 \- $46\.00 per hour Mechanical Engineering Technician II: $33\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Mechanical Engineering Technician III: $39\.00 \- $59\.00 per hour **Communication with Applicants** We communicate with all applicants. jobs.title: VP-Distinguished Engineer of Generative AI Engineering
jobs.description: **ABOUT SLATE** At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them. **WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR** -------------------------- As the **VP – Distinguished Engineer of Generative AI Engineering** at Slate Automotive, you will be the founding architect of our GenAI capability. We are not just building an electric truck — we are building an AI\-native company. You will design, build, and ship the Generative AI systems that transform how we engineer vehicles, run manufacturing, and serve customers. This is a deeply hands\-on role: you will write code, make architectural calls, and lead by example. You will build and lead a lean, high\-leverage team of GenAI engineers, MLOps engineers, and applied scientists — and personally stay in the code — to solve challenges no one in the auto industry has cracked yet. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * **Build the GenAI Stack from Scratch:** Architect and ship the end\-to\-end GenAI platform — context layer, data layer, model serving, agent frameworks, and evaluation pipelines — on a modern cloud foundation. * **Lead by Building:** You are a player\-coach. You will recruit and grow a world\-class team of GenAI engineers, but you will stay in the code — reviewing PRs, making architecture calls, and shipping alongside your team. * **Ship Agentic Systems Across the Company:** Deploy GenAI agents across vehicle engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, software development, and GTM — converting human\-driven workflows into AI\-driven ones that run faster and cheaper. * **Build Slate’s Proprietary AI Moat:** Construct the Context Layer — a living knowledge base of agentic, human, robotic, and enterprise decisions — and the unified Data Layer that trains purpose\-built models on real Slate decisions. This IP is our long\-term competitive advantage. * **Drive GenAI into the Physical World:** Take GenAI beyond the laptop — partner with Vehicle Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to embed AI into the factory floor, design tooling, and supply chain, upgrading traditional auto manufacturing from the inside. * **Set the Standard for AI\-First Engineering:** Establish the engineering culture, standards, and practices that make Slate a destination for world\-class AI talent — and that make our GenAI output measurably better than the industry. **WHAT YOU BRING** * **12\+ years** of engineering experience, including **3\+ years** building and shipping production GenAI systems (LLM\-based applications, agents, RAG pipelines), with **5\+ years** in a senior technical leadership capacity. * **GenAI Architecture:** Deep hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), open\-source model deployment, vector databases, agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar), and prompt engineering at scale. * **MLOps \& Production Systems:** Proven track record taking GenAI from prototype to production — including evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and continuous improvement loops. * **Fine\-Tuning \& Custom Models:** Experience fine\-tuning and training purpose\-built models for domain\-specific tasks. Familiarity with the tradeoffs between hosted APIs, open\-source models, and custom training for cost, latency, and IP reasons. * **Data \& Cloud Foundation:** Solid grounding in modern data stacks (Snowflake, Databricks, dbt) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure). Comfortable reasoning about cost, latency, and data architecture as first\-class constraints. * **Academic Grounding:** BS required; MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field preferred — but exceptional track record beats pedigree every time. **SALARY RANGE** The compensation for this position is the range Slate reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job\-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; work location; and other relevant business and organizational factors. $222,431\.00 \- $370,719\.00 Base Pay Range (Annual) Additional Compensation and Benefits: Slate offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in the equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs. **WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?** At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start\-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles. * Safety First * Delight Customers * One Team * Relentless Improvement * Fast, Frugal, and Scrappy * Respectful Collaboration * Positive Legacy **WE WANT TO WORK WITH PEOPLE THAT REFLECT THE COMMUNITIES IN WHICH WE OPERATE.** Slate is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. technology roadmaps. * Work with vendors and service providers to resolve technical issues and support strategic initiatives. * Provide end\-user and site support when required. **Here's what you’ll jobs.title: Software Engineer II – Enterprise Application Development
jobs.description: We are looking for a Software Engineer II to join our Enterprise Application Development team and help build the software that runs our retail convenience store business. Our team designs, develops, maintains, and supports applications in\-house, giving engineers the chance to work directly with the business and see the impact of what they build. We work across a broad range of applications, systems, and business processes, so there's always something new to learn. This is a mid\-level role for someone with professional experience and technical confidence who can contribute independently, bring fresh perspective to the team, and keep growing their technical and business knowledge. What You'll Do: * Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and support enterprise applications. * Analyze complex technical and business problems and develop effective solutions. * Work with business analysts, stakeholders, and technical team members to understand requirements and business processes. * Contribute to technical designs and application architecture. * Develop and support RESTful APIs, backend services, and system integrations. * Participate in peer code reviews and collaborative development practices. * Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting solutions. * Improve application performance, reliability, maintainability, and security. * Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve applications and business processes. * Stay current with emerging technologies and contribute ideas that improve how we build and support software. What Sets You Apart: * A self\-starter who takes ownership and moves work forward without constant direction. * Naturally curious about how systems, technology, and the business behind them work. * An engaged contributor who brings ideas, asks questions, and looks for better ways to solve problems. * Comfortable working through unfamiliar problems and picking up new technologies. * Able to respectfully challenge existing approaches and contribute to technical decisions. * A strong communicator who works effectively with both technical and non\-technical people. * Takes pride in building quality software and improving the systems and processes around it. Required Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience. * 3–5 years of professional software development experience. * Strong understanding of software development fundamentals and strongly typed programming languages such as C\#, Java, Kotlin, or similar. * Proficiency with SQL and relational databases. * Professional experience developing or consuming RESTful APIs. * Proficiency working with Linux\-based containers and containerized applications. * Solid understanding of container orchestration concepts. * Experience with source control, code reviews, testing, debugging, and modern software development practices. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications: * C\# / .NET * Spring Boot * Kotlin * SQL Server * PostgreSQL * Docker * Linux / Ubuntu * Azure DevOps and Azure Pipelines * CI/CD practices * Microservices architecture * Automated testing * AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or similar Our Technology Our development environment includes: .NET \| Spring Boot \| Kotlin \| SQL Server \| PostgreSQL \| RESTful APIs \| Docker \| Azure DevOps \| Azure Pipelines \| Git \| Linux/Ubuntu You won't need experience with every technology listed. We value strong engineering fundamentals, adaptability, and the ability to learn. Our containerized environment is continuing to evolve, with container orchestration part of our longer\-term technology roadmap. Benefits: * Starting Pay: $85,000 \- $100,000/year salary. * 100% company paid retirement\- Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). * Health, Vision \& Dental benefit package. * YMCA discount program. * Monday \- Friday (in office). As you grow into the role, you'll take on rotating after\-hours on\-call support. Why Join Us? You'll work on software that matters to the business, alongside a team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. You'll work across a diverse technology landscape, learn how a complex retail organization operates, and help shape the future of our applications. If you're curious, engaged, and want to build more than just software, we'd like to meet you. To help provide our employees with a safe work environment, we are a drug free workplace.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: HOW TO APPLY: Complete our application at stupidsimple.tools/pages/careers\-mechanical\-design\-engineer. Applications sent only through Indeed will not be reviewed. Hello from Stupid Simple Tools \- We’re a young, (but not too young), engineering and design company making premium workshop tools. We like to think of ourselves as a collaborative group of artists, designers, and engineers who work together to create high quality, kickass tools! All our products are designed from the ground up in\-house, and each represents a blend of engineering innovation and design beauty. We’re pride ourselves in our work ethic and design quality, and are looking for a like\-minded engineer. You can find all the tools our team has developed at: **www.stupidsimple.tools** We are searching for an experienced mechanical design engineer – someone who will work alongside our lead mechanical engineer and our talented industrial designers to help bring our next generation of tools to market. The mechanical design engineer position will require a mix of 'product design' soft skills , in addition to 'mechanical engineering' hard skills . Our ideal hire would be able to take control of a project from start to finish: 1\. Contributing to a products concept and feature list 2\. Turning concepts into mechanically engineered and manufacturable product 3\. Delivering 3D models and technical drawings 4\. Test initial prototypes and make design refinements 4\. Monitor production of first batch As part of 5\-person team team your skills, contributions, and personality matter. As such, there are plenty of growth opportunities professionally, financially, in skill, and in project focus – we want you to grow alongside the company. What you will work on (with the team): Product ideation: Contribute to our brainstorms where we decide which products we will develop next, and discuss the project goals Mechanical Design: After we solidify the functional features \& ornamental design of our products – we switch gears into mechanically designing the tool, with material and manufacturing considerations applied. Product Prototyping \+ Analysis: Prototyping is an important phase of our product development. We analyze dimensions, tolerances, appearances, and of course function – before sending revisions to our manufacturing partners for the next prototype. Product Production: Once we’re ready for production, we organize timelines and production goals – then manage the progress. We generally have 2\-3 prototype runs before we jump into bulk production orders. Skills we’re looking for * 4\+ Years of Mechanical Engineering \& Design Experience * Strong creative and design vision * Moderate to advanced skill level in SolidWorks (our CAD platform) * High proficiency with creating AND reading GD\&T drawings * Experience running analysis: Including FEA, CFD, and stress / fatigue analysis * Deep understanding of manufacturing processes – specifically CNC and injection molding * Fluency and experience in DMF * Ability to steer a project from concept to production: including manufacturing decision\-making; production, labor, and material calculations; monitoring production schedules; estimating future requirements. Added bonuses: * Experience in Curvature/Nurb modeling software (Blender, Rhino) * Previous experience working in a D2C Product Start Up * Well developed portfolio of product / Mechanical design work If you’re interested, apply at stupidsimple.tools/pages/careers\-mechanical\-design\-engineer with your resume \& a sample project portfolio (optional, but HIGHLY recommended)! We are looking to bring on the right candidate immediately :) With love \- The Stupid Simple Team \<3 Pay: $35\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Expected hours: 10\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: IT Project Engineer
jobs.description: **IT Project Engineer** ======================= **About SugarShot** ------------------- SugarShot is a managed services provider delivering IT, cybersecurity, cloud, and advisory services to growing businesses. Our teams collaborate across Engineering, Project Management, Service Delivery, and Client Success. We value clear communication, ownership, and continuous improvement. You'll have the opportunity to solve varied technical challenges, contribute ideas, and help improve how we serve our clients. **About the Role** ------------------ SugarShot is seeking a Project Engineer who can design, build, and implement technology solutions for our clients. This is a hands\-on engineering role spanning Microsoft and Mac environments, infrastructure and endpoint projects, and practical uses of AI and automation. You will turn client needs into workable technical designs, deliver the solution, and make sure it can be supported after launch. The right person combines strong systems engineering expertise with sound judgment and clear communication. You work independently, collaborate effectively with project managers, technical teams, and client stakeholders, and take ownership of delivering reliable, supportable outcomes. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead technical discovery, assess current environments, define requirements, and design solutions that fit client needs, security standards, and supportability. * Build and implement projects across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Windows, Azure, macOS, Apple device management, and related identity, collaboration, and endpoint platforms. * Partner with the project manager to develop technical estimates, identify dependencies and resource needs, and provide timely updates on progress, risks, and blockers. Flag changes that may affect scope, budget, or delivery dates before proceeding. * Execute migrations, deployments, integrations, configuration changes, and modernization projects with clear plans, validation, rollback considerations, and client communication. * Follow established change\-management processes, coordinate maintenance windows and client approvals, and validate that delivered solutions meet agreed requirements before project closure. * Design and implement production\-ready AI\-assisted workflows and automations that solve specific business or service\-delivery problems. Use scripting, APIs, and workflow tools to connect systems and data, automate repeatable processes, and apply appropriate access controls, human review, logging, testing, and data\-handling safeguards. * Troubleshoot complex issues across Microsoft and Mac environments and work with project managers, service delivery, security, and client stakeholders to resolve dependencies. * Produce clear technical documentation, implementation records, training, and handoffs so delivered solutions are sustainable for the client and our support teams. * Maintain accurate time entries and project records, and provide post\-implementation stabilization support to resolve issues and complete the transition to service delivery. * Recommend improvements based on project findings and help standardize reusable designs and automations across clients. * Participate in after\-hours implementations, cutovers, and maintenance windows as project needs require. Occasional client\-site visits and travel may also be required. **Requirements** ---------------- * Minimum three years of experience as a Project Engineer. * Experience managing your technical work within a project, including planning tasks, estimating effort, tracking progress, meeting deadlines, and communicating dependencies, risks, and blockers to the project manager. * Experience delivering client\-facing IT projects in an MSP or other multi\-client environment. * Strong hands\-on proficiency across Microsoft and Mac ecosystems, including Windows and macOS administration, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, identity and endpoint management, migrations, security controls, cloud or hybrid environments, and at least one Apple management platform such as Addigy or Jamf. * Hands\-on experience building production automations and AI workflows using PowerShell, Python, APIs, Microsoft Power Automate, or comparable tools, with a practical understanding of testing, support, governance, and platform limitations. * Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements, evaluate tradeoffs and implementation risks, and communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Strong documentation and independent\-work skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple time zones with project managers, technical and engineering teams, clients, and internal teams. **Helpful Experience** ---------------------- * PSA/RMM platforms such as ConnectWise Manage, NinjaOne, or related MSP tooling. * Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI services, or comparable enterprise AI platforms. * Microsoft Graph, Apple Business Manager, Autopilot, and cross\-platform endpoint deployment. * Security, compliance, or governance requirements in regulated client environments. * Relevant Microsoft or Apple certifications, or a portfolio of delivered engineering and automation work. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- You deliver projects that meet the client's goals, work reliably across their Microsoft and Mac environment, and transition cleanly into support.
