jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: Sweet James Accident Attorneys is a rapidly growing, AI\-powered personal injury firm based in Orange County, CA. In less than a decade, we've built a nationally recognized brand and a proprietary AI and automation stack that make us one of the largest and most efficient providers of legal services in the country. Our growth runs on a culture of excellence, compassion, and results: Our team is committed to exceptional client experience and to supporting one another in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. We invest in our people, encourage professional growth, and provide meaningful opportunities to build rewarding careers while making a real impact in our clients' lives. **Lead AI Engineer** **The details** * Location: Sweet James Headquarters (Newport Beach, CA), on\-site * Team: Technology * Reports to: Chief Technology Officer * Compensation: $200,000 to $250,000 base salary, depending on experience **The role** Technology is how we practice law, not a department beside it. We have built a highly automated, AI\-forward experience for every client\-facing role, from intake to settlement, and it is one of the leading examples of applied AI in the legal field: Our case teams run at a fraction of the headcount our largest peers need for the same work. The systems behind that result are built in\-house, and you will be one of the people building them. Sweet James is seeking a Lead AI Engineer to own the direction, standards, and health of the AI platform and to lead the engineers who build it. This is a player\-coach seat for a staff\-level engineer ready to manage: You will set the architecture, turn the roadmap into a build plan the team can execute, and remain hands\-on in the code. You will report to the Chief Technology Officer and own how the platform is built and run. The distinction from our Senior AI Engineer seat is scope: Senior engineers own features end to end; you own the system they fit into and the people who build it. **Responsibilities** * Direction: Own the architecture of the AI platform (e.g., document intake and filing, fact extraction, case search, the internal assistant and its agents, voice agents) and review every major design before it is built. The roadmap is set by the Chief Technology Officer and product leadership; you decide how it gets built. * Standards: Define how the team ships, including code review, testing, and the evaluation sets every AI feature must clear before release. * Platform health: Own uptime, monitoring, incident response, and access controls across the platform, and ensure no system depends on one person. * People and capacity: Allocate the team's capacity against the priorities the Chief Technology Officer sets, make the trade\-offs when demand exceeds it, and coach, review, and hire the engineers who carry the work. * Delivery: Ship production code yourself every week. * Business partnership: Decide with attorneys, case managers, and operations leaders which work is worth automating next, and report results in hours returned, error rates, and adoption. * Data governance: Set the rules for least\-privilege access, audit trails, and which client and medical data may reach which model. **Qualifications** **Required:** * Experience: 8\+ years building production software, with a track record as the technical lead on systems other engineers depended on. * Leadership: Mentoring, design review, and ownership of a team's output; formal people management is welcome but not required. * LLM craft: Systems shipped to real users spanning prompt and tool design, retrieval, structured extraction, evaluation, and cost and latency tuning. * Stack: Strong Python and TypeScript/Node, production SQL in Postgres, Docker, containerized cloud services (Azure preferred), CI/CD, and monitoring. * Operations: Ownership of uptime, including on\-call, incident reviews, and rollbacks. * Communication: Clear design docs, runbooks, and plain\-language explanations for non\-engineers. **Preferred:** * Models and tooling: Anthropic Claude and OpenAI APIs at production scale; agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol; vector search (e.g., pgvector); self\-hosted or open\-weight models (e.g., vLLM, Baseten). * Workflow automation: Platforms such as n8n. * Salesforce: The data model and APIs; Litify a plus. * Voice: Voice AI and telephony (e.g., Retell, Twilio, Zoom). * Industry: Legal, insurance, or healthcare. Sweet James is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act and applicable local law. jobs.title: Site Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** Symbotic is seeking a Site Engineer to support the day\-to\-day reliability, availability, and performance of our automated warehouse systems in a live production environment. This role is hands\-on and operational in nature, aligned closely with a Maintenance Engineer or Lead Automation Technician profile. The Site Engineer focuses on troubleshooting, maintaining, and stabilizing complex electro\-mechanical and automated systems to ensure safe, consistent system uptime. This role is not commissioning\-focused, not controls\-programming\-heavy, and not customer\-facing, but instead centered on system health, equipment reliability, and technical execution on site **What we do** The Site Engineer is part of the Customer Operations organization which is responsible for leading the day\-to\-day operations of Symbotic’s robotic material handling system. The Customer Operations organization drives operational excellence by engaging and partnering with our onsite customers to drive best\-in\-class quality, safety and system performance. **What you’ll do** * Monitor and maintain the health of automated systems including conveyors, lifts, robotic vehicles, motors, sensors, and PLC\-controlled equipment. * Perform advanced electrical, mechanical, and automation troubleshooting to resolve production\-impacting issues. * Diagnose failures across PLCs (Allen\-Bradley), VFDs, AC/DC motors, servo motors, sensors, and control hardware. * Support and execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities on automated equipment. * Utilize system data, alarms, logs, and dashboards to identify fault conditions and recurring issues. * Document maintenance activities, repairs, and findings using CMMS systems (e.g., Maximo) and internal tools. * Act as a senior technical escalation point during system disruptions or downtime events. * Partner with on\-site maintenance, operations, and technical teams to restore and stabilize system performance. * Provide technical guidance and on\-the\-job support to maintenance technicians and operators. * Step in to support critical on\-site technical functions as needed to maintain operational continuity. * Ensure compliance with OSHA, LOTO, electrical safety, and Symbotic safety standards. **What you’ll need** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * Minimum of 1 year of hands\-on experience with PLCs, preferably Allen\-Bradley, focused on diagnostics and troubleshooting (not heavy programming). * Minimum of 1 year of experience with VFDs, including diagnosing speed, torque, and drive\-related issues. * Minimum of 1 year of experience working with AC and DC motors. * Hands\-on experience with automated systems such as conveyor systems, conveyor belts, vertical lifts, and motor\-driven equipment. * Experience supporting autonomous or semi\-autonomous systems, including conveyors, lifts, AS/RS, robotics, servo motors, or 480V systems. * Working knowledge of SQL, Python, and Linux for diagnostics, log review, and system interaction. * Strong hands\-on experience assembling, operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting robotics and electro\-mechanical systems. * Prior experience in maintenance engineering, automation maintenance, or lead maintenance technician roles preferred. **Our Environment** * Work is performed in an active industrial environment with high levels of automation. * Ability to work at heights of up to 45 feet and within confined spaces. * Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. * Exposure to varying temperatures and production conditions. * Must comply with all PPE, LOTO, fall protection, and electrical safety requirements. * Ability to work flexible hours, including off\-shifts, as needed to support system uptime and recovery. * Valid driver’s license required. \#LI\-Onsite \#LI\-KK2 **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. The base range for this position in the posted location is $69,000\.00 \- $101,200\.00 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, 401K, PTO and/or other benefits.

jobs.description: **Department Description:** At Disney, we’re storytellers. We make the impossible, possible. The Walt Disney Company (TWDC) is a world\-class entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways to move audiences around the world—a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts and a cruise line to sports, news, movies and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences — and we’re constantly looking for new ways to enhance these exciting experiences. The Enterprise Technology mission is to deliver technology solutions that align to business strategies while enabling enterprise efficiency and promoting cross\-company collaborative innovation. Our group drives competitive advantage by enhancing our consumer experiences, enabling business growth, and advancing operational excellence. **Team Description:** We are the Finance Engineering \& AI team, and we exist to be Finance's technical partner — for FP\&A, Payroll, Controllership, and Tax \& Treasury alike — turning business process needs into working software and intelligent automation. Our AI Platform team designs and builds the intelligent automation layer that streamlines and scales finance workflows, while our Business Process Applications team owns and operates the core systems finance relies on every day. Together, we combine deep finance domain expertise with custom engineering to give Finance both a stable operational backbone and a path toward an increasingly automated future. **What You’ll Do:** Disney Financial Insights (D\-Fi) is a new platform reimagining how Finance teams and budget owners across Disney interact with financial data — replacing manual pulls, static reports, and email\-driven approvals with one AI\-powered, orchestrated experience built on top of Disney financial systems. This is a build\-from\-scratch mandate — you'll be shaping team structure, engineering practices, and technical architecture from an early stage (MVP in progress), not inheriting a mature system. This role is the primary technical point of contact for finance stakeholders \& cross\-functional partners and is accountable for translating the platform roadmap into a shipped, governed, production\-grade system. just overseeing it. * **Own technical direction end\-to\-end.** Set architecture and technical strategy for the AI/ML and data layers underpinning D\-Fi, ensuring every capability — variance analysis, scenario modeling, the natural\-language experience — is built on a governed, semantic data foundation rather than one\-off pipelines. * **Be the stakeholder\-facing technical lead.** Act as the credibly to technical and non\-technical partners and leaders. * **Own the AI/LLM roadmap.** This is the highest\-visibility and most sensitive capability on the platform — you'll guide its direction business finance transformation leads on driving adoption across the enterprise — both finance workers and budget owners. **Required Qualifications \& Skills:** * 10\+ years of software and/or ML engineering leadership experience, with a strong track record of owning technical direction and architecture for complex systems end\-to\-end. * Demonstrated experience architecting and shipping production LLM/AI applications — not just prototypes. * Production experience with LLM application architecture — RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and context/retrieval design at scale * Working knowledge of LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent) and vector databases/retrieval stores (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or Snowflake Cortex Search) * Strong data modeling background, ideally including semantic/governed data layers (not just raw pipelines) * Ability to read, write and review Python code * Working knowledge of modern web/full\-stack language or framework sufficient to guide UI\-layer architecture decisions * Familiarity with MLOps practices — model monitoring, retraining pipeline design, containerization, and CI/CD for ML systems * Experience working across distributed, cross\-timezone engineering teams, with the judgment to know what belongs in synchronous vs. asynchronous workflows. * Comfort operating as the primary technical voice in front of senior business stakeholders — able to translate finance/business problems into technical scope, and technical trade\-offs into business language. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Background building internal tools for finance organizations is a plus, but not required — genuine curiosity about the domain is. * Exposure to ERP/EPM platforms such as SAP, Oracle EPM, or Cognos, and/or experience integrating custom applications against enterprise system APIs * Experience working alongside or evaluating third\-party/consulting\-delivered engineering work, with the judgment to assess technical quality and architectural fit quickly **Required Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus jobs.title: (Staff / Senior Staff) AI Infra Engineer, Inference Infrastructure
jobs.description: ### **About The Role** We're looking for a software engineer, reliability\-minded but still a builder, to own what happens in production to the Kubernetes\-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. The platform team builds the manifest\-driven API and controllers that let the inference team declare what they need, a cluster, a model deployment, a capacity change, and get it reconciled underneath. Your job is to keep that promise true in the real world: triaging InfiniBand issues when prefill and decode nodes stall exchanging KV cache over RDMA, diagnosing hero\-model and LoRA\-serving faults that don't show up in generic health checks, and extending the automated self\-healing system so each new failure mode becomes a permanent fix instead of a recurring page. The core value we're after is keeping the decoupling real even when things break, and keeping the fleet efficient without that efficiency becoming a new source of instability. You'll own SLOs and error budgets for inference serving, lead incident response, and turn what postmortems teach you into actual changes in the controllers and automation, not just updated runbooks. You'll also work the reliability side of capacity efficiency, since a mistuned defragmentation or bin\-packing pass is itself a production risk. Strong candidates have hands\-on production\-reliability experience on large\-scale distributed or GPU\-serving systems, are comfortable troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA and Kubernetes controller/CRD\-based platforms, and think about GPU infrastructure, and the tools that keep it reliable, as software to be engineered. A product mindset applies: the on\-call experience, the clarity of an alert, and the judgment built into an automated remediation are things you ship and iterate on. ### **Responsibilities** * Operate the provisioning state machine in production: own the health of the host lifecycle pipeline, discovery, inference bring\-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA, triaging stuck or failed state transitions at fleet scale and feeding real failure patterns back into how the states and transitions are designed. * Triage and extend automated self\-healing: when the node\-scanning and remediation platform misses something, a new failure mode, an InfiniBand issue in disaggregated prefill/decode serving, a GPU Xid variant, a hero\-model or LoRA\-specific fault, diagnose it live, drive the fix to production, and turn it into a new detection/remediation plugin so it's automatic the next time. * Own end\-to\-end reliability of the pipeline: hold the SLOs and error budgets for provisioning and fleet health, lead incident response when idempotency, retry, rollback, or drift assumptions break down in practice, and drive the systemic fix, not just the hotfix. * Partner with the inference/ML platform team from the production side: be the one who knows how real cluster topologies, interconnects, and scheduling constraints actually fail in the field, and feed those failure modes back as first\-class requirements into the platform's abstractions. * Work alongside machine learning researchers, engineers, and product managers to bring our latest technologies into production, enabling advanced research through awesome engineering. * Introduce new techniques, tools, and architecture that improve the performance, latency, throughput, and efficiency of our model inference stack. * Build tools to give us visibility into our bottlenecks and sources of instability, then design and implement solutions to address the highest\-priority issues. * Lead reliability cross\-functionally: build coalition across infra, ML platform, and product teams around shared reliability priorities, manage stakeholders through incidents and roadmap trade\-offs, and represent the reliability point of view in planning so it shapes decisions before they ship, not after an outage. ### **Requirements** * Experience operating a provisioning or host\-lifecycle pipeline in production, comfortable troubleshooting stuck or failed state transitions (discovery, bring\-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA) at fleet scale, and translating real failure patterns back into improvements to the state machine’s design. * Deep experience owning production reliability for large\-scale distributed systems; GPU/ML\-serving infrastructure experience is a strong plus. * Hands\-on experience troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA networking issues, ideally in a multi\-node training or disaggregated\-inference context — comfortable reading IB port counters and subnet manager logs, not just application metrics. * Familiarity with the operational realities of multi\-tenant model serving (LoRA/adapter\-based serving) and with running differentiated SLOs across model pools of different priority. * A demonstrated track record of eliminating operational toil through automation and tooling you built yourself, not just process or documentation. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, reconciliation loops, and node\-level health/remediation systems. * Comfort with event\-driven architectures, backpressure/circuit\-breaking design, and treating observability (metrics, logs, traces) as something built into a system, not added after an incident. * A software\-engineering mindset first: you write and ship production code, and you think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered, not a fleet to be manually operated. ### **About Together AI** Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $250,000 \- $320,000 \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Equal Opportunity** Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Family** IT \- General**About Us** At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there. **Who We Are** We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life. Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them. We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms. **What We Do** Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1\) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2\) Protection Solutions and Savings \& Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3\) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs. Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23\.9 million customers worldwide.\* For more information, visit transamerica.com. **Job Description Summary** Design, develop, deploy, and support artificial intelligence (AI) solutions that improve products, services, and business processes across the organization. Leverage advanced AI engineering, cloud\-native development, and software engineering practices to deliver scalable, secure, and responsible AI applications and platforms.**Job Description** Responsibilities * Design, develop, deploy, and support AI applications, automation solutions, and digital agents. * Deliver generative AI (Gen AI) and agentic solutions using established frameworks and cloud technologies. * Apply software engineering with best practices to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable AI solutions. * Support the full AI solution lifecycle from design through production support. * Contribute to the enhancement, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise AI platforms and services. * Improve AI products, engineering processes, and technical standards through the application of best practices. * Support platform reliability, monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Lead small projects or technical workstreams and help ensure successful delivery. * Mentor and support less experienced engineers through coaching and knowledge sharing. * Collaborate with business, architecture, security, and platform teams to deliver AI solutions and communicate technical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences. Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, or related field * Eight years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, or related disciplines * Two years of experience in end\-to\-end AI solution design, development, testing, monitoring, and maintenance * Experience designing and developing agentic workflows * Experience delivering AI solutions in cloud environments * Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) Bedrock and AWS SageMaker * Experience with OpenAI technologies, AWS Bedrock Agents, and LangChain * Proficient in Kubernetes and Docker containerization technologies Preferred Qualifications * Master’s degree in artificial intelligence, data science, or related field * Experience working in the insurance industry or other regulated industries * Experience supporting enterprise AI platforms and cloud\-native solutions * Experience applying responsible AI, security, privacy, and governance practices * Professional certifications in artificial intelligence technologies * Professional certifications in cloud\-native technologies * Developer\-level certifications in relevant technologies Working Conditions * e development. Curiosity is the quality we value most. Much of our work involves solving complex problems, applying knowledge in new ways, and continuously improving how we operate. As technology evolves rapidly, we look for inquisitive people who are confident challenging the status quo and helping us drive change. *This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion. Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation in order to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.* **What We Offer** For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well\-being of our employees. Compensation Benefits * Competitive Pay * Bonus for Eligible Employees Benefits Package * Pension Plan * 401k Match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Tuition Reimbursement * Disability Insurance * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Employee Discounts * Career Training \& Development Opportunities Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits * Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service. * Ten (10\) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays). * Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars * Parental Leave – fifteen (15\) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child. * Adoption Assistance * Employee Assistance Program * Back\-Up Care Program * PTO for Volunteer Hours * Employee Matching Gifts Program * Employee Resource Groups * Inclusion and Diversity Programs * Employee Recognition Program * Referral Bonus Programs **Inclusion \& Diversity** We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women. To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company\-sponsored, employee\-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all. **Giving Back** We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994\. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work. **Transamerica’s Parent Company** Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999\. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23\.9 million people across the globe.\* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: **Helping people live their best lives.** As a leading global investor and employer, the company seeks to have a positive impact by addressing critical environmental and societal issues, with a focus on climate change and inclusion and diversity. * As of December 31, 2023

jobs.title: Marketing Technology Developer
jobs.description: ABOUT THIS JOB We’re looking for a resourceful developer who can independently build landing pages, implement tracking and integrations, and troubleshoot campaign issues. You should bring strong practical development skills, use AI tools effectively, and learn unfamiliar systems quickly. RESPONSIBILITIES * Build responsive landing pages, multistep forms, and offer pages from designs or briefs, including validation, loading states, error handling, and mobile usability. * Configure tracking parameters, including ad\-platform macros, UTMs, click IDs, and affiliate identifiers, and preserve them across redirects, forms, and connected systems. * Implement and troubleshoot browser and server\-side conversion events, including event timing, payloads, identifier matching, and deduplication. * Connect forms and campaign flows to lead\-delivery endpoints and third\-party APIs, managing authentication, responses, and error handling. * Manage DNS, subdomains, redirects, SSL, and email\-related DNS records using Cloudflare and hosting platforms. * Use browser DevTools, network inspection, and server logs to diagnose issues, investigate reporting discrepancies, and verify the full journey from ad click through lead delivery and conversion reporting. * Work within existing repositories, CMSs, and site builders; use Git and manage environment variables, deployments, and rollbacks. * Deliver fast, accessible pages with secure form handling. Clarify requirements, identify dependencies, communicate blockers, and document changes and remaining limitations. REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS * Strong practical knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript, including browser behavior, third\-party scripts, and component\-based development. * Proficiency with a modern frontend framework and the ability to contribute to existing Next.js, SvelteKit, and Tailwind projects. * Working knowledge of HTTP, JSON, APIs, URL encoding, cookies, and browser storage. * Understanding of how advertising platforms, tracking links, landing pages, forms, and lead\-delivery systems connect, including how campaign and affiliate identifiers move between them. * Proficiency with LLMs and AI coding tools for development, debugging, research, and documentation. Ability to provide clear context, break down tasks, and review and test AI\-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and compatibility. * Sound judgment when using AI: verify uncertain outputs against documentation and system behavior, and protect credentials, customer information, and internal data. * Ability to work independently, learn through documentation and investigation, and demonstrate practical development and troubleshooting skills through previous work or hands\-on examples. Our company offers great benefits: full healthcare package (medical, dental, vision, life), 401k with a company match, catered lunch, coffee, tea and snacks, paid parking, competitive pay, and much more! Anyone who joins our team will have great potential for career and personal growth.

jobs.title: Mid level Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ You will design, build, and operate production\-grade multi\-agent systems for commercial and federal customers. The work spans the LangChain ecosystem, reliable agent loops, advanced retrieval architectures, and ontologies that ground agent reasoning. You will also connect agents to enterprise tools and to each other through MCP and A2A. This role suits an engineer who thinks in systems: how agents reason, retrieve, act, recover from failure, and get evaluated and observed in production. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ Agent development and orchestration * Build single\- and multi\-agent applications with LangChain and LangGraph, including stateful graphs, supervisor/worker and hierarchical patterns, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints. * Engineer robust agentic loops (plan, act, observe, reflect) with clear termination conditions, retry and self\-correction logic, guardrails, and cost and latency budgets. * Apply loop engineering to tune iteration depth, tool\-call strategy, memory handling, and state persistence so agents behave predictably. * Use LangSmith for tracing, debugging, prompt and dataset management, and automated evaluation; maintain regression suites for agent behavior. Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) * Build and optimize Agentic RAG (agent\-driven query planning and iterative retrieval), Adaptive RAG (routing by query complexity), Corrective and Self\-RAG, GraphRAG (knowledge\-graph retrieval and reasoning), and Cache\-Augmented Generation with semantic caching. * Design chunking, embedding, hybrid search, re\-ranking, and query\-rewriting strategies. * Measure retrieval quality with faithfulness, context precision and recall, and answer relevance. Ontologies, context, and skills * Develop domain ontologies and knowledge graphs (OWL/RDF or property\-graph models) that ground agent reasoning and power GraphRAG. * Practice context engineering: decide how instructions, memory, retrieved knowledge, and tool results are assembled in the context window. * Build reusable agent skills and tool libraries with clear interfaces, documentation, and versioning. Interoperability protocols * Build and integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients that expose enterprise data, APIs, and tools to agents securely. * Implement Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) patterns for agent discovery, capability negotiation, task delegation, and cross\-vendor communication. Engineering and delivery * Write production\-quality Python (TypeScript optional) with tests, CI/CD, and secure coding practices. * Take agents from prototype to production with product, data, and platform teams. * Contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, and internal standards for agentic systems. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 10 years of software engineering, with at least 4 years building LLM\-powered applications. * Hands\-on production experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith. * Demonstrated experience designing agentic loops, tool calling, memory, and multi\-agent orchestration. * Practical experience implementing several RAG variants (Agentic, Adaptive, GraphRAG, Cache RAG/CAG) and evaluating their quality. * Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs and applying them to retrieval or reasoning. * Strong context engineering and prompt design for complex agent workflows. * Experience building or integrating MCP servers and clients, and working knowledge of the A2A protocol. * Proficiency in Python, REST/gRPC APIs, and asynchronous programming. * Solid grasp of LLM failure modes (hallucination, prompt injection, context limits) and their mitigations. Trillion is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered for positions without regard to race, religion, gender, native origin, age, disability, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Includes: + Research to understand our highly matrixed system. + Data\-informed recommendations and decision making. + Technical capabilities to sunset or disable unneeded products. **Application support and internal system integration (40% of time)** * Design, develop, and maintain application solutions that support business processes and operational needs across departments. * Develop and support API\-based integrations between internal systems, third\-party platforms, and cloud services to improve data flow and reduce manual processes. * Support migration from legacy ERP systems and related technologies to modern application platforms, including data integration, process mapping, testing, and transition support. * Translate business requirements into technical specifications, conceptual designs, integration plans, and maintainable application solutions. * Develop current and future state application architecture road maps in partnership with business and IT teams. * Design intuitive, well\-modeled API endpoints for internal and user\-facing consumption, using OpenAPI specifications and API testing tools to document and validate integrations. * Evaluate and recommend new technologies that align with organizational needs, technical standards, security requirements, and long\-term maintainability. * Document application designs, integrations, support procedures, system dependencies, and migration plans from a technical perspective. **Application\-level support requests (10% of time)** * Respond to support requests that require application\-level assessment, troubleshooting, remediation, or coordination with vendors and internal technical teams. * Analyze reported issues to determine root cause, business impact, system dependencies, and appropriate remediation steps. * Partner with departments to clarify requirements, prioritize support needs, communicate status, and implement practical solutions. * Participate as an active member of the IT Team. personal and professional growth. * Complete other projects \& tasks assigned. **Required Experience** * At least 4 years of experience with a proven track record of success in software architecture, software development, application support, or DevOps, with a portfolio of successful software or integration projects that demonstrate strong technical skills and leadership. * At least 4 years of field, or equivalent experience. * 5\-7 years of experience in software development, application architecture, solution design, or DevOps, with a strong portfolio of successful software projects that demonstrate technical skills and leadership. * 5\-7 years of experience architecting solutions for internal systems, business applications, APIs, integrations, cloud services, and cross\-department workflows. * 5\-7 years of experience with AWS developer tools and services used to build, deploy, monitor, secure, and maintain application solutions. * Previous experience with database administration, including database maintenance, performance awareness, backup and recovery practices, data integrity, security, and support of application data needs. * Previous experience with ERP, jobs.title: Senior Embedded Engineer, MCU Firmware
jobs.description: **About the Role** Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high\-velocity team of multi\-disciplinary experts to turn real\-world operations into high\-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real\-world, long\-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race\-and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real\-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match. Our AV Labs Hardware team is building the next\-generation E/E architecture for our L4 data\-collection vehicle fleet. The automotive MCU beside the main compute platform owns what must always work: vehicle network access, power sequencing, thermal and voltage supervision, time synchronization, and secure firmware updates. You will own that firmware from third\-party board support through bring\-up and deployment of our in\-house production hardware. **What the Candidate Will Do** * **Core firmware and drivers:** Design, write and maintain C firmware and drivers for automotive MCUs (Infineon AURIX TriCore) on FreeRTOS and AUTOSAR Classic: CAN\-FD, Ethernet, SPI, I2C, LIN, ADC, PWM and on\-board devices such as switches, PMICs and IMUs. * **Vehicle I/O:** Own the bridge between vehicle CAN\-FD buses and the compute SoC, including buffering, filtering, timestamping and latency. * **Power, thermal and time:** Implement power sequencing, sleep and wake, voltage and temperature monitoring, fan control, SoC watchdog and reset supervision, and gPTP and PPS time distribution. * **Bootloader and secure update:** Own the bootloader and dual\-bank (A/B) update path, including versioning, signing, rollback and recovery of field units. * **Bring\-up and co\-design:** Own board bring\-up and validation for custom hardware. Join schematic reviews with hardware engineers, and debug with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and on\-chip debuggers such as Lauterbach TRACE32\. * **Supplier code and releases:** Integrate and regression\-test supplier firmware drops, keep builds automated and reproducible, and mentor teammates on code quality and best practices. **Basic Qualifications** * **Embedded experience:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, with 7\+ years developing embedded software in C/C\+\+ on an RTOS or bare metal. * **Automotive MCU expertise:** Hands\-on firmware and driver work on automotive\-grade MCUs (AURIX TC3xx preferred; Renesas RH850, NXP S32 or similar considered), with CAN/CAN\-FD and Ethernet, board bring\-up, and hardware debugging tools. * **Production lifecycle:** Experience taking embedded systems from prototype and third\-party integration to production, ideally in autonomous vehicle, robotics or mission\-critical automotive domains. **Preferred Qualifications** * **Security:** Hardware security module (HSM) and secure boot experience, including secure update, key management and chain of trust on automotive MCUs. * **AURIX and AUTOSAR:** AURIX iLLD and AUTOSAR Classic (MCAL and BSW configuration with tools such as Vector or ETAS). * **Functional safety:** ISO 26262 (ASIL B through D) and MISRA C, including safety mechanisms such as watchdogs, memory protection and E2E. * **Timing:** PTP/gPTP (IEEE 802\.1AS) and hardware PPS routing across vehicle networks. * **AV compute platforms:** MCU\-to\-SoC interfaces on autonomous driving platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE or Jetson. For Sunnyvale, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $180,000 per year \- USD $200,000 per year. You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. jobs.description: **About the Role** Agentic Pods is building a new model for how Engineering partners with teams across Uber to transform work with AI. We are looking for an Agentic Software Engineer to design, build, and operate production\-grade agentic systems and processes that improve complex operational workflows. This role combines backend engineering, reliability engineering, and a forward\-deployed working model. You will work directly with operators and domain experts to discover opportunities, determine where agents can safely help, and turn ambiguous problems into reliable software. You will own solutions from discovery through architecture, implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. **What You Will Do** **Discover and Build Agentic Systems** * Embed with operational teams to understand workflows and identify where agentic AI, deterministic software, automation, or human decision\-making can meaningfully improve how work gets done. * Design, build, and iterate on production agentic systems, including agents, skills, backend services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, alongside real users. **Own Production Reliability** * Define reliability and quality targets and build observability across agent decisions, model behavior, dependencies, and workflow outcomes through tracing, logging, metrics, alerting, fallbacks, and recovery. * Own systems in production, using incidents, operational data, and user outcomes to continuously improve performance, resilience, and reliability. **Make Agents Safe and jobs.description: Overview: Live the **experience**. From professional empowerment to continual learning opportunities. We’ve been defined as a “mature start\-up.” A place where interdepartmental exposure, open doors, and genuine collaboration is ubiquitous. Where challenges come fast and furious, requiring agility, mental dexterity, and creativity. Where **our passion for better solutions** drives us and is core to who we are. We’re engineering for the future of retail, and it’s no\-holds\-barred. But for those motivated by continual change and ambiguity, by superior leadership, by whip smart colleagues who will press you daily for your very best, you’ll find that virtually nothing’s impossible at Ulta Beauty. : **NOTICE OF JOB OPPORTUNITY** **COMPANY:** Ulta, Inc. **LOCATION:** 1000 Remington Blvd., Suite 120, Bolingbrook, IL 60440 **TITLE:** Lead Artificial Intelligence Engineer **HOURS:** Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm **DUTIES:** Direct and oversee the full lifecycle execution of complex AI initiatives, bridging the gap between exploratory data science and production engineering, including formulation and statistical modeling to deployment and scaling. 5\.0% Contribute technical leadership to the development and optimization of advanced algorithms for recommendation and decision engines, utilizing techniques such as collaborative filtering, embeddings, clustering, reinforcement learning, and constrained optimization. 5\.0% Architect and deploy GenAI solutions: Design pipelines for Large Language Models (LLMs) including fine\-tuning, RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation), and prompt engineering for enterprise retail use cases like analytics augmentation and decision support. Co\-ownership (with other Engineering Lead peers and Engineering Practice lead) of governance and standards for AI engineering related portions of these technologies. 15\.0% Ensure "Enterprise Readiness": Take ownership of the non\-functional requirements of AI systems, explicitly optimizing models for low\-latency inference, high throughput, data privacy compliance, and cloud cost efficiency. Help enforce adherence of others engineering team members to standards. 10\.0% Build production\-grade pipelines: Transition code from experimental notebooks to modular, version\-controlled software packages. Implement automated training pipelines, CI/CD for ML, and robust monitoring for data drift and model degradation; establish team’s practices for this space. 10\.0% Code Quality \& Standards: Responsible for defining and enforcing engineering standards within the Enterprise AI team, including unit testing, documentation, peer code reviews, and reproducibility frameworks. 10\.0% Translate business needs into technical specs: Partner with business and IT product teams to refine vague use cases into concrete engineering requirements, identifying technical risks early in the project planning process. Represent as a decision maker within the team for AIML engineering topics, and act as a primary point of contact for the Engineering domain within a team. 10\.0% Advise on emerging areas of technology and AI; evaluate and recommend AI technologies, frameworks, and tools to maintain cutting edge capabilities. 5\.0% Proactively look for opportunities to drive AI innovation, promote and advocate for those capabilities within Agile delivery framework. 5\.0% Project Estimation \& Planning: Own detailed technical roadmaps, providing accurate time and effort estimates for the Engineering phases of projects. 5\.0% Engineering Standards: Promote adherence to statistical best practices and software engineering principles across the engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence. 10\.0% Communication: Present technical results and architectural decisions to senior stakeholders, effectively communicating the trade\-offs between model complexity, performance, and cost. Serve as an escalation point and technical authority for the team. 10\.0% **REQUIREMENTS:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics or other quantitative field. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Unify is building the **first AI\-native outbound platform** where agents and sellers work side by side. We help revenue teams identify buyers already in market, enrich accounts with data from 40\+ sources, and execute personalized, multi\-channel outreach—all from a single AI\-powered workspace. Trusted by some of the most innovative go\-to\-market teams, Unify enables reps to spend less time on manual work and more time building relationships, delivering up to **90% time savings** on list building and **19% higher output per rep**. We're building a team of curious, ambitious people who care deeply about craftsmanship, move with urgency, and thrive in fast\-paced environments. If you're excited about shaping the future of AI and building products that redefine how modern revenue teams work, we'd love to meet you. **About the role:** =================== As an Applied AI Engineer at Unify, you will bring new agent capabilities from zero to one and build the systems that make them work in production. You’ll own the agent harnesses that turn model capabilities into useful actions: planning, tool execution, context management, memory, and error recovery. You will work closely with product, design, and engineering to build agents that research accounts, identify opportunities, and execute GTM workflows. You’ll move quickly from prototype to customer usage, then use evaluations and real execution traces to make the product better. If you want to build production AI systems and own the outcome from first experiment through launch, this role is for you. **What You’ll Do:** =================== * **Build agent harnesses:** Design the execution loops, tool interfaces, context, and memory that let agents complete complex workflows reliably. * **Ship AI products end to end:** Turn ambiguous customer problems into working features, connecting agents to Unify’s data, integrations, and workflow infrastructure. * **Make quality measurable:** Build evals from real customer tasks, and use traces and failure analysis to improve agent behavior. * **Build for production:** Own reliability, latency, and cost. Make long\-running tasks resumable, handle tool failures, and give users visibility and control over agent actions. * **Experiment with new capabilities:** Test models, prompting strategies, retrieval approaches, and orchestration patterns. Measure what improves outcomes and bring it into the product. * **Shape our AI foundation:** Build reusable tools and engineering practices that help the team ship faster, partnering with product and design to prioritize the work that matters most to customers. **Who You Are:** ================ * You have 3\+ years of software engineering experience and hands\-on experience shipping LLM applications or agents to production. * You have built systems with tool calling, multi\-step execution, and evaluations. You understand how the software around a model affects what it can accomplish. * You are a strong programmer in TypeScript or Python, with experience building backend systems and integrating APIs. You’re comfortable owning a feature across the stack. * You think empirically. You define success, run experiments, inspect failures, and use evidence to decide what to build next. * You care deeply about customers and can turn a high\-level product idea into a deployed solution. You balance speed with sound engineering judgment. * You take initiative, learn quickly, and collaborate generously. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and make the people around you better. jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Security Engineering
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced **Senior Engineer** to help strengthen and reinforce our security processes, workflows, and posture as it relates to our applications, cloud infrastructure, and platform. In this role, you won't just be patching what's already broken; you will be defining how we find and close exposures before they're used against us. You will own and engineer the detection, investigation, and response capabilities that protect our global platforms while leading the charge into AI\-augmented defense, using AI to compress the time between a vulnerability's disclosure and its exploitation in the wild. You will act as the bridge between deep, code\-level investigation and enterprise\-wide risk reduction, ensuring our software supply chain, cloud infrastructure, and applications are not just compliant, but resilient by design. **\*\* Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office four days a week. \*\*** **What Makes This Job Awesome? You will...** * **Security Architecture \& Tooling:** Own our SAST/DAST program end\-to\-end, selecting, tuning, and integrating static and dynamic analysis tooling into the CI/CD pipeline so vulnerabilities are caught before merge, not after breach. * **AI \& Agentic Defense:** Proactively identify and build AI/LLM\-driven agents that close the gap between exposure and detection. CVE feeds alone are a shrinking signal in an AI\-accelerated threat landscape, so we need LLM inference layered at multiple points in the platform: dependency and supply\-chain analysis, code\-level review, and runtime behavior, catching what a CVE number never will. * **Deep Investigation:** Own security incidents end\-to\-end, from the first anomalous signal, through root\-cause analysis and remediation, to the post\-mortem that prevents recurrence. You follow a problem to completion; you don't hand it off halfway through. * **Read by Code:** Read code fluently enough to validate a finding at the source rather than taking a scanner's word for it. You won't be writing production code daily, but you need to be comfortable in at least one systems language (C, C\+\+, Rust, or similar languages) well enough that reading it critically, and catching what's wrong with it, is second nature. * **Vulnerability \& Threat Management:** Lead vulnerability management and threat modeling across our entire environment, internal and external, prioritizing based on real\-world exploitability and business impact, not just CVSS score. * **Compliance \& Trust:** Partner with legal, IT, and leadership to maintain and mature our compliance posture (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, InfoSec, and customer security questionnaires), translating audit and control requirements into practical engineering work rather than checkbox paperwork. * **Mentorship \& Influence:** Act as a force multiplier by mentoring engineers and influencing cross\-functional product teams on secure coding, threat modeling, and security\-first development. * **Incident Response:** Serve as a high\-level escalation point for complex security incidents, conducting deep\-dive post\-mortems that drive structural improvements rather than quick fixes. **What You'll Do** * **A Student of the Craft:** You're less interested in being the smartest person in the room than in staying honest about how fast the room is changing. AI has rewritten the security landscape almost overnight, and some of the assumptions and playbooks that worked two years ago no longer hold. You know your way around Arxiv and ACM, and keep a genuine eye on the research as it's published, not just the vendor's take on it three months later. You track where the industry is headed, not just where it's been, and you're comfortable saying "that doesn't work anymore" and rebuilding the approach. * **Secure by Design:** You have hands\-on experience with secrets management (Vault, AWS KMS/Secrets Manager, or similar), secure API design (authN/authZ, input validation, rate limiting), and system hardening standards like CIS Benchmarks and SELinux/AppArmor. * **The "AI Native" Defender Mindset:** You are passionate about the intersection of security and AI, and you think beyond CVE feeds, you want LLM inference embedded at multiple layers of the platform (supply chain, code, runtime) doing the correlation and triage a human can't keep pace with alone. To you, an LLM is nothing more than a non\-deterministic program, and you can tell the difference between a genuine threat and hype. * **Proven Track Record:** You have 8\+ years of experience in Security Engineering, AppSec, Vulnerability Research, or Incident Response, with at least 2 years in a Senior\-level capacity driving cross\-team initiatives. * **Foundational \& Polyglot:** You can write in a systems\-level language, such as C, C\+\+, Rust, Go, or ASM, not because you'll ship production code daily, but because writing it is what makes reading it, and anything else in the stack (Ru OC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks, and know how to satisfy an audit's control requirements without over\-engineering the underlying system. * **Autonomous Operator:** You take direction from your team lead on priorities, but how you plan and execute against those priorities, and how you go about securing the environment day to day, is up to you. If you spot a gap, something that needs doing and isn't on the agenda, you don't wait for it to be assigned, you raise it and work with your lead to get it prioritized. **What VTS Values \& How We Show It** * **Strive for Excellence** \- We know your potential is unlimited. jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer (Forward Deployment)
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Agentic AI Engineer (Forward Deployment)** **Experience: \-**8\+ Years **Location: \-**3 days work from office Edina, MN (1st preference) Chicago, IL (2nd Preference) Irving, TX (3rd Preference) **What is in it for you?** We are seeking a hands\-on **Senior Agentic AI Developer / Forward Deployed Engineer** to design, build, integrate, and operationalize enterprise applications. The engineer will work closely with business stakeholders, domain experts, product owners, architects, data engineers, quality engineers, and platform teams to translate business problems into secure, testable, and supportable solutions. This is an **embedded delivery** role with end\-to\-end implementation ownership, covering discovery, technical design, application and data development, AI integration, evaluation, deployment, and operational readiness. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable implementing deterministic business rules and developing governed AI\-assisted capabilities. This is not solely a prompt\-engineering, model\-research, or architecture\-advisory position. **Roles and Responsibilities:** **Embedded Discovery and Solution Delivery:** Partner directly with business users and subject\-matter experts to understand workflows, pain points, exceptions, and desired outcomes. Translate business requirements into technical specifications, user stories, testable acceptance criteria, and incremental delivery plans. Identify when deterministic logic, conventional automation, retrieval, or an AI agent is the appropriate solution. Build working vertical slices that demonstrate business value rather than disconnected proofs of concept. Communicate technical trade\-offs, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. **Agentic AI and LLM Application Engineering:** Develop bounded AI capabilities for research, explanation, recommendation, and workflow assistance. Implement structured outputs, context retrieval, tool/function calling, prompt versioning, and output validation. Design tool contracts with explicit permissions, schemas, failure behavior, and audit requirements. Ground AI responses in approved, versioned sources and preserve links to supporting evidence. Implement human review, escalation, abstention, and fallback behavior. Enforce authorization boundaries in application code and tool permissions\-not through prompts alone. Evaluate model and framework options against approved enterprise requirements for quality, security, latency, and cost. **Software and Data Engineering:** Build production\-quality backend services, APIs, data\-processing components, and workflow integrations. Develop Databricks notebooks/jobs and SQL transformations for ingestion, normalization, matching, comparison, and validation. Implement data\-quality checks, schema validation, deduplication, reconciliation, and versioned processing rules.mMaintain reproducibility through pinned rule sets, input references, and traceable execution records. Collaborate on reviewer\-facing interfaces and end\-to\-end application behavior. Engineer reliable integrations using appropriate retry, idempotency, timeout, and recovery patterns. **Quality, Evaluation, and Verification:** Create unit, integration, end\-to\-end, regression, and negative tests. Develop representative evaluation datasets with domain experts. Assess AI outputs for grounding, correctness, usefulness, safety, and appropriate abstention. Test unauthorized tool use, prompt injection, sensitive\-data exposure, and failure scenarios. Trace delivered functionality and verification evidence to acceptance criteria. Review AI\-generated code with the same rigor as manually written code. **Security, Governance, and AI\-DLC:** Follow the applicable AI\-DLC lifecycle, approved tooling paths, review requirements, and release controls. Implement least\-privilege access, secure authentication, secrets management, and data\-access restrictions. Use synthetic, mock, or approved de\-identified development data where required. Maintain architecture decisions, prompt/tool documentation, approval evidence, and delivery records. Escalate unresolved data classification, privacy, model approval, and risk decisions to accountable owners. Preserve human authority over final business decisions and production promotion. **Operational Readiness:** Instrument application behaviour, retrieval, tool calls, model usage, failures, and dependencies. Establish prompt/model traceability and appropriate telemetry protections. Implement usage and cost attribution, monitoring, s, and agreed reliability measures. Produce deployment guidance, rollback procedures, runbooks, and support handover materials. Work with platform and operations teams while retaining delivery\-team accountability for application quality and remediation.**Duration: \-** **Educational Qualifications: \-** Engineering Degree BE/ME/BTech/MTech/BSc/MSc. Technical certification in multiple technologies is desirable. **Skills: \-** **Mandatory skills** Strong hands\-on Python and SQL development skills. Demonstrated delivery of an LLM\-enabled application beyond a basic chatbot or notebook demonstration. Experience with tool/function calling, structured responses, retrieval\-grounded generation, and AI evaluation. Strong backend/API engineering skills, including validation, authentication, authorization, error handling, and automated testing. Experience with Databricks or a comparable enterprise data platform, with the ability to work effectively in Databricks. Understanding of relational databases, data modeling, audit trails, and transactional integrity. Experience with cloud\-hosted applications, preferably on Azure. Proficiency with Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and reproducible deployment practices. Ability to diagnose issues across application, data, integration, and infrastructure boundaries. Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to work independently within a cross\-functional delivery team. Practical understanding of sensitive\-data handling and secure enterprise development. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with FastAPI, React, and TypeScript. Familiarity with NestJS, Next.js, and PostgreSQL. Experience with Databricks Apps, Jobs, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and asset bundles. Experience with Azure Blob Storage, managed identities, and application monitoring. Experience with an agent framework such as LangChain/LangGraph, Azure AI Foundry Agents, or an equivalent framework; willingness to use the approved project stack. Familiarity with retrieval evaluation, knowledge\-base versioning, and reviewer\-feedback workflows. Experience in healthcare data, data\-use agreements, compliance\-sensitive workflows, or enterprise data validation. Experience using approved AI coding assistants while maintaining code provenance, testing, and human review. **Skills** RAG Pipeline, AgenticAI, Python, Azure

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: As a Staff Software Engineer, you are a senior individual contributor who leads technical direction for a team or group of teams. You take on our most complex and ambiguous engineering problems, design the systems behind our loan origination, underwriting, and servicing platforms, and raise the quality of engineering across the organization. You will work in an environment of high\-volume transactions, sensitive borrower and financial data, and third\-party integrations. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, but your largest impact comes from architecture, unblocking teams, and growing the engineers around you. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Lead the technical direction and architecture for systems owned by one or more teams, and align that work with the broader platform. * Break down ambiguous, high\-impact problems into clear plans, and drive them from design to delivery across teams. * Design systems for scale, reliability, security, and maintainability, and make pragmatic tradeoffs between them. * Write, review, and improve code in high\-impact and high\-risk areas, especially lending\-critical workflows such as underwriting, pricing, and closing. * Partner with product managers, QA, design, and business stakeholders to turn challenging business problems and vague requirements into clear technical plans. * Lead design reviews and technical decisions, building consensus across teams with different priorities. * Own the technical integrity of integrations with loan origination systems, credit bureaus, pricing engines, and other third\-party vendors. * Build security, privacy, auditability, and regulatory requirements into our systems, including correct handling of PII and financial data. * Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers, and set standards for code quality, testing, and operational excellence.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every "even better" qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $120,500\.00 \- $231,000\.00\.
