jobs.description: **DevOps Engineer** *Mixed\-Cloud Platform \& Release Engineering* **Position Overview** We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to help build, operate, and continuously improve the CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure that support our mobility products. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role responsible for the reliability, security, and velocity of build and release automation across a hybrid environment that includes Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and on\-premises data centers. You will work alongside a team of DevOps engineers, SREs, and release engineers, partnering closely with Software Engineering, QE, Architecture, and Information Security to help hundreds of microservices ship safely multiple times per day. Success in this role is measured by your contributions to deployment frequency, change failure rate, mean time to recovery (MTTR), platform availability, and the security posture of the delivery pipeline. **Essential Responsibilities** **CI/CD \& Release Engineering** * Build, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines supporting hundreds of microservices and applications, including pipeline\-as\-code standards, build artifacts, container images, and deployment automation across Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions. * Contribute to measurable improvements in DORA metrics: deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, and time to restore service. * Implement and maintain release patterns (blue/green, canary, feature flags), rollback procedures, and pre\-production validation gates. * Partner with QE to embed automated testing — unit, integration, contract, performance, and security — into pipelines so that quality is enforced before production. **Hybrid Cloud \& Infrastructure Operations** * Build and operate infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and on\-premises data centers, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and connectivity between environments (VPN, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, peering, and transit). * Manage and support Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, and on\-prem clusters), container registries, service meshes, ingress controllers, and supporting middleware. * Write and maintain Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) using Terraform and platform\-native tooling (CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep); participate in drift detection, peer review, and policy\-as\-code on all infrastructure changes. * Support capacity planning, cost optimization (FinOps), and rightsizing efforts across cloud and on\-prem footprints. **Observability, Reliability \& Incident Response** * Build and maintain the observability stack — metrics, logs, traces, and synthetic monitoring — and help define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for critical services. * Participate in on\-call rotations and act as an incident responder for production events, contributing to root\-cause analysis and tracking corrective actions to completion. * Support chaos engineering exercises, game days, disaster recovery testing, and business continuity exercises to validate the resilience of hybrid systems. **Security \& Compliance** * Partner with Information Security to implement shift\-left security practices: SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container image scanning, and IaC policy scanning in every pipeline. * Manage secrets, certificates, and identity infrastructure across cloud and on\-prem environments (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, IAM, RBAC). * Help maintain audit readiness for SOC 2, PCI\-DSS, and other regulatory frameworks applicable to mobility and payments processing by producing evidence of pipeline controls, access management, and change governance. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Software Engineering to ensure new services are built with pipeline, observability, and infrastructure templates from day one — not bolted on later. * Work with Architecture to align platform direction with the broader technology roadmap, including migrations between legacy and modern platforms. * Document runbooks, pipeline standards, and infrastructure patterns so that knowledge is shared across the team. * Respond to system issues, participate in high\-priority incident calls, and support emergency activities outside of standard hours as needed. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 3\+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure roles. * Hands\-on experience operating production systems in at least one of the following: AWS, Azure, or on\-premises data centers, with an interest in developing depth across a hybrid environment. * Experience with CI/CD platforms, specifically Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions (or comparable: Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI), including writing and maintaining pipeline\-as\-code. * Working experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform preferred; CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, Ansible, Puppet, or Chef a plus). * Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes — EKS, AKS, or self\-managed) and container build/registry workflows (Docker, ACR, ECR, Harbor). * Proficiency in scripting and automation in one or more of: Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go, or TypeScript/JavaScript. * Working knowledge of Git workflows, branching strategies, and code review practices. * Familiarity with observability tooling such as Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Azure Monitor / CloudWatch. * Willingness to participate in on\-call rotations and respond to production incidents. * Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in mobility, transportation, tolling, parking, or other regulated, high\-volume transaction\-processing environments. * Exposure to compliance regimes such as SOC 2, PCI\-DSS, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP. * Hands\-on experience with service mesh, API gateways, or zero\-trust networking patterns. * Experience with FinOps practices and cloud cost management tooling (CloudHealth, Apptio, native cost explorers). * Experience migrating workloads between on\-prem and cloud, or between cloud providers. * Relevant certifications: AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, Azure Administrator / DevOps Engineer Associate, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), HashiCorp Terraform Associate. * Familiarity with data and AI/ML platform operations (model registries, feature stores, ML pipelines). **What Success Looks Like in the First 9 Months** * Within 90 days: ramped up on the team's CI/CD platform, infrastructure, and observability stack across AWS, Azure, and on\-prem; owning at least one pipeline or service area independently. * Within 6 months: contributing measurable improvements to deployment frequency and change failure rate for owned pipelines; actively participating in the on\-call rotation and incident response. * Within 9 months: recognized as a go\-to contributor for at least one platform domain (CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, observability, or security); mentoring newer engineers and contributing to team standards. **Verra Mobility Values** An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values: * **Own It.**We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation. * **Do What's Right.**We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous. * **Choose Courage Over Comfort.** We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease. * **Win Together.** We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others. *With your explicit consent which you provided as part of the application process, we will retain candidate personal data solely for the business purpose for which it was collected. In no event will we retain such data more than two (2\) years following the closure of the recruitment process relating to the role for which you applied or in the event other related job opportunities arise within the company.* *Verra Mobility Applicant Privacy Notice* Verra Mobility is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. .

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Client Lifecycle
jobs.description: Virta Health is on a mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. Current treatment approaches aren’t working—over half of US adults have either type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, and obesity rates are at an all\-time high. Virta is changing this by helping people reverse their metabolic condition through innovations in technology, personalized nutrition, and virtual care delivery reinvented from the ground up. We have raised over $350 million from top\-tier investors, and partner with the largest health plans, employers, and government organizations to help their employees and members restore their health and take back their lives. Join us on our mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. As a Senior Software Engineer on ReCon (Revenue \& Contracts), you'll build the systems that turn care delivered into revenue recognized. ReCon owns Virta's quote\-to\-cash path end to end: how customer contracts and pricing are configured, how clinical events become billable episodes of care, how subscriptions and invoices are generated, how claims reach payors, and how we prove all of it reconciles across commercial, billing, and our clinical data. National health plans, PBMs, and large employers depend on the data we produce not just to pay us, but to bill their own clients — so correctness here is a customer\-facing product, not back\-office plumbing. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Lead projects end to end: take an ambiguous problem from a finance, RCM, or client\-facing stakeholder, shape it into a design, drive it through review, and own it in production. * Build and extend the Go services behind Virta's quote\-to\-cash path — contract and pricing configuration, billable event generation, subscription and invoice management, and claims submission. * Make billing correctness provable. Expand the assertion and reconciliation framework that catches discrepancies across Salesforce, Zuora, and our clinical data before they ever reach a customer invoice. * Improve the reconciliation and billing data our health plan and employer partners depend on — not just to pay us, but to bill their own clients. * Design self\-service tools so finance, RCM, and client operations can configure contracts, correct data, and run bulk changes without an engineer in the loop. * Apply AI where it earns its place. * Raise the bar around you through design and code review, and mentor engineers on the team. **90 Day Plan** =============== Within your first 90 days at Virta, we expect you will do the following: * First 30 days: Production PR merged and deployed; can whiteboard the money path unprompted; has independently found at least one thing that's wrong. * 60 days: A TDD survived architecture review; Stakeholders start to recognize you and work on building a future\-looking feature/project with you. * 90 days: Owns an ambiguous problem and proceeds towards completion with a product mindset; another engineer’s design got better because of your review. **Must\-Haves** =============== * 5\+ years building and operating backend services in production, in Go or another statically typed language * Experience with event\-driven architectures and the failure modes that come with them — eventual consistency, ordering, idempotency, and systems that disagree with each other * Strong SQL, and comfort working across both application code and the analytics layer * You've owned a system where correctness had consequences outside the company — billing, payments, claims, ledgers, or regulated reporting * A track record of working directly with non\-engineering stakeholders: turning a finance or operations problem into a design, and explaining the tradeoffs back * Experience with a major cloud platform (we use GCP) * Working with AI to accelerate development workflows and enhance the SDLC * Experience in frontend development with React and Typescript. **Values\-driven culture** ========================== Virta’s company values drive our culture, so you’ll do well if: * You put **people first** and take care of yourself, your peers, and our patients equally * You have a strong sense of **ownership** and take initiative while empowering others to do the same * You prioritize positive **impact** over busy work * You have **no ego** and understand that everyone has something to bring to the table regardless of experience * You appreciate **transparency** and promote trust and empowerment through open access of information * You are **evidence\-based** and prioritize data and science over seniority or dogma * You **take risks and rapidly iterate** Is this role not quite what you're looking for? Join our Talent Community and follow us on Linkedin to stay connected! *Virta has a location based compensation structure. Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications \& experience. For this role, the compensation range is 161,500 \- 232,500\. Information about Virta’s benefits is on our Careers page at:* *https://www.virtahealth.com/careers**.* *As part of your duties at Virta, you may come in contact with sensitive patient information that is governed by HIPAA. Throughout your career at Virta, you will be expected to follow Virta's security and privacy procedures to ensure our patients' information remains strictly confidential. Security and privacy training will be provided.* *As a remote\-first company, our team is spread across various locations with office hubs in Denver and San Francisco.* *Clinical roles:* *We currently* ***do not hire*** *in the following states: AK, HI, RI* *Corporate roles:* *We currently* ***do not hire*** *in the following states: AK, DE, HI, ME, MS, OK, SD, VT.* *Virta uses Ashby as its applicant tracking system, which incorporates AI\-powered tools (provided by OpenAI, AWS, and Google Gemini) in certain aspects of the recruiting process, including application review, candidate screening, and interview note taking; your data is not used to train AI models, and all final hiring decisions are made by Virta Health personnel.* **For more information, see Virta’s AI Interview Resources page.** **https://www.virtahealth.com/careers/ai\-interview\-resources**

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer – Data Acquisition
jobs.description: This is a remote position; however, the candidate must reside within 30 miles of one of the following locations: Portland, ME; Boston, MA; Chicago, IL; Dallas, TX; San Francisco Bay Area, CA; and Seattle/WA. ### **About the Role** The **Data Acquisition Team** is the entry point to WEX’s Data\-as\-a\-Service (DaaS) platform—responsible for ingesting, validating, and orchestrating raw data from dozens of internal systems and third\-party providers. As a **Staff Software Engineer**, you will own the technical direction and delivery of core data acquisition platform capabilities. You will remain hands\-on while leading architecture decisions, developing reusable ingestion services, and guiding engineers across teams. Your work will support batch, change data capture (CDC), and event\-driven ingestion, with clear expectations for data quality, reliability, security, and cost. WEX is undergoing a data platform transformation—and this team builds the foundation. Every pipeline you create contributes directly to powering analytics, automation, and product intelligence across all business domains. If you’re passionate about **scaling data platforms from the ground up**, this is your chance to help shape how WEX ingests and leverages its most valuable asset: data. ### **What You’ll Do** * Build and maintain **high\-performance data acquisition pipelines** that integrate with a variety of systems across WEX and third\-party vendors. * Lead the design and delivery of a modular ingestion platform with reusable connectors and configuration\-driven onboarding. Establish metadata and configuration patterns that reduce source\-specific development and support Data Acquisition as a Service. * Build schema validation, completeness checks, reconciliation, duplicate prevention, and audit logging into shared ingestion components. * Support safe retries, replay, backfills, and schema evolution so failures can be recovered without losing or incorrectly duplicating data. * Design batch, CDC, and streaming ingestion patterns that meet agreed freshness, throughput, and recovery requirements. Evaluate performance, source\-system impact, and operating cost when selecting and extending ingestion technologies. * Ensure **traceability, lineage, and security** through integration with control plane and governance systems. * Lead design and code reviews, maintain technical specifications and architectural decisions, and mentor engineers in reusable platform design. * Establish automated testing and CI/CD practices for ingestion code, connector configuration, and infrastructure, with validation before production deployment. * Partner with the established production support process on complex escalations, root\-cause analysis, and preventive engineering improvements. ### **What You Bring** **Required:** * **B.Sc. in Computer Science**, Engineering, or related technical field; M.Sc. a plus but not required. * **8\+ years** of software engineering experience, including delivery of production distributed systems or data platforms and demonstrated technical leadership across team boundaries. * Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Scala, or another systems\-focused language. * Experience with **data integration and ingestion pipelines**—you understand what it means to bring data in from source systems, transform it, and deliver it **reliably** downstream. * Solid grasp of **engineering fundamentals**, including version control, modular design, testing, and performance tuning. * Demonstrated experience designing and operating production integrations that handle **schema evolution**, **failure recovery**, **observability**, and **secure access**. * Ability to lead **architecture decisions**, explain **engineering tradeoffs**, resolve **dependencies** across teams, and guide implementation through **production adoption**. * Practical experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools for design, coding, testing, or documentation, with validation of generated outputs for correctness, security, and maintainability. * A collaborative mindset—comfortable working across domains, products, and infrastructure layers. * A strong sense of ownership and accountability—you care deeply about building systems that last. **Preferred:** * Experience building reusable connectors, metadata\-driven ingestion services, or configuration\-driven onboarding capabilities. ### **What Success Looks Like** During your first year, you will work with engineering and product leadership to establish baselines and agree on outcomes such as: * Reducing onboarding lead time and manual effort through shared connectors and configuration\-driven patterns. * Increasing adoption of reusable ingestion capabilities across sources and teams. * Meeting agreed completeness and freshness criteria, with reliable reconciliation and recovery. * Improving deployment quality and reducing recurring failures through automated testing and actionable observability. The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non\-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well\-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section. Pay Range: $140,600\.00 \- $173,100\.00

WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives. Our wearable technology collects rich physiological data, providing members with actionable insights into their recovery, training, and sleep. We are seeking a Senior Applied ML Algorithm Engineer to develop and deploy signal processing algorithms and machine learning models that transform raw sensor data into accurate, reliable, and real\-time physiological insights on WHOOP devices. In this hands\-on role, you will own algorithm development from data analysis, model training, and Python prototyping through efficient C/C\+\+ implementation, firmware integration, and production validation. Working closely with Data Science, Firmware, Hardware, and domain experts, you will deliver robust on\-device algorithms that improve the member experience while meeting the power, memory, compute, and latency constraints of wearable hardware. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** --------------------- * Design and develop algorithms that combine signal processing, feature extraction, and machine learning to derive meaningful physiological insights from wearable sensor data. * Analyze large\-scale, noisy sensor datasets to train and evaluate models, identify performance gaps, and improve accuracy, robustness, and generalization across diverse members and real\-world conditions. * Translate algorithm prototypes and trained models into production\-ready C/C\+\+ implementations, optimizing signal processing pipelines and on\-device inference for accuracy, power, memory, compute, and latency. * Partner closely with Firmware and Hardware teams to integrate algorithms into production firmware, validate execution on target hardware, and resolve differences between prototype and embedded performance. * Define performance metrics and rigorous validation plans, combining offline evaluation, lab\-based experiments, real\-world data analysis, and on\-device testing to assess algorithm accuracy, reliability, and efficiency. * Collaborate with Data Science, Software, Product, and domain experts to translate research findings into production\-ready capabilities, investigate post\-deployment performance gaps, and drive continuous algorithm improvement. **QUALIFICATIONS:** ------------------- * 5\+ years of experience developing signal processing and machine learning algorithms for time\-series or sensor data in real\-world applications. * MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong foundation in digital and statistical signal processing for noisy time\-series data. Experience with physiological signals or wearable sensors is a plus. * Proficiency in Python for data analysis, model development, and experimentation, and C/C\+\+ for implementing efficient algorithms in embedded firmware. * Experience developing, training, and evaluating machine learning models using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit\-learn. * Demonstrated experience deploying machine learning models to resource\-constrained embedded systems, including optimization across accuracy, power, memory, compute, and latency. * Ability to independently investigate complex algorithmic problems, design rigorous validation experiments, and communicate technical tradeoffs with firmware, hardware, and data science partners. * Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day\-to\-day tasks, ensuring AI\-assisted work aligns with the same high\-quality standards as personal contributions. This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office. Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply. WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E\-Verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Compensation Range: $150K \- $215K

jobs.title: Data Scientist (Staff - Senior Staff Levels)
jobs.description: **About the Opportunity** We're hiring various roles from Staff level to Senior Staff level Data Scientists. At Wonder Data Science, our mission is to build data science and machine learning systems that improve how our marketplace operates, how customers experience the platform, and how the business makes high\-quality decisions. You will identify high\-leverage opportunities across the business, including marketplace efficiency, customer experience, ETA accuracy, fulfillment reliability, pricing strategy, supply planning, demand forecasting, and operational performance. You will design statistically rigorous frameworks to understand causal impact, separate signal from noise, and guide business strategy through experimentation, measurement, and principled inference. You will help define how we structure trade\-offs like customer experience vs. operational efficiency, speed vs. cost, prediction accuracy vs. business impact, short\-term metric movement vs. long\-term marketplace health, and automation vs. human judgment. You’ll prototype, experiment, influence architecture, and ensure we operationalize models and insights that actually move business metrics — not just analyses that look good offline. **The Impact You Will Make** * Serve as a technical thought leader in Data Science — defining principles, frameworks, and best practices for how Wonder uses data, experimentation, and machine learning to improve customer, marketplace, and business outcomes. * Mentor and coach a growing team of Data Scientists and contribute to career development and technical excellence across the group. * Lead the exploration of interconnected marketplace systems, recognizing feedback loops between customer behavior, fulfillment reliability, ETA accuracy, pricing, supply planning, product experience, and business performance. * Develop causal inference and experimentation frameworks that help Wonder understand which product, operational, and marketplace changes truly drive business impact. * Partner with engineering to drive architecture decisions for shared data layers, feature pipelines, modeling APIs, experimentation infrastructure, and production ML services. * Define and implement robust experimentation strategies for changes that move business metrics in high\-noise environments. * Champion business\-impact\-driven data science, integrating causal inference, experimentation, risk\-aware modeling, and scalable production ML systems that learn and adapt. **What You Bring to the Table** * 6\-8\+ years of industry experience with MS or 6\+ years with PhD in Statistics, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. * Proven experience applying data science and machine learning to complex business problems, such as marketplace optimization, customer experience, forecasting, personalization, pricing, supply/demand balancing, operational policy changes, or product experimentation. * Deep expertise in causal inference, experimentation, and statistical modeling, including methods such as A/B testing, difference\-in\-differences, regression discontinuity, instrumental variables, synthetic controls, uplift modeling, or causal impact analysis. * Strong intuition for business and product trade\-offs — customer experience vs. efficiency, ETA confidence vs. conversion risk, fulfillment reliability vs. cost, marketplace growth vs. quality, and short\-term optimization vs. long\-term health. * Proficiency in Python, data analysis, visualization, and writing scalable, production\-ready code using object\-oriented design. * Demonstrated ability to take data science, ML, or causal inference systems into production, partnering with engineering on architecture, deployment, and monitoring best practices. * Fluency in SQL or similar tools for directly interrogating production\-scale datasets. * Experience mentoring and providing technical direction to other scientists, analysts, or engineers. **Got These? Even Better** -------------------------- * Experience leading end\-to\-end design of data science, machine learning, measurement, or experimentation frameworks within marketplace, consumer product, fulfillment, logistics, pricing, forecasting, or operations systems. * Experience designing causal measurement strategies for complex systems where product, marketplace, and operational decisions interact across multiple layers. * Background in causal inference, econometrics, Bayesian modeling, experimental design, or observational measurement in high\-noise environments. * Experience with applied experimentation frameworks, including A/B testing, power analysis, heterogeneous treatment effects, guardrail metrics, interference effects, and long\-term impact measurement. * Experience building or influencing production ML systems that combine predictive modeling, causal measurement, experimentation, and business rules * Influence across disciplines — able to align product, engineering, operations, business, and data science around a cohesive ML, experimentation, and measurement strategy. * Experience defining strategy and technical roadmaps for data science, machine learning, experimentation, or causal inference platforms. Staff Data Scientist New York: $208,500 \- $225,000 per year. Illinois: $187,500 \- $202,500 per year. Senior Staff Data Scientist New York: $240,000 \- $260,000 per year. Illinois: $216,000 \- $234,000 per year. Wonder uses geographic\-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience. **Benefits** The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non\-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands. Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here. **A Final Note** At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E\-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. **We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy**.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer (Senior - Senior Staff Level)
jobs.description: **About The Opportunity** We're hiring various roles from Senior level to Senior Staff level Machine Learning Engineers. You will own model architecture across several connected technical areas: search ranking, homepage and topic recommendations, retrieval, and query understanding. You will be accountable for how those pieces fit together, not only for any single model. You will set technical direction alongside other engineers, product managers, and platform partners. You will raise the bar on how the organization builds, evaluates, and operates models, and mentor the engineers around you through design reviews, code reviews, and direct feedback. We expect you to challenge technical decisions across teams when the engineering case is clear, and to bring evidence when you do. Our team practices end to end project ownership, and our work focuses heavily on personalized recommendation, retrieval, and classification from catalog content and clickstream. Deep neural networks, learned embeddings and approximate nearest neighbor retrieval, transfer learning from pre\-trained large scale models, calibration, classic regressions, fine tuning, and large language models all have a place in our daily lexicon. **The Impact You Will Make** * Own the architecture of our ranking and recommendation stack end to end: candidate retrieval, multi\-objective ranking, calibration, and the ensemble that trades conversion against profitability. Make the cross\-system design calls that no individual model owner can make alone. * Lead the evolution of our optimization objective from short\-term conversion toward long\-term diner value, including the offline evaluation and online experimentation work required to trust the result before it ships. * Bring state of the art research in information retrieval and recommender systems into our runtime environment: LLM\-driven query and intent understanding, embedding\-based retrieval, sequential user representations for cold start, and real\-time inference. jobs.title: Sr. Engineer - IT Data Analytics
jobs.description: **Job Description** Wynn Resorts is building an integrated system of data, analytics, and action to attract guests and scale the highly personalized service our top guests know us for, driving loyalty, visit frequency, and revenue through ever\-increasing levels of personalization. The Senior Data Engineer is a hands\-on senior engineer on the Customer Intelligence Platform (CIP) team, responsible for designing, building, and operating the cloud data pipelines and models that turn guest, gaming, and hospitality data into trusted, real\-time knowledge for the business. **Key Responsibilities** **Data Architecture \& Modeling** * Contribute engineering input on feasibility, performance, and cost in solution design sessions led by architects across Snowflake, Azure Databricks, and the Azure data platform. * Implement physical data models from approved logical designs (dimensional, medallion, and canonical patterns) , and deploy them as production schemas in Snowflake and Databricks. * Support evaluation of ingestion, integration, replication, and open table format (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake Horizon Catalogs) options through hands\-on proofs of concept and benchmarking. * Document implemented data flows, technical specifications, and data contracts that downstream teams can build against. **Data Ingestion \& Pipeline Engineering** * Define, design, and implement reusable batch and streaming ingestion patterns using Databricks, Airflow, Kafka, and Snowflake. * Deliver real\-time and near\-real\-time data to the business, so guest and operational data is available at the right time and place. * Integrate core hospitality and gaming source systems, including property management, player tracking, CRM, and marketing platforms. * Build pipelines as code with CI/CD, automated testing, and environment promotion across development, test, staging, and production. * Maintain and support ingestion tooling in production, owning monitoring, alerting, incident response, and cost and performance tuning. **Data Quality, Governance \& Security** * Implement data quality controls defined by governance standards, including profiling, cleansing, validation rules, and automated checks embedded in every pipeline. * Build lineage, reconciliation, and observability into pipelines to maintain data integrity from source to consumption. * Implement governance standards in the platform, including catalog registration, access control, and classification (e.g., Databricks Unity Catalog, Snowflake RBAC). * Implement PII protection controls, including masking, least\-privilege access, and audit logging, to meet privacy and gaming regulatory requirements. **AI\-Enabled Engineering \& Innovation** * Build the data foundations for predictive ML, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI agent use cases, including feature pipelines and retrieval\-ready datasets. * Apply automation, including RPA and AI agents, to streamline data operations and analytics delivery. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate pipeline development, testing, and documentation, while maintaining code quality, security, and review standards. **Technical Leadership \& Mentorship** * Guide and mentor data engineers through code reviews, pairing, and design feedback. * Set and champion engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the team. * Translate business requirements from Marketing, Gaming, Hotel, and Analytics stakeholders into technical designs and delivery plans. **Qualifications** **Required** * At least six (6\) years of data engineering experience, including at least 3 cloud data analytics projects delivered end to end * Production experience building and operating data pipelines on Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks * Advanced SQL: complex transformations, window functions, and performance tuning on large datasets * Advanced Python for data engineering, including PySpark \& Snowpark, automated testing, and reusable, packaged code * Hands\-on experience implementing data models (dimensional and medallion) in a cloud warehouse or lakehouse * CI/CD and Git\-based workflows for data pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps) * Regular hands\-on use of AI coding assistants in production engineering work, with sound practices for reviewing, testing, and securing AI\-generated code **Preferred** * Experience in the casino resort, hospitality, or luxury industries, including guest identity resolution or customer data unification * Orchestration and streaming experience with Airflow and Kafka * Erwin or comparable modeling tools, plus infrastructure as code (Terraform) * Governance tooling such as Databricks Unity Catalog or Microsoft Purview * MLOps, feature stores, vector search, or LLM and AI agent data pipelines * Certifications in Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Azure **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. **About the role** ------------------ Oura is rebuilding how it builds software. Every engineer has agentic tooling, and our own pipeline already takes a well\-formed ticket to a reviewed, tested commit stack. It runs interactively, headless, and on a cloud sandbox fleet, with its own evals and tracing. We are looking for engineers who use AI as a fundamental building block of both the products we ship and the way we build them. That is a strong start on one stage of the lifecycle. The next step is the whole loop. As a Staff Engineer on the AI Transformation team, you will architect and own the system that turns agentic development from something power users do into the way hundreds of engineers across iOS, Android, backend and AI services ship every day. That means spec and intake, planning, implementation, review, testing, CI/CD, release, observability and incident follow\-up, each with agents doing real work and humans keeping judgment where it matters. This is a fast\-moving, LLM\-forward team. We prioritize rapid prototyping, iterative loops and AI\-native development, with the speed of a startup and the reach of a product used by millions of members. You can work remotely from anywhere in Europe, or hybrid from our offices in Helsinki, Oulu or Tampere. You will build the pipeline, measure it, and make it trustworthy enough that teams choose it. Success is measured in validated changes reaching members faster and safer: time to a trustworthy signal, escaped defects, cost per merged change, and how many squads run on the paved path because it is better, not because they were told to. **What you will do** -------------------- You don't need to do all of these on day one, but these are the kinds of problems you'll own: * **Set the technical direction for the agentic pipeline:** Make our existing ticket\-to\-PR pipeline dependable infrastructure. Own its architecture, including agent orchestration, context management and tool calling, and improve its reliability, throughput, cost and developer experience across mobile, backend and web repositories. Run it unattended where the risk allows. * **Close the loop across the SDLC:** Extend agentic workflows beyond code generation into spec quality checks, test generation, automated review, CI failure triage and repair, release verification, and post\-deploy signals, so the system improves from what happens after merge. * **Prototype fast, then harden:** Get a new workflow running in days, prove it on real tickets with real squads, and turn what holds up into production infrastructure. * **Run AI in production properly:** Agents in production take more than an API call. Own the eval sets, LLM\-as\-a\-judge grading, versioning, tracing and dashboards that tell us whether a workflow change made things better, including the hardest case: a change that passes CI and is still wrong. Track the numbers that matter (merge rate, rework, time\-to\-signal, cost per change, escaped defects) and make them visible to engineers and leadership. * **Make autonomy safe:** Design sandboxing, permissions, human checkpoints and guardrails proportional to risk, with privacy by design as the default. Health data, security and infrastructure changes get stronger controls; low\-risk, easily verified work runs hands\-off. * **Lead AI\-native engineering by example:** Set the bar for AI\-augmented engineering across the organization. Show in your own work what a pipeline\-first engineer ships, and raise the craft of the engineers around you. * **Drive adoption with the teams:** Embed with squads and their AI DRIs, find where the pipeline breaks on real work, fix the system rather than the single output, and turn what works into paved paths, skills, templates and docs other engineers can extend. * **Partner cross\-functionally:** Work with platform, developer productivity, security and privacy, AI infrastructure, mobile and backend squads, product and design, and engineering leadership to make trade\-offs explicit and keep everyone moving on one system instead of five parallel ones. **Requirements** ---------------- We'd love to hear from you if you are: * **An experienced builder:** 6\+ years building and operating production systems that other engineers depend on, including developer tooling, internal platforms, or AI infrastructure ineers, managers and non\-engineering partners. **Nice to Haves** ----------------- You don't need all of these, but they're nice signals of fit: * Experience with coding agents at depth: skills, MCP servers, hooks, sub\-agent orchestration, headless runs. * Built evaluation harnesses or benchmarks for coding agents, or LLM\-as\-judge grading tied to build and test outcomes. * Experience with sandboxed execution at scale: ephemeral dev environments, VM or container fleets, macOS build infrastructure. * Background in developer productivity measurement (DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4\) and in turning metrics into decisions without turning them into targets. * Shipped to mobile apps or other environments with slow, expensive feedback loops. * Experience in digital health, wearables, MedTech, or other privacy\-sensitive or regulated products. * Contributions to open\-source AI projects, or a portfolio of projects built on the latest agent capabilities. * Mentored engineers or led an engineering community of practice. ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: * Competitive salary and equity packages * Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources * An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends \& family * 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off * Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Region 1 $198,050 \- $233,000 Region 2 $180,200 \- $212,000 Region 3 $169,150 \- $199,000 A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location. We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers! We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note: * Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards. * We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront. * Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email. Stay cautious and protect your personal details. To all recruitment agencies: Oura does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Oura employees, or any other organization's location. Oura is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Suno** ============== We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). **About the Role** ================== Suno's song creation agent is becoming something other teams build on. As a Senior AI Platform Engineer, you'll build the APIs, SDKs and shared tooling, including eval infrastructure, tracing and model routing, that let engineers across Suno ship agent features faster. You'll work closely with the agent team, partner teams and Infra, and your customers are other engineers, so adoption is a measure of success. You'll help shape the platform as it grows. **Listen to the song we made about it:** **https://suno.com/s/bxgQXsn06Vz3KKEn** **What You'll Do** ================== * Design and build the platform APIs and SDKs that other teams use to build agent features. * Develop shared eval infrastructure, including the eval runner, results storage and dashboards, and help the team decide what to build and what to buy. * Implement end\-to\-end tracing and observability, so any request can be followed across services from prompt to audio. * Manage model provider routing, fallback, rate limits and cost controls. * Partner with engineering teams across Suno to onboard them onto the platform with docs and hands\-on support, and with Infra on the reliability and scale of the agent runtime. * Help more people turn ideas into music by making it faster and safer for teams across Suno to ship agent features. **What You'll Need** ==================== **Must\-Haves** --------------- * 4–6 years building and scaling backend or platform systems in production, in any language. * Experience on a team that supports other developer teams, including building a platform, API or SDK that other teams adopted. * Experience with production LLM or agent systems, for external or internal users. * Depth in distributed systems and observability, including tracing across services. * Comfort working with internal customers: scoping with partner teams, earning adoption and handling ambiguity. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Experience building an eval or tracing product. * Experience running LLM gateway or model routing infrastructure. * Experience writing SDKs that other teams use. * Experience with Python backends. **Work Location Policy** ======================== This role is expected to work from the designated Suno SF office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full\-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience. Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/bxgQXsn06Vz3KKEn **Additional Notes** ==================== Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. **Perks \& Benefits for Full\-Time Employees** ============================================== * Company Equity Package * 401(k) with 3% Employer Match \& Roth 401(k) * Medical, Dental, \& Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA \& FSA options) * 11 Paid Holidays \+ Unlimited PTO \& Sick Time * 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave * Creative Education Stipend * Generous Commuter Allowance * In\-Office Lunch (5 days per week) **Compensation** ================ * $228K\- $363K Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Compensation Range: $228K \- $363K

jobs.title: Senior AI Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **About Within** Tldr on us: **Series B, $91M raised, 7x growth** last year. Digital Transformation gave rise to a $600B consulting Industry. AI Transformation will be 10x bigger and will be delivered through agents. We built that. Our AI discovers how work actually happens across every team and application, Structures it into a living Context Graph, and Improves it continuously. ServiceNow mapped 900\+ processes in 9 days. DoorDash captured 3,800\+ finance operations in 14 weeks. That's not a project. That's compounding intelligence. OpenAI, Google, DoorDash, and Stripe use Within to transform how they transform. We shipped GPT\-4 document chat within 12 hours of OpenAI's API launch. We move fast, reward agency, and care deeply about our customers, our team, and our mission. **The Role** ------------ We're hiring Senior Backend \+ Applied AI Engineers to build the core systems that power Within's multimodal agents in real enterprise environments. This is a hands\-on engineering role at the intersection of distributed systems and applied AI: you'll design and ship backend services that ingest messy real\-world data, orchestrate model/agent workflows, enforce enterprise\-grade security and deliver reliable outcomes at scale. You'll work closely with product, design, and other engineers to turn ambitious AI capabilities into production\-grade features that Fortune 500 enterprises can depend on. We care deeply about engineering fundamentals (correctness, observability, security, performance) and equally about iteration speed \- because in this space, only the teams who ship quality products \& features at incredible velocity win. You'll set technical direction for critical subsystems and mentor engineers earlier in their careers \- raising the bar for the entire team. **Note**: We do not require a CS or Engineering degree. We care about your ability to ship, your systems thinking, and evidence of strong execution \- whether through production work, open\-source contributions, research, or high\-quality side projects. **Who You Are** --------------- * **Backend engineer with sharp product judgment** \- You design and build services, APIs, data models, and infrastructure that are reliable, observable, secure, and fast. You can explain architectural tradeoffs as fluently as you can debate the right abstraction boundary. You optimize for outcomes \- developer velocity, latency, correctness, uptime \- and not just for elegance in the abstract. You've been the person teams turn to when a design review needs a tiebreaker. * **Systems thinker with uncommon foresight** \- You see around corners. While solving today's stated requirements, you anticipate how services will need to evolve \- functionally and non\-functionally. You design for the future but build for the present, and you never let architectural dogma slow the team down. You've designed at least one system from scratch that other engineers now build on top of and is used in production at scale. You establish patterns and conventions that become team defaults. * **Applied AI builder who ships to production** \- You're energized by LLMs, multimodal agents, orchestration protocols, and the messy work of making the entire AI stack reliable. You think instinctively in terms of evals, model regression tests, traceability, and exception handling. You've shipped multiple AI\-powered features to production and have hard\-won opinions about orchestration patterns, eval frameworks, and failure modes at scale. * **AI\-native developer across the entire SDLC** \- You wield tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Copilot as extensions of your craft. You are extremely confident to run concurrent agents doing your chores reliably. You use AI to generate technical designs, scaffold APIs, draft schemas, write tests, and build migration plans. You've built custom workflows and internal tooling around AI\-assisted development that others on your team have adopted. * **Ship with velocity and craft** \- You find the shortest path to get features into users' hands while obsessing over the details that create trust. You balance the tradeoff between taking shortcuts, and just enough tech debt to pay off in the next sprint or two. You believe speed and quality aren't opposites \- they happen together when you're thoughtful about how you build. You've developed a reliable intuition for when to cut scope versus when to invest, and you help the team make those calls with confidence. * **Bring energy that elevates the entire team** \- You see gnarly distributed systems challenges as puzzles waiting to be solved. Your optimism, intensity, and passion for craft are contagious. You make everyone around you faster and more ambitious. You also frequently cross\-pollinate learnings by seeking and sharing them with the team. You create leverage by unblocking others \- through code reviews, architecture guidance, and clear technical writing that becomes team documentation. * **Experience:** 4\+ years designing and shipping production\-grade products **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build the backbone of Within's AI platform** \- Design, experiment, build, test, and deploy the backend services that power everything our users use. You'll own critical infrastructure end\-to\-end: from data ingestion and storage to API design, background processing, and deployment architecture. You'll make foundational decisions on technology choices, data models, and service boundaries that shape the platform's trajectory. * **Turn AI pipelines into bulletproof workflows** \- Implement AI orchestration pipelines that hold up under real\-world variability. You'll work with structured outputs, tool calling, state management, grounding, and other guardrails to ensure agents behave reliably at scale. Build comprehensive evals and regression tests so the team ships model changes with confidence. You'll define the orchestration patterns and evaluation frameworks the team standardizes on. * **Design for the future, ship for today** \- Balance long\-term architectural vision with relentless shipping cadence. You'll make pragmatic decisions that keep the codebase healthy and the product moving forward \- knowing exactly when to take on deliberate tech debt and when to invest in foundations. You'll own the technical roadmap for your area and make the calls on when the team pays down debt versus pushes forward. * **Build for enterprise security and scale** \- Design least\-privilege access, strong tenant isolation, auditability, and secure data handling. You treat trust and safety as core engineering requirements, not afterthoughts. You'll define security and isolation patterns for new product surfaces and be accountable for the trust posture of your systems. You also design and build systems that scale gracefully as a feature grows from 0 1 10 100\. * **Multiply your impact across disciplines** \- You speak backend, AI, product, and infrastructure fluently. Partner with frontend and design to shape how AI capabilities surface to users, and turn ambiguous product ideas into concrete technical plans that drive better decisions across the team. You'll be a key voice in cross\-functional planning, shaping what we build as much as how we build it. **About our Benefits** ---------------------- * **Equity** in addition to competitive cash compensation * **100% Employer\-Paid Medical, Dental \& Vision options!** * Paid Parental Leave * $500 Annual Learning Fund * $150 Monthly Wellness Fund * 401k via Betterment * Relocation support to San Francisco Bay Area (where applicable) * Office\-related Perks: + **BART or Caltrain to the office?**: Contribute pre\-tax funds to a Parking \& Transit account, and you will never be taxed for it! + **Lunchtime, Leveled Up**: Enjoy curated local eats delivered to the office daily to enjoy with the team over an engaging conversation + **Snack Central**: Drinks and snacks for every craving \- from healthy bites to Within team favorites. + **Safe \& Secure Bike Room**: Commute in and safely store your bike. *Within is an equal opportunity employer. Within provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status.* Compensation Range: $220K \- $280K
